tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 1 bya mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod

tei:div.tei:p: bya::ba 'gu/ //shā chi/hā sbya mu:/(sbya 085305 000ji 'ang 5055'acu 7 bci kho migaX 507 khor
gu mgrin khron zla ba'i rtogs brjod/bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang /
py-i na sprin sdi+on spro bu'i rtogs da|da/pong ljongs mi dmangs dpa skran khang

dpe hūṃ ska nga sha bcom —/ nga tshos rtogs/ brjod 'di dpa skrun byas pa'i nga/ri rang/ yu'/ ni spyir na bod kyi gan3 rabs/ rig rtsom gyi rjes shul rtsa chen rna ris/ nyam pa sor chud kyis bod kyi rig sanang mu mthud nas dar rgyas gong 'phel yong ba bya rgyu dang yang sgos sngon byon 7 khas pa rnams kyis brtsams pa'i snyan zhing sho bde ba'i rjod byed tshig gi 'phreng ba bcad lhug zung 'brel gyi rnam pas mtshar du dngar bar byas pa'i khyad chos sogs rig rtsom la sbyang brtson che ba'i blo gsar kun gyis mkhyen gzigs thub nas deng dus kyi nang don ldan pa'i bcad lhug gang rung gi rtsom yig phul byung mang po gsar du thon pa'i ched du yin pas de don rgya che'i klog pa po rnams nas dgongs 'jags kyis blang dor gnad la mi 'phyug pa mdzad gal che

/na mo gu ru ma/ skre a tā re sgyu/ /byang chub kyi sems mnga' ba'i bya mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa 'khor ba mtha' dag la snying po med par mthong ba rnams kyi rna rgyan zhes bya ba blun rmongs kyis go bde bar gtso bor byas te brjod pa/ rgyal ba kun las lhag pa'i bka' drin can/ /mkhyen dang brtse ba'i thabs mkhas nyin byed kyis/ /nyams chung bdag blo'i chu skyes skyong mdzad pa/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /gdong bzhi rdo rje 'dzin dang mgrin sngon sogs/ /cher rlom rnams kyis rang rang cod pan gyis/ /gang gi zhabs la phyag byas lha yi bla/ /shākya'i gtso bo de la spyi pos 'dud/ rdo rje 'chang dang rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter/ /dri med rje dang ji pa ka ra sogs/ /kun 'dus rgyal ba'i yab gcig tshong kha pa/ /sras dang bcas la snying nas gus pas 'dud/ /gur gum rdul mang brtsegs pa'i lhun por nyin byed 'bum gyis 'khyud lta'i sku/ //zhi

lhag drug cu'i dbyangs dang ldan pas mtha' yas 'gre ba'i re skong ba/sung / /shes bya ma lus kun nas gzigs shing ster brtse'i snying stobs dpag dka'i thugs/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba bskyod pa'i yab gcig zur phud lnga pas bdag skyongs shig /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje gcig bsdus pa/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba kun gyi ma gcig pu/ /rab dkar gangs ri'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /sprul par bcas la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro kun myur du sgrol mdzad btsom ldan ma/ /blo gros spobs pa mchog rtsol ngag dbang lha/ rgyal ba'i yum mchog lhag pa'i lha mo zung / /bdag snying pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur rtag tu rol/ /gang zhig 'khor ba'i gnas la skyo ba rnams/ /skyo shas nges 'byung 'phel bar bya ba sogs/ /dgos pa ldan phyir /// /bye 'khyams skabs las/ /mgrin sngon zla bar skyes pa'i rtoṭa de yang rgya gar 'phags yul/ bskal pa bzang po'i rnam 'dren dam pas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i gnas drang srong lhung ba'i ri'i nye 'dabs grong khyer chen po drug gi nang tshan wa ra ṇa si na/bdag cag gi ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan nas ha cang ring por ma ron pa'i skabs shig tu rgyal po lhas byin zhes bya ba blug byung ste/ de la bu gcig btsas pa la/ yab kyi ming nas gras pa'ilha lha snang stobs ldan du btags shing / skye bo dmangs dag rigs

ldan rgyal po zhes 'bod pa gzhon nu'i dus nas dkon mchog gsum la dad pa/ gzugs mdzes shing blo gsal ba zhig yod do/ de'i tshe rgya gar nub phyogs dza lan dzha ra na/ rgya po chen po ma zho ka zhes longs spyod dang mnga' nga shin tu rgya che zhing 'phags pa dang skye bo'i dge 'dun stong phrag du ma la bsnyen bkur byed pa/ khyad par du yang dge slong dri ma med pa'i dpal zhes/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' mas kyi sprul pa zhig yang yang pho brang du 'byon zhing chos ston pa/ gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo ri la sogs pa'i yi dam mang pos byin gyis rlob pa zhig yod pa de la dus nam zhig gi tshe bu mo zhig btsas te/btsas ma thag ut+pal sngon ngo'i char babs shing bu mo de'i khur tshos g.yon par ut+pala'i ri mo dang / rna bar ral gri'i rnam pa gsal zhing / lus las kyang ut+pala'i dri bro ba byung ngo / de'i tshe bla ma dri med dpal ldan de nyid byon te/ 'di ni spo mo sgrol ma'i sprul pa'o/zhes lung bstan zhing / dbang bskur/ byin brlabs/ ming ma ti mahā ni zhes btags so/ bu mo de yang skye bo phal pa'i spyod pa thams cad dang ma 'dres pa/ dad pa dang snying rje dang / gtong phod che ba/ gzugs mdzes shing spyod lam khyad par du 'phags pas skye rgu thams cad kyi yid du 'ong ba zhig yo da pa la/ dus re zhig rgyal po chen po 'ga' zhig gis slong ba na/ yab dang ming pos ster bar brtsams pa'i tshe/ yab dang ming po la gsol pa/ lha mchog sdub

zas bdag la dgongs/ /khyim ni nyes pa kun gyi gnas/ /gdug can sprul gyi tshang dang mtshungs/ /de yi bde bas tshems pa yang /sbrul nadug gdengs kha'i grib bsil 'dra/ /de bas bdag la brtser dgongs na/ /bdag ni nges par 'byung bar 'dod/ ces zhus pas/ yab kyis/ bu mo khyim gyi nyes pa ni/ /khyod kyis mthong ltar gnas mod kyi/ /'on kyang dgon pa bsnyen par dka'/ /zas gos kyi nas 'tsho bar dka'/ 'dod pa'i bde ba spong bar dka'/ gal te tshul khrims nyams gyur na /bzod dka'i ngan 'gror nges par lhung / /de phyir khe nyen gnyis ka che/ de bas 'byor ldan rgyal po yi/ khab tu bde bar 'gro ba legs/ zhes gsungs pas/ yang gsol pa/ yab kyis kho mo mer bsregs kyang / /gnod pa mdzad pa ma lags te/ /gtan nas thar bar mi rung ba'i/ /khyim gyi mer bsregs de lta min/ zhes zhus pas/ yab kyis/ 'o na rab tu 'byung 'dod na/ /dri med bla ma'i spyan mnga' na/ /tshul khrims nor gyis rgyud gtams te/ /bag yod dgon pa bsten par rigs/zhes gnang ba byin no/ de'i tshe bla ma dri med dpal ldan spyan drangs nas rab tu 'byung bar zhus pas/ bka' bstsal pa/ e ma khyod kyis legs mthong ltar/ /khyim ni 'ching ba kun ldan yin/ /nyon mongs can la me dang 'dra/ /gal te thabs mkhas rgyal sras ma/ga /nyon mongs dbang du ma song na/ da ni khyim du gnas

gyur kyang / /'dam las skyes pa'i pablo bzhin/ /'gro phan 'gyur kyang de dor nas/ /bdag nyid kho nar phan sems pa/ de ni dman pa'i spyod pa ste/ /brtan pa dam pa'i mi mthun phyogs/ /bu mo khyod ni thabs mkhas kyi/ /dbus 'gyur phyogs su myur du song / /'gro rdon rgya cher 'byung bar 'gyur/ zhes lung bstan te gshegs so/ der yab ma sho ka yang mahā bo dhi sogs mjal ba dang bu mo skal ba dang ldan pa'i rgyal po'i chung mar sbyin pa'i slad du 'khor khri phrag du ma dang bcas te yul dbus su chas pa'i tshe/ yul yo ḍi khri sha tshun chad kyi rgyal po mang pos bu mo de'i snyan pa thos te slong ba'i phyir rdo rje gdan du 'ongs so/ de'i tshe rgyal po ma zho ka bu mo dang bcas pas mahā bo snyesogs la mchod pa dang bkur sti bgyis zin nas/ bu mo slong mkhan gyi rgyal po mang bas/ 'ga' zhig la byin na 'ga' zhig khro bar mthong nas/ chos rgyal ma zhos de dag la smras pa/ kye bdag la bu mo mang po ma mchis te gcig nyid do/ de'i phyir khyed rnams su zhig la ster la su zhig la mi ster/ de bas na nang par rgyan gyis brgyan la dus gcig la zhog cig dang bu mo nyid kyis me tog gi 'phreng ba gang la 'phangs pa des dbang ba yin no zhes smras so/ nang par de rnams 'ong ba'i tshe/ bu mo la spas pa/ kye bu mo khyod 'dod pa'i rgyal po mang bas bdag gis gcig la byin na gcig khro bar 'gyur gyi/ khyod nyid kyis me tog gi 'phreng ba 'di grogs kyi skal ba gang la yod pa 6de

la phongs shig ces me tog gi 'phreng ba gtad pa'i tshe/ rgyal po de rnams las yul yo ḍi bra sha'i rgyal po dang snya dha'i rgyal po gnyis stobs 'byor che bas de gnyis thog mar byung ba la ma 'phangs de bzhin du rgyal po mang po 'ong ba'i tha ma na rgyal po lha snang stobs ldan ras dkar gyi gos gyon zhing blon po nyung zad kyis bskor nas byung ba la'aphangs so/ de'i tshe ji5ba kyis bu mo la/ kye bu mo khyod ni shin tu thun te/ stobs 'byor mnga' thang rang cag dang mnyam pa'i o ḍi 'i sha'i rgyal po sogs la me tog gi 'phreng ba mi 'phen par/ wa ra ṇa mi'i rgyalapo longs spyod chung ngu can de la 'phangs pa ci snyam du sems/ zhes gsungs pas/ bu mo na re/ kye ma yab rje bdagal gson/ /rab ni chos kyis phyug pa ste/ /'bring ni dpal dang lang tshos phyug /tha ma nor gyi phyug pa lags/ /mchog ni blo gros nor dang ldan/ /'bring ni dad pa'i nor dang ldan/ /tha ma zang zing nor dang ldan/ /de phyir rgyal bu de nyid la/ /mchog dang 'bring gi yon tan mnga'/ /yon tan tha ma med kyang sla/ /de slad me tog 'phreng ba 'phangs/ zhes smras so/ de nas bu mo la yab kyis ba ba bya dang rdzong ba legs par gnang ste wa ra ṇa mir btang /yab nyid wa ra ṇa sir spyan drangs kyang ma gshegs par nub phyogs su log go/ ma ti mahā ni wa ra ṇa sir phebs te btsun mo dam par mang ga la pas de nyid wa ra ṇa sir slebs pa nas bzung ste/ rgyal po'i

changa' thang sngar las ches zhin tu rgyas par gyur te/ rgyal po dang btsun mo dam pa de gnyis ka dad pa dang gtong phod dang / ngo tsha khril yod sogs ya rabs kyi yon tan ma tshang ba med pas phyung cing / skye su thams cad kyi rigs ldan rgyal po yab yum gis bsngags pa'i yul dam paragyur pa/ 'bangs rnams kyang phal mo che de gnyis kyi yon tan gyi rje su 'gro ba 'ba' zhiyi byung ngo / gzhan yang btsun mo nges legs dang / nges mdzangs la sogs pa'i btsun mo du ma dang / chos blon blo gros rab bzang dang / stong dpon chen po yam she la sogs pa /dun na 'don mang po dang bram ze skar ma 'od dang / snu sto sos bram ze mang po dang bcas pa yod do/ de ltar chos dang 'bya ra pas rab tu phyug kyang bu ma byung bas 'dod pa'i lha la bu 'byung bar gsong/ ba 'debs pa'i skabs shig tu/ yul sto phyogs kyi rgyal po bzang po sbyin pa de nyid/ zhing du mar sangs rgyas dang mjal zhing chos thos pa'i mthar po ṭa lar gshegs bas 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang mjal te/ 'phags pa'i zhal nas/ rigs kyi bu yul wa ra ṇa sir rgyal po ku man ra dza zhes bya ba dkon mchog gsu ma 'a shen tu dad cing / dam pa'i chos :ba bas dus 'da' ba la/ bu med pas sems khong du chud par gyur na/ khyod kyis de'i bur smon lam thob la skye ba zungs shig 'gro ba'i don 'grub par 'gyur ro gsungs so/ yang jo mo sgrol ma'i zhal nas/ leg/ so

bu khyod kyi 'phags pa ri bka' bzhin du sgrub la song zhig bdag kyang gnas der rgyal pa de'i btsun mi'i tshu du gnas pa'i ma ti mahā ni zhes bya pe/ de'i lhums su zhugs sheg dang / de ji srid gnas byi bar du khyod la bdud kyi bsku bas mi tshugs so/ de nas yul byang phyogs kyi rgyal po nam gru skyes khyod kyi blon po dang / lha 'phreng ma btsun mor skyes te bar du gcod cing bslu bar byed do/'on kyang khyod ni lus gang du gnas kyang sdug bsngar gyi skabs mi 'byung ngo thes gsungs so/ des kyang 'phags pa yab yum gyi bka'abazhin bsgrub par dam bcas te/ zhabs spyi bor blangs shing smon lam btab nas wa ra ṇa sis 'phos te/ btsun mo dam pa ma ti ma ni'i lhums su zhusas so/ yab yum gyi rtogs pa brjod pa mdor bsdus pa dang / 'phos shing lhums su zhugs pa'i skabs te dang po'o/ /de nas zla ba ngo bcu gsos nas sras mtshan dang ldan pa/pags pa ku muta ltar dkar ba/ dbral ba'i dbyes che zhing /bzhin gyi mdangs gsal ba zhig bltams pas de ma thag bram ze dmi 'od ces rnga tshan lta la mkhas pa zhig yod pa de bos te bstan par/bram zes legs par brtags nas thal mo sbyar te/ gis brjod mang po'i mjug hūṃ/ mes po kun mkhyen mig bsum pa/ /lha rnams kun gyis 'di bsngags 'os/ /mtshan ltas grangs med mthong gyur kyang / /de /nga ya cha tshan lhag par che/ /sras 'di rgyal po khyed kyi lha/

/dkon mchog gsum des stsal bar nges/ /ming ni lhas sbyin yab lha snang / /de'i sras mtshan ni lhas bstsal zhes/ /lo ni dgu bcu'i bar du 'tsho/ /'on kyang 'di la bar chad che/ /gal te bdud kyis longs bskyod na/ /myur du lus 'di gzhan du 'gyur/ zhes zer ro/yab ku lān rā dza dgyes te/ bram ze la smras pa/ /dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin po che/ /nga yi gtsug rgyan dkon mchog gsum/ /bu yang mgon po de yis bstsal//de ring kho bo bsam pa grub/ /'di skyes dga' bas khyab pas na//'di ming chos kyi dga' ba ste/ /'bangs kyi mgon du nges par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs/ yum gyi zhal nas/ 'jig rten mas kyang ster nus pas/ /nor dang bu dang tshe dpal tsam/ /'grub la ya mtshan ci zhig che/ /gtan bde'i go 'phang mchog stsol ba/ /'phags pa dkon mchog rnam gsum ste/ /'on kyang 'bras kyi phung po yi/ /zhar la sog ma 'grub pa ltar/ /bu yang lha de'i mthu las byung / /dge la 'dun zhing dkon mchog 'bangs/ /de phyir lhas bstsal dge 'dun 'bangs//'di yi ming du bdag gis sbyin/ zhes gsungs te pang du blangs pas rgyal po yab yum gyi dad pa dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje la bram ze yid ches so/ de nas btsun mo nges legs sogs ma ma la gtad de/ mngar gsum gyi zas byin shing skyed srings pas gzhan las skyed che zhing / dkon mchog gi rten mthong ba'i tshe gus pa/ /ma

'gyur du ma byed pa/ skye bo thams cad la bzhin gyi mdangs 'dzum mer ston cing dus nam yang mi ngu ba /bag med pa'i byis pa'i spyod lam mtha' dag dang bral ba zhig byung ngo / sras de ma bsams pa'i lo lnga'i gong du blon po yam she la bu gzugs mdzes shing mtshan ltas ngan pa zhig skyes pa la ming du la gā ma na btags so/ de nas sa kyis gsung dang por 'di skad smras te/ oṃ ma ṇi padra / po ta la yi rtse mo nas/ /mgon med 'gro la rtag tu gzigs/ /dkon mchog rin chen kun gyi dngos/ /'phags pa spyan ras ga ga la 'dud/ ces gsungs pas/ yum dgyes te lus kyi sdong po ches yang / /smra ba'i 'dab ma rgyas pa khyod/ dris pa'i gtam lan drang por spros/ /khyodardzon gnas ni gang nas 'ong / /lha ni gang yin gang gi rigs/ zhes dris pas yum la thal mo sbyar te gus pas smras pa/ sngon tshe drang por sbos pa las/ /mngon mtho'i rten bzang yang yang thob/ /dam pa'i chos kyang lan mang thos/ /deng yang gnas lugs drang por gsol//skye ba 'di yi gong nyid du/ /lha phyogs grong khyer chen po na/ /rgyal rigs bzang po sbyin par 'bod/ /de gong shar phyogs za hor du//bdag ming chos kyi dad par grags/ /lha ni dkon mchog rin chen gsum/ /de la dad pa'i rigs su skyes/ zhes bas pas/ yum shin tu dgyes so rgyal bu de la sngon nas rgyal ba dang rigs mnyam par gra/sdu pa'i gtso bo'i rigs las chos blon dbyar tshul zhes bya ba'i bu/

mig thum zhing mche ba'i myu gu dang skra dmar ser can skad kyi nga ro 'tsher ba byed bzhin dmar la skug rtsi chags pa/ yid du 'ong zhing spyod pa ngo mtshar bas na sprul pa min par grags pa'i blon po gzhon nulo bco brgyad lon pa ye shes 'dzin zhes bya ba zhig yod pa de la rgyal bu shin tu mnyes pas de dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing lhan cig tu gnas/cung zad kyang 'bral mi phod cing / de yang yum dang rgyal bu la zhin tu gus pas gzhon nu rgyab tu khur ba sogs kyi bsnyen bkur byed pa la/ yab ku zhan rā dza'i mdun na 'don yam she bya ba de mi khyim stong phrag gi gtso bo rgyal po'i chung grogs 'khor dang nye du phun sum tshogs pa/ stobs dang 'byor pa longs spyod che zhing / dbang che ba rgyal po gnyis pa lta bu zhig yin pas kho'i bsam pa la/ nga yang rgyal dro/ ku pan rā dza gzhon nu'i dus kyi chung grogs dang blon po gnyis ka bgyis pas/ nar son pa na thugs la 'dogs shing dbang che ba 'di byung / dbadag gi bu la zhwa a na 'di yang da lta nas gzhon nu'i chung grogs dngablon po byed du ma bcug na dbyar tshul gyi bu 'di la rgyal bu shin tu mnyes pas/ gzhon nu nar son tshe/ nga'i bu la dbang mi yong snyam nas/ rgyal po ku gan ra dza'i drung du song ste gus pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas pas phyag btsal ba dang / rgyal po stong dpon la zhin tu mnyes pa yin pas/ spre/ stong dpon chen po thongs pa legs so/ don ci'i slad du 'ong / gsungs pas/ kho na re/ bdag lha la phyag 1sdud

du 'ong zhing / don yang cung zad mchis so/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/don ci zhig mchis smos shig kho na re/ lhas dam pa stsol zhig lha'i sras gcig bu chos kyi dga' ba 'di ni mtshan ltas dang spyod lam rnamasazhin tu ngo mtshar ba/ yab kyi rgyal srid nges par 'dzin pa'i rigs shig lags na/ 'di'i chung grogs kyi blon po gzhon nu zhig nges par dgos par mthong ste/ dbyar tshul gyi bu 'di ni srin po lta bur bzhin dang skra dmar zhing mche ba dang ldan pa'i mtshan ltas ngan la/ na tshod kyang rgyal bu las ches cher rgan par snang bas/ de bas na bdag kyang lha nyid gzhon nu'i dus nas blon po bgyis pa de bzhin du bdag gi bu 'di ni kho bo las blo gros bzang ba smra mkhas pa/ gzugs mdzes pa/ sgyu rtsal la byang pas da lta nas nges par gzhon nu'i blon por mnga' gsol bar 'tshal le snyam mo/ zhes zhus pas/ rgyal pos smras pa/ ka ye stong dpon chen po khyed kyi bu de ni/ de 'dra ba'i yon tan khyod nyid las lhag par yod pa legs so/ bdag gi gzhon nu yang kho bo las yon tan du ma zhig gis lhag cing / lha dkon mchog gsum gyis bstsal ba yin pas/ de'i phyir blon por mnga' gsol ba yang shin tu gzabs te dgos na/ btsun mo dam pa la yang cung zad 'ji bar bya'o/ zhes gsungs pas/ stong dpon gyi bsam par btsun mo la dris na/ btsun mo bdag la mi dga' bas nger par bgegs bye/ ṭ+wāṃ snya nas bas pa/ lha cung zad gsan du gsol/ 'jig rten

rna skyes bu bud med kyi dbang du sa/nga ba de ni/ 'in tu tha 'a ba/smad pa'i gan su byed pa lags so/ sngon rgya pa po'i bya ba ma thar dag mdun gros la dbang ba'i blon po rnams dang kha na cig tu baspru+o/ bar mdzad na/ deng ni don chung ngu de lta bu yang btsun mo la bka' bstsal ba rigs sam/ khyad kyi yab mes rnams kyis kyang de ltar mdzad pa ma thos la 'jig rten na ngo tsha ba'i gnas kyang yin sgo zhus pas/ rgyal po yang skyengs pa lta bu dang / stong dpon dbang che bas ngo ma bzlogs par/ stong dpon chen po bden no/ da rgyu skar bzang podag la babs pa'i che sras kyi blon por mnga' gsol bar bya'o zhes gsung chad zhor ro/ der stong dpon phyir thon pa dang / yum gyis mkhyen nas rgyal po'i drung du byon pas/ yum sngar bzhin gyi mdangs zla ba lta ku ston te 'dzum gyis bsu ba la/ da res zhin tu gnag ste dran pa 'thor ba lta bur mdzad pas/ slob na re/ lha mo bdag gi khab tu mchis nas deng gi bar bzhin gnag pa cung zad kyang ma mthong na/ deng ci'i phyir bzhin gnag gsungs pas yum gyis/ lha khyed bdas la gson mdzod dang / /zla ba che pa'i ska bas snyed du/ /glo bur gza' yis bzung bar thos/ /gal te zla ba med gyur tshe/ /kumu ta rme nga 'dzum mi ston/ zhes gsungs/ yang ya ba kyis/ ci'i phyir zla ba gzas bzung bar thos/ rgyal po gzhan gyi dmag yong bar thosasam/ khyod rang gi yab dang ming po sogs mi bde ba thos sa /13

gzhon nu la snyun gyis thebs sam/ 'on te ma dga' ba ci byung smos shig gsungs pas lan du/ deng sang rje rgyal zla ba gsal/ /'bang kyi rgyu skar rnam par bkra/ /glo bur dgra yang 'jug mi 'gyur/ /thagaring yul gyi pha rol na/ /yab dang ming po bde bar bzhugs/ /gzhonanu'ang deng dus bde bar mchis/ zhes gsungs/ yang yab kyis/'o na ci'i phyir bzhin gnag ces nan gyis dris pas lan du/ lha khyod blo gros nor gyis dbul/ /grogs ngan gdug can sgrol dang mtshungs//gang dang nye ba dug gis zin/ /'khor ngan don gyi dgra bo yin//myur du yongs su rgol bar byed/ /de slad gzhon nur snying brtse bas//bdag yid mya ngan skyed par gyur/ ces smras pas/ rgyal pos gsan nas/ 'dis zer ba bden srid kyang / stong dpon dbang che zhing kha chad shor nas bya thabs med cing 'jam pos smras na 'di'i ngo mi zlog go snyam nas/ mgo gug lan gsum mdzad de/ ngas go/ bud med ngan mas ci yang smri/ klad med kyi gtam la su zhig nyan/ nga'i yab mes dam pa nas/ deng gi bar du bud med la mdun gros dri pa cung zad kyang med do/ kye kho bo'i rgyal srid kyi bya ba bud mid kyis shes sam/ 'os pa'i bya ba sgrub pa la bgegs ma byed par sdod cing / ces tshig rlom pa can bas pas/ yum gyis/ 'o na lha khyod ji ltar dgyes par mdzod/ /nga ni mi ring myur du tshe dus byed/ /gyis na sdu mtshan khyod kyis mthong 'gyur te/ /de'i tshe rgyal po 'gyod pa ma

mdzod cig ces smras te stan la bzhugs so/ de nas slar yang yum sras kya gam du gshegs nas smras pas/ sras yab kyi drung du song ste/tram̐ lha bdag ni blon po mi 'chal lo/ gal te ci nas kyang dgos na'ang me shes 'dzin 'di nyid stsol du gsol zhes zhus pas/ rgyal pos nges ji ra bud med des 'di la bslabs par nges ri+o snyam nas/ ) gzhon nu khyod kyi chung grogs ni stong da / — na po'i bu la ga a na yin no/zhis smras / yang sras kyis/ kye ma la gā ji na ni mtshan ltas ngan nga ra graṭa shing / na tshod kyang ha cang phra bas mi 'os pa zhig ma lags sam/ yab na re/ gzhon nu/ ma ti mahā ni yang de ltar zer kyang /nge ni bud med rna sa kyi rang bzhin yin no/ 'os ri rim mi 'os pa ni kho bos shes mod/ de bas na ngag las 'da' zhig gsungs te ma nyan no/ de bzhin du btsun mo nges legs zhes bya ba yum ge snying skan tu nye ba zhig yod pa des rgyal po la gsol pas kyang sngar bzhen bsungs te ma gsan no/ der nges legs kyis dharma dang / dharmi bya ba ro chan pas tshod thub cing lta ba dang bsam nga bzang la rings btsun pa/ yum sras la shin tu gus pa gnyis yod pa de gnyis dang yezhes nga ge te 'i/sngu cha la/ yum nyes lung bstan pa sor zhib tu ba nya/da pas/ de dag 'tshogs te gros byas pa/ ye shes 'dzin na re/ /ma ma ti rnga hā ni zo mo sgro la ma'i sprul par grags/ zhing / sngon chad kya nga bdab/ gi thos pa la ji ltar lung bstan pa rnams de kho na ltar gyur1 5

pas/ der yiring lung bstan pa 'di/ de bzhin du 'gyur bar the tshom med do des na rgyal po la btsun mo rnam sa kyis gsol ba la ni bud med kyi ngag ces brnyas par mdzad do zhes zer bas/ des na bdag cag gis lha la gsol bar rigs te/ gal te stong dpon ni dngungadang rtsa 'dzing mang zhing / stobs dang skyu rtsal bzang bas rgyal sdural rgol du doṭa te sdo yang stong dpon gyi ngo bsrungs ba yin na ni rang cag rnams thabs kyis stong dpon med par bya'o/ zhes smras pa nga /dharma ta na re/ kye bzhin bzang / khyod ni blo gros gsal kyang na tshod gzhon pa'i skyon te/ gal te bya ba chen po dag gnam snag kye thog babs pa lta bu zhig dgos pas bdag cag rnams shi'am gson kyang rung gi/ yum sras thugs rje can dang / wa ra ṇa si ba'i skye bo 'di dag rnams kye ched du yin pas na/ nges par da lta nyid du stong dpon bsad de/ thabs kyis lha la zhu ba bgyid do zhes zer ro/dharmi na re/ grogs dag dharma zhin tu ma rung zhing ye shes skudzan yang cung zad ma rung pa ste/ tshode bzhin gshegs pas mkhan po'am/ pha ma'aca / mdza' bo'im/ rgyal po'i ched du ji nga sdig pa'i las mi byaste/ rnam par smin pa rang nyid kho nas myong bar gsungs pa ma dranan / gal te kho bo ni yang dag pa'i lta ba cung zad thos shing sem pa yin pas/ don de'i phyir bya ba de la mi 'jug go/ de bas na thabasdu / kyis rgyal po la zhu bar bya'o zer te ma 'cham/ der yang yang

gleng nas/ ye shes 'dzin gyis blo bton pa ltar 'cham ste/ rgyal po 'i drung du zhu bar 'gro ba/ stong dpon gyis nyan rna mkhan btang bas spros te/ stong dpon yang khong rnams kyi pyi bzhin du rgyal po'i pho brang du song bas stong dpon dang chos blon gsum lhan cig tu 'dzomarnga nas/zhu ba'i skabs ma rnyed par phyir thon no/ der stong dpon gyis rgyal po la gsol pa/ lha blon po 'di dag don ci zhig gi slad du lha'i drungadu 'ongs/ rgyal po na re/ stong dpon chen po/ blon po gsu3 kho bo la phyag byed du 'ongs so/ kho ma mgu ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis bzhin sgyur zhing / lha mkhyen par mdzod cig 'di dag deng stong dpon dang lhan cig ma 'dzoms na phyag byed du nye ba byung song ngo / rgyal po / khyod ci'i slad du de skad smra/ kho na re/ lha blon po 'di rna sa glo bur du lhags pa la don zhig btsal lam/ rgyal po na re/ kho bos ca/ zhe te/ khyod nyid la dri'o/ stong dpon na re/ /ko bori gsol kyang lhas bden par ma 'dzin no/ rgyal po na re/ ci khyod kyis smras pa bden par ma bzung ba'i lan grangs gzhan 'ga' yang yod dam/ kho na re/ma — ching/ kyang deng bden par mi 'dzin no/ rgyal pos/ rtab/ tu tshad mar byas na deng tshad mar mi byeng pa ci zhig sbos dang bden par 'dzin no/ kho na re/ kye ma de lta na lhas dgongs shig blon po 'di dgani/ ngo tsha dang khrel yod dang bral ba/ shin tu g.yo can zhig ste/ rtag 4 pha ma las kyang drin che ba'ilha'i sku srog la yang sngo 1byer

sems so/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ blon po de dag ni las 'bras yongs su shes pa bsam pa bzang po'i rang bzhin can du grags na ci zhig bden nam/ khyod kyis mngon sum du mjal lam/ kho na re/ da lta nyid du gsol ba yang dgongs shig kho bo la bden par mi'adzin no zhes ma gsol tam/ mngon sum du mthong zhing thos so/ rgyal po na re/dus gang gi tshe/ tshul ji ltar thos smos shig kho na re/ dus zhag gsum nas deng gi bar dharmi'i khyem du 'di dag gros byed pa bdag gi nyan rna bgyis pa las thos te/ rgyal po 'di dang / gzhon nu 'di dang / yam she nye ba dang bcas pa brlags te/ dharma tas rgyal po/d+dha na dha ras nang blon dharmi tis phyi blon bya zhes zer ba thos pas da nang khong rnams kyis lha'i sku la gnod par byas su dogs te bdag kyang phyi bzhin du 'ongs pa lags so/ rgyal po na re/ kyi stong dpon/'o na 'di dag la ci zhig bgyi/ kho na re/ lhas bdag la gsan na blon po'i tshul ma yin pa'i nyes can 'di das gson po nyid du mer bsregs par rigs so/ zhes zhus pas/ rgyal pos/ stong dpon khyod kyis mngon sum du mthong zhing thos na de nyid kho na tshad ma yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang rgyal po rnams kyi tshul yin pas cung zad brtag dbyad bya'o smras so/ rgyal po'i bya ba dpyad dka' ba mtha' dag bram ze mngon shes mkhan po rdzun mi smra ba/ pu dz+nya zhes bya ba zhig yod pa de la 'dri ba // pas/ stong dpon gyis kyang / nges par rgyal pos 'di ltar

gsungs pa ni pu tsā la 'dri ngar 'dod pa yin sgo snyam nas/ pu tsā'i khyim du myur du song ste/ rgyalapos khyod la 'don 'di 'dri bar gyur na/bdag bden no zhes spros shig dang bya dga' ster ro/ gal te de ltar mabyas na khyod mkhar dang bcas pa gtan nas brlags par byed do zhes smras so/ der rgyal pos bram ze bos te dris pas kho rdzun spangs pas ci smra snyam nas the tshom du gyur pa dang / glo bur du bdud kyi cho 'phrul gyis yid bsgyur te blon pos bslabs pa ltar zhus so/ de nas rgyal ngo sa mdun gros la dbang ba'i blon po rnams blon chen gsum gyis ma tshor bar mtshan mo zhig 'tshogs te bgros pas/ chos blon blo gros rab bzang sogs kyis/ blon po de dag ni bsam pa dang lta ba gnyis ka bzang ngo zhes deng phan chad wa ra ṇa si 'dir grags la/ khyad par gzhon nu ye shes 'dzin ni skyes tsam nas srog chags grog 'bu tsam la yang bsam bzhin du 'tshe ba byed do/ zhes bdag cag gis ma thos pas/ da dung lhas brtag dpyad mdzad rigs so zhes smras kyang / de'i nang nas yam she'i zhang por gyur pa bu kā la bya ba dang / la ga dmar dang / de wa bha dra rasmi dang / pa ṇi ta ra na ga bya ba rnams shin tu dbang che zhing blon po gsum la yid mi dga' ba yin pas/ de dag na re/ stong dpon chen pos gsungs pa shin tu 'thad de/ nyes pa can 'di rnams gsod par rigs so zhes mgrin gcig tu gleng nga sa/ de'i tshe rgyal po'i zhal nas/ kho bos rgyal srid ni 'tshe ba spangs pa nyid1 sdus

dzin pa dang bde ba 'grub pa yin na/ 'di dag bsad par mi rung gi/gnas nas bskrad par bya'o zhes bka' bstsal pas/ thams cad nge 'a nyan te bskrad par kha 'cham mo/ nang par khrims kyi rnga brdungs shing dung bus par skye bo mang po'i khrom 'tshog pa'i tshe/ glo bur du chos blon gsum bzung ste/ lus gcer bu byas/ yan lag rnams thag pas bsnams mgul du thag pa btags shing mis khrid de pho brang du skor ba'i tshe/ pho brang gi mdun du skye bo'i khrom gyi dbus su rgyal blon rnams drag po'i chas kyis spras nas bzhugs pa'i drung du/ ye shes/ 'dzin gyis 'jigs pa med par/ cung zad bsdad de bas pa/ kye ma sa bdag rigs ldan rje/ /khyod khrims gser gyi gnya' shing ltar/ /bdag cag rnams kyi phrag par snyi/ /nam yang 'gal ba ma bgyi med/ /nyes pa med par chad pas gcod/ /dam pa'i rgyal po'i lugs ma lags/zhes smras pa dang / yam shes ral gri shubs nas phyung ste sdig par brtsams te nyes pa bsgrags pa/ kye ho/ wa ra ṇa si'i skye bo rnams ltos shig nyon cig skye bo ngan pa bsams pa gdug pa can rnams kyi rang bzhin ni 'di lta ste/ gang bsod nams kyi dpung gis skye rgu du ma la dbang bsgyur ba byams pa'i stobs kyis rgyal srid chos bzhin du skyong ba/ 'bangs rnams la ma gcig bu gcig la brtse ba ltar brtse ba'i rgyal po chen po lha snang rigs ldan zhes bya ba ngo mtshar can 'di lta bu la /sdum bzhin du gnod par byed par sems pa'i skye bo ngan pa 'di

dag mthong ba'i chos la 'ji lta ba'i khrims kyis mthar te yul nas bskrad pa la stos la/ deng phyin chad bag yod par byos shig ces drag spya sgrog pa'i tshe/ ye r+shas 'dzin gyi bsam par stong dpon gyi byed luṭa kyi/ nged cag gi mdun gros bgyis pa de 'dis tshor te rgyal po la phra ma bcug pa gdon mi za'o snyam nas smras pa/ kye ma rje blon 'bangasabacas gson /bzang po bzang por rig pa dka'/ /ngan pa ngan par shes pa dkon/ /bzang ngan bya ba ma shes pas/ /rje yi thugs kyang 'bangs kyis bsgyur/ /nyes pa med par khrims kyis mnar/ /bdag cag gson rnams shi yang sla/ /phyi nas wa ra ṇa si 'dir sdug bsngal mun pa 'thib pa'i tshe/ /'gyod pa'i smre sngags ma 'tshal zhig ces da dung mang du smra bar brtsams pas stong dpon gyis bshan pa la bde byas te khrid nas pho brang du bskor bas/ yum sras btsun mo nges legs dang bcas pa byang phyogs kyi pho brang du bzhugs yod pa'i tshe khrims rnga sogs kyi sgra dang zi ber mang du byung ba dang gzigs pas chos blon gsum khrims kyis mnar ba de gzigs nas myur bar byang sgo nas byon te/ smras pa/ kye hud/ blon chen khyed rnams ci phyir 'di lta bu'i khrims kyis mnar/ nyes pa ci zhig bgyis zhes dris pas/ de rnams na re bdag cag rnams kyis rgyal po'i khrims las 'das pa'i nyes pa ni cung zad tsam byas pa yang mi dran no/ 'on kyang lha'i sras gzhon nu chos kyi dga' ba'i nang blon gtso bo chen po ya/1

she'i bus bgyis na/ gzhon nu'i sku srog la bar chad byed par 'gyur ro zhes yum gyis gsungs pa thos pas bdag cag gis gros shig bgros pa stong dpon gyis tshor te rgyal po la phra ma bcug gam snyam ste/ 'on kyang 'gyod pa ma mchis so zhes smras pa dang / sras na re/ khyed rnams 'dir sdod cig bdag gis yab la zhu ba zhig bgyid do zhes gsungs te gshegs par brtsam pa'i tshe/ ye shes 'dzin gyis gsol ba/ lha'i sras de ltar ma mdzad par bdag gis gsol ba 'di cung zad gsan gsol/ kye ma rgyal ba'i sras po snying stobs can/ /lang tsho'i zla tshes gzhon nu ches phra yang / /blo gros dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /gzhon nu'i gzugs can rgyal bu dam pa dang / /rgyal ba'i yum mchog gyur kyang tha mal 'gro/ /yongs su 'dul slad dman pa'i skur bstan te/ bslu med lam bzang ston pa'i sku drin can/ /yum sras deng 'dir bdag la cung zad gson/ /bdag cag snying nas gus pa'i blon po gsum/ /bsam pa rnyed nas deng la thug gi bar/ /rgyal khrims lci ba mig 'bras lta bur bsrungs/ /byas pa bzang ba'i lag rjes ma mchis kyang / bsam pa bzang ba nam yang ma btang ste /rgyal po yab sras spyi bo'i thod ltar bkur /rang mnyam blon po phu nu bzhin du 'grogs /skyong 'os 'bangs rnams bu phrug bzhin du bskyangs/ /nyes par spyad pa nam yang mi dran mod/ /'on kyang de ri~X / bur khrims kyis mnar/ /thag ring yul du bskrad par bka'

bstsal te/ /rje yi thugs rgyud 'bangs kyis bsgyur bar nges/ /nyes par spyod min dkon mchog lha yis gzigs/ /de yi phyir na 'gyod pa ma 'tshal lags/ /'phags ma thugs rje'i mnga' bdag khyed nyid la/ /dus gsum gsal bar gzigs pa'i ye shes mnga'/ /de slad 'di skad bstan pa bdag gis thos/ yum nyid myur du mya ngan 'da' mdzad de/ /sras la bdud kyis bar chad rtsom gyur nas/ /gnas 'dir sdug bsngal dpag med 'byung zhes thos/ /gal te de 'dra'i snang tshul mthong ba las/ /sa mthar 'gro ba shin tu spro lags te/ /dam pa'i bshes gnyen bsten te byang chub bsgrub/ /yum sras gnyis kyi drin lan chos kyis 'a skyil/ /gal te yum sras ma bzhugs gshegs gyur na/ /stong dpon shi'am 'on te gson kyang rung / /sems kyi gus pa'i thag pa bcad gyur pas/ /da ni yab rje'i blon po byed re skan/ /de bas 'di phyir dge ba'i bslab bya stsol/ zhes dang / dharma ta dang / dharmi gnyis kyis kyang ye shes 'dzin gyi ji ltar gsol ba lhar/ nged cag bsam pa bzang po'i blon po gsum/ /'di nas byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /yum sras thugs rje can gyis skyob tu gsol/ zhes zhus shing /yum gyis kyang sras la/ gzhon nu blon po gsum gyis zer ba ltar bden te/ deng zhu ba byed pa'i skabs ma yin no gsungs pas sras gar+sha/gas 'phro bshol lo/ de nas yum gyis blon po rnams la bka' bstsal ba/ /kye ma dad pa'i sa gzhi bzang po la/ /dam pa'i /sdun

dang myur du ci phrad pa dang / /gtan gyi 'dun ma 'grub par nye 'gyur bas/ /gnas nas bskrad la 'gyod pa ci zhig mchis/ /sprodag ni bud med skyon gyi rangabaden te/ /ci byas las su mi 'gro'i steng du rgol/ /legs par gsol kyang lha yis gsan ma gyur/ /nga la 'chi dz+wa gas rtsi/ ltas bdun byung bas/ /mi gnas myur du tshe yi dus byed cing / /gzhon nu bdud kyis bar chad rtsom gyur te/ tshe srog 'dor ram yang na gnas nas 'pho/ /yab rje 'bangs bcas mya ngan du khas gzir/ /de 'dra'i gnas skabs myur du myong bar 'gyur/ /'on kyang las dang smon lam dbang btsan zhing / /bcos su dka' bas lha la nyes pa med//wa ra ṇa mi'i 'gro la drin che ba'i/ /mi dbang rgyal por gus pa ma zlog cig /rtag tu bslab bya yang yang bgyid pa'i phyir/ /deng 'dir mang du smra ba mi 'tshal lo/ /'on kyang tshe 'di'i gleng slong mtha' ma yin/ /yid la gyis shig skal ldan snying gi bu/ /bslu ba med pa'i dkon mchog rin chen gsum/ /gtsug gi rgyan gyi mchog tu 'dzin 'tshal te/ /phal pa'i gtsug rgyan yun lon rnying gyur kyang / /gtsug rgyan dam pa de la rnying du med/ /phal gyi rin chen tshoms pos rephrog pa ltar/ dam pa'i rin chen 'di la 'phrog tu med/ /kye ma de ring mthong ba'i chos nyid du/ gcer bur nor rdzas legs tshogs kun bral kyang / /dam pa'i skyabs 'di 'phral du med la stos/ /de phyir 'dod rgu'i 'byung gnaḥ/ 'di yod bzhin/ /phal gyi nor bu 'tshol ba shin tu blun/ /de

yang yid bzhin nor bu rin chen de/ byi dor byas te rgyal mtshan rtsir btags nga sa /dgos 'dod ma lus char du babs pa ltar/ bdag rgyud ngan pa'i dri ma kun sbyangs te/ /'bras bu dkon mchog rnam gsum thob la 'bad/ /de yi phyir du ston dang bden gnyis chos/ /'phags mchog rnams la snying nas skyabs gsol te/ /lam bzang ston pa'i bshes gnyen 'tshol zhing rtogs/ /rnyed nas sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bskyed/ /lus srog yongs su btang ste bka' bzhin sgrubs/ /spangs rtogs ma lus rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang / /ji ltar zla ba tshes nas nya yi bar/ /dkar cha rim gyis 'phel ba ji bzhin du/ /spangs rtogs phra mo gang du 'phel las byung / /de slad mi dge bcu la sogs pa yi/ /nyes pas nam yang ma 'gos rab tu sgrims/ /rnam dkar chung ngu nas kyang 'bad de spel /mi dge'i grogs spangs dge ba'i grogs dang 'grogs/ /dal 'byor rten bzang phyis nas rnyed dka' bas/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma'i rtsa ba tshugs sam ldog /gnas skabs 'di la ngag las shes gyis la / /tshe 'di'i bya ba thongs la brtson 'grus rtsoms/ /de nas khyod 'gro lhami'i tshe dus byed/ /slar yang gnyis kyis wa ra ṇa sir 'byung / /ye shes 'dzin ni tshe rabs thams cad du/ /kho mos 'bral ba med pa rjes su 'dzin/ /ma 'ong gangs ri'i khrod du'ang bdag dang 'phrad/ /blon po gzhan gnyis skye ba gsum gyi 'og /'phags pa lo gi shā ri'i drung du 'gro/ /lkog gyur gnas //sa

bdag blo'i spyod / pa du/ /byed spro da /'a ga5nga skyabs pyi mthu nyed las//ji ltar smras 'di 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ /dkon mchog rin chen dpang du legang/ gsol te/ /bdag gis dge ba'i smon lam 'di ltar 'debs//rang cag deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /phan tshun chos la spyod pa'i grogs gyur te/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dam pa'i chos 'dzin cing / /rgyal sras spyod pa bla med mthar phyin shog /gnas skabs dge ba'i smon lam 'di btab ste/ /khyed rnams thag ring yul du 'gro ba'i tshe/ /'jiṭapa brgyad sogs mi mthun kun zhi t+ta / /dam pa'i mgon dang myur du 'phrad gyur cing / ces smon lam mdzad do/ de nas sras chung ngu lo lnga lon pa des kyang yum la thar mo sbyar nas/ de'i thog tu cung zad mnyam par bzhag ste/ slar blon po rnams la smras pa/ bslu ba med pa'i skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum/ /bdag gi chos blon rnams kyi mgon skyabs mdzod/ /ca/khyen dang thugs rje'i mnga' bdag 'phags ma yis/ /zab rgyas gdams pa ji ltar bstsal nyid las/ /skyes thob blo dman sbyangs pa'i shes rab bral/ /rmongs pa bdag gis gsol du med mod kyi/ /'on kyang 'phags ma'i rjes su bzlos pa tsam/ /lhag bsam dag pas smra la cung zad gson/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor rin chen thob dus 'dir/ /don chen gtan gyi 'dun ma ma bsgrubs na /tshe ni glog sprin lta bur myur du g.yo /phyis nas dam pa'i rten bzang 'thob pa/ /ka'/ /ka ye gal te bdag la phan 'dod na/ /'bras bu gang

dag rgyu yi rjes 'gro phyir/ /sdig spongs dge sgrub blang rdor legs dpyad de/ /sdug bsngal 'gro ngan skye rgyun gcad par 'tshal/ /srid pa'i rtse nas mnar med bar kun du/ /dam pa'i bde ba nam yang yod min pas/ /yid brtan mi rung 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la /rmi lam du yang yid smon bzlog par mdzod/ /bdag nyid gces 'dzin sdug bsngal kun gyi sgo/ /gzhan la gces 'dzin phan dang bde ba'i gzhi/ /de phyir bdag gzhan brje ba'i bsam bzang gis/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i mgon du 'gyur bar mdzod/ ces smras pas ye shes 'dzin shin tu ngo mtshar te/ sras kyi thung/sa gar dbu gtug cing smras pa/ /ji ltar seng ge'i phru gu chung gyur kyang / /khengs ldan gcan gzan tshogs rnams zil gnon bzhin/ /khyed ni na tshod zla ba gsar pa ltar/ /phra yang mkhyen rab cha shas yongs su rdzogs/ /e ma ngo mtshar che'o lha yi sras/ /bka' drin bdud rtsi'i bcud ni snying la bcangs/ /nged cag sa mthar 'khyams pa'i tshe na yang / /khyed kyi brtse pa 'i lcags kyus mi gtong bar/ /'di phyir dge ba'i smon lam mdzad du gsol/ zhes zhus pas/ yang phyag gnyis kyis ye shes 'dzin gyi mgul nas 'khyud cing thugs kha dang / dpral ba la gtugs te smon lam btab pa/ /bla ma yi dam chos srung tshogs dang bcas/ bdag la skyob cing srung ba'i skyabs gan kun/ de ring thugs rje'i rma thu dngu/nga cher bskyed la/ /bdag gi smon pa'i dpang po mdzad du gsol/ /nga yi lha/nga

dang 'dra ba'i ye shes 'dzin/ /yan lag lta bus dhacho/ dharmi gnyi / /de ring thag reng yul du bskrad pa ni/ /bdag cha snying bton yan /ga bcad dang mtshungs/ /ston mchog thugs rje can la rdzun mi mnga'/ /las kyi rnam par smin pas mi bslu ste/ /bdag cag lhag bsam dag pa'i mthu stobs dang / /dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs la brten nas/ /myur du snying dang yan 'a/ga sor chud de/ /skye ba gzhan du snying dang yan lag ni/ /khyed cag blon po gsum gyis byed par zhog /bdag cag byang chub snying po ma thob par/ /phan tshun dge ba'i grogs su gyur ba dang / /nam zhig su yis bdud rtsi dzon thob pa/ de yi bdud rtsi bgo bsha' bgyid par shog /sangs dus ma thob tshe rabs kun tu yang / /gzhon nu nyid nas dam pa'i mgon gyis zin/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang 'phrad cing dad gyur te/ /thos bsam bsgoms pas bdag rgyud 'dul ba la/ /lhod pa med par rtag tu sbyong bar shog /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don la mngon phyog/sa tshe/ /bdag nyid kho na bde bar re ba'i blo/ /skad cig tsam yang bskyed pa spong byed pa'i/ dam pa'i tshul khrims nyams pa med par shog ces smon lam btab bo/slar yang yum gyis bka' bstsal ba/ lha yi blar gyur ston mchog dam pa dang / /zhi ba chags bral chos dang tshogs bcas la/ /snying nas skyabs mchis deng 'dir bdag cag la/ /thugs rje'i spyan ras gaX /ra mdzad du gsol/ /rje la gus sheng 'bangs la byams pa

can/ /mkhas 6 'i gnas la ma rmongs ba ma pa bzang / /chos kyi blon chen dam pa ye shes 'dzin/ /dharmi dharma bcas pa cung zad nyon/ /leṭa tshogs yon tan ma lus kun gyi rten/ /lam dang lam min ji bzhin lta ba'i mig /log pa'i g.yang sa srung ba'i yongs 'dzin mchog /dul zhing rnam par g.yengs spangs gnas lugs mkhyen/ /smra mkhas snying brtser ldan pa brtag cing btsal/ /rnyed nas bka' bzhin bsgrubs pas mnyes byas nas/ /rgya cher thos dang tshul bzhin bsam pa yis/ /ji ltar blang bya'i don la sgro 'dogs bcad/ /mtha' gnyis bral ba'i lam bzang rnyed pa'i tshe/ /snang shas gdon gyi 'ching ba rgyang bskyur te//bsam gtan 'phel dang rjes su mthun spro 'i sar/ le lo spangs nas rtse gcig bsgrub par mdzod/ /ji ltar skam dang 'grogs pa'i sa gzhi la/ /myu gu skyed nus ldan yang mi skye la/ /chu tshung rkyen dang 'grogs na myur bskyed ltar/ /dang po'i 'a/sa can rnams kyi yon tan yang / grogs la shas cher stos gsungs de yi phyir/ /deng dang ngo tsha khrel yod gos dang bral/ rtag tu ngag gi mi dge'i las bzhir spyod/ /g.yo sgyu ser sna phra dog rab sdang zhing / /gang dang 'grogs na bag med ngang gis 'phel/ /de 'dra'i grogs dag nam ya nga mi sten te /bdag gi dge ba'i lo tog nges par 'joms/ /de dag rnams las bzlog pa'i yon tan ldan/ /lta skyongs skyabs mthun byas par rab tu gzi/ /gang zhig bsten pas bgoskasgod shug kyis 'phel/ /de /sbya

grogs btsal rtag tu 'grogs par bya/ /yid bzhin nor las cher cher rnyed dka' zhing / /chu lhur lta bur shin tu 'jigs sla ba'i/ /yon tan ci 'dod bsgrubs rung rten rnyed tshe/ /chu shing lta bu'i tshe 'khri'i bya ba la/ /ma chags blo sna myur bstad byang chub sgrubs/ /mi dge'i las lam yongs su ma bsrungs na/ /nges par log pa lta ci mngon mtho yang / /med par shes te sgo gsum srung gyis la/ /rtag tu rnam dkar dge la brtson par mdzod/ /gang dag tshe 'di'i dgra tsam gzhom la yang / /dpa' bor smra na thog med nas brgyud pa'i /nyon mongs dgra dang 'thab de shin tu dpa'/ /de phyir dgra 'di gtan nas brlag par mdzod/ /tshangs dang brgya byin 'khor los bsgyur thob kyang / /'du byad sdug bsngal 'ching ba ma grol na/ /yid brtan skad cig tsam yang mi rung ba'i/ /'khor ba'i gnas las myur du sgrol la 'bad/ /bdag gi pha ma'am phu nu mdza' bshes su/ /ma gyur rgyal ba'i spyan gyis ma gzigs pas/ /de phyir 'gro ba 'di dag thams cad kyang / /bdag la drin gyis bskyangs pa sha stag ste/ bde bas phongs shing sdug bsngal bye bas ruri nar/ /shes rab mig 'grib dam pa'i long khrid bral/ /de lta'i mgon med de rnams ya la bor na/ /bangag las khrel bor gzhan med rigs kyis la/ /rtag tu 'gro ba sgrol ba'i khur 'khyer ba'i//bla med byang chub se mas mchog bskyed par gyis/ /bdag dang sems can3 /zugs sogs chos rnams kun/ /kun rdzob blo yis btags pa

'ba' zhig las/ /don dam nam mkha'i pad+mo lta bu ste/ /tha mal byis rnams shin tu skrag 'gyur pa'i/ /gnas lugs zab mo'i tshul 'di btsal bya zhing / /tha snyad rten 'brel bslu med sgyu ma dang / /rmi lam ji bzhin de bzhin 'dir shes gyis/ de lta'i blo mchog dam pa 'di gnyis dang / /ldan pas dge ba'i rtsa ba gang bgyis pa/ /bsod nams nam mkha'i khams ltar pha mtha' yas/ /rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa zhes bya gsungs/ de slad rang gis ji ltar khas blangs pa'i /bcas dang rang bzhin nyes pa rab bsdom zhing /rab byams dge ba'i tshogs kun 'bad pas spel/ rtag tu sems can don la yongs su brtson/ /ji snyed bsags pa'i rnam dkar ci mchis pa/ /bla med byang chub dam par bsngo ba gyis/ /tshul 'di bslab bya'i gnad bsdus gdams pa ste//smra ba'i mtha' ma'i kha chems 'di nyid yin/ de lta'i tshul gyis snang du gyur nas ni/ /bla med ston pa'i bshes gnyen legs btsal te/ /sangs rgyas las kyang dkon pa'i rdo rje'i theg /rang gi ji ltar nus pa nyams su longs/ /su zhig 'di ltar 'bad pas bsgrub bya ba/ /de ni kho mos bu bzhin skyong bas na/ /khyed cag brtse bas 'dzin pa smos ci dgos/ de phyir gdams pa 'di dag snying la zungs/ zhes gsungs/der blon po gsum yum sras dang 'bral bar ma phod parangu zhing smre sngags su smras pa/ nged cag sa rma thar 'gro ba na/ /thugs rje can gyis skyob tu gsol/ /me chu gcan gzan chom rkun sogs /sdu1 yi

'jigs pas/ nyen pa na/ / pacho da la dran pa tsam gyis kyang / /'jibs pa kun las skyob tu gsol/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug sogs/ /nang gi 'jigs pas nyen pa na/ /gang zhig yid la dran tsam gyis/ /'jigs pa kun 'a/sa bdag thar mdzod/ /kye hud 'jig rten ngan so nga las/ /bskyab par cha dzod cig rin chen gsum/ /'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /yum sras gnyis kyi 'bangs su zhog ces smras pas//yum sras gnyis kyang thugs skyo bas spyan chab 'byin du nye zhing smras pa/kye hud yab rje bdud kyis bslus/ /nyes med chos blon gnas nas bskrad/ 'on kyang mya ngan ma byed par/ /dkon mchog lha la gsol ba thobs/ /bdag cag tshe rabs thams cad du/ /yang yang 'phrad cing 'bral ba med/ ces gsungs so/ de'i che gshed ma rnams chos kyi gleng slong mang tri thos pa'i rkyen gyis/ dge ba'i bag chags sad de/ gdug rtsub kyi me ni rab tu zhi nas/ sngar las kye sdig pa la shin tu 'gyod cing 'jigs pas shugs ring 'don bzhin pa dang bcas/chos blon gsum ji tsam 'dod kyi bar yum sus dang gsung gleng byed du 'jug cing rgyal blon la ma 'jigs par gnas so/ yul de 'i khrims srol la/ gnas nas batho da pa rnams zhag gsum gyi bar gshed mas skyel dgos pas/ 'gro ba la nye ba dang gshed ma rnams kyis yum sras la phyag btsa'/ te/ kye ma deng bdag cag gis 'dus byas rnams ni mi /sdu gsungs pa yang go/ sdig pa dro ༷ sa kyis sdug ba dzal bskyed pa

yang go/ rang byas kyi sdig pa rang nyid kho na la myong ba yang go/ byas pa'i las rnams chud mi 'dza' zhing / las ma byas pa dang 'phrad du med pa ga nga go/ 'khor ba skya tha' dag sdug bsnga gyi rang bzhin du gsungs pa yang go/ deng yang bdag cag mi'i nang gi tha shal ba khyi phag lta bus/ chos blon ngam pa mi'i nang gi khyu mchog dam pa 'di dag gi sku la rdung 'tshog 'ching 'khyig sa gas mi 'os shing mi 'tsham pa'i bya ba 'di lta bu la bsam bzhin du 'jug pa ni smyo ba las kyang ches smyo ba/ 'khrul ba las kyang ches 'khrul ba'o/ kye hud de ltar na bdag cag gi 'jig rten phyi ma cir 'gyur/ yum sras thungs rje can gnyis kyis gzigs zhes/ lus sa la 'gre ldog pa dang skra 'bal zhing /brang brdungs/ ngag yum sras kyi mtshan nas 'bod cing 'o dod byed/yid mya ngan dang 'gyod pas rab tu gdung ba'i tshe/ yum gyis gshed ma rnams la smras pa/ bslu med dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /las ngan gshed ma rnams kyi mgon mdzod cig /kye ma nyon dang las ngan gshed ca 'i tshogs/ /dran pa mang ji nga ji/ ma dran pa dkon/ 'gyod pa mang yang sdig pa 'gyod pa dka'/ /go ba bzang yang las 'bral ོ / ba nyung / /de ring dge ba'i bag chags sad par nges/ /da ni dbon mchog gsum la skyabs bzung ste/ /sngar byas sdig pa 'bang zhags drag pos sbyongs/ /phyin chad srog dang bsdos te sdig pa spongs/ /dge ba sgrub cing sras kyi bka' la nyon/ /ma 'ong /rdos

ri'i khrod du rang cag 'phrad/ /las kyi dbang gis khyed cag rngon pa'i gzugs/ /kho mo'i zas med bdud rtsi 'thung 'gyur zhing / /dbyangs kyis yid bskul rtse gcig sgrub par byed/ /de tshe khyed rnam sa byang chub sa bon thobs/ /bdag gi ming ni snye na zhes bya ste/ /gzhon thu de yang rgyal po'i bur 'gyur zhing / /nges legs de tshe rdo rje mtsho ru 'gyur/ /da lta'i chos kyi blon po ye shes 'dzin/ /kho mo'i ming po rgyal por skyes pa yi/ /drung du skye 'gyur slob dpon shā la zhes /gser gyis bslus te lam bzang sgrub grogs byed/ /dharmi dharma gnyis kyang yang yang 'phrad/ /zhib mo'i lung bstan re zhig dgos pa chung /'on kyang gshed ma dad cing yid ches phyir/ /cung zad thal gyi nyes na bshags par bgyi/ /khyed cag dge ba'i bsam pa skyes pa'i mthus/ /srid pa'i mtsho las bdag gis 'dren par shog ces smras pas/gshed ma rnams kyi mya ngan dang 'gyod pa cung zad zhi zhing / sras dang chos blon gsum po dang bcas kyang ngo mtshar zhing / yum la dad pa lhag par 'phel lo/ der gshed ma la la na re/ rang cag rnams ni bsam pa dge ba rnyed pas mi 'tsham pa'i las 'di lta bu la mi 'jug ste/ rgyal po dang stong dpon dag gis bsad na'ang rung ngo / zhes zer ba la/ ye shes 'dzin gyis/ ka ye nang rje de skad ma zer/nged rnams ni khyed cag song yang rung / ma song yang rung / gnas nas 3/da par 'gyur la/ gal te ma song na khyed rnams rgyal po'i

chad pas srog 'phrog par gdo na mi za ste/ yum sras thugs rje can 'di lta bu las gsung gi bdud rtsi blang du yang med par gces pa'i srog dang 'bral bar byed pa ga la rig legs par soms shig gsungs pas/ de dag las gshed ma rgan pa zhig gis gzhan rnams la shub bur byas te/ blon po chen pos gsungs pa shin tu 'thad de/ de kho na ltar ro/ der ma zad rang cag ma song na gshed ma gzhan zhig la gtod pas rdung 'tshog 'ching 'khyig sogs byed par gyur la/ rang re rnams song na ni de ltar mi bya'o/ zhes smras pas thams cad 'gro bar 'chams te/ der sras kyis rang gi pho brang nas gser gyi dong tso blangs te/ blon po rnams la byin nas smras pa/ thag ring 'gro la skyel ma bya rigs kyang / /khyed cag khrims phog yab rjes bka' gnang na/ /kho bor skyel mar 'gro ru mi ltar bas/ /byang chub bar gyi grogs su bdag 'gyur gyi/ mya ngan ma byed nga yi blon po rnams/ /thugs rjes skyobs shig dkon mchog rin chen gsum/ zhes bas so/yum gyis kyang / de bzhin du gser gyi tshogs gnang ste smras pa/da ni yun ring gleng ba'i skabs ma mchis/ /khyed rnams 'di nas rdo rje gdan du song / /byang chub chen por mchod cing smon lam thobs/ /de nas nub phyogs kha che'i yul du song / /dza lan snye ra'i rgyal khab chen po na/ /kho mo'i yab rje chos kyi rgyal po dang / /de sras byang chub sems dpa' bcas pa bzhugs/ /gzhan yang de na 'a/sdus

mchog du ma dang / /khyad par bde ldan mgon po 'od dpag med/ /tha mal dge slong tshul du rab sprul pa/ /dri med pad+ma mthong grol dbang por grags/ /de dag rnams las zab rgyas gdams pa longs/ /don chen gtan gyi 'dun ma bsgrub par gyis/ zhes gsungs so/btsun mo nges legs kyis kyang gser dang / mu tig mang po dang /rang gi rgyan cha bzang po las bkrol te byin nas smon lam 'di ltar btab bo/ gang la nyes par gyur pa kun bral zhing / /yon tan rnam pa ma lus dang ldan pa/ /bde bar gshegs pa de sras bcas pa dang / /bshes gnyen blo gros chen po'i zhabs la 'dud/ kye de ring 'di lta'i gnas skabs mthong / /nyes med bsam bzang chos blon khrims kyis mnar/ /lha yang cung zad 'khrul bar gdon mi za/ /bsod nams dman pa'i bu mo nges legs la/ /'jigs las skyob pa'i nus pa ma mchis kyang / /bsam pa dge ba'i smon lam cung zad 'debs/ /dkon mchog lha yi bden pas 'grub par shog /khyed cag thag ring yul du gshegs pa'i tshe/ /gcan zan sbrul gdu ga me chu chom po dang / nad gdon sogs kyi ming yang mi 'byung zhing / /phun tshogs don kun yid bzhin 'grub par zhog /myur du bslu med dam pa'i mgon gyis zin/ /zab rgyas gdam pa thos dang thos pa'i don/ /tshul bzhin sgrub par mtha' ru phyin gyur te/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i mgonadu /spyir bar shog /bdag cag 'phags ma'i bka' 'bangs thams

cad kyang / /tshe rabs kun tu yang gyi ring 'phrad 'gyur zhing / /pan tshun lam bzang sgrub pa'i grogs gyur te/ /byang chub dam par mi phyed 'dun gyur cig ces smras pas/ blon po sasum gyis/ gser dang mu tig bstsal ba gsol kyang mdzes rgyan rnams ma stsol lo zhes zhus kyang /yum gyi zung ltar bar chad ma byung na/ /rgyal po nor gyi sa phongs pa ga la mnga'/ /bar chad gyur na 'byor pas ci zhig bya/ /kho mo bsod nams yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /rgyan cha 'bul gyi cis kyang len paragasol/ zhes nan gyis byin no/ der chos blon gsum 'gro ba la nye ba na/ yum sras gnyis la yi da 'phreng ste srog gi thag pas sbrel ba ltar gyur te/ gom re'i mtshams nas snyi mig re blta zhing / yum sras gnyis kyis kyang blon po rnams ma yol bar gzigs nas bzhugs so/ de rnams gtam gleng ba sogs la stong dpon yid shin tu ma rangs kyang / sras la cang smra bar ma nus par ma mthong ba ltar byas nas bsdod do/ de nas rgyal bu pho brang du byon te/ yab kyi drung du bzhin gnag ste 'dug pa la/ yab na re/ gzhon nu ci'i phyir bzhin gnag ste 'dug sras kyis/ /rgyal po bcol chung 'bangasagyis bsgyur/ /nyes med bsam bzang gnas nas bskrad/ /'gyod pa'i dus zhib/ gzigs par 'gyur/ /gsan nam yab rje chos kyi rgyal/zhes smras pas/ gzhon nu'i gdong la ce rer gzigs shing mi smra bar gnas so/ stong dpon gyis yum la ci yang smra bar ma nus kyang 3/sa

legs la ma rangs te/ rgyal po'i drung du song nas zhus pa/ /lha btsun mo srung du gsol/ rgyal po na re/ ci ma ti mahā ni la zer rnam/ khos/ ma lags te nges legs so/ rgyal pos/ des ci zhig byas/ stong dpon na re/ de dbyar tshul gyi bu sogs nyes can gsum gang rung zhig gi nyams par byas shing / da dung ma bsrungs na de ni g.yo can ma 'phyon ma zhig lags so/ rgyal po na re/ khyod kyis mthong ngam/ kho na re/ dngos su ma mthong yang nyes can gsum bskrad pa na lha gshegs pa dang 'dra ba'i mya ngan byas so/ rgyal po na re/ des mya ngan ci byas/ kho na re/ rgyan cha rnams bkrol lo/ rgyal po zhe sdong gi kun dkris drag po skyes te/ da lta nyid du khug cig zer/ der bkug pas/ rgyan nyung ngur byas pa mthong ba dang khro gnyer bsdus/ dbral rtsa bsgrengs/ mig 'bur tshugs byas te/ phyag g.yas kyis ral gri'i 'chang ba nas bzung / /g.yon gyis snying kha'i thad kyi gos bzung ste/ ngan ma khyod kyis ci'i phyir rgyan rnams bkrol zhes dris pas/ de bud med shes rab can yin pas/ nges par da lta lan smras na bdag gsod do snyam nas/ bzhin 'dzum por bstan te/ thal mo sbyar nas lha bdag la phyis nas gsol lo/ da lta gtong du gsol/ zhes smras pas/rgyal po na re/ nges par da lta sbos shig de 'dra min na khyod kyi mgo dru /sa gcod do/ de na re/ lha dgongs par mdzod cig cung zad

bral nas btsun mo btang ba'i tshe zhus pa/ lha bdag la ci'i phyir mi dgyes/ rgyal po na re/ /rgyal po'i bsrung bya 'bangs yi na te/ /'bangs kyi bsrung bya rgyal khrims yin/ /bcun cho'i bsrung bya rang lus yin/ gal te lus kyang mi thub pa'i /btsun mos bdag la ci zhig bya/gsungs pas/ btsun mos yang 'di la gcig gis nges par phra ma bcug pa red snyam nas/ dmod pa shugs drag bor te/ 'bras sa lu'i 'bru spar ba gang lag tu thogs nas smras pa/ /rgyal po'i bsrung bya 'bangs min na/ /nyes med khrims kyis ga la mnar/ /'bangs kyi bsrung bya khrims yin na/ /gzhi med phra ma ci phyir 'jug /btsun mo'i bsrung bya lus yin kyang / /lus la nyams pa ngas mi dran/ /gal te lha yi rgyal khab tu/ /mchis nas deng la thug gi bar/ /skyes pa gzhan zhugs lta ci smos/ /yid la dran pa'ang ma bgyis na/ /nang par sa lu skam po las/ myu gu sngon po skye gyur cig /dkon cha chog lha yi bden pa dang / /rten 'brel zab mos bslu mi srid/ /gal te bdag tshig 'di bden na/ /bden pa'i tshig 'di 'grub gyur cig /ces smras te/ rgyal po'i lcag tse'i steng du bor nas song bas/ btsun mo de snya/nga dkon mchog gsum dang yang dag pa'i —3 ba la mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan cing / mo la bden pa shin tu bzang ba yod pa'i stobasakyis nang par sa lu skam po de las myu ga sngo ljang dri ma med pa skyes pas/ rgyal po shin tu dga' zhing yid ches so/ de'i tshe 8sdus

legs kyis khrus skegs par byas/ gos gsar pa bags/ sngar las kyang ches che ra lhag pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan te/ rgyal ngo'i drung du song bas/ rgyal pos tshod bgam pa'i phyir myu gu rnams sbas/ sa lu skam po 'ga' zhig stor te smras pa/ khyod kyi bden tshig de ni 'di 'dra'o/ der btsun mos/ lha bdag gi nongs par spyod pa ni dus nam yang mi dran mod kyi/ 'on kyang dkon mchog gsu / gyis bdag mongs par gziṭa par gyur na ni/ bdag nyes pa can yin rmā ci smos/de'i phyir lhas bdag srog dang bral du gsol zhes 'jigs pa med par mgo bo bstan pas/ rgyal po shin tu ngo mtshar zhing yid ches te myu gu bstan nas/ lha mo khyod ma nongs kyi bdag nongs te bzod par gsol lo/ khyod lta bu'i btsun mo dam pa ni 'jig rten na dkom no/bdag gi btsun mo dam pa ma ti mahā ni 'phags ma yin la/ khyod ni nye ba'i 'phags ma ste/ deng phyin chad khyod kyi ming de skad ces bya'o/bdag gi bang mdzod thams cad la dbang bsgyur bar dbang ba shu ra ro zhes sogs bstod pa du mas bstod do/ khyod kyis bdag la nang par ba kra zhis pa'i don dang bcas te smra'o zhes rmi nga der mas shig gsungs pas/ nges reb/sa kyis gsol ba/ lha kho mo bzang ngo / lhas kyang ma nongs te/ lha'i thugs la mnga' ba'i dug gsum gyiri nongs par mkhyen pa mdzod cig der phyin chad ma brtags ma dpyad par bya ba ༵ 0'jug par mi 3 tshal lo/ 'bangs kyi phra ma la na gtod par mi

dzo tshal lo/ bdag gis gsol nga 'i dus/ ni drang ma lags te/ nam byug mdzad pa 'di dag la 'gyod pa'i dus cig mchis so/ gal te deng gsal na bud med kyi ngag ces lhas brnya ga par mdzad do/ 'phaṭam ma ti mahā ni lta bu la yang brnyas par mdzad na kho mo la lta ci smos zhes zhus pas/ rgyal po na re/ lha mo gzhan rnams bdag gis go zhing yid la byed do/ nga'i rgyud kyi dug gsum gyis ji ltar nongs sbos shig yang btsun mo na re/ lha cig bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /ma rig dbang gis phra ma gsan/ /'dod chags dbang gis kho mor chags/ /de yis phrag dog rab drangs shing / /de las zhe ldang drag po skyes/ bdag gis thabs mkhas ma gsol na/ /nyes med kho mo de'u bsad/ /de phyir lha yis slan chad kyang / /nyon mongs dgra la bag zon 'tshal/ zhes smras pas/ yang rgyal po na re/ lha mo 'o na khyod kyi rgyan rnam sa ci'i phyir nyes pa can la byin/btsun mo na re/ bza' shing 'ga' zhag 'bras bus brlags/ /dud 'gro 'gari zhig rang shas brlags/ /bud med 'gari zhig gzugs kyis brlags/ /'byor ldan 'ga' zhig nor gyis brlags/ /lha cig sbyin pa mi gtong ba'i/ /nor ni sdug bsngal sa bon yin/ /rgyal po na re/ sbyin pa btang na sbyin gnas gzhan yod mod/ /nyes nga can la ci'i phyir sbyin/ yang btsun mo na re/ yon tan zhing gyur mkhan slob dang / /phan par sems pa'i pha ma dang /nu /sa

mnar ba'i 'gro ba rnams/ /sbyin pa'i zhing gi mchog tu gsungs/rgyal po na re/ lha mo bdag gis khrims bcad pa la khyod kyis phan bdag tu rung nga / yang btsun mo na re/ lha yis mdzad pa'i las 'bras kyang / /kho mos mi dbang de bzhin du/ kho mos bgyis pa lhas mi dbang / de phyir lha cig khyed dang bdag /rang rang byas 'bras so so yin/ rgyal po na re/ khyod yo byad dang bcas pa nga la dbang na/ las 'bras ngas mi dbang ba ci zhig btsun mo na re/lha yis sngon tshe dge spyad pas/ /bdag la khyed kyis dbang du mdzad/ /span chad legs par ma spyod na/ /gshegs nas 'jig rten gzhan bzhud tshe/ /lha yis rgyal srid bsnam du med/ /'jig rten rje ris bran res ni/ /chu dang gram pa ji bzhin lags/ rgyal po na re/ nga rgyal po yin pas rang bzhin gyi bsod nams che/ khyod bud med yin pas rang bzhin gyi bsod nams dman de bas na rje ris bran res su ga la 'gyur/ yang btsun mo na re/ ma rig 'ching las ma grol na/ /'khor los bsgyur kyang ci zhig phan/ /brgya byinadabul po'i mi gtsang 'phyags/ /dbul pos sum rtsen khang bzang spyod/ /bsod nams che chung gnas skabs yin/ /rgyal po nga rgyal che ba'i phyir/ /phal cher bran du skye ba mang / /des na lha yang nga rgyal skyungs/ rgyal po na re/ kho bo bran du mi skye'o/ yang btsun mo twe lhare/ /lha yi sku tshe dpag med nas/ /bsags sdig dug chu'i

gye mtsho cher/ /rgyal srid spyod pa'i zhar byung gi/ /dge sdig 'dre pa'i sman thigs de/ /blugs pas bdud rtsir bsgyur bar dka'/ /gal te shes bzhin ma bsrung na/ /mang po spyad par rlom gyur kyang / /mi bzod lta sogs chom po yis/ skad cig gcig la ma lus 'phrogs/ yang rgyal po na re/ lha mo 'o na ngas khyod la dri ba zhig 'ji ste/ btsun mo dang blon 'bangs 'di rnams byi bde skyid thams cad kho bo'i bka' drin la brten te byung ba ma yin nam/ btsun mo na re/ rgyal po rnams ni ngo bstod dgyes/ /drang po'i gtam la nyan pa dkon/ /gal te mi dgyes mi 'tshal na/ /kho mos yin lugs drang por gsol/ rgyal po na re/ lha mo drang por thos dang /kho bo shin tu dga'o/ btsun mo na re/ bde dang sdug bsngal ma lus pa/ /rang rang rgyu sngon song la brten/ /de phyir bdag cag blon 'bangs kyi/ /bde skyid lha yi bka' drin min/ rgyal po na re/ /'di dag kho bos ma bskyangs na/ /phan dang bde ba ga la yod/ btsun mo na re/ phan bde 'grub pa'i rgyu mchog ni/ /ma bskyangs gyur kyang rang rang bde/ /sdug bsngal rgyun can 'bangs rnams kyi/ nyes pa rgyal pos sel mi nus/ gal te lha yi drin yin na/ /khyed la nye ring med gyur kyang / 'bangs rnams bde thug mi mnyam ci/ 'on kyang khyed kyi bka' drin gyi/ /byed rkyen cung zad tsam la brten/ /de ni kho mos drang por gsol/ zhes zhus 11/

rgyal po yang dag pa'i lta ba la nges pa cher rnyed nas smras pa/ /e ma 'di ni za mo'o/ yang btsun mos/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyis kyang / rten cing 'brel 'byung tshul 'di las zab mo'i chos 'ga' gsung du med/ /de slad bdag ni 'di nyid sems/ rgyal po na re/ lha mo khyed ni bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen ma'o/ btsun mo na re/ bde chos phyi rol dngos pos ston/ legs bshad byis pa'i ngag gis gleng /shes rab bzang ldan skyes bu la/ /kun yang dge ba'i bzhes su 'gyur/ /gti mug bsgribs pas rmongs pa 'ga'/ /dge bzhes bsten pas mi dge 'phel/ zhes smras pas/ rgyal po shin tu dgyes so/ der stong dpon yam she byung ba la/ rgyal pos gong gi de dag bsnyad pas/ kho shin tu cha/gu nas/ smras pa/ lhas sgyu ma mkhan mkhyen nam/ rgyal pos/ shes te rang re'i 'bangs su yang yod do/ kho na re/ sgyu ma mkhan gyi bud med mkhyen nam/rgyal pos/ shes te sgyu ma mkhan ci 'dri ba de 'dra'o/ kho na re/de la yid gtad du rung ngam zhes smras pas/ rgyal pos don sgrigs nas/ kyi ma gti mug can 'di ci zer/ btsun mo dam pa de la kho bo yid ches pas nges shes rnyed du zin na khyod kyis bzlog tu thub bam/ smra ba ma mang bar sdod cib/ gsungs pas/ de shin tu ma rangs kyang smra ma nus par rang gi khyim du song ngo / tshul de 'bangs rnams kyis thos pas/ de dag ngo mtshar te/ de phyin chad btsun so

dam pa ma ti mahā ni dang 'dra bar bkur zhing / 'bang / byi /khyim bdag mo phal pa rnams kyi lus kyi mi dge ba'i sgo khe shas /pa'i rkyen du yang 'gyur to/ der btsun mo gnyis sras dang bcas pa' gsungs la brten rgyal po the tshom dang yid mi bde cher skyes kyang rgyal po'i smra ba lan gcig yin pa dang / stong dpon dbang che bas bzlog ma nus par/gza' skar bzang po la babs pa'i tshe/ stong dpon gyi bu blon por mnga' gsol bas/ rgyal bu de yang nye bar brtse ba dang ldan zhing /las kyi dbang gis de la shin tu byams shing gtsigs su mdzad do/ de yang phral du rgyal bu'i bsnyen bkur la shin tu mkhas shing / bka' la brtsi ba dang / rig pa sbyangs shing sgyu rtsal shes pa/ rgyal bu la sha tsha zhing snying nye ba ltar ston pa sogs blon por 'os pa'i yon tan thams cad tshang ba zhig byung ste/ re zhig bar thams cad bde skyid dang ldan nga ra gyur to/ blon po gsum yang rgyal po'i pho brang mthong ba las ma yol bar brdung zhing bdas te khrid pa'i tshul byas/ de nas bcings pa rnams bkrol te/ dal bus 'byon du bcug nas/rang rang gi bza' btung rnams thun mong du spyod cing phan tshun dga' ba'i gtam gleng bzhin par zhag gsum gyi bar du bskyal/ de nas rang rang gi gos phung de blon po rnams la phul bas/ blon po rnams kyis/ kye grogs dag rang rang gi khyim gyi bkres pa dang dbul ba mi dran nam/ nged rnams gos mi len no smras pas/ de da/ na

re/ sngon choring khyi gyi dbul ba la bsams nas sdig pa'i las dpag tu med pa bgyis pa de dag thams cad / pha'am/ ma'am/ spun zla ma/ srungam/ sri nga mo'am cha/chis brang ngam/ bu tsha'am/ bran dag gis cung zad kyang myong ba'i grogs mi byed do/las kyi rnam smin mi da pa ni bdag kha na la myong ba zho bas/ da ni gnongs tsu / 'gyod do/ shin tu 'gyod do/ kye ma bdag cag bsod nams cung zad bsags pa'i phyir du/ /'di ni da / ba 3 grogs chos kyi spun khye da rnams kyis longs spyod du gsol/ zhes nan gyis phul te phyag byas so/ der ye shes 'dzin gye sa/ nged cag gsum la byams shing brtse ba yi/ /gshed ma tī gzugs rnams sdig pa kun byang ste /rnam grol ye shes sa bon legs thob cing / /myur du 'phrad nas chos la spyod par smon/ zhes smras/ nas yid 'phreng bas 'bral mi phod pa tsam byas te gshed ma rnams phyir log pa dang / rang rang gi gnyen bshes soṭa kyis gos med sgren mor gyur pa cis nyen dris pas/ rgyal po'i chad pa yong du do gas te chom rkun gyis 'phroṭa so zhes smras so/ de dag yum dang rgyal po 'i mchod gnas rnams las chos nyan te sgrub la rtse gcig tu gzhol lo/ blon po gsum gyis 'phags ma'i bka' bzhin du byang chub chen po la mchod cing smon lam btab ste nub phyogs su zla bganyis la nye bar phyin pas/ bar chad med par dza la rar bgrod de/46 grong khyer gyi sgo srung bar wa ra ṇa si'i rgyal po ku lan rā dza'i

pho nya yin no zhes smras pas/ nang du btang yang pho brang gi phyi sgo srungamakhan gyis khyed cag mu to pa'o zhes ngan smras nas/ nang du ma btang ba'i tshe shar sgo'i pho brang ṣ+pe/ sgo drung nas/ sgo rdung zhing skad kyis bo pas sras rgyal po shar phyogs kyi pho brang gi yang thog tu dkon mchog girten la bskor ba mdzad pas gsan te/ blon po la smras pa/ rang re'i pho brang gi sgo drung nas skad 'tsher zhing snyan pas 'bod pa 'di su zhig blon po des mu to ba lags so zhus/ rgyal po na re/'di'i skad ni ngo mtshar te/ su zhig yin gtam dris shig der des kyang sgo drung du babs te dris pas/ bdag gcag wa ra ṇa si ba lags te/ 'phags ma blo gros che mos 'dir btang ngo / don ni lha'i zhal mjal bar 'dod do/ des kyang rgyal po la zhus pas/rgyal pos/ legs so/ bdag dang 'phrad par bya dgos pas 'dir thongs shig gsungs nas/ rgyal po'i drung du khrid pa dang / rgyal pos/ gtam dris pa kye bzhen bzang dag khyed rnams yul gang nas/ rgyal po su zhig gi 'bangs shig ngon ci'i slad du 'dir 'ongs/ gang khyed rnams kyi byad bzhen dang spyod tshul la dpag na/rgyal rigs sam/ mdun na 'don nam/ gtso bo'i rigs shiga'adra la/ gos rgyan dang 'jug sug ni mu to ba lta bur snang na ci/rgyal po'i khrims dang 'gal mas chad pa'i las byung ba ma yin nam/smos shig gsungs pa'i lan du blon po ye shes 'dzin gyis 4/ga

bcad du smras pa/ e ma sngon bsags bsod nams spyo zang pa'i 'thus/ stobs 'byor rigang gzugs mkhyen rab phul byung ba/ /lha mis bkur 'os sa yi dbang phyug khyod/ /bdag gis gsong la cung zad snyan gtod 'tsha'// /yul ni khyad 'phags dbus 'gyur rechang ba las/ /bye brag wa ra ṇa si'i grong khyer yin/ /rgyal po rigs ldan lha snang stobs ldan te/ /bdag cag de yi mdun na 'don du gyur /khrims dang 'gal ba'i bya ba ma byas kyang / /bsam pa bzang ba'i chad par ga nas nas bskrad/ /gango la bya'i don gzhan 'ga' yang ma 'tshal te/ /khyod kyi mched mo 'phags ma brtse ldan ma'i/ bka' bzhin 'dir lhab/sa sa bdag yab sras kyis/ /zhal bzang lha dang khyed kyi mchod pa'i gnas/ /dri med pad ma'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi yi/ /bgo skalacung zad thob par 'dod na / mchis/ zhes zhus pas/ tshigs su bcad pa 'grigs kyang smra mi mkhas pa zhig ste/ rigs ldan rgyal po yang blo gros chen po thug tu grags pas/ bsam pa bzang ba'i lam du khrims kyis mi mnar ba shes/ khyed rnams kyi gtam la yid brtan cher mi snang mod kyi/ 'on kyang ma ti mahā ni bde bar gnas sam/de'i gya la bu chung ngu zhig skyes par thos pa yang bde bar gnas sam/legs par thos shig gsungs pas/ yang ye shes 'dzin gyis/ /blo gros che yang ma rig dbang gyur pa/ /de srid 'khrul pa'i spros pa ma cho~X pas/ /rje yi thugs rgyud 'bangs kyis bsgyur ba na/ /bsam

pa bzang yang khrims kyis mnar bar mthong / bdag cag sngon gyi las dbang btsan pa'i phyir/ bsam pa bzang yang khrims kyis mnar bar gyur/ /snyigs dus nag phyogs bdud rigs stobs rgyas pas/ /bsam bzang ldan gang tshad mar mi 'dzin par/ /g.yo sgyu can la drang po'i skyes bur 'dzin/ /blo can mkhas pa rtswa ltar dor nas ni/ /ba glang lta bu'i thun po'i rjes su 'jug /chos ldan skyes bu bar gcod dbang 'gyur zhing / /log par spyod pa ches cher dar gyur pa'i/ ngang tshul 'di rnams lha yis ma gzigs sam/ /lha khyod blo gros nor gyis phyug ces thos/ /de slad gtam 'di rigs pa yin nam min/ /khyod kyi dpyod par 'gyur snyam ji bzhin smras/ gzhan du snyigs dus skye bor nges pa ci/ /yang gcig gson dang midabang chos kyi rgyal/ lha yi lcam gcig ma ti mahā ni/ /rga na 'chi med go 'phang mngon mdzad phyir/ /sdug bsngal gyur pa'i go skabs ma mchis kyang / /tha mal dor yang da lta bde bar bzhugs/ /phal pa'i 'bangs kyis bsgyur ba ga la nus/ /byas pa bzang ba'i lag rjes med gyur na/ /bsam pa bzang bar gang las dpag par nus/ /sbyor ba'i bya ba thabs mkhas mi shes na/ /bsam pa bzang yang bzang ba tsam du zad/ /gzhan gyi nyes pa ri bzhin mthong sla yang / /rang skyon rdul phran bzhin du rtogs par dka'/ /snyigs dus skye bo'i ngang tshul ngas kyang mthong / /gtam r+ṣa yid brtan med ces smras pa yang / //sbyar

gnas skyes bu nyin gyi skar ma ltar/ /dkon zhing ga yo can mtshan skar ltar mang ba'i/ /snyigs dus skye bo'i rī nga tshul mthong nas smras/ /'on kyang bu mo blo gros che mo dang / /de sras bcas pa bde ba'i gtam de snyan/ /da dung dag la kho bo brtag dpyad byed/ /zhag gsum 'das nas yab rje'i zhal yang ltos/ /de bar ngakon mchog gsum la bkur bsti gyis/ zhes gsungs te/ dkon mchog gi rten bzhugs pa'i khang par bzhag bza' btung dang gos sogs nang blon rnams dang 'dra bar byin no/ zhab gsum nas blon po zhig btang ste rgyal po'i drung du khrid de/ rgyal po'i zhal nas bzhin bzang dag kho bo zhag bdun re'i mtshams su yab kyi drung du phyag byed par 'gro zhing / de'i bar du yab nyid rtse gcigata/ rto/cha/ pa gzhol ba yin pa la/ de ring dus la babs pas rang cag rnams yab kye drung du 'gro'o/ khrus dang gtsang sgra gyis shig khyed rnams kyis smras pa'i gtam rnams bden nam rgyun pa yang deng mngon du 'gyur ro gsung / der de ltar byas te song bas/ pho brang dbus ma'i rtse mor bsam gtan gyi khang bu bkod pa mdzes pa zhig 'dug pa'i sgo drung nas kyang dri ngad bzang po phun sum tshogs pa ldang zhing / sku'i gzi brjid kyis blon po gsum rab tu 'dar dgos pa byung / de nas blon po zhi dul can zhig 'dug pa des nang du khrid pas/ ye shes 'jin gyis ni/ bcom ldan 'das gaXrdo ba'i bdag po'i skur mjal/ blon po gzhan gnyis kyang rin

po che'i khri la dar gzab 'bol brtsegs kyi steng du rgyal po shin tu bgres nyams can/ sog tshom dkar po sked pa'i bar du slebs pa/sku sbomal sha rgyas shing brjod chags pa/ ral pa dkar po'i thor cog la rin po che'i rgyan can/ rigs sngang nga shub bur gsung shing phal cher spyan zim bur mdzad la/ skabs khagar 'bur tshugs su gzigs pa/ 'jigs par bltas na 'jigs shing rngams pa/ legs par bltas na yid du sdug pa/ mthong ba tsam gyis dang ba 'dren zhing / drungadu ji tsam gnas pa tsam gyis dga' ba ches cher 'phel ba zhig 'dug pa la/ rgyal jo/ dang blon po gsum bcas kyis phyag byas pas/ ye shes 'dzin la skyes bu dam pa bde bar byon nam zhes rang dang lhan cig tu khri'i steng du bzhag sras rgyal pos kyang phyag byed du bcugagazhan gnyis la bzhin bzang dag bde bar 'ongs sam zhes stan dma' ba zhig la bzhag go/ der yud tsam gyi bar cang mi gsung bar spyan btsum ste bzhugs/ de'i tshe sras rgyal po ni/ yab la sangs rgyas dngos dang 'dra ba'i 'du shes yod pas/ blon po la phyag 'tshal dgos pa de the tshom ci yang ma byung bar dad pa lhag par 'phel/ dharma ta ni ci yang ma bsam/ dharmis/ nged gnyis lo ni rgan/ gnas nas bskrad pa ni 'dra/ ye shes 'dzin la 'di lta bu zhig byed pa ni mi 'os pa zhig ste/ rgyal po 'di k+ṣa nga cung zad 'khrul par nges snyam pa dang / rgyal po chen po des/ nyirmi la/ spyarnga/ 'bur tshub5—1 su

gzigs ste/ /me tog ldum rwa gcig la yang / /me tog phal pa du ma dang / /sku dum wa ra gcig skyes na/ /skye gnas khyad par med gyur kyang / /snga mar mkhas pas rtsis su med/ gcig zhos 'jig rten khams na dkon/ /ri bo gcig la skyes pa yi phal pa'i smon shing mang po dang / /ha ri'i tsan dan gcig skyes tshe/ /snga ma rtsis su mi byed de/ /gcig shos mkhas pas cis mi len/ /rgyal po blon sogs 'di dag rnams/ /riṭa 'byor mtho dma' mtshungs gyur kyang / /skyes bu dam pa shin tu dkon/ /skye bo phal pa rtsis su med/ /kye ma ye shes 'dzin 'di ni/ /'od dpag med kyi thugs sras te/ /rta mchog khro bo'i rnam sprul yin/ /skye bo gti mug can ci sems/ zhes gsungs te slar yang spyan btsums nas bzhugs pas/ dharmis rgyal po la mngon shes mnga' bar yid ches te/ shin tu zhum par gyur ro/de nas 'di skad gsungs so/ /kye ma nyon dang blon chen blon po dag /gtam gang thog mar khyed la 'dri rigs kyang / /bdag gi gzhon nu la soṭa yid ches phyir/ /khyed rnams smra pos de dag kho bos smra/ /khyed cag yul ni wa ra ṇa si ste/ der yang rgyal po lha snang stobs ldan dang / /nga yi bu mo ma ti mahā ni/ /deng sang bde zhing de yi gzhon du'ang bde/ /'on kyang sngon gyi las smon dbang gis ni/ /myur du bar chad rnam pa 'jug par 'byung / /rgyal po de ni byang chub sems chi ldanaca drong / /de 3 /da 'bangs kyis bsgyur ba la brten nas/ /nyes med

khyed rnams gnas nas bskrad par gyur/ /kye ma g.yo can de yi phra ma yis/ /rgyal po ku na ra dza 'khrul du bcug /kye hud sems can 'di kun snying re rje/ /'khor ba'i gnas 'dir yid brtan ga la mchis/ zhes gsungs pas/ ye shes 'dzin shin tu dad de phyag mang du btsal zhing gdong mchi mas g.yog bzhin du smra pa/ /dkon mcho ga gsum po kun gyi dngos/ /chos kyi rgyal po khyed la 'dud/ /ji lta ji snyed kun gzigs pa/ /chos kyi rgyal po khyod la 'dud /gsang ba kun gyi bdag po ste/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /ji ltar gsungs pa de bzhin du/ /lha mchog khyed kyi sras mo de/ rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum gyi mchog /dus gsum kun mkhyen khyod dang mtshungs/ bslu med lam ston dge ba'i bshes/ /bdag cag rnams kyi mgon gcig lags/ /'on kyang rgyal po 'bangs kyis bsgyur/ /nyes med bdag cag gnas nas bskrad /de ring 'di lta'i gnas skabs rnyed/ /gsang bdag dngos gyur mgon dang mjal/ /da ni khyod kyi thugs rje yis/ /byang chub bar du yongs 'dzin gsol/zhes zhus shing / blon po gzhon gnyis/ kyis kyang phyag mang du byas so/ de'i tshe yang bka' bstsal ba/ dam pa'i skyes bu ye shes 'dzin khyod kyis/ /'gro don byed pa'i sdong grogs bdag gis byed/ blon po gzhan gnyis bas ma pa dag pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis brtse ba'ilcags dkyus mi gtong ngo / /bu mo ma ti mahā ni de nyed/ /phyi ltar tshangasabya sdu'i

bu mo dbyangs can ma/ /nang ltar ad+ma ta re thugs brje'i gter/ /gsang ba ye shes bde skyong mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /de dag tham sa cad don du rgyud gcig ste/ /sprul pas 'gro ba skyong bar byed pa yen/ /de nas miring byang phyogs gangs can du/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyi ma ltar gsal 'gyur/ /thugs rje'i gter chen lo gi shā ra yi/ phal cher mi rje'i tshul gyis skyong byed cing / /mgon po 'od dpag med ni phal cher du/ /de mi mastod gnas tshul du 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bdag cag phal cher sras sam 'khor gyi tshul/ /skabs 'gar cung zad mi dad tshul gyis kyang / /mgon de'i che ba 'gro la ston par byed/ /gzhan yang gnas der sprul pa bsam mi khyab/ /theg mchog la mos 'gro ba grangs med 'gyur/ /blo gros chen pos bud med gzugs bzung ste/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan pa rgya cher spyod /de yi gzhon nu chos kyi dga' ba yang / /skabs 'gar mkhas shing skabs 'gar zhi dul can/ /skabs 'gar gtum pa skabs 'gar zhugs pa'i tshul/ /gnas der skye ba mang du len 'gyur zheng / /lha snang rgyal dang ye shes 'dzin khyod kyang / /yang yang gnas der skye ba len par 'gyur/ /ma 'os mthong tshul cung zad bshad pa'o/ /blo gros che mo ma bu gnas kyi bar/ /wa ra ṇa sir bde skyid ldan gyur kyang / zhes pa tsam gsungs pa'i 'phro ma rdzogs pa nyid nas tso hūṃ gsungs te/ slar yang spyan btsum nasabya /zhugs pa'i tshe/ sras kyis yab la/ e ma de ltar bka'

bstsal ba ltar blon po de rna rku gyis bo rngo la smras par gyur kyang kho bo the tshom du gyur mod/ da ni the tshom chod do/ kye ma wa ra ṇa si ba rnams de ltar rung la/ 'khor ba 'di'i rang bzhi na 'di 'dra'o/zhes zhus pas/ yab bzhad gad mdzad cing blon po 'di dag drang po'i rang bzhin can du gyur pa'i rkyen gyis 'dir sprug pa yin ngasungs/de nas rgyal blon rnams la bza' btung bzang pos tshim par zungad do/ yang yab kyis/ blon po gsum la bka' bstsal pa/ ka ye nyon dang blo ldan blon po'i tshogs/ /rang gi rtogs pa brjod pa cung zad smra/ /kho bo rgyal po ma zho ka zhes bdag sngon bsags bsod nams bzang po'i las dbang gis/ /stobs 'byor rigs bzang rgyal po'i bu ruskyes/ /bcu gsum lon tshe yab rje dgung la gshegs/ /na tshod gsar pa shin tu phra gyur kyang / /rgyal srid bya ba'i gnya' shing phrag par lci/ /mnga' 'bangs rnams la dge bcu'i khrims srol spel/ /phyi nang gnyis las nang 'di bstan la dad/ /bslu med dkon mchog rin chen thugs rje dang / byams pa rgya cher bskyed pa'i nus mthu las/ /bde skyid chen pos kha che'i rgyal khams khyab/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i mkhas grub mang po dang / /khyad par lo grangs nyer dgu 'o na pa 'i tshe/ sangs rgyas dngos gyur bla ma dam pa mjal/ /zab rgyas dam chos bdud rtsis bdag rgyud gtams// chos kun gdod nas rang bzhin med pa dang /rten byung bslu med 'gal ba med par gi/ /'khor ba'i skyon kun6 sdung

bzhin mthong ba dang / /'khor bar gnab/ pa 'gal ba med par rgo/skyi /spre ji sman du bsgyur ba'i gdams ngag shes/ /ci byas dge bar 'gyur ba'i gdams ngag shes /mi gtsang gser du bsgyur ba'i gdams ngag shes/ /shes ltar nyams su blangs shing mngon du 'gyur/ /khyim thab mun dob lta bur tshud gyur kyang / /bya ba don yod byas so blo ldan ngag de nas bzhi zung bcu dang brgyad lhag lo/ /ron nas rgyal srid bu yi khur du byin/ /rgan po gtan gyi 'dun ma sgrub la brtson/ mi ring myur du tshe yi dus byas te/ /lcang lo can gyi pho brang dam par 'gro/ /ma 'ong byang phyogs bod yul bdag gis skyong / /rgyal po blon po mkhan po la sogs gzugs// /du mas 'gro ba rnams kyi don byed cing / /rgyal ba rgya mtshos rgyal ba'i mdzad pa mdzad/ /snang ba mtha' yas shing rtas legs drang mthus/ /khyad par bstan pa'i nyi ma lan gsum 'char/ /de yi dus su rang cag 'phrad par 'gyur/ /da ni mang por smra ba'i long med de/ /'chi bdag gzhin rje'i zhags pas mdun nas 'then/ /lang tsho'i dpal gyis snyi nas rab hūṃ phul/ /srog 'gags phyogs su chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'gro/ /de phyir rgan po sgrub la gzhol bar bya/ /chos bzhin spyod pa'i skal ldan khyod rnams kyang / /sras kyi pho brang nang du bde bar bzhugs/ /zhag bdun 'das nas slar yang gnas 'dir gshegs/ zhes gsungs pa dang / rgyal blon rnaX/ phyir thon te/ blon po gsum la/ sras rgyal pos sngar las

kyang lhag pa'i bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pas tshimapar mdzad do/dri ra blon po gsum gyis sras rgyal po'i drung du song nas phyag btsal te gsol ba/ lha khyod ni bdag cag la sku drin bsam gyis mi khyab ste/lag na rdo rje dngos dang 'dra ba'i chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal mthong ngo /'on kyang chog shes med pa bdag cag gis da dung don zhig gi slad du lha la gsol btab na/ lha thugs mi dgyes pa mi 'tshal lam zhes zhus pas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ bzhin bzang dag khyed cag bsam pa shin tu bzang zhing legs pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i phyir/ kho bo yang glo ba dga' ste/ de phyir bdag gis sgrub tu rung la/ bsgrub par nus pa'i don zhig yin na ni dam pa sbyin no zhes gsungs pas/blon po gsum gyis gsol ba/ bdag cag la 'phags ma ma ti mahā ni'izhal nas/ kho bo'i yab dang / ming po'i mchod gnas bla ma dri ma med pa'i dpal gyi nal snga nas las chos kyi bdud rtsi gshos shig ces bka' bstsal na/ don de'i phyir lha'i mchod gnas de mthong bar 'tshalalo zhes zhus pa/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ ka ye/ ma tsar+ya pad+ma badz+ra bai ma ya sri wa na ni/ gnas gcig tu ma nges te/ o rgyan/ za hor/ be da / 'gro lding / zangs gling / gser gling / kha che/ rgya gar sogs du mar bzhugs pa dang / gshegs pas tshad bzung bar dka'/ la la dag o rgyan du mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi tshogs dpon mdzad zer/la la dag rdo rje gdan du dge slong zhig tu bzhugs zer te/ 'a//sa

pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rigs bdag ca/gon po snang ba mtha' jigs dngos yin par grags/ kho bos kyang yab kyi drin las/ lan gcig gnyis kho na mjal/ de ni ma ti mahā ni mo nyid kyis shes te/ mo la dus nam 'dod du mjal bar thos so/ 'on kyang kho bo spru nus pa med mod/ yab la gsol gdab par bya'o gsungs/der zhag bdun song ba'i rjes/ sngar bzhin yab kyi drung du song bas/ yab nyid kyis rig sngags shub bur gsung ba rdzogs ma thagasras kyis snyun legs par dris pa'i rjes su/ ye shes 'dzin gyis pus mo btsugs/ thal mo sbyar te rab tu gus pa'i yid kyis gsol ba/ rje khyed rdo rje sku brnyes phyir/ /rga na 'chi las rnam 'grol kyang / /tha mal rnams la tha mal gyi/ /spyod pa rab tu ston mdzad phyir/ /gal te deng 'dir bdag cag dor/ khyod ni bde bar bzhu sa pa legs/ /bdag la gsol ba'i don zhig 'tshal/ /thugs rje brtse mnga' mgon pos 'di/ /rab tu dgyes pas gsan gyur ste/ /dam pa rtsol bar mdzad par rigs/ /las ngan tsā na lha ra bdag /rnyed dka'i mi yi lus thob kyang / /blun pos rin chen sdod rnyed nas/ /mi gtsang 'phyag par byed de bzhin/ /sngon chad bag med dbang du gyur/ /da ni tshe yi lhag ma 'dir/ /rten bzang gru 'di la brten nas/ /snying po rin chen len par 'dod/ /'on kya /ra du ma grub na/ /lus ni chu yi sbya ba 'dra/ rnam shes mar

me lta bu ste/ /longs spyod rnams ni sgyu ma 'dra/ /tshe srog ri gzar chu ltar 'gro/ /srid nga 'i rgya mtshor zhugs pa bdag /las kyi rlung gis rab bskyod de/ /'khor ba srin mo'i gling du 'khyer/ bde 'gro'i dag ma gur spyod pa'i mthar/ /ngan 'gro'i lcags khang nang bcug ste/ /sdug bsngal srin ma'i zas su byed/ 'di mthong kho bo rab tu skyo/ /dal 'byor gru gzings la brten nas/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho las brgal te/ /snying po'i rin chen len 'dod bdag /thabs mkhas ded dpon dam pa bral/ /bskal pa bskal pa du ma nas/ /bdag la thugs rje'i thugs mnga' zhing / /gang gis mngon mdzad yon tan kun/ sems can don du mngon mdzad pa/ /thub dbang smra ba'i nyi ma de/ /bdag cag bsod nams stobs dman pa'i/ /nub kyi rir ni 'dzegs par bstan/ /nyon mongs nad kyis gdungs bdag la/ /gang des sman mchog bstsal thos kyang / /ma rig ling tog stug po yis/ /shes rab mig ni sgrib gyur pas/ /bdag sa/sa kun nas ma mthong ba'i/ /sman de bdag la ston mdzad pa/ /dri ma med nga 'i dpal ldan sachog /thub pa'i zhal skyin dam pa zhig /lha yi cod pan dbus bzhugs zhes/ sarba tā ra mi yi gzugs/ /blo gros chen po'i gsung 'a/sa thos/ /brtse ba'i thugs kyis dgyes dgongs nas/ /mngon sum zhal bzang lta bar gsol/ zhes zhus shing / blon po gzhan gnyis kyis kyang phyag btsal cing zhus pa//9

spyan hur re mdzad de/ ha las pa'i tshul gyis kye tshe dang ldan pa 'di dag ci zer/ nga'i lus 'di yang mi mthong ngam nga rgan po ldang byed dkar ba gting nas thon/ /mgo skyes gnag pa dkar por gyur/ bzhin gnyer mas bzung / dbang po dwangs ma rnams ni nyams/ lus ni gzhu ltar gug cing ri ltar lci ba 'di lta bu zhig sgo 'di'i phyir rkang pa ma bzhag par lo bcu dang zla ba bcu song bas/dri med dpal ldan zer ba mchod gnas yin pa lta ci mthong thos kyang mi dran gsungs/ 'o na gong du sangs rgyas dngos gyur bla ma dam pa mjal/ zhes ma gsungs lags sam zhus pas/ ci zer/ sangs rgyas dngos gyur bla ma dam pa zhes smras na/ dri med dpal ldan yin dgos sam/ de ni za hor rgyal po'i khab tu 'khrungs pa'i dge slong chen po dze+e ro tsa na yin mod gsungs pas/ yang gsol ba/kye ma bdag cag stod dang ldan par lhas dgongs su gsol/ 'phags ma ma ti mahā ni mi bden pa gsung ba'i go skabs ga la yod/ khyad par lha'i sras kyis kyang yod par zhal gyis bzhes pas/ ci nas kyang brtse bas bzung du gsol zhes gsum gas phyag byas pas/ sras la cer gyis gzigs te/ dri med dpal ldan zer ba gang du yod/khyod kyis mthong yod par snang na khyod rang khong rnams la ston cig gsungs/ sras kyis kyang / 'jigs shing bag tsha ba dang gus pa'i rnam /gyur gyis/ blon po 'di dag bsam pa bzang ba lags pas
