thugasarjes bzung kyi gsal zhus pa cung zad mnyam par bzhag ste/slar zhal 'dzum bag dang bcas/ e ma snod ldan bag chags sad pa 'di/ /ngo mtshar kun gyi phul du che bar mthong / / nor lha'i phyogs su kha gtad brag phug la/ /nyin byed 'od stong ldan yang ci zhig bya/ /rul zhing chud zos gyur pa'i sa bon la/ lha yi rgyal po'i char gyis ga la phan /shar phyogs la lha'i ri bo'i rtse mo na/ /sprin bral nyi 'od phog pa su yis sgrib/ /chu lud sa tshogs nus ldan sa bon gyis/ /phyu gu dus su bskyed pa su yis 'gog snod ldan dad pa'i me long dri med ngos/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i snang brnyan shar ba yang / /kho bos bgegs su byed pa nus min pas/ /gsol ba thobs dang 'dod don myur du 'grub/ /dri med pad+ma 'gro ba'i mgon po de/ /snyigs dus 'gro la thub dbang zhal bskyen te/ /ngo mtshar sku yi bkod pa'i rnam rol ni/ /ngos bzung nus pa'i tshur rol mthong ba med/ sangs rgyas zhing dang zhing gzhan lta ci smos/ /zhing 'dir la las shar du sku 'khrungs shing /shar du bzhugs zer de bzhin lho la'ang ste/ /phal cher nub dang dbus dang skabs 'gar byang / /sku yi bkod pa bye ba du ma yis/ blo dang 'tshams par gdams pa'i bdud rtsi stol/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ /'gro ba'i mgon po de ni mi rten phyir/ /skal med rnams kyi mdun du'aji de mi mthong / /'khrul ba'i sgos pa dag pa'i skyes bu

la/ /'bral ba'i go skabs nam yang yod pa min/ zhes gsu ngas pas blon po gsum rab tu dga'o de na sras rgyal po dang / blon po gsum sngar bzhin sras kyi pho brang du slar yang gshegs pa dang /zhag gsum song ba dang / sras rgyal ngo blon po gsum dang bcas pa mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor ba /ster la yab kyi drung du zhog cig ces byung bas/ sras kyes ma chod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyabapa myur du sta gon byas te drung du song nas/ sras kyis skab la gsol ba/ /lha'i sku bde ba la gnas sam/ sngon zhag bdun du 'ong bar bka' bstsal na/ deng zhag gsum 'das nas shog ces gsu nga ba dgos pa ci zhig gi slad du bka' bstsal zhes gsol bas/ deng bla ma dri ma med pa'i dpal gshegs par 'gyur ba'i don de'i phyir yin no gsungasate/ sa gzhi rnams dri zhim spros kyi chus chags chags dang byi dor legs par byas/ khri la sogs pa'i bkod pa mdzes par bshams pa'i mdun du mchod gtor dpag tu med pa bshams/ de nas yab nyid thal mo sbyar te nub tu zhal gzigs nas gso la 'debs drag tu mdzad cing / khyod rnams kyis spros bsregs pa dang / rol mo drag tu gyis shig gsungs/ de ltar byas pas re zhig na rgyal po nyid phyag 'khar ba la brten nas sgo 'gram na phar spos ring thogs te byon pa dang lhan cig tu nub phyogs nas tshur la 'od kyi lam dkar po sna ༵ brkyangs pa lta bu/ sne mo khye'u mang pos bzung ste/ snam

ba sgril ba ltar byed pa zhig nas/ dge slong sku dar la babs pa/pan zhu dang chos gos snam sbyar gsol ba/ spyan gnya' zhing gang tsam du gzigs pa/ shin tu zhi zhing dul ba la/ 'khor de dang 'dra ba'i dge slong brgyad kyis bskor ba/ gzhan yang mchod pa byed pa'i lha'i bu dang bu mo mang pos/ mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod bzhin par gshegs pa'i tshe/ rgyal blon rnams kyis phyag byas pas/ thog ma nyid du ye shes 'dzin la gzigs te/ tshe rabs sngon nas rigs kyi sras/ /nga yi yi dam lha dam pa/ badz+ra badz+ra gi la ya/ khyod kyi 'dod pa'i lha yin no/ zhes gsungs/ der khri mtho ba la bla ma bzhugs su gsol/ khri gzhan brgyad la dge slong gzhan brgyad bzhugs pa dang lhan cig tu mchod pa du mas mchod pa dang bcas te yab kyis gsol ba btab pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /'gro ba kun gyi 'dren pa rje/ /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag rin po che/ /bla ma chen po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mthar 'dzin dri ma kun spangs pas/ /dri ma med pa'i mchan mnga' ba/ /dag pa ye shes stong pa'i sku/ /snang ba mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje chen po chos kyi dbyings/ /bde ba chen po rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje nyid du sdom mdzad pa/ /mi bskyod rdo rje la phyag 'chal/ /tshad medare skong 'dzin bral zhing / /kun la mnyam nyid rin chen gter/ /ji bzhin gzigs pa'i ye shes mnga'/ /rin chen 'byung //sa

khyed la 'dud/ /'dod chags chen po bde ba che/ /bde ba che las ma g.yos par/ /so sor rtogs mnga' pad+ma'i mtshan/ /pad+ma'i zhing 'dzin khyed la 'dud/ /phrag dog chen po'i stobs bcom zhing /'du byed med pa 'du byed mchog /'phrin las mkha' ltar mtha' yas pa/ /don kun grub pa khyed la 'dud/ /rnam par snang ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /mun pa stug po rab bcom pa/ /rgyal ba kun gyi sku yi dngos /me long ye shes bdag der 'dud/ /mthari yas ye shes thams cad kyang / /lhan skyes ye shes chen po yi/ /rigs ni gcig pur sdom mdzad pa/ /rigs kun bdag po khyed la 'dud/ /khams gsum 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig pu/ /mar mes mi shes mun pa sel/ /phul byung mdzad pa kun gyi bdag ye shes mdzod 'dzin khyed la 'dud/ /bdag cag thugs kyi brtses dgongs te/ /gsung gi bdud rtsi sgo phye nas/ /nyon mongs nad rab sel du gsol/ /mchod sbyin dam pa mdzod du gsol/ zhes zhus pas/ de'i zhal nas/ /rgyal kun gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin gsang ba'i bdag /gang gis rjes bzung sngon bsags bsod nams kyi/ /dpung mnga' sa spyod rgyal po nga la gson/ /chos kyi rang bzhin mkha' ltar stong pa'i dbyings/ /'gro med 'ong med 'du 'bral ga la yod/ /kun rdzob snang ngor dngas pa'i rdzing bu'i dbus/ /zla gzugs bzhin du sgyu ma'i ros gar mkha6// ri/zla ba'i gzugs la zla ba zhen gyur pa'i/ /byis pa rnams

kyis chos kyi don ma rtogs/ /sgro mas bslus pa'i skyes bu gang gi zor/ /sgyu ma'i mdzes mas 'dod pa'i don byed ltar/ /ngas kyang 'gro ba rnams kyi don byed de/ /ngo mtshar 'di ni /skyod kyi spyod yul yin/ zhes gsungs so/ de bzhin du sras rgyal po dang / ye shes 'dzin sogs blon po rnams rang rang gis gsol ba btab cing /blon po gsum gyi wa ra ṇa mi'i byung ba rnams kyang zhus so/ de nas slar yang yab rgyal pos/ gser gyi maṇ+ḍal khru do pa/ rin po che mar gad kyi phra btab pa la/ mu tig gi tshom bus phyur bur gtamasapa phul nas/ gsol ba btab pa/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi ngo ba nyid/ /thugs rje chen po'i bla ma dgongs su gdo la/ /thog/sa med 'khor bar yang yang 'khyams pa bdag /las kyi dbang gis nub phyogs yul 'dir skyes/ /gzhon nu'i dus nas rgyal srid btson rwar tshud/ /bsam pa rnyed nas dam pa'i chos la dad/ /shar phyogs mkhas pa budhe'i zhabs la sogs/ /lung rtogs mtha' yas yongs 'dzin du ma bstan/ /khyad par 'gran gyi do med rin po che /dus gsum sangs rgyas khyed kyi rjes su bzung / /tshe rabs kun gyi mgon du zhal gyis mches/ /ngo mtshar zab mo'i gdams pa du ma bstsal/ /lus ngag yid gsum dge ba'i las la sbyar/ /khyed kyis bka' drin ma lus gzhal ba ni/ /stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten chen po 'di/ /yid bzhin nor gyis bar mtshams med bkang ste/ /phul kyang6 cha

tsam 'khor ba ga la srid/ /'on kyang bdag cag bsod nams gsag slad du/ /rgyal srid 'bangs bcas ma lus khyed la 'bul/ /tshe rabs kun tu thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ zhes gsol btab/sras rgyal pos kyang de 'dra ba'i maṇ+ḍal phul te gsol ba btab/ blon po gsum gyis kyang rang rang gi yo byad ci 'byor pa phul te gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas blon po gsum la/ kye snod ldan dag lam gang la mos/ mgrin gcig tu/ theg pa chen po la'o/yang slob dpon gyis/ de'i nang gses gang la mos gsungs/ rdo rje theg pa la'o zhus/ de'i yang nang gses gang la mos gsungs shin tu rnal 'byor lags so zhus pas slob dpon gyi zhal nas/gang zhig dam chos tshul bzhin bsgrub 'dod na/ /'jig rten 'di yi don gnyer bzlog par gyis/ /nges 'byung thar pa'i lam sna zin 'dod na/ /srid la bsams pa'i 'dod pa ring du thongs/ /theg pa chen po'i don la mos gyur na/ /bdag nyid kho na bde 'dod 'khri ba chod/ /mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal 'dod na/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i sa bon drung nas phyungs/ /bla med theg pa mchog la mos gyur na/ /dam tshig sdom pa mig gi 'bras ltar srungs/ zhes gsungs te theg pa chen po thun long ba'i lam gyi rim pa la 'khrid cing byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed rgyal po yab sras dang bcas lhan cig tu lha/ ༵'i lha'i dkyil 'khor du bcug nas dbang bskur/ zab pa dang

rgya che ba'i gdams pa du ma bstsal cing / tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba sogs ngo mtshar brjod las 'das kyang gsang ba'i gtam sgrog tu mi rung ba mang bas gzhag go/ mthar rgyal blon rnams la thun mong du bka' bstsal pa/ /kye ma ngo mtshar chos kyi dbyings/ /grags stong sgra brnyan lta bu yi/ /brjod med brjod pa'i tshig 'di la/ /chos rgyal yab sras blon bcas nyon /'du 'bral med kyang 'du 'bral ba/ /sgyu ma'i rol rtsed ngo mtshar che/ /chos dbyings ye shes ngang nyid na/ /dge slong nga dang 'bral ba meng/ /rtag tu gsol ba snying nas thobs/ byin rlabs myur du 'byung ngo bu/ /da nas mi ring rang cag kun/ /'di nas byang shar phyogs su 'gro/ /byang phyogs gnas de ngo mtshar che/ /gangs kyi ri bo'i 'phreng ba ni/ /rab dkar shel 'phreng bsgrigs pa 'dra/ /spang gi ri bos bskor ba ni/ /gser g.yu'i 'phreng ba bsgrigs pa 'dra/ rtsi shing nags tshal rab tu rgyas/ /snyan pa'i sgra 'byin bya tshogs 'du/ /mdzes pa'i ni'u seng me tog dang / /yan lag brgyad ldan chu bo mang / /mdzes pa'i gnas bzang 'ga' zhig ni/ /sum rtsen lha yi gnas la 'gran/ /'jigs pa'i gnas mchog 'ga' zhig ni/ /srin yul laṅka pu ri 'dra/ /skye bo'i gnas mchog 'gar bltas na/ yi dwags grong khyer ser skya 'dra/ /gnas de'i skye bo'i tshogs rnams kyang / /longs spyod chen pos mi g.yengs shing / /longs spyod ha cang chung du'ang min6/7 /

zhe sdong 'dod chags shas che zhing / /dad dang skyo shas gsar 'grogs tshe/ /blo sna mang zhing 'dod thag nye/ de 'dra'i skye bos gang gyur cing / 'dre srin gdug pa mang ba'i gnas/ /thugs rje chen po'i zhing khams te/ /da lta chos kyi sgra mi grags/ /da nas mi ring chos sgra sgrog rgyal po lha yi tshan can dang / /de bzhin khri yi mtshan mnga' ba/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang sprul pa 'byung / /dam pa'i gnas der byin brlab 'gyur/ /de tshe rigar phyogs rgya nag tu/ /rgyal po ma sho chen po khyod/ /seng ge'i ming mnga' rgyal por 'gyur/ /da lta 'phur 'gro'i gnas bzhugs pa'i/ /spru la pa'i gzugs brnyan dam pa yang /de tshe khyod kyi mchod gnas byed/ /dge sbyong bdag gi smon lam dang / /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs rje dang / /gdong dmar 'gro ba'i bsod nams las/ /rgyal po ma sho khyod nyid ngang / /blo gros che mo ma bu yi/ thabs mkhas bya ba der yang bsgyur/ /gzugs brnyan dam pa'i 'phrin las kyis/ /skye rgu du ma'i bsod nams spel/ /de nas slar yang mi ring bar/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang sprul pa'i gar /'jam dpal dbyangs dang dbyer med pa'i/ /rgyal po me tog ces byar grags/ /rgya chen smon r+ṣa/ma mthu btsan pas/ /'phags pa'i yul nas dam chos bsgyur/ /bdag kyang de tshe gnas der 'gro/ /lha srin gdug pa kun 'dul zhing / /tha mal rten 6sdunas du ma yang / /rdo rje'i gnas su byin gyis rlobs/ /gsang

sngagasachos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /kye ma chos rgyal chen po khyod/ /der ni rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sras/ /rgyal po khri'am btsan po'i ming / /lha sras de tsho'ang rgyal por 'gyur/ /ye shes 'dzin ni de yi tshe/ /ar+ya sa le 'od ces grags/ /mi ring gnas der sdig spyod can/ /rgyal po dar ma'i ming 'dzica gyis/ /thub pa'i bstan pa snub byed de/ /'on kyang rigs gsum mgon po dang / /nye sras brgyad kye rnam sprul pa/ /khrims ldan dge sbyor dam pa 'gas/ /bstan pa rim gyis gso zhing skyong / /de nas slar yang pad dkar 'chang / /dge bsnyen tshul du 'byung 'gyur zhing / /smon lam dbang sge/sa kho bo yang /shar phyogs rgyal po'i bu yi tshul/ phul byung da sbyong dam pa zhig /smon lam rgyal ba'i 'dun btab pa'i/ /'bras bu gnas der smin par 'gyur/ /lha khyod de tshe brtson 'grus ming / /shes rab che zhing tshul khrims dag /lha sras de tsho rgya gar du/ /rgyal po dharma'i ming du 'gyur/ /ye shes 'dzin khyod de yi tshe/ /khri mchog dpal 'byor rnal 'byor 'dzin/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dang kun tu bzang /'phab/sa pa'i gnas brtan mang po yang / /de tshe mi yi gzugs kyis rol/ /e ma ngo mtshar shin tu che/ /gtsang ma'i bstan pa'i sgron me ni/ /chu la khrims dri bzang phyogs kun khyab /ting 'dzin sdong po sra ba la/ /shes rab 'od kyis mun pa sel/ /de lta'i bstanapa'i thon me ni/ /re zhig gnas par rab tu gsal/ /'a/sdug

mchog dam pa du ma yi/ /bstan pa de la bya ba byed/ /'on kyang log pa'i chos spyod pa/ /mang pos bstan de rim gyis 'grib/ /tha mar lha ra'i ming 'dzin pa'i/ /sdig spyod stobs dnge ldan zhig dang /gzhan yang de ltar bdun gyis ni/ /bstan pa yongs su nyams par byed/ bdag dang spyan ras gzigs dbang sogs/ rigs gsum mthon gyi sprul pa 'gas/ /skabs 'gar rab tu byung ba'i tshul/ /res 'gas stobs ldan rgyal po'i tshul/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyi 'gro don spyod/ da dung nyon dang rgyal blon rnams/ /kho bo'i sprul pa'i zlos gar mchog /gnas der mang byung 'di lta ste /shar nas blo gros bzang po ( je rin po che tsong kha pa )grags/ /sto nas bsod nams rin chen (sgam pa ba )'dzin/ /nub tu kun dga'i rgyal mtshan (sa paṇa )sgrog /byang du nyi ma 'od zer (ba tshab lo ts+tsha ba )grags/ /de sogs grangs las 'das pa yis/ /mtha' yas 'gro la phan pa dang / /bstan pa rin chen spel bar byed/ rgyal po khyod kyang gnas gang der/ /skye ba du ma len 'gyur zhing / res 'gas khrims ldan mkhan po ste/ /skye bo du mar gdam ngag 'bog /skabs 'gar stobs ldan rgyal po'i tshul/ /mtha' 'khob mang po dbang du 'dud/ /yongs su grags dag mdor bstan na/ /nashā mkha' lta/ /gas bla me dang / /da/ pa byashā chub dpashā na shā/ /smon

la ṭā ye shes ri/ chen dang / /slar yang yin chen bshāne nams /nā/ /de sogs mtshan gyi zur ldan pa/ /du mas 'gro la phan pa sbyong / /tsa ma ri zhes grags pa sogs/ /khyod kyis gnas gzhir mang du 'byung / /ma 'ongs rnam par gnon pa zhes/ /rgyal ba de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur/ /ye shes 'dzin yang shes rab dang /'o/ dang da/ bcom lha sangashā rgyas/ /rmi ñcā na yo/ tan dang / snyeṭā shes ra / / 0dra da// / /dri me/2 bso/3 nams kun /shā dga'/ji byarje ngaX dbang kau ldan pa/ /'a// las dang ni /sbya zhes/ /ming du 'dzin sogs du ma yis/ /gnas der 'gro la phan pa sbyong / /ma 'ongs dri med mtshan mnga' ba'i/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'tshang rgya 'gyur/ /lha sras bha dra khyod nyid ni/ /dbang phyug ming ldan lnga dag dang / /grags pa ye shes lha la sogs/ /sngon gyi las smon dbang gis ni/ /phal cher rgyal ngo 'am khyim bdag ste/ /bstan la dad pa'i rigs su skye/ /nyirmi ti dang dharma ta/ /dge ba'i bsam pa ma nyams pa ra /skye ba 'di yi 'og ma na bde ba can du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /kye ho ya ba rje mi ring bar/ /lcang lo can gyi zhi/1 du

'gro/ /sras kyi chab srid lo mang brtan /dharma myur du tshe dus byed/ /ye shes 'dzin dang dharma ti/ /shar gyi phyogs su slar yang 'gro/ /wa ra ṇa si'i rgyal khab tu/ /da dung bdag cag lhan cig 'dzoms/ e ma de ltar lung bstan pa/ /lha yis ji ba lgen rab mthong yang / /lha sras blon rnga bcas pa dag /yid ches phyir du cung zad bstan/ /skye zhing skye ba bca/sa cad du/ / yongs su 'dzin par bdag gyur ro/ zhes gsungs te shar phyogs su gshegs so/ de nas yab rgyal po ni sngar ltar bzhugs/ blon po gsum sras kyi blon po bya dgos par bka' bstsal kyang nan gyis zhus nas/rang rang skang ba'i bsam gtan gyi khang bu re brtsigs/ te/ rtse gcig tu sgrub pa la brtson pas/ a cor+sha'i lung bstan bzhin/ dharma tshe'i dus byas te dag pa'i zhing du skyes so/ sku byis pa'i skabs dang / chos blon gsum nub phyogs su gshegs pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o/ / / /de nas rgyal bu lo bcu pa'i dus su stong dpon gyi bu la sogs pa gzhon nu'i tshogs kyis bskor te/ grong khyer gyi srang zhig nas mar byon pas/ rnal 'byor pa bgres po skra dang sma ra ring zhing dkar ba lus rid pa sprul sgyur sna tshogs shes pa zhig snang bas thams cad kyis mi ma yin zhes 'jigs skrag byas pa la sras kyis 'di grub pa brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa 'dra yin srid pas la ga ā na song la gtam dris shi/ /sungs pas/ gsungs pa bzhin gtam dris pas/ nga ni gar 'gro

radir 'gro med di zer/ yul gang nas yin/ i ḍi ya na /kā 'ongs/ mtshan ci zer/ bram ze tha rlu pa'am/ grong 'jug mkhan pozhes zer/ ces shes/ chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur ston pa'i bstan bcos shes so/ gzhan ci shes/ de'i don yang shes so/ skyabs gang yin/ dkon mchogagasum yin no/ dgra su yin/ nyon mongs pa'o/rgyal po su yin/ sangs rgyas yin no/ de la sogs pa'i gtam mang du dris nas rgyal bu la zhus pas rgyal bu rab tu dgyes nas nang pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig yin 'dug pas pho brang du spyan 'dren zhu dgos gsungs/ rgyal bu nyid byon nas rnal 'byor pa'i zhabs spyi bor blangs te pho brang du 'byon par gsol ba btab pas/ nga pho brang du mi 'gro yi gsungs te/ nan cher byas kyang 'byon du ma 'dod pas/'o na thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas/ ri dwags rnams gdul byar 'gyur ba la dgongs nas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur te/rgyal bu dang la ga ma na gnyis la zab lam grong 'jug dang bde mchog la sogs pa'i sngags bla na med pa'i gdoms pa bstsal/ rnal 'byor rang gi snying ga ral gris gzhags te snying 'khor la sdom pa'i rnam pa khru lam mer yod pa bstan te/ nags gseb tu gshegs so/ rgyal bu pho brang du byon nas lo rgyus bsnyad pa yab kyi gsan te/ rnal 'byor pa mchod gnas su spyan 'dren par byed dgos dgongs te nyin du ma'i bar nags gseb na btsal kyang ma rnyed/ de nas yab kyi rgyal bu gzhon 78

nu byang chub sems dpa' 'di sku bgres par gyur pa'i cha 'gro don mi 'byung bas grong 'jug slob pa shin tu legs 'dug grong 'jug sbyang bar zhu zhus pa bzhin/ pho brang gi rtse cho ra la ga a na dang gnyis kyis grong 'jug slob pa la gus pa'i tshe/ rgyal po'i bla shing gi rtse nas gser gyi mdog can gyi bya mgo bo g.yu lta bu rkang pa byu ru lta bu can/ snyan 'gyur gre ba'i lam nas mi skad kyi dbyangs smra bas 'di skad do/ phyogs ni lho yi gru 'dzin nas/ /lha ni legs byin myur skyobasam/ /nga ni de yi bya ma rta/ /leṭa smras ngag la ma nyan par/ /blon chen ngan pas bsgyur ba ni/ /spros ngad ngos kyi gla ba bzhin/ /legs par brtag dpyad ma byas na/ /bzang bzang lta bus bslus pa mang / /gangasacan ri yi rgan rgon dang / /wa ra ṇa si'i rgyal po 'dra/ zhes da dung mu mthud nas smra grabs la/ btsun mo nges legs kyis mthong nas bltar song ba dang 'phrad pas bya ngo mtshar can 'di ci yin nam smras pas/ mtshar ro ngo mtshar bya de mtshar/ /nga las rgyal po rigs ldan mtshar/ /pho brang rtse yi sras gcig de/ bskal pa'i bar du sdod grabs gyis/ /lo 'ga'i tshe yang phung ba 'dra/ /phugs phyis ngan pa byed pa kun/ /'phral du 'phung ba 'byung nyen che/ /'phags ma gshegs la nye mthong nas/ /bya nga bsu ba byed par 'ongs/ ha ha zhes god thengs gsum byas pas/ btsun mos gtam zhig 'dri snyam pa dang 'phur nas7 sdung ste/ sras bzhugs pa'i khang pa'i zur du babs nas skad snyan

pos 'di skad smras so/ /byang chub sems pa'i khyi'u chung / /e ma thog med khri'u chung / /'gro don nags kyi khrod du yod/ /da ni nags khrod gsheṭa cas ran/ /po ṭa la nas rje btsun cha sa//de skad gsungs so riṭakyi bu/ /bdud kyis bslu bar skad na'ang / /don du dgi ba'i bskul mar gyur/ zhes gsungs pa dang / la gā ā nas bltas pa dang 'phur nas gar song cha med du song ngo / de nas rgyal blon gnyis kyis grong 'jug sbyangs te pha rol po'i phung po la lus rnying pa dor nas skad cig gis 'jug nus pa byung / rgyal pos kyang de'i dga' ston rgya chen po mdzad do/ sras dgung lo bcu gsum lon pa'i skabs su mi shis pa'i ltas mang po byung / thams cad ci yin zhes gleng ba'i skabs su/— yum ma ti mahā ni snyun gyis btab pa dang / thams cad yid ma bde nas yum mi bzhugs pa yin nam zhes gleng zhing / mnga' 'og gi mig sman mkhan bra mkhan mo ma sogs kha 'tsham par yum btsun mo ma ti mahā ni la ngan no/ zhes zer bas rgyal pos kyang gnyug ma'i dge 'dun dang gzhan gyi yul nas dge 'dun spyan 'dren pas mtshon rim 'gro rgya chen po byas kyang / de nas ma thar bar rje thur yod pa'i skabs shig tu/ sras pho brang gi yang rtser bzhugs yod pa/ glo bur du yum gyi drung du byon zhig zer bas myur du byon pas/ rgyal po dang nang 'khor mang po yang slebs nas 'dug pa la/ rgyal pos snyun dris pas/ kye ma sa spyod mi dbang bdag la gson/ blo ldan chen po sku drin //ga

nyid lags/ /de ring kho mo 'chi ba'i dus la glibs/ /gang du song kyangang la sdug bsngal med/ /sa spyod chen po mya ngan ma mdzad cig /'khoraba'i gnas la 'khyams pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /'dus pa'i tha mar 'bral ba chos nyid lags/ /kho mo gzhon nu'i dus nas yab kyi drung / /dkonamachog gsum gyi mchod pa'i las la brtson/ /slob dpon chen po sku ba bha dra dang / /bu dha'i zhabs sogs du mas rjes ༄ bzung / /khyad par dri med dpal ldan 'gro ba'i mgon/ /nub phyogs yul du dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur/ dus gsum kun gyi bla ma yin no gsungs/ /de nas rab tu byung bar 'dod na yang / /las kyi dbang gis wa ra ṇa sir bskyal/ /rgyal po khyod kyang dkon mchog gsum la mos/ /bdag gis mchod pa byed par ma bkag cing / /sems can kun la dmiṭa pa'isnying rje skyes/ 'bangs rnams kho mo'i ngag la brtsi ba yis/ /thams cad dge ba spyod cing skyabs 'gro byed/ /bdag ni dge sdig 'dres mar da pa'i snyir/ /'gyod pa med pa'i gdengs shig ma mchis kyang / /mi tsher rku 'phrog srog gcod kho na byed/ mtshams da lnga spyod mi yang 'chiba'i / /'gyod pa med cing brjod pa mang ba na/ /bdag la 'tsher ba gang yang ma mchis so/ rgyal po khyod kyis kho mo med shul na/ /sdig pa ma lhad dge ba ci cher bskyed/ /nges legs nges mdzangs bzang mo la sogs pa'i/ /btsun mo rnams kyang bdag bzhin brtse bar skyongs/ /khyadalha sbyar bdag cag rnams kyi snying gcig / ga na nu'i lus can chos

kyi dga' ba 'dis/ /rgyal po khyod kyi rgyal srid 'dzin pa dka'/ /'on kyang khyod kyis 'di nyid bsrung bar mdzod/ /nang blon chos la mos dang rigs rus mtho/ /rang dang spyod mthun brtse bar sems pa rnams/tshogs nas mdun gros byed pa'i dus na yang / kun dang gros bsdur gros thag rang gis chod/ /blon ngo ma 'dzin thad gar drang po gyis snying nas phan par smra la gces par mdzod/ /rang nyid ma gtags kun rgyus lon par dka'/ /snying dang 'dra ba'i bzang pos bslus pa mang //thams cad yun ring bar du brtag par dgos/ /rgyal po bya ba ri ltar brtan dam/sa pas/ smras tshad bden du bzung na rung ma yin/ /yab mes rnams kyi srol bzang tshul bzhin dgos/ /srol bzang nub na rgyal srid 'jig pa yin/ /rang dang gzhan don byed snyam gang yin kyang / /sems la bsam pa ngag nas smra mi bya/ /ngag nas smras nas ji bzhin 'bad pas sgrubs/ /ma grub bar du yal bar 'dor mi rung mnga' 'bangs 'di dag khyod kyi bsod nams mthus/ /khyod nyid gcig la kunagyis bkur bas na/ /'di dag dor na khyong nyid khrel med yin/ /thamasacad dge ba'i las la bsku mu bar gyis/ /nye ring med par thams cad legs par skyongs/ /srog gcod rku 'phrog 'dod ngan spyod pa dang / /rdzun phu tshig rtsub ba ba sems gnod sems sogs/ /lus ngag yid kyi mi dge spyong pa rnams/ /spang du 'jug pa'i khri /sa sdom legs par zungs/ /nyes can tshig gis lcags kyus thul na leṭa/ /ma thul ku/ la

gnod par byed pas na/ gcig la gnod pa dgos kyang 'jam mi bya/nyes pa chung la drag shul khrims mi gcod/ /rgan la dmod dang dma'adabab byed mi 'jug /bca/sa cad rgyu 'bras spyod dang skyabs 'gror slobs/ /'bangs rnams skyong zhing 'bangs kyi pha ma mdzod/ /phyogs kyirgyal por rang mnyam mthun par 'grogs/ /mthon po rnams la bkur zhing bstod pa gyis/ /leṭa pa'i lam gyi chos khrims dam par sdoms/ de ltar byas na bde ba dpag med 'byung / /mnga' 'bangs rnams la bde legs gong du 'phel/ /kun gyi nyid la bkur ba'i gnas su 'gyur/ /yang cig chos la bkro ba'i kha chems yod/ /'jig rten 'di na sangs rgyas 'byon pa dka'/ /de yi bstan dang mjal ba de bas dkon/ /dal 'byor thob nas rang dbang 'byor dus 'dir/ /bstan labakur bsti'i bya ba cis mi bgyid/ /nye brgyas gtsos pa'i 'khor ba 'di nyid las/ skyobs par nus pa gzhan ni gang yang med/ /nyes pa kun bral yon tan rin chen gter /dkon mchog gsum la snying nas blo gtad bcol/ /gang zhig tshul khrims bag yod brtul zhugs te/ /yan lag 'di dag thub pas rgyal po sogs /blo ldan khyim na gnas la mchog tu bsngags/ /mi mchog dpa' bos 'di dag legs par bzhes/ lus dang srog la nges par babs na yang / /skyabs bzang rin chen gsum po nga mi bya/ /skye zhing skye bar chos bzhin spyod pa ru/78/skye bo'i smon lam yang dang yang du thobs/ /sa spyod mkhas pa'i

dbang po chen po la/ /dman pa'i bud med dag gis gsol mi —tshal//ron kyang 7 ba'i tha ma 'di yin pas/ /sa spyod khyod kyis tshul bzhin spyod par mdzod/ ces sogs dang / tshig lhug pa'i gtam yang mdzad/ gzhan yang skye 'phreng gi lung bstan 'ga' re yod kyang 'og nas byi'u'i lung bstan dang don la khyad med pas ma bkod/ de ltar gsungs pa'i mjug tu/ kye lha gson cig rgyal po khyod dang nga 'groṭa nas snying gcig pa lta bu las rgyal pos bdag ma bskyangs snyam pa dang / bdag gis rgyal po la gus pa ma bgyis bsam pa yang med/ da ni kun gyi chos nyid kun 'gro ba'i la ma der bdag 'gro nas ran pas rgyal po la sogs pa mya ngan ma mdzod cig gsungs pas rgyal po bshum zhing phyag la 'jus nas smra ba/ kye ma kye hud brtse ldan ma/ /de ring bdag la cung zad dgongs/ /kho bo sngon bsags bsod nams kyis/ /rgyal po'i rigs su skye ba blangs/ /lang tsho yongs su ma dzogs par/ /rnam g.yengs le lo'i 'dam du byings/ /de nas khyod nyid khab tu mchis/ /kho bo dam pa'i chos la sbyar/ /khyod kyi bka' drin bsam las 'das/ /btsun mo du ma mchis mod kyang / /btsun mo dam pa khyod med na/ /kye ma kho bo ji ltar byed/ /kho jo ji srid 'tsho yibar/ /khyod ni cis kyang bzhugs par mdzod/ / gal te de lhar ma gyur kyang / /gzhon nu rgyal sar ma 'khod bar/ /bzhugs par thugs rjes dgongs par mdzod/ ces gsungs pa dang / slar yang 7/ma

gyis/ yang citho gson dang sa spyod rigs ldan spyol/ /bslu med dkonamachog skyabs su bzung ba'i mthus/ /skye rang skye bar rgyal ba'i bstan dang mjal/ /dam pa'i chos la mos pa thob par 'gyur/ /kye ma mya nganam mdzod chas kyi rgyal/ /nga dang 'dra ba'i btsun mo mang du mchis/ /kho mo mi 'chi rang dbang ga 'a yod/ gnas par 'dod kyang ma shi su zhig gzigs/ sngon gyi las kyi 'phen pa'i mthu zad na/ /'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po che rnams kyang / /longs spyod bsam yas dor te gcig bur 'chi/ /pad ma'i skye bo'ang de ltar 'chi gyur te/ /dbul zhing 'phongs pas nyen pa'i skye bo yang / /rang gi zas ngan longs spyod bor te 'gro/ /rgyal rang rang rgyal rgyal sras nyan thos kyang /sku lus spangs te 'da' bar mdzad 'gyur na/ /bdag cag skye bo phal pa lta ci smos/ /'di ni bdag nyid gcig pur ma laṭa kyi/ /rgyal po kun gyi yinapa /khyen par mdzod/ ces gsungs pas/ rgyal po skya ngan gyis rab tu non te smra ma nus so/ der sras kyi yum la 'jus te/ /kye gson dang 'phags ma rje btsun sgrol ma dngos /khyod skye dang 'chi bar rang dbang ci phyir med /dus de ring gsol ba'i 'bras bu mi stsol na/ mkhyod kyis sems can yal bar 'dor 'gyur ram/ /khyod gal te 'jig rten gzhan du gshinas gyur na/ /bdag mgon med rgyal bu'i mgon skyabs su la zhu/ /bdag chos kyi dga' ba'i grogs po su la bcol /'basdus 'khor tshogs stos bcas skyabs gnas su la byed/ /ma khyod kyi

bka' drin bsam dang brjod las 'das/ /dus dang por mngal du zla bcu'i bar du bskyangs /dus bar du phyi rol btsas pa'i tshe na yang //nga gcang btsog blang dor mi shes dud 'gro 'dra/ /mi kun gyis byis para'abongs pa'i tshe na yang / /ma khyod kyis ngal dub med par rtag tu bskyangs/ /lus lang tsho'i me tog cung zad rgyas pa nas/ /skyabs bzang po bslu med dkon mchog gsum la sbyar/ /chos ba mo blang dorabadud rtsi bdag la ba la/ /khyod sku drin bsam bzhin sems la bzod glag med/ /da gal te mi bzhuṭa 'jig rten gzhan gshe na/ /bu bdagakyang gar gshegs ci nas 'khrid par mdzod/ ces yum la bcangs te bshums pas/ yum gye phyag zas kyi spyi bor bzhag ste/ kye ma nyon dang gson cig lha yi sras/ /dus gsum kun tu nga mi rjes su 'dzin//mya ngan ma byed nga yi tshig 'di nyon/ /thon dus rgyal ba 'od spung ba na pa la/ /bu khyod rgyal po stobs ba nga shing rta / /sa spyod gri kro'i 'bangs kyi rgyal phran yin/ /khyod thon rgyal bu byams bzang zhes bya ba/ /rgyal ba'i rgya mtsho'i zas su gyur pa'i tshe/ /kho mo rab tu brtan zhes rjes su bzung / 'di gong chos kyi dad par gyur tshe yang / /bdag gi rjes su bzung ba'i snying gi bu/ /ma 'ongs gangs ri'i smongs su bdag cag 'phrad/ /dri med dpal ldan la sogs paṇa chen rnam / /'a ga pa'i yul nas bod du dngos su byon/ /rgyal ba r+ghaṃ mtsho rgyal po'i tshul dubyon/ /khyod kyi yab kyang de blon po'i tshul/ /khyod gi rgyal po de1 yi

sras su gyur/ /slar yang ljongs der rgyal ba rgya mtsho ni/ /dharma sasgo'i mtshan mnga' rgyas par mdzad/ /gnas de ma stong bar du gnas der byung / /khyod kyang rdo rje sangs rgyas grags pa mnga'/ /phu m+me ma ti dharmabod du byung / /mdor na bod du skye ba du ma blangs/ /nga yis yang yangadrin gyis skyong bar gyur/ /rgyal bu khyod nyid 'dor bar dka' na yang //'chi bdag pho nya'i dus kyi zhags pas zin/ /'di las thar ba'i go skabs ga la mchis/ /de ni dus la bab bo mkhyen par mdzod/ /bu khyo dmagon med ma sbo mgon skyabs yod/ /dam pa'i mgon ni dkon mchog rnam gsum ste/ /gang la brten pas mi zad 'khor ba las/ /grol nas rnam grol zhi ba dam par 'byin/ /bu khyod grogs med ma smra grogs yod kyis/ /ji tsam mang du 'dris bzhin bde ba ster/ /gzhung bzang rgud kyang mi 'dor sbyi thag ring / khyod kyi grogs ni dge ba'i las lam yin/ /yab rje dam pa da lta bde bar bzhugs/ /'bangs kyi mgon skyabs de yis mdzad par 'gyur/ rgyal bu khyod ni sngon gyi las dbang gis/ /myur du mi yi gzugs 'di 'dor ba 'gyur/ /'on kyang lus 'dir ji tsam gnas kyi bar/ /yab rje rgyal po thod bzhin bkur ba dang / /mnga' 'bangs 'gro rnams bu bzhin skyong bar mdzod/ /nga dang mi ring myur du 'phrad par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa dang sras kyi yang gsol pa/ kye ma da dung dgongs dang thugs rje'i bdag nyid ma/kho /lha rgyal bu chos kyi dga' bar grags pa 'di/ /sngon ba gas bsod

nams mi dman dal 'byor mi lung thob/ /thob ji ra ca zad bslu med dkon mchog skyabs dang mjal/ /yang cig las ngan dbang gis de ring sdug bsngal thob/ /lang tsho'i me tog chung ngu'i 'dab ma ma rgyas shing / /dam chos bdud rtsi'i bgo skal rgya chen ma thos par/ /bshes gnyen dam pa ma khyod chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/ /phal gyi pha ma drin can tshe dus byas la yang / /bsam med byis rnams mya ngan gdung ba rab thob na/ /'phaṭa ma khyed 'dra'i cha/gon dang bral ba ci mi sdug /dengasang skye bo phal cher dag min las la dga'/ /stobs 'byor dbangathang ldan na dgra bo yin kyang 'dud/ /cung zad rgud par gyur na pha ma yin kyang 'dor/ /phan lan gnod pas 'jal zhing cis kyang mgu mi nus/ snyigs dus skye bo'i ngang tshul bsam bzhin snying nas skyo/ /byis pas byis pa bdag gi blo gtad su la byed /'phaṭa ma khyod kyis spangs na da ni ci bya kye/ /rigs pa'i gnas la rgya chen mang du ma thos shing //yab mes gong ma'i mdzad bzang rgyal srid srol mi shes/ /byis pa'i byisapa bdag gis chos srid ji ltar bgyi/ skye zhing skye bar 'brel ba med par zhal 'chos kyang / /da lta 'bral ba'i snang tshul 'di nyid mthong gyuratshe/ /yid ni the tshom mya ngan gdung bas rab tu gdung / /sa spyod riṭa ldan yab rje chos kyi rgyal po yang / /nges legs nges mdzangs la sogasabatsun mo mang mchis kyang /btsun mo dam pa khyod med thugs la ji ltar bde/ /wa ra ṇa si'i mnga' 'bangs chab srid 'gro rnams kyang / /

chu med bye tshan nang du lhung ba'i nya lta bu/ /khyod mad mya ngan gdung ba'i thang la 'khrum par 'gyur/ /'phags ma thugs bskyed dam bca' dering 'dor 'gyur ram/ zhes brjod cing bshums pas/ yang 'phags ma'i zhal nas/ yang cig gson dang chos kyis dga' ba zhes/ /kho mo'i nga 'dra rgyal zas dam pa khyed/ /bsod nams ci gyir mi gsog legs par soms/ kho mo la mya ngan bya 'tshal/ /sems khrel mi dgos rtag tu bral ba da/ /nga 'gro ri bo po ṭa la tsu 'gro/ /'phags ma'i bka' yis myur du shog ces gsungs/ /nga 'gro rgya gar nub kyi phyogs su 'gro/ / ma chen pos myur du zhog cig gsungs/zhes gsungs pas/ ya zas kyis/ kyi ma da dung dgongs dang thugs rje'i spyan mang ma/ ga na nu'i lus can snying med chos kyi dga' ba nga / /sgro na lo grangs bcu phrag brgal bar gyur na yang / /stom las le lo'i dbang gis don med stong par song / yab yum bka' drin can gyi bka' drin ma lu pa/ /bskal brgya'i bar du bsgrubs kyang ba ma par mi nus kyang / / shas tsam zhig rang cha nus pas gzhal lags na/ /ma grub bar du 'phaṭa ma cis kyang bzhugs par gsol /'phags pa'i bka' yis myur du shog ces gsungs byung na/ /mgon med bdag cag de ring sdug bsngal 'dir gyur pa/ /'phags pas cung zad 'di la dgongs par ma mdzad na/ /thugs rje chen po'i ma / yang mtshan tsam mi 'gyur ram /de bzhin bla ma chen po'i

thugs rje'i bangag nyid kyang / /'gro bkun la thug rje nye ring ma mchis na/ /bdag dang wa ra ṇa si'i 'gro ba ji lta'i 'dor/ bdag gis gsol 'di de ring don med mi 'gyur mdzod/ ces ga5ོla bas/yang yum gyi zhal nas/ yang cig gson dang bdag snying gzhon nu khyod/ /bskyur te 'gro la bdag kyang sems la kyang / /dus la babs tshe bcos su ga la yong/ /kho mo ske yang drin lan gzhal du yod/ rten bzang lus 'di chud gathon mi bya bang/ /dran shes bag yod thag pas rgyun du sdoms/ /rtag tu dge bcu'i las kyi lam da sbyor/ /de ltar byas na bdag gi drin lan 'khor/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran cing rgyun du mchod/ /dam chos bdud rtsi mos sheng bsam pa dang skyi /de don sgrub la rtag tu gzhol bar 'tshal/ /de ltar byas na pha ma'i drin lan 'khor/ /rgyal ba'i rjes 'jug dge sbyong dam pa rnams/ /rtag tu gtsug gi nor bu lta bur mchod/ /'gro la gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa thams cad spongs/ /sdig snang chung ngu yin kyang ring du dor/ /de ltar byas na kho mo'i drin lan 'khor/ /ta la'i sa bon zhin tu chung ngu las/ /smon shing rab tu rgyas pa 'di ga gas la/ /sdig dang ma 'dres dge ba chung ngu yang / /brnyas bgyid mi rung 'bad pas bsgrub par 'tshal/ /mi bzod sdig pa'i chom rkun ma bcoms na/ /dge ba'i longasaspyod kun tu 'joms par 'gyur/ /rgyal bu rtag tu sems 'di bsrung bar mdzod/ de ltar byas na kho mo'i drin lan 'khor/ /sdubyed

bde 'don pa'i 'ching ba rab tu chod/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal ma lusadang du longs/ /lam mchog theg chen lam bzang 'di dran pas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas dgyes pa'i rmad byung lam/ /mar gyur sems can kun gyi drin la na 'khor/ /bdag gi drin lan 'khor ba lta ci smos/ 'phagang pa thugs rje chung ba ma lags kyang 'gro ba'i las dang dgos pa' dbang gis yin/ /bdag dang mtshungs par rgyal po yab sras sogs /kun la gnas tshul 'di 'byung mkhyen par mdzod/ /'di dag smra ba'i mtha' yin yid la zungs/ zhes gsungs pas/ sras kyang sems mya ngan gyis gdung bas rab tu g.yos kyang bya thabs med par yum gyi sku la bcangs te 'dug go/ gzhan yang nges legs la sogs pa'i btsun mo rnams dang / blon po rnams kyis gsol ba btab kyang bzhugs par zhal gyis ma bzhes par/ rang rang la lung bstan te/ da ni kho mo 'chi ba'i dus la babs pas kho mo shi ma thag tu ma ti mahā ni shi'o zhes rgya gar nub phyogs su thos par gyis shig gsungs te/phyag g.yas pa ba 'i steng du bzhag ste spyan nam mkha' la gzigs pa dang nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis gang ste 'ur sil sogs rol mo'i sgra kun gyis thos pa byung ste/ e ma mas can rnams snying re rje zhes gsungs nas/ da bdag gi rten rnams rkoms gsungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku mang du yod pa rnams spyan drangs te dbu la gtu sdus pa re mdzad cing spyan chab bsil/ khyad par ston pa thub pa'i

dbang po chen po dang / rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ bla ma dri med dpal ldan gyi sku gsum la yun ring po'i bar du gsol ba btab nas/ glo bur du sku gshegs te song bas yab sras btsun mo nang blon dang bcasate 'o dod 'bod cing sku gdung la reg pas nam mkha' nas gzugs med pa'i skra ya nga byung / der yum gshegs pa grong khyer ba rnams kyis thos te phal cher ngu zhing 'o dod 'bod cing pho brang gi mtha' bskor te/ la la ni sa la 'dre ldog la la ni dran pa nyams pas sdug bsngal byung / sto sngu dpon dang lag dmar sogs la la rab tu 'dzum pa ma gtogs phal cher mya ngan gyis non pa dang sras kyis rang nyid mya ngan med pa ltar mdzad de pho brang gi lcags ri'i steng du gshegs nas gsung chen pos/ nyon dang grong khyer ba rnams nyon/ khyod cag sdug bsngal ma byed par /gal te yus la mos pa rnams/ /dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba thobs/ gsungs pas/ de dag gis sras kyi gsung thos pas yid kyi mya ngan cung zad gsos te/ rang rang gis ci 'byor gyi mchod pa byed cing / rgyal pos kyang mnga' thang gi gsum cha dge 'dun gyi zhabs tog dang mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas te/ sku gdung ni byin za'i phung por sbyangs pa las/ ring bsrel dang 'ja' 'od kyi gong bur gyur te/ de nas mya ngan gyi khur cung zad zhi ba'i dus na sras rgyal bu yang yum zhi bar gshegs pas thugs skyo ste gcig pur bzhugs pa dang nags khrod rnams su rtsed 'jor 'byon pa la 8 7

dga' bas rgyal po dang / nang blon chen po dharma ra// gā pa de/rdo rje 'od bzang / blon chen nyi ma rnams dang / stong dpon chen po yam she/ blo gros rab bzang sogs gros la dbang ba du ma zhig 'tshogs nas/ sras gcig pur bzhung/sa gnas pho brang du ma bzhugs pa 'di yum zhi bar gshegs pas thugs skyo ba dang / lang tsho dar skabs su gyur pas btsun mo gzhon nu ma zhig med pas lan par 'dug ces gleng ste/ rgya gar dbus kyi rgyal po rgyal ba phyag na'i bu mo gzhon nu ma gser bzang bya ba mdzes shing lta na sdug pa bud med kyi skyon thams cad dang bral ba zhig yod pa de btsun mor 'bul ba legs zhes bgros te kha 'chams nas rin bskyal te/ rgyal phran gzhan gyi bu mo bzhi dang bcas pa btsun mor mnga' gsol lo/ de'i tshe yab kyi zhal nas/ sras gceg rgyal bu nga la snyan gson dang / /bdag nyid rgyal por rab skyong lha snang bdag /nyer lnga'i lo nas rgyal srid gnas 'dir bkod/ /da ni bcu phrag lnga lon lang tsho yol/ /gcig pur dben pa'i gnas la nyer spro bas/ /phyi nang blon bcas 'bangs rnams skyong ba ru/ /rgyal bu khyod kyis da ni mdzad nas ran/ zhes gsungs pas/ sras kyi thugs la gal te da lta nas rgyal srid du bskos na mi rung bas yab kyi bka' bcag tu mi btub kyang da lan cung zad zhu dgos dgongs nas/ e ma gson dang chos kyi rgyal/ /mi yi dbang po bad// la gson/ /kho bo chos kyi dga' ba zhes/ /ma yis bor ba'i dwa

phyag bdag /yab rje'i thugs kyis skyong bar mdzod/ /bdag nyid rgyal por 'os gsungs nga sa/ /de ltar ma gsungs yab gcig pu/ /gzhon nu'i dus nasasrid 'byor kun/ /dmyal bar 'ching byed ( thong nas su/ /me dong dor nas bsil khang snyeg /rab tu byung bar 'dod lags kyang / /bdag ni khyod kyi bu gcig pu/ /smod kyi ga' nan ma bzlogs par /re zhig khyim du gnas so zhes/ /khas len khyed la bgyis mod kyang / /da lha'i dus su kho bo ni/ /na tshod ha cang mi chung ya nga / yab mes gong ma'i 5la ma mthong / /chos srid /zim ra kyi gnad mi shes/ /des na rgyal por mi 'os na/ /yab rje sa rgyal sa 'dzin pa'i tshad/ lo grangs nye lnga ma lon par/ /ci /bder gnas pa'i gnang ba stso la/ /yab rje da na pa ma dgongs shig ces zhurnga/ pas/ yab kyis kyang sras kyis smras pa ltar bgyi bar zhal gyis bzhes/ sras rgyal bu yang pho brang gi nang du btsun mo blon po dang bcas pa dam pa'i chos kyis dus 'da' zhing bzhugs pa'i skabs btsun mo gser bzang mas sras la chos kyi bgo skal len zhing sgom pa'i tshe/ nub gcig btsun mo'i rmi lam du thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong dang cajal nas 'u nga bstan pa spyi dang khyad par du rgyal bu chos kyi dga' ba las gsang sngags kyi bdud rtsi longs shig gsungs pa ltar/ btsun mos zhus pa'i ngor btsun mo la sogs pa'i nang 'khor 'ga' la gsang sngags bdud rtsi yang bstsal/ de'i tshe/ gser bzang mas gsang ba'i tshul 8sdus

rang gi sgo gsum la sogs pa'i maṇ+ḍal phul te gsol ba/ /sa spyod lha zas gzhon nu mchog /chos kyi dga' ba rin po che/ /kho mo shin tu ba nga mo 'di bsam pa dag pas gser dang 'dra/ /dbus phyogs rgyal po'i bu mor sa/ /skye ba dman pa bud med lus/ /'dod chags las kyis khyim thab cing / /'on kyang lha sras khyod dang mjal/ /sngon gyi bsod nams mthi mi dman/ /da ni 'khor ba'i gnas 'di las/ /yongs su thar ba'i thabs kyi mchog /zhar byung tsam gyis 'grub sla ba'i/ /dam pa'i chos shig bdag la stsol/ /'di dang phyi ma yongs ga la ba'i/ /lung bstan pa yang stsol bar mdzod/ zhus pas sras kyi zhal nas/ dus gsum gtan gyi skyabs gnas rin po che/ /bsku med dkon ma②ོga rin chen rnam gsum la/ /gus pas 'dud do byang chub snying po'i bar/ khyod kyi thugs rje'i lcags kyus ma gtong zhig shin tu bzang mo mi dang don mtshungs khyod/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa btso ma lhad dang bral/ /sngon dus bsags pa'i bsod nams mi dman pa'i/ bzhin bzang ma khyod bdag la tshur gson dang / /dman pa'i bud med lus su gyur na yang / /shes rab ma②ོga dang ldan zhing bstan la gus/ /'di 'dra'i dad rten bzang po rnyed pa'i dus/ /deng 'dir chos la 'bungs shig bzhin bzang ma/ /chos kyi dga' ba bdag dang 'phrad pa yang / /sngon gyi dus na smon lam 'brel ba zab kho bo /ma pa'i bshes gnyen du ma las/ /gdam ngag rgya cher mang du ma

tho rnga sa/ mtha' yas gdam pa bdag nas ma 4 tsal kyang / /rtag tu le lo slongs la dge la 'bungs/ /'jig rten bya ba zhen log bla sna stungs/ /phan par smra ba rgya jig rten 'di na dkon/ /dam pa'i chos la sbyor pa de bas dka'/ /grogs dag chos la bskul bar byed pa de//shin tu gzhung bzang drin can go bar gyis/ ston mchog dam par skyabs su song gyur nas/ 'jig rten lha la nam yang skyabs mi 'tshol//dam pa'i chos la skyabs su song gyur nas/ /rgyal ba'i gsung dang mi mthun thams cad spongs/ /'apaza/nga/ pa'i dge 'dun skyabs su legs brten nas/ /mu stegs byed dang nam yang 'grogs mi bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la snying nas 7bas song na/ /mthong tshad dgra ru langs kyang nyam mi nga / /srid zhi'i 'jib/sa las skyobs par nus pa de/ /dkon mchog gsum las nam yang gzhan du med/ /de phyir skyabs gnas dam pa de kho na /'gro ba thams cad pha mar rgyal bas gsungs/ /rang gi rig pas mngon sum grub bzhin du/ /de dag 'dor ba shin tu khrel med yin/ /re re'i dren yang gzugs su grub gyur na//stong gsum 'jig rten khams 'di sgod du chud/ /de drin gzhan gyis 'khor bar mi nus phyir/ /ngam chos byas nas bla med byang chubasgrubs//'gro rnams byang chub thob par bya'o zhes/ /bsam zhing de don nyams su legs bstar bas/ /smon dang 'jug pa'i sgo nas sems skyed cing / /pha rol phyin drug lam la legs sprob pa/ /sangs rgyas sa la bgrod 97 'i

gzhir nges bya/ /lus kyi sgo nas khengs 'gying che ba dang / /chen por rlom nas gzhan 'a/ khyad gsod cing / /dkon mchog gsum la dad pa ma byas na/ /de ni chos dang mi mthun shes par gyis /ngag gi sgo nas ngag bkyal rdzun tshig dang / /gzhan gyi skyon brjod phra ma smra ba mang / /pha rol dkrug pa'i tshig rtsub smra byas na/ /de ni chos dang mi mthun shes par gyis /yid kyi 'gyu ba nyon mongs phra rags mang / /mi dge'i gnyen pos so sor ma brten par/ /de dbang gtong bas rgya 'byams sems spyad na/ /di ni ②ོsa dang mi mthun shes par gyis/ /'dod chags gnyen por 'khor ba'i skyon sgoms bya/ /gti mug ga nyen por rten 'brel zab mo sgoms/ /zhe ldang gnyen por byams pa bsgoms pa gces/ /rnam par g.yengs dang ser sna'i gnyen po ni/ /mi rtag pa dang skyo shas drag po skyed/ /kun gyi gnyen por spros bral zab mo sgoms/ /zhar byung tsam gyis 'grub par sla ba ni/ /nyin mtshan dus gsum kun tu sgo gsum srungs/ /dran shes brtan po nam yang gtong mi bya/ /spyi bor bla ma yid dam dbyer med bsgoms/ /bdag rgyud byin rlabs thob la 'bad pa skyed/ /rtag tu rang nyid rje btsun sgrol mar skyed/ /tā re'i bzlas pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bya/ /snang grags thams cad lha sngags dag tu lta/ /spyod lam zhi dul dran shes brtan par bya/ /dam chos bsgrub la bar chad zhin tu ma nga / /dus rnams rtagazi ṭ+wāṃ bdud kyis bslu ba 'byung / /de dang de la legs par gzab

par mdzod/ /mi dge bcu spongs dge ba bcu la slobs/ /de ltar byas na legs so bzhin bzang ma/ /rang yang snyem las rnam g.yengs dbang gyur na/ /gzhan la bskul ba 'os pa ma lags kyang / /bdag gi yum de'i gsung rab lhad med cing / /bsam pa bzang pos bshad phyir nyes pa ci/ /kho bo rgyal bu chos kyi dga' ba dang / /tshe 'dir yun du 'grogs par dka' na yang / /ma 'ongs mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas ma thob par/ /yang yang 'phrad cing phan tshun she par 'gyur /zhes gsungs pas/ slar yang ga ra ba nga mas zhus pa'i ngor lung bstan pa yang 'ga' re yod do/ don ni 'og 'byung ba'i lung bstan rnams su med pa med cing tshig tshogs che ba la bsams nas ma bris/da ltar phan tshun gsung gleng gi bas tshar na / gser bzang ma thugs la skyo shas drag po 'khrungs te/ rgyal bo'i bu mo gser bzang ma zhes bdag /bsod nam dman zhing sngon gyi sbyangs pa chung / /nyon mong shas cha blo gros dman pa bdag /lha zas khyod kyi gsung gi bdud ba thob/ /khyad par gsang ba yang gsang gdams pa bstan/ /thab shes cha tshang la ba mang du gsungs/ /dus ga gas gsal ba'i lung gis mad ches mdzad/ /khyod dang lhun du mi 'grogs gsungs pa dang / /gdul bya ri dwags bya la yod gsungs pa/ /'di la kho mo yid mi bde gyur pas/ /gal te khyod nyid de ltar gyur pa na/ /bdag ni gson pas ci bya sdug bsngal skyed/ /rab ni wa ra ṇa sir zhusdud

bzhuṭa 'tshal /'bring yang bdag nyid mgon khyod gar bzhugs khrid/ /tha mar lus srog 'dor las gzhan pa med/ /brtse bar darkangs dang rgyal sras 'gro ba'i mgon/ zhes zhus pa zug bu'i zhal nas/gang zhig skyabs su bsten pa tsam nyid kyis/ / dod don kun 'grub mi 'dod dgra sel ba/ /ba da rin na dkon mchog rnam pa gsum/ /na yang 'bral med snyi bor rtan bar gas/ /legs par gson dang blo ldan gser nga ma/ /dman ga da da lus su gyur na yang / /rigs rus skyo 'brang rmad byung rgya ma rigs/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la mos zhing dam chos brtson/ /'di 'dra bsod dmas mi dman shes par gyis/ /nga nyid sangs rgyas ba na la bkur ba dang / wa ra ṇa si'i 'gro rnams skyong ba'i phyir/ /mi lus su gnas par spro na yang / /bdag gi yum gyur phyags rje chen po de / /dus gsum ma lus gsal bar gzigs pas na/ /sku nyid gshegs kha gsung gi tha mal/ /lus 'di myur du 'dor ces yang yang gsung /des na rang gis gsal bar ma mthong yang /bshes gnyen da ba'i ga gang la yid ches thob/ /gal te kho bo gnas dbang ma byung na/ /gar 'gror khyod nyid khrid pa'i thabs kyang med/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor thob pa'i dus 'di ru/ /lus srog 'dor bar du da pa ga la srid/ /de bas rgyal bas rjes su bstan pa yi/ /dam pa ri gsung gi bdud rtsi leṭa par 'thung / /zhe /sungs so/ de ltar grong rejug gi rkyen gyis bya'i lus su 'gyur

ba sngon nas shes bzhin du/ slar mi shes pa ltar de'i las la dbang medapar 'jug pa gang snyam na/ sngon gyi las kyi rnam na dus 'dir smin pa la sngag ldan g.yang la mchong ba bzhin du bya ba'i bas yod pa she bzhin du mi byed pa lta bu zhig byung ste sems can rnams kyi las kyidabang mthu btsan pa la ni rgyal po'i thugs rjes kyang bzlog par dka' ba yin sna zhes pa'i brdar rig par bya'o/ sku ga na nu skabs dang grong 'jug sbyangs shing yum zhi bar gshegs pa'i skabs te gsum pa'o/ /de nas de'i tshe nyin gyi dus su rgyal po yab zas blon po btsun mo rnams thams cad rtsed 'jo'i di ga' ston dang / chos kyi gleng mo byed cing nub mo rgyal bu dang btsun mo gser bzang ma gnyis khang bu gzhan ga tu bzhugs te zab mo'i chos gsung ba la sngon gyi las kyi dbang gi rgyal zan gyi bu mo/ sā ra su ti ni bya ba de'i bsam pa la/gser ba nga ma dang nged rnams btsun mo yin par mnyam na yang /rgyal rtsa mo dang lhan cig gan nas nged rnams la zur tsam yang mi blta ba di zhin tu ma rangs par bya ba yin snyam nas/ phrag dog zug rngus snying la zin nas stong dpon gyi bu dang khya sa 'dres par byas te sems zhin tu mthi na pa ltar gyis smras pa/ nged rnams phyogs kyi rgyal po'i bu mo rgyal bu'i btsun mor blangs par 'dra na yang rgyal bus gserabazang ma ma gtogs nged rnams la cung zad tsam yang mi gzigs miX

'di zhin tu ma 'dra bas/ kho mo yid ma bde bas khyod la thabs yod dam/ rgyal po de khyed kyis byas nas btsun mo nged kyis byed pa zhig byung na ang smras pas/ la gā sgyu nas thos pa/ rgyal bus khyod rnams la brtse bar ma mdzad kyang thabs med/ rgyal bu byang chub mas dpa'amangon par mkhyen pa mnga' ba 'di 'dra la gdon mi nus khyod kyis gser bzang ma lha bu zhig yong bar da pa 'dug rte/ nga gi rgyal bu chos kyi dga' ba lta bu zhig bskal brgya'i bar du'ang mi yong / de bas nga rang pha mes kyi sgron po rang dga' pas te ma nyan pas/ btsun mo na re/ la hā tsā na khyod de lha ma zer/ rgyal bu skog 'gyur mi shes pa dngos su myong bas rgyab/ zlon pos rgyal sa bzung rabs shin tu mang / chos kyi dga' ba las khyod ni mkhas/ gzugs ni bzang /blo ni che rgyal po mi yong ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yod/ khyod kyis ba ga pa'i thabs shig yod kyang yod/ byed kyang byed dgos/ sa pas/ la gā ā na re/ rgyal bu 'di la mngon shes nges par yod/ khyod kyis bstod pa ji ltar byas kyang chos kyi dga' ba las nga lhag pa zer cig nga yis thub pa'i thabs med/ des ma zad de ltar byas na wa ra ṇa si'i sde chen po 'dis kyang rang cag srog dang phral nas yong / nga la rgyal bu 'dis thugs brtse bas bsam ngan skyes na nga khrel med du 'gro bas/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ngan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong du yong de // mi byed sbos pas/ mo na re/ khyod kyis bdag gi sa pa 'di

mi nyan na nga ni srog 'dor ba las bya thabs med zer nas 'jus te ngus pas/ der sngon gyi las dbang dang 'phrad bud med kyi ngag ma bzlogs par/ kho na re/ khyod de tsam thug na ngas kyang thabs gzhanagyis mi thub kyang rgyal bu'i lus 'di grong 'jug gi thabs kyis thub pa'i 'bad pa mtha' 'khyol ba zhig byed zer te khas blangs nas thog mar rgyal bus lkog 'gyur shes mi shes brtag pa'i phyir du rgyal po skyo bsang la phebs pas gzigs sar khang pa bkod pa mdzes pa zhig gi nang du rin po che'i khri la gser gyi bum pa mi gtsang bas bkang ba zhig bzhag ste/ rgyal bu lags 'di'i nang du ci yod bas pas/ rgyal bus kyang / de'i nang na rin po che sna tshogs pa yod gsungs bas kho la the tshom byung / yang r+sā ra su ti ni la nad chen po zhig gis btab paltar byas nas/ rgyal bu la btsun mo na nas snang bas rkyen ji ltar yin zhus pas/ btsun mo la sde brgyad kyis gnod pas na ba yin pas dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur dang /ca sdo brgyad la gtor ma btang bas phan gas/ngas pas kyang the tshom je cher skyes/ yang gdol pa'i rigs/ kyi mi zhig la gdong legs par bkrus/ gos gtsang ma bgos bram ze'i chas su zhugs nas rgyal pos gzig/sa sar bzhag nas rgyus med pa ltar byas nas 'di rigs gang yin zhus pas bram ze'o gsungs pas kyang the tshom shin tu che ba skyes nas btsun mo shā ra su ti ni la rgyu mtshan smras nas da ni rgyal po grong 'jug gi thabs kyis myur du bslu nus 9spyar

'dug gi sem bde bar gyes she ba/smri sa pa sa/ btsun mos kyang shin tu dga' nas/ la gā ā na la g.yos dag phun sum tshogs pa sbyar ba dang rin po che du ma byin te sems mthun pa'i gtam dang bcas nas/khyod kyi rgyal bu yab yum 'di bslu bar byas nas khyod rgyal sar byung na bdag bsam pa rdzogs par 'gyur ro smras so de'i dus su chu srin rgyal mtshan gyi sder gtogasapa rnams kyis la gā a na'i phyi na sprin ltar 'thibs te gnas so/ dkon mchog gsum gyis kyang rgyal bu'i gdul bya bya la yod par dgongs so/ cider la ga ā nas rgyal bus ma mkhyen par phyogs thams cad du ltar song bas/ pho brang gi byang phyogs su mes kyi skyed mos tshal yod pa dang cang mi ring ba na chu bo mahā dza na bya ba chu shin tu che ba'i pha rir phun sum tshogs/ pa'i nags tshal mthong nas rgyal bu la zhus pa lha sras thugs skyo bsang gi ched du skyed tshal dang nags tshal bzang po rnams su gshegs par dgongs sam/ la gā ā na phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas mchis na 'gro'o/ rang re'i pho brang gi byang phyogs su sngon gshegs ma myong ba'i mes kyi skyed mos tshal mchi'o/ 'o na nang bar nyid du 'dong ngo / bzhon pa dang gos rgyan sta gon gyis shig lha'i sras btsun mo 'khoji dang bcas nas gshegs sam/ gzhon nu'i 'khor dang bcas nas gshegs/ gzhon nu'i 'khor dang bcas te 'gro'o gsungs/ der sta gon grub nas gshegs par chas pa'i tshe rgyal po // btsun mo sogs gyis bzhol kyang ma nyan par chos blon blo gros

rab bzang gi bu rgyal po'i bu mo dang / rgyal phran gyi ba gzhon nu gtum spyod dang / gtso po'i bu legs bzang dang mthong na dga' so gas gaspyan nu du ma'i 'khor dang bcas te gshegs so/ blon po'i bus kyang khu byug gi ro gsar pa rma med pa gnyis btsal te/ rang gi lha la 'dod don 'grub par gsol ba btab ste rgyal bu dang chabs cig par gnas der chas pa'i lam khar rgyal bu'i thugs la skyo shas dpag tu med par skyes te 'di skad smras so gu ru rat+na tra ya na mo/ /skyabs gnas bslu ba med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /dbyer med skyabasakyi dam pa bla ma ltar/ /rtse gcig gdung shugs drag pos gus phyag 'tshal/ /nam yang brtse ba'i lcags kyus ma gtong zhig /bdag nyid rgyalabu chos kyi dga' ba 'di/ /bsod nams bsags pa'i dal 'byor mi lus thob/ /mngon mtho'i rigs skyes rgyal ba'i bstan dang mjal/ /bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi zugs rjes bskyangs/ /yang gcig bsod nams legs par ma bsaṭa te/ /lan gcig thob pa'i dal 'byorastong zad btang / /rnam par ga nga ba dbang song blo gros dman/ /yang dag bshes gnyen dam pa ma mjal zhing / /ga na don lta zhog rangadon mi 'grub pa'i/ /skye bo ma rungs rgyal po'i lus su skyes/ /kye ma kye hud dkon mchog ༄ gas rjes zungs/ /'di nas byang chub snying por mchi/ kyi bar/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas dang dam pa'i chos/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun las gzhan skyabs med pas/ /nam yang /sdus

rjes zungs shig rin chen gsum/ zhes gsungs te thug/mu 'a/ skyo shas dpag tu med pa 3khrungs pas/ des tshe nam mkhar ga ngas ched pa'i sgrar/ myur du lus rjes 'gro don pe la med/ /rgyal rī sa se sa bskyed ma chung blo stobs bskyed/ /yang dab/ bla ma 4 rjes 'dzin 'gro ngon 'byung / /wa ra ṇa si'i 'gro rnams snye nga re rje/ zhes pa'i sgra byung /der skyed mo'i tshal der ngebang nas khrus mdzad de rtsed cho/ri bye brag shin tu mang po rtse ba'i tshe/ la gā a nas rgyal bu la lha'i sras/ chu bo chen po mahā jo na'i drung du gshegs par 'tshal lam/ rgyal bus de lta bu'i chu bo gang du ma chi sko/ 'di dang nye ba na yod do/ lags so 'gro'ozhes gsungs te/ rim gyis chu bo de'i 'gram du byon pas de'i pha ri'i bye ma'i gling zhi — rga / ba'i pha ro'/ du na gas tshal shing to0 dang me tog phun sum tshogs pa su la bus mthong nas blon po la smras pa/ kye grogs po chu 'di'i pha rol du ya mtshan can gyi nags tshal 'di lta ba rgyal po gzhan gyis bdag tu bzung ngam/ blon pos zhus par ma bzung ngo / pe na tan du ca/ yod dam/ ma sa te 'di dang 'di lta bu'o zhes yon tan rgyas par ba/sal bas las kyi dbang gis rgyal po thug 'phrog ste/ ka ye la gā ā na/ de di na nges par chu 'di'i pha rol tu blta bar 'dzi dgos pa myur du / r+sha brang nas ko gru longs dug gsungs pas/ 'a gā gā ོ can tu dga' nas khu byug gi ro de bton te ///na nu gzhan gyi ma mthong bar rgyal bu la phul nas/ de lha'i

sras/ de ltar na 'di la 'pho ba mdzad de gshegs par 'tshal lo zhes zhus pas/ rgyal bu mnyes nas kye blon po ngam pa thung lta bu rnyed par dka' 'o/ 'di lta bu'i bya'i ro gsar pa ma med pa da lta nyid du ga nas rnyed gsungs pas kho na re 'di ni rgyal bu gnas 'dir gshegs pa'i cha rkyen nyid du sngon nas sta gon bgyis so/ zhin tu legs mod kyi 'on kyang gzhon nu gzhan dang bcas lhan gcig tu 'gro bas ko gru longs zhig der ma zad grong 'jug gi 'pho ba ni bum ze dag gi man ngag zab mo yin pas rtsed mo'i phyir du bya mi rung ngo gsungs pa dang / yang la gā ā nas ko gru len par bgyis na nyi ma yang gyi mor song / yab kyis gsan par gyur na mi dgyes par gyur bas bdag cag rnams la chad las kyang 'ong ngo / gal te gshegs par bzheng nas ci kyang 'di la 'o skol rgyal blon 'phos te gshegs par rigs so/ rgyal bus 'o na deng ldog la nang par yab la rjes/ su gnang ba zhus te 'ong ngo / yang kho na re/ kye ma lha'i sras ci zheg dgongs/deng nyid du skyo bsang du gshegs pa la yab dang btsun mo dam pas ji tsam zhig bkag de phyin chad gshegs su 'jug re skon smras pas/ rgyal bu yang yid gyur te 'o na gzhon nu gzhan rnams grong 'jugabyed pa la gsang ba'i phyir du gzhan bskrad par bya'o gsungs nas gzhon nu gzhan rnams la/ kye bzhin bzang dag khyed rnams re zhig me tog bzang po btsal ba'i phyir gzhan du song zhig la ga a / 0sdud

gnyis 'dir sdod do/ slar bde ma byung bar la ma 'ong zhig gsungs pas/ de dag na re/ nged kyang lha'i mas gang du bzhugs pa la der sdod do zer ba la/ la gu ā nas kyang da rnams lha'i bka' yang mi nyan nam/ gal te lha'i bka' las 'das na/ lhas rgyal srid thob pa'i tshe khyed cag rang gi mgo bo yang dbang med par 'gyur to smras pas/de rnams skrags te song ngo / de nas phung po rnying pa gnyis der bzhag nas mi ma gyi spung ma la bcol/ bya ro gsar pa gnyis la 'pho ba btab ste chu bo'i pha rol du song / de na ro brgya ldan pa'i shing tog dang mdzes pa'i me tog rnams la longs spyod cing ltad mo la g.yengs pa'i dus su stong dpon gyi bus/ rgyal bus cha/ gzigs par myur du 'phur nas chu bo'i tshur rol tu/ rgyal bu'i gdung la grong 'jug byas nas rang gi phung po chu bor bskyur te/ 'o dod byas pas gzhon nu gzhan rnams blta bar byung / rgyal bu la ci nyes zhus pas/ snying gi grogs po la sa ā na rtsed mo'i phyir du chu nang du song ba chus khyer ro bas nas ngus pas/ thams cad kyis bden par bsams nas lha'i sras de ltar ma mdzod cig rgyal bu brtan par bzhugs na wa ra ṇa mi'i sde chen po 'dir rig pa can gyi blon pos ga la thogs/ nged rnams kyis kyang sgo gsum 'bad pa chen pos khyod kyi bka' bzhin bsgrub par 'tshal lo zhes sbos so/ de nas thams cad wa ra ṇa si'i phyogs su myu/ sdur song ngo / rgyal bu khu byug gi rnam pa can du yod pas ni

shing tog me tog la sobs pa btsal bas g.yengs te yun ring tsam nags stug po'i khrod du lus/ da grogs po btsal te chu po'i pha rol du 'gro snyam nas yun ring btsal bas ma rnyed pas grogs po la bar smi kyid byung ba yin nam snyam du dgongs nas dkon mchog gsum la gdung bas 'bod pa 'di gsungs so/ bslu med skyabs kyi phul byung dkan mchog gsum/ /deng 'dir bdag la dgongs pa'i dus la babs/ /de ring bde ldan dben pa'i na gas khrod 'dir/ /shing tog nags tshal ltad mo ngo mtshar yang / /byis pa'i dus nas snying gis bskyangs pa'i bu/ /grogs kyi dam pa la ga ā na de/ /da lta'i dus su btsal kyang ma rnyed pas/ /gces pa'i srog la bar chad ma byung ngam/pha rol dgra bo'i 'tshe ba ma byung ngam/ /bdag gi grogs de rnyed par ma gyur na/ /kho bo rgyal po'i khab spya ji ltar 'gro/ /yab rje chos kyi rgyalapor ji ltar zhu/ /blon chen stong dpon yam sher ci skad smra/ /bdag gi grogs po'i skyibs su dkon mchog bzhuṭa/ /myur du 'phrad pa'i 'phrin las 'jug bar mdzod/ ces gsungs pas/ sprin dkar zho gsar thungs pa dra zhig mdun du nar gyis byung ba'i nang du lha'i bu dkar po lus phyed sprin gseb tu nub cing lus phyed thon pa zhig na re/ sngon gyi dus nas bstan pa yang / /de ring khyod kyis brjed dam ci/ /groṭa pobasam pa ngan 'chang sa/ /da lta rgyal po'i khab tu song / zer ba thos pas groṭa pos grong 'jug byas pa min nam/ snyam du bsams nas 0/ra

ba'i tshul gyis chu bo'i pha rol du gzugs phung gnyis yod shul du song ste gziṭa pas gzuṭa gnyis dang grogs po'i tshoṭa bcas mi 'dug pas grong 'jug byas te wa ra ṇa si'i pho brang du song ba mkhyen nas bya ba'i thabs dang bral zhing nyi ma yang dmar thag chad du song bas rkyen byas sngar chos ma bslabs pas 'gyod pa dang da lta'i snang tshul 'di la skyo shas drag po skyes te smras pa/ mtshan tsam thos kyang thar pa'i sa bon 'debs/ /skya bas su bsten pas 'khor ba'i 'jigs las sgrol /bslu med skyabs kyi dam pa de bzhin gshegs/ /dam pa'i chos dang tshogs mchog la phyag 'tshal/ /skyabs med mgon med chos kyi dga' ba bdaga'adi nas byang chub snying po ma thob par/ /skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung khyed rang mkhyen/ /myur du thugs rjes skyob pa'i dus la babs/ /yab yum bka' drin can gyi nyi zla gsal/ /blon tshogs rgyu skar lta bur rabatu bkra/ /'bangs kyi skar tshoṭa zhin tu mang gyur cing / /bde skyid kunagasal yar la spyod pa'i dus/ rje btsun sgrol ma dngos gyur 'phags ma des/ /zas su mngar gsum 'bras dkar 'o mas gsol/ /lu ba 'jamapo'i gos kyis yongs su bgos/ /dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis bskyangasamod kyang / /bsam med byis pa'i ngang du mi tshe 'das/ /snying po med pa'i rtsed 'jo'i roga' ston la /nyin mtshan kun tu bag me nga dbang duspyad/ /de tshe 'pha gas ma'i gsung ge snying gtam gyis/ /dal 'byor 'dini //4 tu rnyed par dka'/ /tshe 'di gyib tsam skad cig glog 'khrug

'dra/ /bu khyod rtsed 'jo byed pa'i long med par/ /rnam dkar sgrubs shig gsungs pa ngas ma nyan/ /dam pa'i lha chos lang tsho rgyas dus sgrub/ /byis pa'i dus su rtsed 'jo 'di byed snyam/ /kye ma de tshe 'phaṭa ma'i gsung ma nyan/ /da ni 'gyod pas zin no kye ma hud/ /rmongs brtul dud 'gro'i lus su gyur pa'i tshe/ /dam pa'i lha chos ma gtogs phan mi 'dug /dkon mchog rnam gsum ma gtogs skyabs mi 'dug /dkar nag las 'bras ma gtogs grogs mi 'dug /bsod nams las gzhan longs spyod mi 'dug mang / /byis rnams dga' skyid rtsed 'jo'i las de la/ /snying po til tsam med pa de ring shes//shes kyang cung zada'agyis so dge 'dun 'bangs/ /de nas wa ra ṇa si'i 'gro spyi dang / /kho bo bsod nams shin tu chung gyur pas/ /'phags ma yum de ma bzhugs zhi bar gsheṭa/ / yab rje snyi nang zlon po'i tshogs bcas kyis//bdag la mi mi 'dod dgu'i longs spyod bstsal/ rin thang bral ba'i dar zab gos kyis g.yogs/ /mdzes shing lta sdug lha yi lus lta bu'i//rgyal po'i zas gyur btsun mo khab tu bsus/ /spyod mthun blo ldan blon po'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /'gro na glang chen rta dang shing rta bzhon/ /'dug na rin chen dar zab khri la bzhag /skyo bsang phyir du glu gar rol mo rtsed/ /snying nas gces phyir ci 'dod ngag bzhin bsgrubs/ /rkyen des khe bo'i blo 'di lta bus bsgyur/ /mi yi longs spyod zang zing 'du 'dzis g.yengs/ nam phugs dam pa'i chos bzhin bsgrub 1/sdus

kyang /'phral du yab rje btsun mo blon 'bangs kyi/ /bka' la brtsi dang ngo srung bya ba'i phyir/ /re zhig bar du rgyal srid spyad dgos snyam//phun tshogs rnyed dka' dal 'byor thob dus der/ /dam chos ma bsgrub da ni 'gyod pas zin/ /nye 'bangs longs spyod gzhan lta ci zhig smos lhan cig skyes pa'i gcu gas kyang mi dbang bar/ /rang nyid gcig pur dud 'gror gyur dus 'dir/ /rgyal zid ma mchis btsun mo ma mchis te/ /blon po 'bangs dang longs spyod ma mchis so/ /mthi dpung ma mchis mnya na pa'i grogs ma mchis/ /skyobs par byed pa 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum/ /rjes 'brangs grogs ni dkar nag las 'brang te/ /phan par byed pa dam chos kho nar snang / /srid pa'i bde bar 'dod pas longs spyod dang / /kha grags bkur ba rnyed pa thams cad kun /chu shing lta bur snying po med par go/ /go yang cung da 'gyis so dge 'dun 'bangs/ /mi mnya na spangs nas sgo gsum mthun byas shing / /ma yis bu ltar brtse bar bskyangs byas pas/ /snying ltar gces pa'i grogs po'i snang tshul 'dis/ /'jig rten 'di la blo gtad med par go/ /ba cu med dkon mchog rnam gsum cu gas rje las/ /myur du dal 'byor mi yi lus thob ste/ /snga ma lta bur le lo mi bgyid par/ /myur du thar pa bsgrub la brtson par shogaces gsungs so/ de nas mun pa nag chel te byung / mi skad /rdo khyi skad ni med/ /bya dang byi'u rnams ni rang rang shing gi

mgor skad sgrog cing sdod gnas 'tshol/ gcan gzan rnams skad kyi ngar ro sprog cing rtse zhing 'phyo ba/ rlung bsil bu langs pas yid mi bde zhing shin tu 'jigs pa dang skyi g.ya' ba byung nas de'i rkyen gyis yum 'phags ma ma sta mahā ni de nyid kyi bka' drin spyi dang khyad par sku snyun gyis thebs pa'i tshul bstan nas zhing gzhan du gshegs khar/yum sku drin can des rgyal bu kho rang la spyan gyig gyig gzigs nas/thugs 'bral mi phod pa lta bus phyag spyi bor bzhag ste gsung ge tha ma bka' bstsal ba de dran nas snying la gdung ba drag po skyes te/ ma thugs rje can de ma bzhugs pa'i 'og tu bu las ngan can bdag ra 'dilta bu'i sdug bsngal myong ba las 'os ci zhig yod snyam nas yum thugs rje can de'i mtshan nas lan gsum bos te/ gdung ba'i shugs drag pos 'phags ma'i zhal chems dran pa 'di gsungs so/ bslu med dkon mchog ma lus 'dus pa'i sku/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gyur bshes gnyen ma'i/ /zhabs kyi pad+mor snying nas gus phyag 'tshal/ /kye ma kye hud yum khyod gang du bzhugs/ /bdag gi ngang tshul 'di la gzigs su gsol/ /khyed kyis bdag la phan par gsungs gyur kyang //snying med kho bos ma nyan srid la chags/ /da ni de ring 'gyod pa'i dus zhig byung / /ār+ya tā re'i rnam sprul 'phags ma la/ /skye go na 'chi'i sdug bsngal ma mchis kyang / /blo chung bdag por ba zhe bcu'i lo lon tshe/ /ma khyod sku la bsnyun gyis thebs tshul bstan/ 10//ga

pa'i zhing du phebs pa'i dgongs pa gtad/ /bdag cag 'bangs rnams chu bral nya snar gyur/ /'o dod 'bod cing khyod sku bskor ba'i tshe/ /phyag gi pad+mo bdag gi spyi bor bzhag /gyig gyig spyan gyis gdong la ce rer gzigs/ brtse ba'i thugs kyis shin tu 'phreng zhing dgongs/ /bslab bya lung bstan du ma legs par bstsal/ /khyad par gshegs kha'i gsung gi mtha' ma la/ /kho mo shi la mya ngan ci'i phyir byed/ /nga la sems khrel mi dgos legs soms dang / /yab rje chos kyi rgyal pochen po 'di/ /cung zad bcol chung bdud kyis bsgyur la nye/ /bu khyod gal te sdug bsngal byung gyur na/ /dkon mchog gsum la snying nas gsol ba thobs/ /gsungs nas bzhugs par zhal gyis ma bzhes pa/ /tshul de da lta mngon sum bzhin du dran/ dran yang dngos su mjal ba'i skal ba zad/ /ma khyod dag pa rab 'byams zhing du gshegs/ /dge 'dun 'bangs nga wa ra ṇa sir lus/ /lus par ma zad bdud kyi bslu ba byung / /glo bur gnyen 'dun longs spyod kun dang bral/ mi med 'jigs rung nags tshal stug po 'dir/ /rang nyid gcig pur dud 'gro'i gzugs cu gyur/ /drin can ma de'i bka' drin snying nas dran /'khor ba'i chos la skyo ba gting nas skyes/ /skyabs mchog rnam gsum bskul ba'i dus la babs/ /nyams thag bdag ni khyod kyis dor lags na/ /mgon skyabs dpung gnyen byed pa gzhan su mchis/ /myu/ ༵ thugs rje gzigs shig rin chen gsum/ zhes gsungs so/

de nas 'jigs yi re skyo ting nger ljon shing gi mgor shing lo gcig gi 'og tu yibs te bzhugs pas mun pa rdzogs di rub ste nam stod kyi char nam mkha' sprin dang bral zhing dwangs ba la/ skar tshogs gas zhing bkra bar byung yang nam smad glo bur du sprin gyi tshogs 'dus te 'brug sgra drag pa sgog cing char gyi rgyun chen po babs/ chu rlung 'thab pa'i 'ur chom gyi sgra dang / smon zhing gi lo ma sogs rlung gis skyod pa'i shog zhog dang / /chil chil gyi sgra chen po grags/ mun pa shin tu snag pas rang gi gzugs kyang mi mthong zhing / sdod gnas kyi shing sdong gi yal ga rnams rlung gis skyod cing sprugs pas sar lhung la khad lhung la khad la/ shing gi yal ga gcig la sbar 'tham byas te gnas so/ de'i tshe sdug bsngal dang 'jigs skrag gi snang ba dpag tu med pa skyes te/ ci drag la thug par byung yang bsam blo btang ste dran pa rnyed nas rang gis rang la gros 'debs sdug bsngal mun sel 'di gsungs so/ dkon mchog gsum la snying nas mgos phyag 'tshal/ /sdug bsngal mun pa sel bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gting mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'dir/ /nyon mongs thug bsngal na kras rab gces pa'i/ /bdag sogs 'gro rnams srid las bsgral du gsol/ /rgyal srid 'byor pa'i chu mtsho spungs pa'i ngogs/ /'khor 'bangs pad+ma'i tshal rab rgyas pa'i dbus/ /bde skyid gshog yangs rgyas pas sding byed pa'i/ /dad pa'i rgyal po rgyal bu'i gzugs sdu/na

de/ /deng dus dud 'gro'i gzugs gyur nags khrod 'dir/ /stobs med 'byor bral grogs med gcig pur 'khyams/ /tsha grang ltogs skom thug bsngal du mas gzir/ /'khor ba 'di la yid brtan ci zhig mchis/ /rgya che ba /da /dzes rgyan gyis rab rgyan pa'i/ /rgyal po'i pho brang dbus gnas rgyal bu de/ /mun nag stug por char rlung drag pos brdungs/ /mi med nags khrod 'khyar ba'i dus shig byung / /kye ma 'di yang 'khor ba'i rang bzhin te/ /bdag nyid kho na'i bgo skal ma yin kyang / /blo chung kho bo mya ngan gdung bas gzir/ /sdug bsngal mun pa sel zhig dkon mchog gsum/ /rin chen sna tshogs las grub khri steng na/ /dar zab 'bol 'jam gdan gnas rgyal bu de/ /rtsub cing hrag la mi brtan 'gyur ba yi/ yal ga gdan du re ba'i dus shig byung / /kye ma 'di yang 'khor ba'i rang bzhin te/ /bdag nyid kho na'i bgo skal ma yin kyang / /blo chung kho bo ngan gdung bas gzir/ /sdug bsngal mun pa sel zhig dkon mchog gsum/ /rin chen gos kyi yol ba bla bre dang / 'phan gdugs bzang po'i 'og gnas rgyal bu de/ /chu thigs gcig tsam bsrung bar mi nus pa'i/ /ljon shing 'dab lo gcig la re byes byung / /kye ma 'di yang 'khor ba'i rang bzhin te/ /bdag nyid kho na'i bgo skal ma yin kyang / /blo chung kho bo mya ngan gdung bas gzir/ /sdug bsngal mun1 ༵ sel zhig dkon mchog gsum/ /snyan pa'i glu dbyangs rol

mo'i sgro nyan nas/ /yid la ngal bso byed pa'i rgyal bu de/ /gcan gzan ngar skad chu rlung 'ur 'ur sgra/ skyo dang 'jigs pa skyed la nyan dus byung / /kye ma 'di yang 'khor ba'i rang bzhin te/ /bdag nyid wa na'i bgo skal ma yin kyang / blo chung lo bo mya ngan gdung bas gzir/ /sdug bsngal mun pa sel zhig dkon mchog gsum/ mdzes shing rigs bzang yid 'ong btsun mo dang / blo ldan blun pos bskor ba'i rgyal bu de /bya dang byi'u spra spre gcan gzan sogs/ mi sdug grogs dang 'grogs pa'i dus shig byung /skye ma 'di yang 'khor ba'i rang bzhin te/ bdag nyid kho na'i bgo skal ma yin kyang / /blo chung kho bo mya ngan gdung bas gzir/ /sdug bsngar mun pa sel zhig dkon mchog gsum/ /mi yi bza' btung bye brag bzang po la/ /ci 'dod gdam gar spyod pa'i rgyal bu de/ /shing 'bras ngan dang chu gtsang tsam spyod de/ /ltogs skom bkres pa'i nyen pa'i dus shig byung kye ma 'di yang 'khor ba'i rang bzhin te/ /bdag nyid kho na'i bgo skal ma yin kyang / /blo chung /ko bo mya ngan gdung bas gzir/ /sdug bsngal mun pa sel zhig dkon mchog gsum/ /dbang po legs tshang rang bzhin rgyan gyis mdzes/ /lang tsho dar zhing bongs dang kha dog bzang / mi yi mngal nas lhan skyes mi yi lus/ /de yang deng dus gzhan gyis dbang med 'phrog /kha dog sngo ba'i spu dang sgro yis khebs/ /nag cing sra ba'i mchu dang sder mo can/ /nyam chung 1/sdub

chags gzugs su skad cig 'phos/ /shin tu rmongs pas bsgribs pa'i dus shig byung / kye ma 'di yang 'khor ba'i rang bzhin te/ /bdag nyid kho na'i bgo skal ma yin kyang / /blo chung kho bo mya ngan gdung bas gzir/ /sdug bsngal mun pa sel zhig dkon mchog gsum/ /kye ma nyon dang lhas bstsal dge 'dun 'bangs/ /mdza' bshes gzhan gyi gros rogs ma mchis kyang /rang gis rang la de ring gros shig 'debs/ /bsgrims te mno bsam legs thong blo stobs skyed/ /mthon po'i rigs su skyes pa'i lha sras khyod/ /drin can pha mas bskyangs pa'i gces phrug khyod/ /blon 'bangs 'khor gyis bskor ba'i rje bo khyod/ /dran shes go cha bgos pa'i dpa' bo khyod/ /dud 'gror gyur kyang sdug bsngal ga la dgos/ /khyod la bzang po'i phun tshogs du ma mchis/ /ma nor dam chos thos pas skal ba bzang / /shugs drag dad pa brtan po'i mgo 'dren bzang / dkon mchog skyabs su 'dzin pa'i rgyab rten bzang / /byams dang snying rje chen po'i dpung gnyen bzang / /theg chen chos dang ma bral bsam pa bzang / /skyo shas nges 'byung drag po'i skul ma bzang / /blo phugs chos la gtad pas 'dun ma bzang / /rten cing 'brel 'byung shes pas lta ba bzang / /dran dang shes bzhin brtan po'i srung ma bzang / /bzang po gzhan dang bral yang ci byas sla/ /khyed kyis rgyal phran phra mo'i srid thob nas/ /de yi longs spyod churdo ༵ las nyams la/ /de tsam sbya ngan drag po ci phyir byed/ /de

ni 'khor ba 'di yi rang bzhin te/ stong gsum 'jig rten khams la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /tshangs pa brgya byin 'khor los bsgyur sogs kyang / /las bzang stobs zad dmyal ba'i mthil du lhung / /mnar med me yis bar mtshams med bar bsregs/ /'phral gyi bde bas char yang bskrun med pa'i/ /ting 'dzin dga' bde'i ro la spyod rnams kyang / /sdug bsngal reg bya mtshams med myong ba yi/ /rab tu tsha sogs dmyal bar 'tshod cing bsregs/ /lha yi chu bo dal gyis babs pa na/ /lha drug gzhon nu pho mo'i tshogs rnams dang / /rtsed 'jo'i dga' ston bzang por g.yengs rnams kyang /mtha' mar mi 'dod bzhin du so sor 'bral/ /reg pa tsam gyis sha rus pags 'byed pa/ /mthong bas 'jigs skyed dmyal srung tshogs rnams kyis/ /zangs zhun khol ma'i chu bor 'tshod cing dkrug /mi mo sus kyang cha tsam bskrun dka' ba'i/ /spyod pas mi ngoms 'dod yon lnga yi gter/ /lha yi bu mo mdzes ma'i tshogs rnams dang / /mthun pa'i 'dod reg dga' mgur spyod rnams kyang / bsdus 'joms thig nag spu gri'i nags tshal dang / /shal ma li sogs 'jigs rung sems dmyal du/ /yan lag nying lag dum bur myag thag gcod/ shin tu mi bzod reg bya myong bar 'gyur/ /thos pa tsam gyis 'dod chaṭa bral rnams kyang / /snying gi pad+mo g.yo bar nus byed pa'i /dri za'i bu mo'i spu dang mi lung sogs nyan nas yid la dga' ba myong rnams kyang / 1//sdus

gsod ku di ra bzhad skra mtshang 3bru'i tshig /rtsub cing mi snyan rtag tu thos par 'gyur/ /da dung nyon dang dge 'dun rin chen 'bangs/ /khyod kyang sngon tshe tshangs pa lan mang thob/ /stong gsum 'jig rten khams la dbang yang bsgyur/ /skabs 'gar mnar med dmyal bar skye ba blangs/ //skru zhun khol ma rgya mtsho las lhag 'thungs/ /skabasa'agar khyi phag dag tu skye ba blangs/ /mi gtsang phung po ri rab las lhag zos/ /nub gcig myong ba'i sdug bsngal 'di tsam la/ /khyod kyi skad ngan de tsam 'don byas na/ /mnar med dmyal bar skyes tshe ji ltar bya/ /srid 'dir zag bcas bde la spyod pa'i mthar/ /mi zad sdug bsngal myong ba rang bzhin yin/ /srid pa'i 'byor pa thob pa'i tha mar rgud/ /nor rdzas longs spyod bsags mthar gzhan gyis spyod/ /mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun 'groṭa pa'i ma mthar 'bral/ 'di dag 'khor ba 'di yi gshis min phyir/ /khyod nyid kho na'i bgo skal ma yin pas/ /skad ngan bton pas mi phan thar lam tshol/ /bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje dang / /bdag pyi / lhag bsam dag pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /bdag dang mar gyur regs drug sems can kun/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal che las sgrol bar shog ces smras te cung zad 'das pa dang / char rlung de dag thams cad zhi sprin gyi phung po rnams 'thor te nam mkha' dri ma med par gyur pa'i tshe smras rnga /114 spyin da lta dwangs la da lta 'dus/ /sprin da lta 'dus pa da lta

'thor/ /'dus byas kyi chos kun 'od dang 'dra/ /skad cig kyang mi rtag 'gyur bar go/ ces smras/ de nas rim gyis nam langs te nyi ma 'char ga'i 'od dmar chem gyis byung ba'i tshe bsam pa/ kye ma kho bo dud 'gro'i gzugs su gyur kyang reg pa shin tu gsal bas mi'i gzugs ngu yod pa 'i gnas nabs dang khyad par mi snang bas/ wa raṇa si'i pho brang gi rtse mor babs te yab dang btsun mo sogs dang mjal tsam zhig byed dgos pas tsug mar dkon mchog la gsol ba zhig btab nas/ de nas 'gro snyam ste smyon shing mtho ba zhig gi rtse mor 'phur te smras pa/ kye ma nga yi bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ /nyams thag bdag gis gsol ba 'di la dgongs/ /dus 'dir bdag la brtse ba'i mthu dpung bskyed/ /re sa gzhan na med do thugs rje can/ /bdag gi dge ba'i bzhes gnyen drin can ma/ /thar pa'i lam mkhan ma ti mahā ni/ /bdag cag dor nas dag pa'i zhing du bshegs/ /rgyal bu las ngan chos kyi dga' ba bdag gnyen 'dun kun bral nags mthar gcig pur 'khyams/ /rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrub la mthu med pa'i /nyams chung 'dab chags snyu byug lus su gyur/ kye ma 'di ya nga sngon gyi las 'bras te/ /yid brtan meng pa 'khor ba'i gshis su go/ /deng nas bdag gi bde thug legs nyes kun/ /bslu med skyabs mchog rin chen gsum gyis mkhyen/ /zas med nags khrod snag por 'khyams pa'i tshe/ /kho bo'i mgon skyabs dkon //ga

gsum gyis mdzod/ /zla grogs med pa gcig pur lus pa'i tshe/ kho bo'i grogs po dkon chog gsum gyis mdzod/ /zas gos dang bral bkres skom gdung ba'i tshe/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis gdung ba sel bar mdzod/ ces smras te 'phur bar brtsams pas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug de nyid/ /mgon med pa'i 'gro ba cithams cad la nyin mtshan dus kun tu/ skad cig kyang mi g.yel bar gzigs pa yin pas/ de'i tshe yang rgyal bu de rjes su 'dzin pa'i dus chol babs par dgongs te sprul pa'i bya khu byug gi rnam pa can/ sgro dang spu re re'i rtse nas 'od zer lnga lnga khrom khrom 'phro ba/ shin tu yid du 'ong ba zhig gi rnam pa bstan te gar byung cha med du rgyal bu khu byugagi rnam pa can gyi mdun du babs nas/ tshod bgam pa'i phyir mkhyen yang ma mkhyen pa ltar mdzad nas bka' bstsal pa/ kye ma khu byug sngon po dbyangs snyan khyod/ /gnas 'dir da lta ci byed gang nas 'ong //da ni gar 'gro ci phyir gdung dbyangs 'then/ /skyabs su su bsnyen groṭa gyur gzhan med dam/ /khyod la legs pa'i yon tan ji tsam yod/ /khu byug bdag dang lhan cig 'grogs byed dam/ /ji ltar bden par drang po'i tshul du sgos/ zhes gsungs pa la/ zla bas lan phul ba/skyabs gnas bslu ba med pa'i bde bar gsheṭa/ /de sras bcas la snyinganas gus pas 'dud/ /rin chen 〉sdur sngon po'i kha dog la/ /'dzam bu /1 sbya'i gsar zhun 'phreng ba yis/ /yongs su bskor 'dra'i mdzes

pa'i sku mnga' zhing / /zhin tu snyan 'jibs dbyangs kyi 'phreng ba ni/ /mgrin pa'i lam nas legs par sgrog pa yis/ /yid la dad pa mchog skyed mdzad pa khyod/ /mthong ba tsam gyis lhag par dga' ba skyes/ /de phyir gnas lugs yin tshul drang por 'tshal/ /cung zad dgongs par mdzad rigs e ma grogs/ /nga ni wa ra ṇa si'i grong khyer gyi/rgyal po lha snang stobs ldan zhes pa'i bu/ chos kyi dga' ba dge 'dun 'bangs zhes grags ar+ya tā re 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig ma/ /tshe 'di'i ma yi tshul gyis dngos byon te/ /dgyes bzhin brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung skyi /legs pa'i lam bzang dge ba'i lam la sbyar/ /bslu med skyabs gsum skyob pa'i mgon du bsten/ /dkar nag las 'bras blang dor gnas su bsnyen/ /dran shes bag yod brten bya'i grogasasu bsten/ /yid ches dang ba'i mos pa rtag tu skyes/ /gzhan yang bram ze chen po tha ru pa/ /pha rol phung po'i grong du thogs med du/ /'jug pa'i man ngag zab mo dag kyang mnos/ /de nas mi ring dge ba'i bshes gnyen ma/ /'jig rten khams su mi snang ltar gyur te/ /ribadag cag bor te yongs su mya ngan 'das/ /yab dang phyi nang blon po'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /rgyal srid khyim thab bya bar kho bo sbyar/ /de yi tshe na sngon gyi las dbang gis/ /bdag gi grogs po la gā ā na zhes/ /srid la chags pa'i 'dod pa'i dbang du song / /khrel med ba thabs du ma'i 'phrul sbyor gyis/ /bdag gi gzugs la grong sdu/ga

byas par gyur/ /kye ma rnyed dka'i dal 'byor thob na ya nga / /rang dbang med par gzhan gyi lag tu so nga / /gnas 'dir gnas pa'ang de yi rkyen gyis lags/ /da ni gar 3gro bdag la'ang cha ma mchis /'khor ba'i bde la yid brtan med mthong zhing / /skyabs gsum yon tan dran pas gdungs dbyangs 'then/ /skyabs ni ston pa sangs rgyas lung rtogs chos/ /grogs kyi dam pa tshogs mchog dge 'dun yin/ /de la gus shing de yi bstan pa la/ /rang gi nus mthus ji tsam nus pa slob/ /de las yon tan cung zad cas yang med/ /srid pa'i zhags pas rang dbang med par bcings/ rtag tu las nyon gnyis kyi gzhan dbang gyur/ /de phyir skyon rnams kun gyi rang bzhin yin/ /khyod dang bdag gnyis skyabs gnas mthun gyur cing / /spyod mthun lta ba mtshungs na lngan cis 'grogs/ zhes pa la sprul pa'i bya de na re/ e ma nyon dang skal bzang dge 'dun 'bangs/ /nga ni thog med dus nas /byed kyi mgon/ /nged 'dir rjes/ su 'dzin phyir gnas 'dir mchis/ /khyod kyi smras rnams bdag gi /long du chud/ /cad kyi ma yi tshul bzhin bshes gnyen ma/ abya tā re rgyal ba'i yum mchog yin/ /grogs kyi dbang gis dud 'gro'i gzugs phung du/ /gyur pa 'di yang las kyi dbang yin te/ /blon po 'di dang srog lan yang yang chags/ /e ma legs par nyon dang dge 'dun 'bangs/ /chos ma// 8skyes bu gang du gnas kyang bde/ /snying stobs ma zhum sems

bzang skyed bgyid dang / khyod kyi las dang bdag gi smon lam gyis/ /smra shes don go'i dud 'gro 'khor du 'du/ /rang dang gzhan gyi bya ba rgya cher 'grub/ ces sogs gsungs pas/ rgyal bu bya'i gzugs brnyan can gyis kyang spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par yid ches te gsol ba btab pas/ legs pa'i lam la dkri ba'i blo sbyong ba'i rim pa mang du gsungs shing / de'i don zang du chud de zhag du ma'i bar chos kyi dga' ston rol cing lngan cig tu gnas so/ rgyal bu bya'i gzugs brnyan can la yang sprul pa'i byi'u chung zhes mtshan btags so/ de nas sprul pa'i bya'i zhal nas/ 'gran zla med pa'i rgyal ba'i gtso/ /snang ba mtha' yas zhabs la 'dud/ /kye ma snying zas byi'u chung / /re zhig nags khrod snag po 'dir/ /bya tshogs gzhan dang lhan cig sdod/ /'di nas lo gcig 'das pa'i tshe /bla ma dri med dpal ldan che/ /'khor tshogs du mas bskor te 'byon/ de tshe nga yang khyod dang 'phrad/ ces gsungs te gar song cha med du gshegs so wa ra ṇa sir ni rgyal bu rdzun ma 'khor bcas pho brang du bsu ba dang bcas phebs pa dang / gser bzang mas blon po'i bu med pa thos ma thag tu sgo mdun na mar byon pas/ sngar rgyal bu mthong ba'i tshe sems la dga' sgo dpag med yod pa la yid mi dga' ba drag po skyes pas/ the tshom shin tu che ba skyes r+ṣa// snun dris pa/ ma lus 'gro la phan bde stol ba'i mgon/ /bslu med dkon1 sdu/ga

gsum gyi thugs kyi sdos/ /lha zas dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo la/ /sgo gsum gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal bu skyo bsang rtsed mor gshegs pa'i tshe/ /thugs bde ngal ba med par mchis lags sam/ skyed mos tshal gyi ltad mo ji ltar gzigs/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rten bzang mjal lags sam zhes gsungs pas/rgyal bus kyang lan ji lta ba bzhin du btab pas sngar gsung thos tshe sems shin tu bde bar yong bar la de yang ma byung nas yid ma bde ba chen po skyes so/ de nas stong dpon chen po yam sher rang gi bu shi ba thos ma thag tu mya ngan gyis sems rab tu non te the tshom med par ga ’ nga chen po la ltebs nas shi bas yab rab skyong rgyal pos kyang de'i dge rtsa rgya chen po mdzad do/ ga ra su ti ni rgyal bu la gā ā na yin par shes te rab tu dga'/ gzhan wa ra ṇa mi thams cad la sngar gyi rgyal bu yin pa'i snang ba las ma byung ba sngar lhar byung / de'i dus btsun mo gser bzang ma phyir bskrad de su ra su ti dang lhan cig tu gnas pa dang / sngar rgyal bu la chos kyi bya ba 'ba' zhig las med pa la/ spyod pa sna tshogs pa byed pa dang / nyin bzhin rgyal po btsun mo nang 'khor rnams la dam chos kyi bdud rtsi rtsol ba yin pa la/ de yang rgyun chad pa dang / sngon ngag 'jam zhing 'phags pa'i dge 'dun mthong tshe bkur sti byed pa la/ ngag mi /sdu zhing dge 'dun la sdong bar byung bas thams cad kyis rgyal bu
