mdzad spyod gyur zhes gleng ba las stong dpon gyi bu yin pa mi shes/ de'itshe btsun mo gser bzang mas rgyal bus mkhyen pa'i yig rigs sna tshoṭa pa bstan pas phal cher shes rab che bas shos kyang la la ma shes/ sngar rgyal bus gsungs pa rnams la kho mos 'di thad nas 'di ba da snang bas ji ltar lags dris kyang sngar gsungs pa rnams cung zad kyang sbo rgyum byung bas/ btsun mos sngar gyi lung bstan pa yang dran nas/rgyal bu brdzus ma yin par rtogs nas pho brang gi sgor shing byang la yi ge 'di ltar bris/ mtshan mo gzhan gyis ma tshor bar gcig pur bros te song ngo / /skyabs gnas bslu ba med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/dbyer med gcig bsdus bdag gi bshes gnyen mchog /chos kyi dga' ba'i zhabs kyi pad+ma la/ /dus gsum kun tu gus pas phyag bgyid do /nyon dang sa spyod rgyal po gtsor gyur pa'i/ /wa ra ṇa mi'i 'gro rnams bdag la gson/ /chos kyi zla ba nub tu nub nas song / /stag thags gyon pa'i wa skyes bkur ba las/ /blo yid chos dang bstun na mi legs sam/ /gser bzang ma yi snying dbang bton zin pa/ /da lta bar du blun nas ma go yi/ /da ni phyogs med sa mtha' bskor du 'gro/ /snyi nas ngas zer 'di rnams bden nam rdzun/ /rgyal po la sogs kun gyis gzigs par 'gyur/ zhes so/ de nas nam langs pa dang blon chen blo gros rab bzang gis mthong nas shing byang rgyalapo la gzigs su phul nas btsun mo mi snang tshul zhus pas/ /sdu po

phyir cung zad bskul/ /de yang dge la phyogs pa'i tshe/ /snyi dang nang gi bdud gnyis 'byung / /phyi yi bdad ni 'di ltar ste/ /sngon tshe bdag cag ston pa yis/ /byang chub thugs bskyed nas bzung ste/ /spyod pa spyod tshe kun du yang / /ji ltar thugs bskyed bzang mdzad par /de ltar sdig can bdud kyis kyang / /smon lam log par btab byung bas/ /rang re thub pa'i rjes 'jug la/ /nges par gnod 'gyur shes bya ste/ /byang chub sems dpa' dang po bar/ /ston pa la sogs gzugs bstan te/ /rim gyis sems las nyams byas nas/ /dman ba nyid du lhung bar byed/ /tshul khri /sa tshul bzhin bsrung ba yi/ /dang po'i las can 'khor bzhi'i mdun/ /bla ma 'am grogs 'khor rgyal po sogs/ /sna tshogs thabs kyi gzugs bstan te/ /'dod pas byang chub thob 'gyur gyi/ /dka' bas byang chub nam yang min/ /de phyir 'dod la ci dgar spyod /zhes smra brtul zhugs nyams par byed/ /ting 'dzin shes rab spyod la 'ang / /yid dam lha 'am ston pa'i gzugs/ /lung ston chos 'chad de nyams byed/ /'khor bzhin bden la dga' gyur cing / /'dod pa chung dang mchog shes la/ /grong gi bsngags pa brjod byed cing / /'du 'dzi thabs kyis sprul par byed/ /mis ni dge ba'i bya ba la/ /dang por 'jug tshe bzlog byed cing / /bar du dge las nyams par byed/ /tha mar kun tu bsgrims nas 'tsho/ /mdor cin // 2dus dge blo can/ /shes rab chung ba phal mo che/ /phyi yi bdud

kyi bran du 'gyur/ de phyir mkhas pa rnams kyis ni/ /bsgrims te de dbang gtang mi bya/ /nang gi bdud kyang 'di lta ste/ /stobs ldan nyon mongs dgra bo 'dis/ /thog med dus nas rang re rnams/ /phung par byas shing brlags par byas/ /bde ba nam yang ma bskye da cing / sdug bsngal thams cad bsgrub par byas/ /phyi yi bdud kyi rtsa ba yang /nang bdud ma rung 'di yis byas/ /dgra dang nad 'bras zugs rngu sogs/ /mi 'dod thams cad 'di yis bskyed/ /dad dang tshul khrims bsod nams sogs/ /legs tshogs ma lus 'di yis bcom/ /sngon chad gnod cing 'dir yang gnod/ /da yang 'di dbang btang gyur tshe/ mu mtha' med par sdug bsngal byed/ /gal te 'di dgrar ma bzung bar/ /'di yi bran du byas gyur kyang / /gyi phyir shin tu gnod 'gyur ba/ /'di las tha chad gang na yod/ /mdor na 'di las gnod gyur pa/ /bdag la dgra yis ma byas shing / /nad kyis ma yin gdon gyis min/ /gshin rje 'byung po sogs kyis min/ /de phyir 'di la dgra bzung la/ rtag tu 'joms par bya bar rigs/ pha rol do zla'i g.yul tsam las /rgyal ba dpa' bo ma yin te/ /thog med bskal pa'i snga rol nas/ /de 'dra'i rgyal ba yang yang thob/ /gang zhig bcom pas phyi nang dgra /gtan med nyid du 'joms byed pa/ /su zhig nyon mongs dgra 'joms pa/ de ni dpa' bo'i dpa' bo yin/ /tshangs dang brgya byin 'khor bsgyur dang / /bsam gta/ lha/de

bza' bar brtsams/ /nyi lhags char gyis lus la rab gdungs shing / /bcud ldan mi zas dri tsam med pa yis/ stogs skom tsha grang drag pos phyi nas gzir/ /bshes dang bral ba'i gdung bas nang nas gzir/ /tsha grang sdug bsngal myong lugs 'di lta na/ sems can dmyal bar skyes snyam the tshom skyes/ /stogs skom gzhin rje'i 'jig rten nyid la 'gran/ /mgon med dud 'gro nyid dang shin tu mtshungs/ /'jigs skrag bar do'i sems can bas kyang lhag /'di 'dra'i thug bsngal las ngan gang gi 'bras/ /yab gcig chos kyi rgyal po dza ya dang / /yum chen me tog kun tu mdzes pa yis/ /dar thab gos bskon 'dod dgu'i longs spyod byin/ snying gi ze'u 'bru ltar bskyangs gces phyug ma/ /mgon med skyabs med gcig pur phyogs mthar 'khyams/ /yab yum bka' drin can gyi 'di mkhyen na/ /thugs la bzod par 'gyur ram kye ma hud/ /chos kyi ched du'ang btang bar ma nus shing / /byi dor rgyan gyis shin tu gces bzung ba'i/ /sha khrug phung po 'di yeng dang gi dus/ /rtswa ltar dor nas 'gro ba'i dus la babs/ /tshe 'dir sngon bsaṭa bsod nams dman gyur pas/ /dge ba'i las la spyad pa tshar med kyang / /yab yum bka' drin can gyi bka' drin dang / /rgyal sras chos khya dga' ba'i thugs rī las/ /cung zad bsags pa'i dge ba ci mchis dang / sgro/tshe /sdus gzhan du bsags pa'i rnam par dkar/ /de dag ma lus

gcig tu bsdoms pa dang / /bslu med dkon mchog rin chen bden pa'i mthus/ /ji ltar btab pa'i smon lam 'grub gyur cig /skye gi na dang 'chi ba la sogs pa/ /dpag med sdug bsngal spyod pa'i ma rnams kyi/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho rab tu skem gyur nas/ /kun kyang bla med bde ba che thob shog /bdag kyang ma gyur 'gro ba thams cad la/ /re ba skang ba'i nor bu ltar gyur te/ /long pa rnams kyi mig tu bdag gyur cig /'on pa rnams kyi rna ba'i dbang po dang / /rmongs pa rnams kyi shes rab dam par shog /zhugs pa rnams kyi smra bar 'gyur ba dang / /bkres pa rnams kyi zas su bdag gyur cig /phongs pa rnams kyi mgon dang nore du gyur/ /sdug bsngal can la dbugs dbyung bgyid pa dang / /tsha bas gdungs la zla bltar bsil zhing / /grang ba rnams la nyi ltar bdag gyur cig /'jigs pa chen po brgyad kyis nyen gyur pa/ /de dag rnams kyi 'jigs pa sel bar shog /thar 'dod rnams la thar lam ston byed cing / /gnas skabs gnas mal khang bzang rgyal srid dang / /nor gos bzhon pa la sogs 'dod rnams la'ang / /sdig pa med par bdag gis sbyin par shog /mdor na bla med byang chub ma thob par//skyabs kyi dam pa dkon mchog gsum bzung ste/ /don gyi gtso bo gzhan don gtsor byed cing /bsam pa'i gtso bo byang chub sems bskyed de/ /spyod pa'i gtso bo rgyal sras spyod pa la/ /slob pa/lha /na

ras gzigs dang mtshungs par zhog /'di nas kho mo shi 'phos gyur ma thag /bdag gi bshes gnyen cho sa kyi dga' ba de/ /gang du bzhugs kyang zhal bzang mthong gyur te/ /lhan cig dam nga 'i chos la spyod par shog /bshes gnyen de nyid bya yi gzugs bzhugs sam/ //'on te dag pa'i zhing du bzhugs kyang rung / /myur du mjal ba'i skal ba thob gyur nas/ /bdag gi mya ngan sel ba'i dbugs dbyung zhing / /thugs je 'i lcags kyus legs par 'dzin tshopar zhog /der ma zad do tshe rabs kun tu yang / /bshes khyod 'gro ba'i don du gar 'khrungs kyang / /bdag kyang lngan ceg gnas der skye ba dang / /khyad par khyod la sdug bsngal ma mchis kyang / /'gro don cha/dzad la dga' ba'i tshul bstan pa/ /lhag par dka' dang zla grogs med pa'i sar/ /bdag gis khyod kyi sdong grogs byed par zhog /tshe rabs kun tu bde 'gro'i rten thob cing / /bla med sangs rgyas bstan dang mjal ba dang / /dam chos bsgrub par mi khom skyon spangs te/ /nyin mtshan dge ba'i las la brtson par zho /gzhan dbang gyur ram rkyen ni gang yang rung / /lus srog bye ba phrag brgya gtong dgos kyang / /skyabs gnas gsum dang bsam pa bzang po 'di/ /skad cig tsam yang gtong bar ma gyur cig /bdag la sdug bsngal myong ba 'di bdag gis/ /sems can kun gyi dre ga bsngal smin gyur pas/ /de dag —/ mas kyi /sdu bsngal zad gyur zhog /dkon mchog bden pas smon lam

'grub gyur cig ces smras nas/ gcan gzan 'jigs su rung ba la lus 'di ster dgos snyam nas gom pa bstan bor ba dang / gar byung cha med par mdun du dge slong chos gos rnam gsum sku la gsol ba dbu thum zhabs rjen tshul khrims kyi dri ngad ldang ba zhig byung nas/ btsunamo gzigs pa dang e khrims grogs gzhan med pa'i sar bud med dang phrad pa mi legs kyi gsungs nas gshegs grabs byas pas/ gser bzang ma spyir dge 'dun la rab tu dad pa dang / khyad par rgyal bu med pa'i yus kyis brdungs nas ngu zhing zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ bslu med dkon mchog rin chen rnam pa gsum/ /las ngan bdag la thugs rjes skyabs su gsol/ /'di nas byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /skyabs mchog rin chen gsum gyis ma gtong zhig /kye ma gson dang sprul pa'i dge slong lags/ /srid kyi skyon spangs rnam dag ngur sgrig 'dzin/ /ston pa'i rjes 'jug kho mo'i 'dren pa mchoganyon mongs yongs bral khyod kyis ma gzigs na/ /kho mo lus srog 'dor las gzhan 'ga' med/ /las ngan bu mo gser bzang ma zhes bdag /las kyi dbang gis 'khor ba'i gnas su skyes/ /sngon bsags dman pas bud med lus rten thob/ /rgya gar dbus phyogs rgyal po dza ya zhes/ /stobs 'byor can de bdag gi pha lags kyis/ gzhon nu'i dus nas dkon mchog gsum la mos/ /skyabs su 'gro la legs par bslab par bya/ /srid kyi bde ba btson ra ltar 1//nga

na/ /shākya'i rab byung rnams la dad pa skyes/ /ngur sgrig 'dzi pa nam zhig yong ngam snyam/ /nyin dang mtshan du bsam gtan de la byas/ /'on kyang las kyis rgyal po'i chung mar byin/ /wa ra ṇa ra rab skyong rgyal po'i bu/ /sprul pa'i rgyal bu mchog cig grogs su thob /sgo gsum 'bad pas de la bsnyen cing bkur/ /gsung gi bdud rtsis yid rab brlan byas kyang / /yang cig bdag gi bsod nams gting nas zad/ /rgyal bu dam pa bar chad dbang du song / /der ni skyo shas drag pos yid g.yos te/ /nags tshal gnas 'dir ngu 'bod 'khyams shing mchis/ /da ni 'khor ba 'di las sgrol ba'i thabs/ /bla med dam pa'i chos shig bdag la stsol/ zhes dang /rgyu mtshan zhib tu zhus pas/ dge slong de sa la bzhugs nas/ khyod dkon mchog gsum la de tsam zhig mos na rjes su 'dzin gyi bdag gi ngag 'di la nyon cig gsungs te/ e ma ho dus gsum bde gshegs bden gnyis dam pa'i chos/ /byang sems nyan rang kun tu gus pas 'dud/ /nga yi skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po la/ /snying nas mos pa brtan pa'i bud med khyod/ /da lta dge slong nga dang 'phrad pa 'di/ /sngon gyi las bzang deng 'dir sad par nges/ /srid 'di mi rtag skad cig glog dang 'dra/ /khyod kyi sngar gyi bya ba de rnams kun/ /bsam par shes na chos la yid ches 'gyur/ /'byor ldan rgyal po/ ༵ mor skyes pa dang / /dam chos dar ba'i yul grur skyes pa de//

rnam dkar dge ba'i las la spyad pas na/ /'bras bu bslu med 'byung bar ston pa yin/ /rang nyid rab tu byung la mos na yang / /dbang med rgyal po'i chung mar byin pa des/ /sngon las bya yi grib ma ji bzhin du/ /'dor med phyi bzhin 'brang ba go dgos so/ /sprul pa'i gzhon nu mchog dang mjal ba de/rtso bsam pa bzang po gser dang 'dra ba la/ /sprul pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang / /rjes su chags nas bzhad ces ston pa yin/ /rgyal bu dam pa grogs su thob gyur nas/ /de nyid bar chad dbang du song ba de/ /gang du 'dus pa'i tha ma so sor bral/ /des mtshon gson pa'i tha ma 'chi ba ste/ /'dus byas mi rtag yin zhes ston pa yin/ /de nas grogs med gcig pur 'khyams gyure te/ /bzod dka'i sdug bsngal drag po myong ba de/ /'khor ba'i bya ba 'di dag thams cad la/ /snying po cung zad tsam yang med par ston/ /da lta dge slong nga dang 'phrad pa 'di/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la blo gtad na/ /'phral rkyen sdug bsngal cung zad byung na yang / /yun du bde ba thob ces go bar gyis/ /de sogs nyin re'i bya ba re la'ang / /go na dam chos ston pa sha stag go/ /khyod nyid snying nas dam chos byed pa na/ /tshul khrims bsrung ba yon tan kun gyi gter/ /thog mar rnam dag sdom pa mnod dgos pas/ /khyod ni rgyal rigs du gyur nyon mongs rigs/ /bud med yin pas blo mang 'dod thag nye/ /stobs 'byor che bas sdug sran khyag di dka'/ 12//la

te bslab bya 'gal zhing nyams gyur na/ /'o skol gnyis kur mi legs chen po skyed/ /de lta min na bdag gis chos smra'o/ gsungs pa dang /gser bzang mas kyang ji ltar gsungs pa bsgrub par khas blangs nas rab tu byung ste/ bla mas shing gi lha las rdzu 'phrul gyis chos gos blangs pa gnang ba'i ngur smrig gi gos kyis bklubs te mtshan byang chub bzang mor btags nas/ byang chub tu sems bskyed du bcug ste pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam la khrid de/ rgya gar lho phyogs kyi rgyal po'i mnga' 'bangs su song zhig par lung bstan te dge slong 'ja' ltar yal lo/bzang mo ni yul phyogs kyi mtha' rnams su zas bsod stoms tsam gyis 'tsho zhing / thos don legs par bsgoms pas rgyud la yang tshul bzhin skyes pa'i skabs shig na/ sngar gyi rang gi bla ma dge slong byung nas 'phab/sa pa thub/sa rje chen po'i bsgom bzlas byin sngags lam la khrid de/der thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas 'phags pa'i zhal mthong nas rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor ma chen po zhig tu gyu ra te phyis su byi'u chung dang mjal ba yin te 'og tu gsal lo/ da lta yang ri bo po ṭa la la sogs pa rnams su 'byor zhing rgya bod la sogs par sprul pa'i zlos gar rgyun mi chad par bzhugs pa yin la/ bla ma dge slong de ni dri med dpal ldan nyid kyi sprul pa'o/ de dag gi tshe wa ra ṇa sir yang yab rgyal po'i rgyal srid rgyal bu rdzus ma la phog pas/rgyal1 ༵ 0de ni sdig spyod sna tshogs pa'i bya bas wa ra ṇa si'i 'gro ba

rnams sdug bsngal zhing dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur mi bya ba dang / yab la dbang mi ster zhing bkur sti mi byed pa sogs thams cad sdug bsngal la sbyor ba byung bas/ yab ni mya ngan gyi mal du gzims pas sha spags rus la thim sa/ zas kyang mi bzhes par shugs ring 'don zhing pho brang gi rtse mor bzhugs so/ nang blon dang 'bangs grong 'jug yod par shes pa rnams the tsho / che bar skyes/ phyi rol gyi 'bangs grong rijug yod pa mi shes pa kun na re/ rgyal bu 'di rlo na po la gā sgyu na zhi tshun mdzad spyogangan pa 'di lta ra byas pas sngar rgyal bu stong chub se /sa dpa' zhes pa de yang blon po khyad par can gyis byas par 'dug ces gleng dgos pa byung / de'i tshe btsun mo nges legs/ sems la sdug bsngaladrag po skyes nas rigs ldan rgyal po la zhus pa/ /kye ma rgyal po chen po laṭa/ /deng dus wa ra ṇa si 'dir/ sdig pa spyod pa'i rgyal bu yis/ /thams cad sdug la sbyor ba 'di/ /sngon gyi lung bstan dran lags sam//stong dpon chen po rmi ma she yi/ /phra ma rgyal po khyod kyis nyan/ /'phags ma yum gyi gsung nyid la/ /bud med ngag ces zer nas brnyas/ /bsam bzang chos kyi blon po gsum/ /gzhan gyi yul du chad pas bskrad/ /mtshan ngan la gā ā na de/ /rgyal sras chen po'i blon por bskos/ /bsam bzhin dran bzhin 'di ltar byas/ /da ni bas ma pa rdzogs sam ci zhes smras pas/ rgyal po sdug bsngal gyis rab hūṃ myos te/ cung zad bsam blo zhig btang nas smras pa/ /bslu med ༵༵sa

kyi dam pa dkon mchog gsum/ /snying med bdag gi spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /bden no khyod bden nges legs khyod rang bden/ /bcol chung rgyal por rab skyong zer ba bdag /gzhon nu'i dus nas dam pa'i chos dang mjal/ /dkon mchog bslu ba med pas rjes su bzung / /rje btsun sgrol ma dngos su btsun mor slebs/ /rnam dkar dge ba dpag med bsgrub par byas/ /'on kyang 4la srid skyong ba'i bu med nas/ /lhag pa'i lha la rtse gcig gsol ba btab/ chos mthun blo gros gsal ba'i bu gcig skyes/ /'phags mas dus gsum gsal bar ribastan na yang / /dmus long bdag gis shes bzhin g.yang sar mchongs/ /bdud kyis byin rlabs mtshan ngan blon po yis/ /nga yi bu de'i lus la yid sems zhugs/ /yun ring brtan par bzhugs par 'dod nas su/ /grong 'jug sbyang du 'jug pa de nyid kyang / /rang gis rang nyid brlag tu 'jug pa bzhin/ /sprul pa'i btsun mo mi gnas gzhan du song / /khyod kyis bdag la de ltar sdang ba ni/ /da ni ci bya bya ba'i thabs dang bral/ /bzang po nam zhig rgud du med pa na/ 'dus byas mi rtag rgyal bas ga la gsungs/ /da ni 'gyod kyang bya ba thal nas song /de ltar ma smra nges legs bzhin bzang ma/ /'phags mas khyod la dam chos ma bstan nam/ /khon 'dzin gzhan sems dkrugs na rung ngam ci/ /da ni kho bo snying rje'i yul du gyur/ zhes gsung pa//32nges legs kyang skyengs pa lta bu cang smra rgyu ma byung / der rgyal

po'i thugs dgongs la/ da ni bu 'di la chad pa'i las byas nas gsod pa'am mtha' la sprugs nas/ chos kyi blon po ye shes 'dzin la sogs/ pa slar bkug nas rgyal srid blon pos bskyangs du 'jug pa las 'os med dgongs pa yod tsa na/ mnal lam du btsun mo ma ti mahā ni byon te/kye chos rgyal rab skyong chen po khyod da ni mya ngan ngal ba ma byed par dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba thob cig khyod kyis bdag gi ngag bcag pa dang / nyes med kyi chos blon chad pas mnar ba dang /gzhon nu'i dus su sdig pa'i las byas pa dang / tshe rabs sngon nas b.lags pa'i sgrib pa mang po zhig smin pa yin pas sdug bsngal ba ma byed par re zhig rgyal bu brdzus ma rgyal du chug cig dang nam zhig na khyod kyi rgyal srid sto ngas par mi 'gyur ro/ de ltar min par rgyal bu brdzus ma 'di gsod pa'am chad pa gcod pa sogs byas na yang de'i rnam par smin pa phyi ma 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ zhes gsungs pa rmis/mnal sad pa na mno bsam bzhes nas ngar sngar yang ma ti mahā na'i jig bcag pas 'di ltar byung / da yang dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rjes rmi lam du yum gyis lung bstan par nges pas/ de la ma nyan na gdon mi za bar nyes pa bskyed par 'gyur ro snyam du dgongs nas chad cipa gcod pa'i sems zhi nas phyi nang blon po rnams kyis rgyal bu 'dis mi 'tshams pa'i bya ba byas pas khrims kyis mnar dgos 'dug ces yang yang zhus kyang ma gsan no/ grong 'jug gi rkyen gyis bya'i lus ༵ lha/nga

ba dang sprul pa'i bya dang mjal pa so gas kyi skabs te bzhi pa'o / / de nas byi'u chung ni sprul pa'i byas lung bstan pa ltar shing 'bras gsol zhing nags stug pa rnams kyi khrod du 'grim nas/ smra —/khan ne+e tso ('jam dpal dbyangs kyi byin gyis ba bas zhing bas bzhin du smon lam btab pa zhig go )gcig 'dug pa de la gsungs pa/ gi gi ku ku byi'u'i dbyangs/ /smra mkhan khyod kyis go 'am ci/ ri /go na legs lam dam chos yod/ /dal 'byor mi dang skal ba mnyam/ zhes gsungs pa la smra mkhan ni tso na re/ gsung go gsung go dam chos gsung / /ngas kyang nyan no khyod kyis gsungs/ /byi'u gzhan la'ang gsung bar zhu/ dud 'gro'i blo dang ldan pa mdzod/ ces zer bas/ byi'u thugs la dga' ba lhag par skyes nas/ da ni bya rnams la chos smras kyang / go bo yin snyam du dgongs nas ni tso la/ skyabs 'gro byed du bcug nas/ ni tsos bya dang byi'u gzhan rnams la bslabs pas shes/ de'i phan yon dang blang dor rnams gsungs pas ni tsos go nas gzhan rnams la bshad pas thor re ba go/ de nas 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i 'jig rten gyi mthong tshod la dper blangs nas gsungs pas shin tu legs par go/ gzhan las 'bras kyi bla dor sogs pa rim gyis ba rten pas ni tso ma gtogs bya gzhan rnams dud 'gro la song bas shin tu go dka' bar gyur te mongs pa'i tshe byi'u'i dgongs pa la/ da ni chos mi go ba yin nam snyam du dgo~X nas thugs la yi mug skyo shas drag po 'khrungs te/ dkan

mchog gsum la gsol ba btab pas dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rīrjes bya rnams blo dang ldan par byung ste chos bstan pa go nas zams cad sems zhi zhing dul nas sdig pa 'dzem zhing yid kyis ye ge drug pa rgyun mi chad du bzla ba'i bya sum cu tsam byung / de'i tshe slob dpon la de tso bskos nas ming sangs rgyas 'dzin du btags/ byi'u chung rang nyid nags khrod dben pa zhig tu snga dro skyabs 'gro dang 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ gung du dkar nag las 'bras dang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal/ snyi dro byams pa dang snying rje/ srod du byang sems/ tho rengs stong nyid bsgom zhing bar kun tu dkon mchog gsum dang gtong ba dang tshul khrims dang 'phags pa lo gi shā ra rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas yi ge drug pa bzla zhing yun ring por bzhugs pas/ sngar gyi sprul pa'i byas gsungs pa bzhin du/ bla ma dri med dpal ldan ga mas su byang chub sems dpa'i cha byad can gyi khyi'u dkar po g.yon du bud med mdzes ma sngon mo/ mdun du khyi'u gur kum gyi mdangs can/ gzhan yang 'khor bsam gyes mi khyab pas bskor ba mdun gye nam mkha'i khams ma lus pa khyab pa 'ja' 'od kyi lam nas byon pas/ byi'u chung gi kyang sngar sprul pa'i byas lung bstan pa'i bla ma dri med dpal ldan yin par shes nas bya ru gyur pas bkur sti gzhan byed pa ma byung yang / yid la dad pa'i gdung ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa skyes te/ zhabs kyi pad+mor mgo bos gtugs te/ 'gran gyi do med rin po che/ /dus //ma

sangs rgyas kun 'dus pa/ /dri ma zad pa'i mtshan mnga' ba'i/ /bla ma chen po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /las ngan byi'u chung bdag nyid/ /dkon mchog thugs rjes gzhan dbang gis/ /dal 'byor mi yi lus rten thob/ 'phags ma yum gyis rjes su bzung / /bras ze chen po tha ru par/ /zab lam grong 'jug gdams pa bslabs/ /srid 'byor la chags mi dge'i grogs /blon po ngan pas bdag lus 'phrogs/ /'khor nor stobs 'byor lta ci smos/ /rang gi lus kyang dbang ma gyur/ /da nas nags khrod 'khyar ba'i tshe/ /sprul pa'i bya yi rjes su bzung / /dpal ldan bla ma mjal 'gyur zhes/ /brtse bas bdag la lung bstan mdzod//de ring sangs rgyas dngos dang mjal/ /spyir yang dkon mchog gsum gyi drin/ /sgos su nga yi bshes gnyen mchog /sprul pa'i bya de'i sku drin yin/ /i ma gson dang rin po che/ /dam chos bdud rtsi bdag la zhu/ /'khor ba'i gnas las thar bar mdzod/ ces dang rgyu mtshan zhib tu zhus pas/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ kye ma 'khor ba'i gnas la bde ba ma mchis rigs kyi bu/ /thug bsngal kun gyi rang4bzhin 'di las myur du bros/ /khyod kyis smras rnams ma lus bdag gi sngon nas shes/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtse bas gdul bya la gzigs pa'i/ /dus la babs tshe nye ring med cing sgrib tu med/ /shes par gyis shig legs bshad bdud brtsi bdag gis sbyin/ /srid 'dir las nyo/ ༵༵nga gis skyes mthar nges par 'chi/ /nam 'chi nges med deng

sang 'chi yang ci cha yod /khyod kyang rgyal por gyur tshe longs spyod mongs rtsa ma btang bas/ da ni dud 'gror gyur tshe 'gyod kyang phan med ltar/ /gang zhig rang dbang 'byor tshe chos la ma spyod na/ /gzhan dbang gyur tshe phyis nas 'gyod kyang ji ltar bgyid/ /don dam chos kun rang bzhin gyis grub stong pa nyid/ /kun rdzob snang ngor kun rdzob rgyu yi 'bras bu smin/ /de phyir sdig las sdug bsngal dge las bde ba byung / /thug bsngal kun gzhi bde ba yongs bral 'khor ba 'dir/ bdag dang bdag 'dra mar gyur sems can thams cad kun/ /las nyon dbang gis thar med yongs su 'khor 'gyur zhing / /ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal dag ni bsam 'das dang / /skye 'gro'i bde sdug myong tshul legs par bsam byas na/ /'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal rang bzhin shes par 'gyur/ /'khor ba de 'dra'i 'jigs las skyob cing sgrol ba'i ded dpon gang zhe na/ /skyon kun yongs spangs rdzogs sangs rgyas dang bden gnyis dam chos 'phags tshogs te/ /ston pa dang ni rang gi ston pa bshes gnyen dam pa legs bkur bya/ /ston pa'i gsung dang bshes gnyen dam pa'i bka' ni 'bad pas bsgrub par bya/ /de las 'gal bas bskal brgya'i bar du rtse gcig 'bad kyang 'bras bu med/ /phyi yi ston pa mu stegs byed spangs rang lugs ston par yid ches bya/ / khyad par ston pa bshes gnyen dam pa gya tshom brten na 'dun ma nyes/ /blo dang ldan pa log pa'i ston pas bslus par gyur pa shin tu mang1 /37

brtag cing yon tan ldan nga 'i slob dpon bzang po brten nas gsung bzhin sgrub/ /mi dge can dang groṭa su 'grogs pas rang la mi dge zhuṭakyis skyed/ /dge ba'i grogs kyis dge ba'i chos yang rang la yongs su phan 'gyur ba/ /des na dad ldan dam pa'i grogs nyid btsal bar shin tu gal che'o/ /lam gyi gtso bo byang chub semal dang de yi legs drangs bslab pa gsum/ /bslu med dam par sangs rgyas kyis bstan yid ches nyams le/na mtham thug yin/ /rtag par le lo gnyid thugs spangs nas nyin dang mtshan du brtson 'grus bskyed/ /dran shes bsnyen te bag med spangs shing rgyal ba'i rjes su legs par slob/ che dang chung —ba kun gyi bran bzhin rang nyid yongs su dman cha 'dzin/ /tshe 'di'i khe drags rgyal kha ma lus gzhan la rnam par gtong bar bya/ /de lta'i spyod dang mi ldan pa na chos dang nam yang mthun mi 'gyur/ /de ltar dge slong bdag gi chos lugs yin gyi skal ldan khyod kyis zung / zhes bya la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa ha cang mi mang ba gsungs pa'i mjug tu/ byi'u chung la gong du gsungs pa rnams kyi don bzhin/ bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas/ 'bras bu mngon du byed tshul gyi bar gsung gis legs par bstsal/ thugs kyi dgongs par gtan nas byin gyis brlabs/ rtag tu 'bral ba med pa'i smon lam mdzad do/ der bla ma'i zhal nas/ rigs kyi bu de lta bu ni lam gyi ri/ ༵ cha tshang tsam zhig mdor bstan pa yin gyi/ gzhan nga sngon

sprul pa'i byas bstan pa'i chos rnams kyang yid la zungs shig 'di nas skye ba lnga'i steng du bdag las gsang sngags kyi chos zab mo mang po zhig thos par 'gyur gyis/ de'i rten 'brel tsam gyi phyir du da lta yang dkyil 'khor du bzhugs tsam bya ba yin pas de yang lus rten 'di yis bzhugs su mi rung bas/ de nas zhag bdun 'das nas rgya gar nub phyogs su ngas brda byung ba'i dus su zhog cig gsungs te bla ma nam mkha' nas gshegs so/ der byi'u chung shin tu dga' nas zhag bdun gyi bar du'ang sgug mi tshugs pa lta bu byung /zhag bdun song ba'i tshe bud med gzhon nu sma ra ser 'khyug ge ba gnyis byung nas/ da 'gro zer ba ltar/ de gnyis kyi phyi bzhin du song bas/ rgya gar nub phyogs kyi dur khrod chen po rol pa rngam pa zhes bya ba na rdo rje'i phug pa zhes pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang 'ja' 'od kyi rang bzhin gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa phyi nang sgrib med du mthong ba rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i sgo bzhi re rer srung ma gnyis re 'dug pa la shar sgo'i srung mar mkha' 'gro ma gnyis kyis brda byas pas nang du khrid de/ dbus su seng ge'i khri'i steng du pad zla la bla ma dri med dpal ldan nyid rin po che'i dbu rgyan la sogs pas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i chas su bzhugs pa la 'khor dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba bzhugs 'dug pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/rigs kyi bu khyod kyis bya'i lus su gnas pas dkyil 'khor du //sdus

mibatub gsungs/ 'o na ji ltar bgyid zhus pas/ se gol zhig tog ste sngags kyi sgra 'ga' re gsungs pa dang / byi'u'i lus de nyid las rgyang yis chad pas/ mdzes shing phun sum tshogs pa rin po ches brgyan pa'i khyi'u'i lus zhig tu gyur/ der bla ma'i zhal nas/ / tshogs kyi longs spyod dam tshig gi rdzas rnams bsdus shig ces gsungs pa dang / mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis sha chang la sogs pa'i dam rdzas kyi yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa skad cig de nyid la 'du ribyas nas/ der bla ma chen po nyid kyis gsang ba sngags kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas rgyal bu yang der bcug ste byin gyis brlabs pas/yid la bde gsal gyi nyams dpag med skyes/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mngon sum du mthong / der mkha' 'gro ma dang dpa' bo de rnams dang bcas/ bla ma nyid kyis tshogs kyi 'khor lo byin gyis brlabs nas thams cad kyis tshogs la rol zhing re res kyang rdo rje'i glu ga ne — chosad tung mi lang ba mdzad do/ de nas yun ring du song ba dang / — ru dul nas/ tshu ma lta bu'i snang ba'i ngang / /kun kyang sgyu ca'i rngo ri byer nye/ /chos dbyings ye shes chen po la/ /gcig dang du ma ga la yod/ /thams cad nam mkha'i rang bzhin nyid/ /rang gi yid la badz+ra mu / zhes gsungs pas/ gzhal yas khang dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma sogs 'khor thams cad nyid kyi thugs kur thims te sdu10 rmi lam gye ngang nas gnyid las sad pa bzhin du/ bla ma paṇ+ḍi

ta'i cha byad can stag lpags kyi gdan la 'gying ba'i 'khor du khyi'u dkar po dang ser po/ bu mo sngon po/ dge slong dge tshul dzā gi dge bsnyen 'ga' res bskor te/ brag phug gi rnam pa bag phebs pa zhig tu bzhugs te snang ba la/ zla ba nyid khyi'u'i chas dang bcas bya'i lus de'i mdun du 'dug der bas zhus pa/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang / /mched lcam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro kun/ /thams cad bla ma nyid las sprul/ /bsdus kyang bla ma nyid la bsdus/ /dus gsum rgyal kun ngo bo de/ /khyod nyid yin pa da gzod go/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po yang / /mgon khyod las gzhan med par rtogs/ /g.yas kyi khye'u dkar po yang / /bla ma'i sprul pa lags sam ci/ /gang yin bdag la gsung bar zhu/ /g.yon gyi bu mo sngon mo dang / /sna tshogs khrims ldan rten 'dzin pa /gzhan 'di rnams kyang gang dang gang / zhes zhus pas/ khyi'u dkar po de'i zhal nas/rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi dngos/ /thams cad bla ma nyid la 'dus//bla ma dri med dpal ldan nying/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa she/ /mas/na po snang ba mtha' yas yin/ /bla cha/ 'di yis rjes/ bzung ba/ /sngon gyi bsod nams stobs mi dman /khyod kyis nga nyid mi shes sam/ e ma blo gros shin tu dman/ /nga ni khyod kyi bshes gnyen te/ /na ning snga ma'i dus kyi tshe/ /bya yi gzuṭa kyis dam chos bstan/ /bla ma dri medadapal ldan dang / /mjal ba'i sa mkhan nga yin mod/ /da du14 sdung

chub snying po'i bar /'o skol 'bral med smon lam bgyid/ gsungs/bu mo de nyid kyis/ e ma nga ni khyod kyi ma/ /ma ti mahā ni yin mod//khyod kyis ma yang mi shes sam/ /de ring rang cag ma bu 'phrad/ ces gsungs pas/ 'phro ma rdzogs par yum dang mjal ba'i dga' ba dang rang la sdug bsngal byung ba'i yul kyis sku la 'jus nas bshums pas/bshes gnyen khyi'u'i zhal nas/ bu bu de ltar ma byed par/ /nga yi tshig la tshur nyon dang / /don dam chos kun rtogs btags tsam/ /rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu la/ /yum nyid gshegs bzhugs bya ba med/ /bde sdug bya ba ga la srid/ /dga' ba zhes kyang yod med de/ /'khrul snang bden par ma 'dzin par/ /de bas de ring dam chos nyon/ zhes gsungs pa thos pas/ yid cung zad ngal bsos nas/ rje 'gran gyi do med chos kyi rje/ dpal dri ma med pa yab yum sras/ /sku sgyu 'phrul 'dra ba'i rol gar mkhan /khyod sprul par bcas la gus phyag 'tshal/ /nga de ring dga' ba'i nyams kyang shar/ /mgon bla ma chen po mjal ba dang / /yum drin can ma dang mjal ba yang / /dpal bshes gnyen khyod kyi sku drin yin/ /ngar 'dzin gyi 'gong po ma thul bas/ /mi bdag la bde sdug ci yang snang / /ma khyod kyis bu sdug bdag dor nas dbyings mi mngon dbyings su zhi bar gshegs/ bu bdag la bdud kyi bslu ba byung / /nga grogs med nags mthar gcig pur 'khyams/ /rje /sdun mchog gsum gyi thugs rje las/ /dus de ring 'di 'dra'i

gnas skabs rnyed/ /da byang chub snying po ma thob bar/ /skyabs khyod rnams bdag gi skyabs mdzod cig ces rgyas pas/ khyi'u dang bu mo gnyis ni bzhad cing bzhugs/ bla ma rin po che zhal 'dzum bag dang bcas nas/ thos pa tsam gyis thar pa'i sa bon 'jog pa'i gsung gis 'di skad do/ dus gsum bde gshegs bden gnyis dam pa'i chos /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la gus pas 'dud/ nyon dang thog med bskal bzang dge 'dun 'bangs/ /dus gsum ma lus bdag gis gsal bar bya/ /snying la chongs shig skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /sngon tshe zas gtsang sras kyi spyan sngar khyod/ /shākya'i rigs skyes dge slong dharma'i ming /dang por nyan thos theg par thos bsam bgyis /snyi nas theg pa chen po'i sgor zhugs shing / /rang rgyud smin byed sa bon legs par btab/ /de nas skye ba mang tsam 'das pa'i mjug /shar phyogs rgyal bu chos kyi dad pa zhes/ /gzhon nu'i dus nas dam pa'i chos la mos/ /nyi zhu'i lo la da lta'i blon po'i bu/ /grogs po bram ze gzhon nur skye ba blangs/ /khyod nyid rgya mtsho chen por bskyur te shi/ /de 'og khyod ni lho phyogs rgyal por skyes/ /da lta'i blon po byang phyogs yul na skyes/ /lho phyogs rgyal pos byang phyogs rgyal po bkums/ /de yi rnam smin srog lan 'dir chags nas/ da lta khyod lus blon pos 'phroṭa pa yin/ /de dag rnams ni 'das pa'i lung bstan yin/ /sngon dus khyod la byin rlabs chos bstan pa'i/ /sprul //3 bya

de da lnga'i khyi'u 'di sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje'i rnam sprul te dge slong bdag mi/ snying gi ze'u 'bru yin/ /ri bo ta lar lo gi sha rar grags/ ma dag zhing khams ma lus kun gyi skyabs/ /dag pa'i zhing khams kun gyi bdag po ste/ /'di yi ba spu'i khung bu re la yang //de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba phrag brgya re/ /de yi mdzad pa zhal dbugs tsam res kyang / dpag tu med pa'i 'gro ba'i ngon mdzad de/ /'di yi rnam par thar pa'i yon tan ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa'i yul las 'das/ /khyad par 'di nas byang shar pha rol na/ /kha ba can gyi rgyal khams bya ba yod/ /zhing de mgon po 'di yi 'dul zhing yin/ /'phags mchog 'di yi thugs rjes yongs drangs pas/ /bdag kyang gnas der 'gro zhing byin gyis rlobs/ /mgon po 'di yi 'das pa'i skyes rabs ni/ /bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i gong rol nas/ /mngon par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yongs su brnyes/ /da lta'ang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mtha' yas na/ /la lar sku bltams la lar bdud 'dul zhing / /la lar 'tshang rgya la lar chos 'khor bskor/ /gzhan du mya ngan yongs su 'da' ba dang la lar rgyal po la lar 'bangs dang ni/ /skabs 'gar khrims ldan mkhan po'i skur bstan te/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i mdzad pa lta ci smos/ /dus de'i sprul pa'ang brjod par nus ma yin/ /'on kyang shākya'i dbang po'i spyan snga ru/ /khyi'u snang ba /rdo byar sku bltams shing / /las 'bras gsungs shing rgyal sras

mdzad pa mdzad/ /'di ni khyod kyi bshes gnyen dam pa ste/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du rjes su 'dzin/ 'di nas myur du bde ldan gnas su 'gro/ /chos kyi rgyal po dkon mchog spangs zhes pa/ /'gro ba rnams la dkar nag las 'bras ston/ /gnas 'dir dge slong bdag gi drung du yongs rje btsun sgrol ma shar du gdan drangs nas/ /'gro ba rnams la bde skyid dpag med stsol/ /gsang ba sngags kyi gdams par 'dod dgur spyod/ /khyod kyang nub kyi phyogs 'dir skye ba len/ sprul pa'i rgyal po de yi zhal mjal 'gyur/ /mgon de skye ba gzhan gyis ma chod par/ /kha ba can gyi rgyal khams skyong ba yis/ /rgyud srong bka' btsan thugs sgam chos kyi rgyal/ /bod rnams rgyu 'bras lam la yang dag sbyor/ /mun pa'i gling du dam chos nyi ma shar/ /de tshe khyod kyang de yi 'khor du skye/ /stong btsan zhes bya rig pa shin tu rno /jo mo sgrol ma shar nas gdan 'dren zhing / /bod du rgyal ba'i sku gzugs rnam gnyis 'byon/ /de nas rgyal rabs lnga nas bod yul der /khri srong lde zhes bka' btsan rgyal po mchog /bstan pa spel ba'i don du skye ba bzhes/ /rgya gar yul nas dam chos bod du len/ /rgya gar paṇa chen mang po bod du 'byon/ /de tshe bdag kyang gnas der dngos su 'gro/ /bod du 'phags yul las kyang bstan pa dar/ /sprul pa'i skyes mchog ro tsa mang po 'byung / /khyod kyang rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sras su skye/ /dam tshig 'dzin pa'i rgyal bu mu rum zhes /blo gtu/ 4/ga

shul che ba zhig tu skye/ /de nas rgyal ba rgya mtsho chen po nyid /gnas der res 'ga' sku dngos res 'ga' ni/ /sprul pas skyong zhing brtse bar mdzad par 'gyur/ /khyad par snyigs ma'i dus su gyur pa'i tshe /bod der dge bsnyen sten pa zhes bya ba'i/ thugs rgyud sgam zhing yon tan sped la brtson/ /mkhyen dang brtse ba'i bdag nyid chen por 'khrungs/ /bdag kyang za hor rgyal po dge ba'i bu/ /di pas ka ra dri med dge slong 'byung / /dngos su bod kyi yul der bdag kyang 'gro/ /log pa sun 'byin dri med bstan pa 'dzugs /lha chos bdun ldan yid bzhin nor bu yi/ /bstan pas bod yul ljongs kun gsal bar byed/ /mi ring nga yang dga' ldan gnas su 'gro/ /skabs 'gar sprul pas bod du gsal bar byed/ /khyod kyang de'i tshe shes rab rdo rje zhes//sbas pa'i rnal 'byor bslab pa gsum 'dzin cing / /bdag dang u ba si ga'i slob mar 'gyur/ /sems pa chen po u ba si ka de/ sngon gyi thugs bskyed smon las dbang nyid kyis/ /bod kyi yul de stongs bar ma gyur bar/ /dngos dang sprul pas yongs su 'dul bar 'gyur/ /khyod kyang gnas der skye ba 'ga' re len/ /grags pa 'dzin pa'i byang chub rdo rje dang / /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'bral tshad don dang ldan/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyu / des/ /bskal bzang rnams la zab lam gdaju/sa pa 'doms/ / rga/sa —'e ca tshan ni gar gyi dbang phyu/ sdu// /gzhan yang bsod nams rin chen chos dpal sogs/ ming

du 'chang ba'i skye ba blangs gyur nas/ /bod rnams re ba yongs su skong bar byed/ rgya gar yul du'ang skye ba mang du len/ yam bu'i yul na dbang phyug rdo rje byung / /sems can rnams kyi don yang rgya cher byed/ /dus kyi yang snyigs tha mar gyur pa'i tshe/ /ma ti'i ming gis da lta'i lo rgyus gleng / /de 'og dharma rnam par rgyal ba zhes/ /'gro ba rnams la phan pa mang po spyod/ /de nas skye ba mang du song ba na/ /mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas su ngas lung bstan/ /rtag tu 'bral ba med pa'i smon lam 'tshal/ zhes gsungs so/ de nas rgyal bu rab tu dga' nas/ phyag lan mang du btsal te gdung shuṭa kyis gsol ba btab pa/ bla ma rin po che ma 'ongs dus su rje btsun yab sras kyis de lta bu'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba'i tshe bdag kyang drung du skye bar gyur na/ bdag gi yum 'phags ma dang yab dang blon po btsun mo gser bzang la sogs pa yang skye'am mi skye/ mjal lam mi mjal blon po la gā ā na/ stongadapon chen po yam she rnams kyang gang dang gang du 'gyur/ da dung yang bar chad byed mi byed thugs rje can gyis gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ e ma nyon dang skal bzang dge 'dun 'bangs da dung gsal ba'i lung bstan 'chad par bya/ /khyod kyi mar gyur blo gros che mo ni/ /g.yu lo bkod par jo mo sgrol mar grags/ o rgyan gnas 'dir gsang ba ye shes te/ /rgyal ba rgya mtshos shar du gdan 'dren 'gyur/ /de tshe khyod //7 rgya

gar nub kyi phyogs /srin po'i /nas dang nye ba'i yul gru na/ /sa spyod 'tsho skyong zhes byar 'gyur ba des/ /mgon po de la dad cing mos pa thobs/ /de nas ma 'ongs gangs ri'i yul ljongs su/ /bdag nyid lha 'dre 'dul du 'gro ba'i tshe/ /khyod kyi mar gyur 'phags ma 'di nyid kyang / /sto na'i ma tshan mnga' mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo mchog /nyon mongs dri bral bdag gi gzung mar 'gyur/ /yab gyur rigs ldan rgyal po 'di nyid ni/ da nas mthe ris skye ba gsum blangs nas/ /de yi dus su lha snang zhes bya ba/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i chos kyi blon por 'gyur/ /da lta'i blon po la ga ā na yang / /las kyi dbang gis de yi bu ru skyes/ /'u ring shul zhes khyod kyis de bsgral bas/ rgyal khrims 'phrogs te khyod nyid mtha' la 'jug /de tshe bdag gis gsang ba'i chos kyi mdzod/ /yongs su phye nas dbang bskur rjes su 'dzin/ /dga' bar gyis shig rigs ldan snying gi bu/ /yam she dud 'gro'i skye ba bzhi brgyud nas/ /de yi dus su blon po klu yi ming / /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bstan pa spel ba la/ /log bar 'khu ba'i sdig pa can du 'gyur de dang nye ba rnams kyang der skye'o/ /chos kyi blon po ye shes 'dzin 'di nyid/ /ma 'ongs bdag dang yum gyis rjes su 'dzin/ /sa le chos blo mgon po zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /skabs 'gar bla ma skabs 'gar slob ma'i tshul/ /yang yang 'phra11 8de blo yid gcig tu 'gro/ /blon po gzhan gnyis dag pa'i zhing

du skye/ /de yi tshe na mi yi lus mi 'byung / /da lta'i dus kyi khyi'u sor po 'di/ /'phags mchog 'jam dbyangs thugs kyi rnam sprul te/ /de tshe mu ni btsan zhes khyod kyi gcen/ /rgyal bas lung bstan bod kyi rgyal sa 'dzin/ /yab la mos shing shes rab snying rje che/ /bdag la dad pa ldan pa zhig tu 'khrungs/ /slar yang mthu stobs nus pa'i rdo rje yis/ /sdig spyod rgyal po glang gi ming can bsgral/ /ma 'ongs dge bsnyen chos 'phel zhes bya'i tshe/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen prañja'i mtshan mnga' ba/ thugs kyi dkyil nas rgyal ba rgya mtshor mos/ /tshad ma'i bstan sogs gsal ba'i sgron me 'dra/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs kyi ze'u 'bru yin/ /blon po gsum la brtse bar mdzad pa yi/ /yum gyi yab gyur nub phyogs rgyal po yang / /de tshe sad na legari zhes khyod kyi mched/ /nga la snying nas mos pa brtan po 'byung / /bcom ldan gsang ba'i bdag po'i rnam sprul te/ /ma 'ongs dge bsnyen chos 'phel byon pa'i tshe/ /brtson 'grus mi 'gyur gsung drung ltar brtan pa'i/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dregs can tshul kyang ston/ /don la rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs sras yin/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i 'gro don spel ba la/ /'di dag gnyis kyang yang nas yang du 'byung / /btsun mo bzang mo gser bzang de nyid ni/ /don gyi rnal 'byor dbang po chen po ra 'gyur/ /tshe 'dir myur du khyod dang 'phrad par gyur/ /rdzu 'phrul thob pas bod du yang yang 'gro/ /phal cher rgya gar yul du 'gro don skyong / 1/19 lta

khyod la chos nyan gsung bsgrubs pa'i/ /bya rnams ma 'ongs khyod kyi gdul byar 'gyur/ /gdun yang tshe 'dir khyod kyi drung gnas pa'i/ /blon po btsun cho/ 'bangs la sogs pa rnams/ /ma 'ongs dus su yang yang 'phrad cing skye/ /thams cad ma lus brjod par mi nus kyi/ /de tsam lung bstan snying gi dkyil du stims/ /byang chub bar du nga yis rjes su 'dzin/ zhes sogs tshigs su bcad pa'i lung bstan pa dang /lhug pa'i sgo nas gsung gleng dpag tu med pa mdzad do/ de nas bla ma'i zhal na / da khyod kyis tshe 'dir gsang sngags bla med kyi bskal pa cher med kyi/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi rten 'brel 'grig pa'i phyir du dkyil 'khor bstan pa tsam byas pa yin la/ da ni bya yi phung por zhugs la bya dang ri dgas rnams la chos shod cig ces gsungs pas/der rig pa 'dzin pa'i byang sems dang / dge slong zhi dul can mang po 'dug pa las dge slong gcig na re/ sprul pa'i byang chub sems dpa' nyon/ /ma 'ongs yab sras bod yul du/ /bstan pa thog mar spel ba'i tshe/ /nga ni be+e ro lo tsār grags/ /lha chos bdun ldan dar ba'i tshe/ /tshul khrims rgyal ba zhes bya ba/ /rang cag legs par 'phrad par 'gyur/ yang gcig gi zhal nas/ ma 'ongs rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ /bstan pa thog mar 'jug pa'i tshe/ nam mkha'i snying po dge slong 'byung / /lha chos bdun ldan dar ba'i tshe/ shākya dbang phyug ces su /sdus/ /de tshe nga dang 'phrad par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs/ gcig

gi zhal nas/ ma 'ongs rgyal ba yab sras kyis/ /bstan pa'i sgron me spar ba'i tshe/ /sngags 'chang bud+dha 1 nar 'gyur/ /lha chos bdun ldan dar ba'i tshe/ /brtson 'grus seng ge zhes su grags/ /de dang de tshe 'phrad par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs/ gcig gi zhal nas/ ma 'ongs rgyal ba yab sras kyis/ bstan pa thog mar smin pa'i tshe/ /rgyal mchog dbyangs zhes bsngags par 'gyur/ /lha chos bdun ldan dar ba'i tshe/ /rin chen gsal ba du/sa su grags/ /rang cag de yi dus su 'phrad/de la sogs pa'i dge slong bcu drug rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can lnga ste nyi shu rtsa gci / gis de 'dra ba'i lung bstan no/ de nas byi'u'i gzuṭa brnyan gyi rgyal bus smon lam 'di ltar btab bo/ 'di nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rje btsun bla ma sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /theg mchog ston pa'i bshes gnyen mdzad gyur te/ /cung zad tsam yang 'dral ba med par shog /khyad par ma 'ongs bod kyi yul ljongs su/ /rje btsun bla ma yab sras gshegs pa'i che/ /bdag kyang 'khor gyi thog mar gyur nas su/ /thugs bzhed 'phrin las bsgrub par byed par shog /bdag nyid mthong thos dran dang reg pa dang //bstod pa'i 'on te bskur pa 'debs kyang rung / /thams cad yab zas rnams kyi rjes bzung ste/ /myur du byang chub rdzogs par sangs rgyas zhog ces smon lam btab ste yid 'phreng bzhin du yab sras kyi zhabs spyi bor blangs nas byi'u'i lus la zhuṭa te 'phur 'ongs sdu//

nub phyogs kyi tshur rol ri bo tsan dan bya ba'i ngogs nas/ rnal 'byor pa rtag mngog sprug cas rus pa'i rgyan can mthong ba tsam gyis dad nus pa zhis 'du / —4 de'i sku mdun nas tshur la 'phur nas byon pas rnal 'byor pa de'i gsu nga las/ khu byug sngon po khyod gang du 'gro zhes gsungs pas/ byi'ur de'i sku mdun du babs nas smras pa/myi/ /rtse gcig sgrub pa'i dam bca' brtan po yis/ /legs par bzhugar pa 3 rnal 3sbyor dbang phyug khyod/ /las ngan tha mal khu byug nga nyid la / /gar 'gro gsung ba mngon shes mnga' bas gsungs/ /bdag ni wa ra ṇa si'i rgyal po'i sras/ /dge 'dun 'bangs zhes bya ba de nyid lags/ /grogs ngan 'phrul gyis da lta bya yi lus/ /nub phyogs dur khrod la li li la ru/ /sprul pa'i dge slong dri med dpal ldan bzhu gas/ /de nyid sras bcas zhal dkyil blta phyir 'ongs/ /da ni 'di nas shar phyogs na gas khred du/ /dben par 'dab chags grogs nang bdag kyang 'gro/ /thabs dang shes rab ye shes me lce yis/ /dngos 'dzin ma lus bsreg mdzad mgon khyod kyi/ /mtshan ni ci lags 'di ru bzhugs pa ci/ zhes zhus pas/ /dza gi de'i zhal nas/ /nyon dang thags med rig pa'i byi'u chung / /khyod nyid wa ra ṇa sir skyes nas bzung / /da lta'i bar kun ji bzhin bdag gis nges /'on kyang tshod bgam phyir du brtag cing dris/ /dri med sapal ldan dngos su mjal ba de/ /bsod nams mi dman shin

du legs so bu/ /nga ni a gadzā gi rdo rje 'dzin/ /dri med bla ma nyed kyi slob ma yin/ /rgya gar nub phyogs rgyal po rmā sho ka/ /blo gros che mo'i yab gyur rgyal po yang / /don du nga yin gzhan du ma sems shig /don dam dbyings su bai rmā shrī yang / /bdag dang dbyer med nam yang 'du 'bral med/ /khyed kyi blon chen dam pa ye shes 'dzin/ /da lta nub phyogs rgyal po'i khab tu yod/ ces bya ba sogs mang du bka' bstsal to/ bya rnams la thog mar chos gsungs ba bla ma dri med dpal ldan las thun rma nga dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gdam pa dang lung bstan thob pa'i skabs te lnga pa'o/ //de nas rgya gar shar phyogs sngon gyi gnas su log nas bya rnams la chos bstan pas/ slob dpon ni tshos zhus pa/ /gang la stong nyi da zab mo dang / /mi rtag sgom pa bstan par bya/ mgrin sngon zla bas/ stong pa'i tshul la dud 'gro 'jigs/ /de bas mi rtag bstan par bya/ ni rtsal zhus pa/ bdag 'dzin 'ching ba ma chod na/ /mi rtag bskoms pas ci zhig bgyi/ zla ba na re/ tshe 'di'i snang shas ma bzlogs par/ /srid las thar ba 'gyur ram ci/ni tsos zhus pa/ gang la bdag 'dzin srog gcig pu/ /bcad na thar la dka' ba med/ zla ba na re/ bcad dka' srid pa'i dra ba 'di/ /gzhan la cung zad ma ltos par/ /mtshon cha gcig pus gcod nus sam/ /de phyir 'dul da /'i dregs rme 'di/ /tho/ du/ ra

skyo shas bsgoms pas gzhom/ ni tshos zhus pa/ gang gi rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ /stong pa'i gshis la rgyu ma mchis/ /sdug bsngal ma mchis 'gog ma ma chis/ /do dam nyid kyang ma mchis lags/zla ba na re/ bdag 'dzin med la nyon mo rī sa med/ /nyon mongs med na mi dge med/ /gang la bdag 'dzin dgra bo 'di/ /du ma'i thabs kyi rim gyis 'dul/ tshogs ni gnyis ka sten par bya/ /'di phyi 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la/ /nges par 'byung bas sred pa bzlog/zhi ba'i spyod pas /tshe ba spongs/ /sems kyang shin tu zhi bar bya/ /de ltar byung na dpung ldan pa'i/ /dpa' bos dgra dpung 'joms pa bzhin/ /'dzin pa rtsad nas bshig par byed/ /gang la dpung dang mi ldan na/ /mtshon cha gcig pus dgra 'joms min/ /'dzin pa'i dgra yi dbang song ba /de srid kha stong ci smras kyang / /phan byed las kyi dbang med par/ /'khor ba zo chun bzhin du 'khor/ /des na 'khrul pa ma bcom par/ /sdug bsngal rgyu spongs dge rgyu sgrubs/ /stong par brten nas thams cad srid/ /gal te rang bzhin grub gyur na/ /de la nam yang 'gyur ba med/ /des na rten cing 'brel 'byung ba/ /gang gis shes kyang mkhas pa yin/ phra mo rgyal ba mchog rnams kyi/ /spyod yul lags pas rtogs dka' yang / /gang gis rang bzhin bcas pa yi/ /nyes snang rags nas rim gyis spongs/ /gnasdu/ sdugs zab mo dam pa ni/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i mchog lags

kyang / /dang por mi rtag sogs bsgoms na/ /tshe 'di bde 'dod dra ba chod/ /bsod nams min pa legs par zlog /mtho ris na yang sdug bsngal gyi/ /rang bzhin shes nas thar 'dod skyed /sdug bsngal rgyu de gang zhig ces/ /dpyad tshe 'dzin pa'i dgra bor shes//dgra de gzhan gyis thub nus min/ /shes rab mtshon gyis 'joms par byed/ /de yang bsod nams go cha dang / /ldan pa'i sgo nas 'jom par bya/ /des na bya tshogs re zhig la/ /mi rtag nag po'i las 'bras dang / /'khor ba'i gtam gyis yid 'byung bya/ /zhi ba'i gtam gyis spro ba bskyed/ /rim gyis blo ni gong du bkri/ /'di ni bstan pa'i go rim yin/ /de ltar yin no sang rgyas 'dzin/ zhes gsungs so/ de nas slob dpon ni tsos kyang / bya rnams la 'di skad gsungs/ kye ma nyon dang bya tshogs rnams/ /'o skol rnams kyi slob dpon gyis/ /khyed cag thog mar yid bskul phyir/ /'di dag gsungs kyis ga bar gyis/ /dam chos tshul bzhin bsgrubs par gyis/ /bslu med skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum/ /yon tan gter chen rin po che/ /gang la skyabs su gsol de la/ /don gnyis ma lus 'grub mdzad cing / /skyob dka' 'khor ba'i 'jigs las kyang /thar mdzad 'di yi sgra tsam zhig /thos pa'ang ska' ba ches bzang bar/ /mkhyen par mdzod la dus rtag tu/ /rjes dran chu bo'i rgyun bzhin mdzod/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang mjal ba ni/ /1/sdus

drug spyi la nyin skar tsam/ /dud 'gro la ni srid mtha' tsam/ /de phyir rang cag sngon bsags kyi /'phen byed las ngan mi dges byas//dud 'gro'i lus rten 'di ltar gyur/ /'on kyang sngon bsags dge ba yis/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi mtshan thos shing / /dam pa'i chos kyi cha shas la/ /spyod du yod pa e ma ho / /da lta legs par ma sbyangs na/ /phyis nas 'di 'drar 'gyur bar dka'/ /de yang chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du/ /brtson 'grus drag po ma bgyis na/ /'dus byas chu yi gnyer ma 'dra/ /longs spyod ston sprin bzhin du g.yo/ /lus srog chu lhur bzhin du 'jig /bzlog tu mid cing bcos su med/ /rtag 'dzin sgrib pas nyer bsgribs pas/ /nam zhig lus 'dor mi shes phyir/ /gal te long med 'chi bdag gis/ /de ring 'dzin nam ci cha yod/ /sang dang phyi ma'i dus gnyis kyang / /dang por gang zhig 'ong ba yi/ /nges pa med phyir phyi ma'i don/ /'grub na snga ma ci byas sla /dge ba'i rgyu yang ma bsgrubs la/ /sdug bsngal rgyu ni nyer bsags na/ /rgyu las 'bras bu nges 'byung phyir/ /'chi ba'i bdud kyis nyer bcom nas/ /mi zad bzod dka'i log par lhung / /brnag dka' 'jigs rung sdug bsngal gyis/ /mtshams med rab tu mnar gyur pa/ /kye hud bdag gis bzod dam ci/ /gang tshe sems dmyal 'jigs rung ba/ /rang res myong ba'i grangs ba/sdu 6na/ /sa chen 'di yi rdul thams cad/ /grangs las mang ba

myong gyur te/ /'khor bar thog ma med phyir ro/ /da dung 'di rgyu ma bcad na/ /de las lhag pa thob par 'gyur/ /mthong chos sdug bsngal ma mthong yang / /rdzun med thub dbang dam pas gsungs/ /da dung 'di 95 bden mi sems/ /shin tu lta ba ngan gyur pa'i/ /nyon mong nadi nyid kho nas nyes/ /mthong ba'i chos la 'di ltar snang / /bde ba che la spyod pa dang / /sdug bsngal gyis mnar 'gro ba rnams/ /sems can du gyur kun nas mtshungs/ /'di dag gi ni khyad par stos/ /chung las 'bras bu che 'byin pas/ /chung la brnyas pa kun tu spangs/ /thog med nas bzung sdig po che/ /phyogs bcu'i mun bzhin rab tu 'thibs/ /tshe 'dir bsathos pa'i sdig pa yis/ /rgya mtsho che brtsi/na kun tu khengs/ /gnyen po dge ba nyam chung bas/ /nges par 'jigs rung dmyal bar lhung / /des na de las skyob pa ni/ /ston pa skyabs dngos sgrub grogs gsum/ /tshul de ji bzhin sgrub par mdzod/ /'di lta'i rten gyis chos sgrub pa/ /rnam pa kun tu dka' bas na/ /skye zhing skye bar dal 'byor rten/ /phun tshogs thob pa'i smon lam 'tshal/ zhes gsungs pas las dang smon lam gyi dbang gis bya rnams kyis ji ltar bstan pa bzhin du go ste/slar yang de dag gi don du sems rab tu gzhol bar byed do/ de nas sprul pa'i bya mgrin sngon zla bas rang gi grog sa po rna /sa la 'di skad gsungs so/ kye ma grogs po sangs rgyas 'dzin la so////

bya tshogs bdag la cung zad gson mdzod dang /theg chen gdams pa'i bdud rtsi / 4 bos 'chad/ /tshe 'di myur 'gro nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra/ /shi nas dkar nag las kyi dbang du 'gyur/ /nag po'i las kyis mi zad sdug bsngal ster/ /'khor ba'i snang tshul sdug bsngal sdug bder brloms nas/ /sdug bsngal 'bad pas bsgrubs pas yid re skyo/ /de lta'i sdug bsngal klong bying 'gro ba rna sa/ /re re'i mngal du lus blangs grangs 'das shing / /bdag gi ma ru ma gyur sems can ni/ /ye shes spyan gyis bskal par gzigs gyur kyang / /rnyed mi gyur te de midamigs phyir ro/ /mar gyur tshe yang yid bcugs drin gyis bskyangs /gang gi nu zho rgya mtsho las lhag 3thung / /bya nang 'gro ba gcig pa'i 'u/sa blangs kyang / /dang por sdug bsngal mngal du yun ring bskyangs /dka' bas gnas bcas btsas tshe zas bcad de/ /sha yi drod sbyar tha mal rdol tshe yang / sdig bcas sha thang gis btsal 'phangs pa'i zas/ /rang gis za bar ma nus thams cad byin/ /'jigs bcas gshog med shin tu dmar ba'i lus/ /nyin mtshan kun tu ngal dub med par bskyangs/ /rab rdzob/sa rang dang mnyam par ma gyur par/ /srog dang bsdos te bsrung shing ngal mang bsten/ /de ltar drin ldan sdug bsngal gyis mnar la/ /phan sems tsam med bdag pas blun pa su/ /dmyal ba'i mi chen 'bar ba/ sdun tu bsregs/ gti mug mun pa 'thibs pos rab tu bsgribs//

nyon mongs dgra yis bar mtshamang med par gzir/ /sdug bsngal rgyu la chog shes med par sbyar/ /zag med dga' bde'i 'byor pa lta ci smos/ /'khor ba'i bde ba tsam yang ches dkon rnams/ /yal bar 'dor ba shin tu khrel med yin/ /de na 'di dag gces par 'dzin dgos kyang / /rang nyid gces 'dzin goms pa'i dgra bo 'dis/ /'di dag yal bor rang nyid 'dzin du 'dug /da ni go brje dgra 'di'i dregs pa gzhom/ /'di yi phyogs 'dzin gtan nas spong bar 'bad//bdag bde rgyu bcas snying nas gzhan la sbyin/ /gzhan sdug rgyu bcas dngos dang 'dun pas len/ /byang chub mchog kyang 'gro ba'i don du sgrubs/ /dge rtsa kun kyang ma rnams don du byed/ /skye dang skye bar 'gro ba'i dbugs 'byin du/ /'gyur ba'i smon pa rgyun chad med par mdzod/ /gang du bsdod kyang sgo gsum 'bad pas srungs/ /ji ltar byas kyang nyam len rtse yis zin/ /su dang 'grogs kyang dman cha rang gis len/ /de ni mkhas pa'i nang nas mkhas pa yin/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i snying po rmad byung ba/ /sdig spongs dge ba bsgrubs pa nyid du 'du/ /de dag shes bya shes nang blang dor bya/ /nga ni re zhig ri dwags lhung ba'i rir/ /thos pa'i don sems nges 'byung bsgrub tu 'gro/ /snying dang 'dra ba sangs rgyas 'dzin khyod kyis/ /'di dag tshul bzhin blo ni bkro bar mdzod/ ces pa la co gas pa rme nga du gsungs te/ bya rnams kyis re zhig lhan cig tu bzhugs dgosdu 5sdur

gsol ba btang pa da nga / de ltar ma kyur kyang ga la ba der 'gro bar gas/la ba btab pas/ zhal gyis ma bzhes shing lhan cig tu 'gro bar yang ma gnang bar/ /'chi ba'i dgra ni nam 'ong nges med pas/ nags su 'gro ba lta ci da lta nyid/ /'joms par 'gyur med 'on kyang nges med du/ /lus srog gnas na myur du gnas 'dir 'ong /zhes zhal gyis bzhes te sto phyogs su song ngo / de nas ri dwags lhung ba'i nags 'dabs su skyo riXs drag po sdom zhing gnas/ pa'i tshe/ nyin gcig ri dgas gcig gis/ byi'u chung gi gas du yun ring bsdad nas bag phebs te gus pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas te snang ba la/ 'di skad ga ri/ngas so/ kun tu 'khor ba'i gnas 'di la/ /sdug bsngal myong bas zad mtha' che/da/ /ri dgas khyod kyang 'di rgyun mchod/ /dkon mtshog gsum la skyabs 'gro gyis/ ci/sa gsungs pas/ go nas gus pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas te bskor ba gsum byas so/ de nas byi'us ri dgas la chos mang du bshad de gus shing yid bcugs pa'i grogs su gyur skabs/ rigs ldan rgyal po'i rgyal khab kyi rgyal phran gyi bu sngar rang gi grogs po gzhon nu gtum spyod zer ba yod pa de 'khor dang bcas pa sngon gyi tshe zhi bar spyod kyang / rgyal bu rdzun mas mi 'dod bzhin du ri dwags gshor du btsud par brten 'khor dang bcas pa nags 'der byung ste grogs po ri dwags mthong ngo / des kya sduda' gzhu thogs te gsod par chas pas/ zla ba'i zhal nas/

ku ku ngathon nu gtum spyod ji ltar sems/ /snying gi grog po legs par soms/ /khyod nyid mi dge'i grogs dbang song / /da ni 'di lta'i spyod ngan byed/ /kye ma bdag gi grogs smyo'am/ /khyod nyid srog dang bral yang sla/ /yang yang drin gyis bskyangs gyur pa'i/ /nyes med rang gis gsod dam ci/ /chos kyi dga' bas sngon smras pa//da lta khyod kyis mi dran nam/ zhes gsungs pas/ des kyang chos kyi dga' ba yin par shes te tshig tsam yang smra ba ma thon par gdung ba'i sems kyis dran med du brgyal lo/ brgyal las sangs pa dang phyag thod bud pa tsam du btsal te/ /kye kye rmi la ma ma yin nam/ /chos kyi nyi ma nub tu nub/ /rjes 'bangs mun pa'i gling du 'khyims/ /gdug can rgyal po'i 'bangs su gyur/ /de ring bya yi gzugs su mjal/ bdag cag khyod kyi 'bangs rnams kyang / /klu bdud lta bu'i rgyal bu yi/ thar med gdug can nad kyis btab/ /mi zad sdig pa'i las la sbyar/ /da ni rgyal ba'i sras khyod kyis/ /gdug can 'di yi srog phral te/ /wa ra ṇa si'i rgyal po mdzod/ ces zhus pas mgrin sngon zla ba'i zhal nas/ /ston dang gtum spyod gzhon nu bdag la nyon/ /sngon tshe rlabs chen smon lam lhan cis pas/ /da lta'i dus na bdag nyid gzugs/ 'phos kyang / /khyod dang 'phrad pa shin tu nge mtshar ro/ /rang cag sngon dus nags tshal mdzes par phyin /bdag dang la gā ā na gnyis shing 'bras kyi/ /bde la 1/sdus

nas bya ror grong 'jug byas/ /bdag ni mdzes pa'i ltad mor yengs skabs su / /la gā gye 4 nas phung por slar zhugs te/ /rang gi lus bskyur rgyal bur brdzus te song / /de nas kho bo gcig phur yid skyo tshe /skya bas mchog rin chen thugs rje'i sprul pa yi/ /sprul pa'i bya sogs bshes gnyen dam pa mjal/ /bya dang ri dwags rnams dang lhan cig gnas/ /da ni 'di na grogs po ri dwags 'di/ /snying brtse'i phyir du lhan cig gnas pa sa gas/ /gtum spyod gzho/ nu bdag la yang gson dang / /mir gyur pa nyid shin tu dka3 zhing dkon /dkon mchog gsum mtshan thos pa de bas dkon/ /cha tshang dal 'byor mthun rkyen ldan pa dka'/ /dam pa'i chos la bar chad shin tu mang / /mi dge'i dzi ga grogs dbang du song gyur na/ /me phung 'bar bar tsan dan song gyur che/ /gang zhig tsan dan bzang yang bsol bar 'gro/ /mi dge'i grogs dang lhan cig gnas pa na/ /bsam pa bzang yang myur du de'i dbang 'gro/ /gang la brten na dge ba nyams 'gyur zhing / /nyes spyod nyo/ mongs 'phe la ba'i grogs po de/ /pha mar gyur kyang ring du 'grogs mi bya/ /ston mchog dam pa bslu med skyabs kyis phul/ /gang der rgyal por zhus nas de yi khrims/ /sdig spong dge ba sgrub la mi gnas na/ /las 'bras blon tshoṭa rig pa can rnams kyis/ /gang du gnas kyang rang dbang med par 'di//ཿ /mi bzad khrims khang ngan song gnas su 'jug /bskol

pa bye ba brgyar yang thar bar dka'/ /de nas sangs rgyas dkon mchog thod bcings te/ /de'i gsung theg gnyis dam pa'i chos la slobs/ /de yi rjes 'jug 'phags tshogs gtsor gyur pa'i/ /tshogs mchog rnams la shin tu gus par bya/ /'jig rung 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rtag bsgoms nas/ /nyin mtshan kun tu skyabs su 'gro bar gyis/ /rang gi yon tan sbas na phrag dog chung / gang du gnas kyang bde ba thob par 'gyur/ /rang skyon ma gsang bstan na kun dang mthun/ /nongs pa med pas rang nyid dpa' mdzangs 'gyur/ gang tshe rang nyid chos dang mthun gyur tshe/ /de tshe ma bsdus par yang gdul bya 'du/ /ma bsgrims par yang 'gro don shugs kyis 'byung / /de phyir bdag rgyud nyon mongs dgra thul 'tshal/ /ji srid khyim gyi 'dam las ma thar bar/ /de srid rgya yis bcings pa'i ri dwags bzhin/ /bde ba'i go skabs nam yang yod min la/ /srid 'byor srin mo'i gzugs la ma chags par/ /khyim spong nus na myur du 'byung bar gyis/ /cis kyang khyim las 'byung bar ma nus kyang / /dge bcu'i lam bsnyen srid la skyo shas bsgoms/ /'chi ba dran pa'i lcag gis ma bskul na/ /brtson 'grus rta yi bgrod pa shin tu dul/ /'di snang 'brog dgon lam las ma thar bar/ /'chi bdag chom pos bcom nas ngan 'gror 'khrid/ de phyir blo sna myur bstungs dam chos sgrubs/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal me nang rab bzhugs kyang / /dga' ri~Xs

bde bar mthong nas gnas shing smon/ /dge bshes gzhan gyis snang tshul bshad gyur kyang / /da dung cung zad tsam yang mi sems par/ /nyes pa spyod la pad mtshor ngang pa bzhin/ /'di ni 'khor ba'i gnas nas gtan thar ba/ /lta ci bde 'gro tsam yang ches dka' gsungs/ /de phyir srid la nam yang smon mi 'tshal/ /nyon mongs dgra la 'dud pa kun tu spongs/ /kun tu lhag bsam shin tu bzang bar mdzod/ /wa ra ṇa si'i rgyal po kho bo la/ /tshe 'dir skal med 'on kyang myur ba ru/ /rgyal bu rdzun ma dpung bcas pham par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs so/ yang gzhon nu gtum spyod kyis wa ra ṇa si'i rgyal po mdzad dgos par gsol mang du btab kyang ma gnang bar/ kye gzhon nu dag kho bo ridir 'di bzhin du gnas pa rgyal po'am blon po'am btsun mo'am 'bangs sam grogs gzhan dag la ma thos par gyis shig de bzhin du gtum spyod khyod kyi 'khor rnams kyis kyang shin tu ngag dam par mdzod cig ye shes 'dzin da lta nub phyogs su rgyal po ma zho ku'i khab tu chos bsgrubs te yod pas 'gro bar nus na der song zhig bla ma dri skyed dpal ldan yang mjal bar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs te/ de dag gis kyang de bzhin du khas blangs so/ gzhon nu gtum spyod 'khor dang bcas pa yang khyim spangs nas nub phyogs kyi mthar bro rig te/ yum gyi yab kyi drung du ye shes 'dzin las chos kyi ba// 4rtsi pre na zhing lhan cig rtse gcig tu sgrub pa la gnas so/ rgyal

bu rdzun ma dang gtum spyod kyi yab thum gyis de dag bab la kyang ma rnyed par yun ring song bas/ re zhig nub phyogs kyi tshong pa dag spu/ gtam las nub phyogs na gnas pa thos te nub phyogs su rgyal po la yi ge bsrings kyang ma btang ngo / de nas bla ma dri med dpal ldan yang mjal te gsung gi bdud rtsi zab cing rgya che ba dang lung bstan pa thob bo/ byi'u ni 'dir bzhugs pa'i skabs shig yang bla ca dri med dpal ldan gyi sku'i yon tan dran te/ gdung ba'i nga rol dbyangs su 'then pa/ ku ku/ 'od dpag med mgon mi yi gzugs/ /'di nas nub phyogs pha rol na/ /tha mal 'gro ba'i snang ngor bzhugs/ /dag na rang dang 'bral med kyang / /da dung ma dag sgrib pas nongs/ /rje khyod kyi yon tan gter mtsho de/ /snying khong rus pa'i gting nas dran/ /blta ba'i mi ngoms mdzes pa'i sku/ /mig sngar mngon sum ji bzhin dran/ /dam chos bdud rtsi stsol ba'i tshe/ /lhang lhang gsung gi nga ro de/ /da lta dran pa'i yul du gyur/ /bdag la brtse ba'i lcags kyu yis/ /skal mnyam gzhan gyi nang nas kyang / /'khyud pa ji bzhin mdzad de dran/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal kun mchod pa bas/ /gang gi ba spu'i khung bu tsam/ /mchod pa phan yon che'o zhes/ /rdzun med dam pa rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhing mchog khyod sku mchod pa la/ /thugs rjer nye ring ma mchis kyang / /bdag gi mos pa'i snang ngo na/ /dngos su zhal dkyil ma mjal skyo/ /zhing rdo rje'i gnas sdu/ga

au rgyan du/ /'khor 'phags mchog 'dus pas bskor ba yang bya mgrin sngon zla ba ma gzigs lam/ /sgos bdag gi bshes gnyen dam pa mgon/ /ma sems can kun gyi skyabs gcig pu/ /dpal rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i 'jig rten dbang / /bya bdag la thugs rjes brtse bar dgongs/ /yum blo gros chen mo thugs rje can/ /bu bdag nyid thugs rjes ma gzigs sam/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbus su khyi'u dkar po ga tsā sa g.yon du bu mo dkar sngon gnyis dang bcas pa sprin dkar gyi lam nas tshur byon nas/ khyi'us byad drangs bu mo de gnyis kyi 'gram btegs te/ bu chos kyi dga' ba ci zhig zer/ /dge 'dun 'bangs khyod ji ltar yin/ /mgrin sngon zla ba'ang nga la nyon/ /dbus kyi khyi'u dkar po nga / /'gro 'dren ma ṇi pad+me yin/ /g.yas kyi bu mo dkar mo nga / /ār+ya sbya ku ṭi ra grags/ /g.yon du gnas pa'i bu mo nga / /aru tā re khyod kyi lha/ /de ltar shes sam rigs kyi bu/ /a mi ta bha bai ma shrīḥthams cad ye shes dang du gcig /chos kyi dbyings la 'du 'bral med/ /gdung ba'i nga rol 'bod mi dgos/ khyod la mgon skyabs rtag tu yod /'on kyang bla ma dran tsam gyes/ /rgyal kun bkur dang mchod pa sogs/ /bsod nams gzhan kun zil ba/non gsungs/ /legs po rjes su yi rang sgoms/ /mtshan dpe ldan pa rgyal ba'i sku/ /yun ring dus su bsdi/sdu pa bas// /bla ma dran tsam bsod nams che/— pacho/ci phyir zhe na

rgyal ba'i sku/ /rjes dran bsod nams chung min kyang / /gcig zhos bsod nams che bas so/ /gzhan yang dpag med phan yon mnga'/ /dad pa'i rtsa ba mi brtan na/ /shes rab ljon pa sad kyis 'khyer/ /byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i char mi 'bebs/ bla ma sangs rgyas kun dngos su/ /kha zhe med par mthong ba 'di/ /yon tan kun gyi 'go 'dren yin/ /rgyal sras kun gyi gshegs shul 'a gas/ rin chen sems kyi sa bon kyang / dad pa'i sa gzhi la brten nas/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu rtse mor zhin/ /srid rtsa gcod pa'i ral gri yang / /dad pa'i ngar dang ldan gyur na/ /myur du 'gran zla pham par byed/ 'phags nor bdun du gsungs pa yang / /dad nga 'i yid bzhin nyid kyis 'dren/ /sbyin sogs rlabs chen spya da pa yi/ /sngon 'gro yin par rig par bya/ /khyod kyi bla ma dri ma med/ /khyi'u nga yi gtsug tu yod/ /bu khyod mjal bar spro na stori / ces gsungs pa dang lhan cig tu/ dbu gtsug nas bla ma chen po sku mdog dmar ser g.yas ḍā ma ru dang / g.yon kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa phyag rgya drug gi rgyan can stag pags kyi smad sham can zhig bstan te de'i zhal nas/ e ma ho chos kyi dbyings kyi ye sheng rang bzhin 'gyur ba med/ /dbyibs kyi rnam rol yongs spyod rdzog pa'i bdag nyid can/ theg mchog ga nga sngags chos kyi bhaṇ+ḍa rab tu sgrog /bde mchog thabs dang shes rab dbyer med rdo rje che/ rnal 'byor pa bdag // na

nam yang 'du 'bral med/ /sngon gyi dus su ji ltar smra5 pa'i gdams pa rnams/ /snying gi dbus su legs par bcangs te sgrub par gyis/ /dud 'gro'i lus 'dis re zhig bya rnams 'dul bar byos/ /'di nas khyod 'dri+o / nub tu bdag gi drung du yong / /sngar 7 sa ji bzhin nub phyogs rgyal po zhig tu skye/ /blo gsal zhi dul rin chen gsum la shin tu gus/ /ma 'ongs byang phyogs gangs ri'i khrod der rang cag rnams/ /'du ba gsum gyis sangs rgyas bstan pa gso bar byed/ /der yang ma zad tshe rabs kun tu 'bral ba med/ /bu khyod don gnyis bsgrub pa'i grogs byed rtag tu dge zhes gsungs te khyi'u'i dbu gtsug tu rub bo/ de nas mgrin sngon zla bas zhus pa/ kye ma bdag gi skyabs gcig pu/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi spyi gzugs rje/ /'di nas byang chub snyi nga po'i bar/ /yab sras rnams kyi brtse bas bzung / /bdag gis deng dus bya tshogs la/ /dam chos bstan zhing go ba 'di/ /las gang bgyis pa'i 'bras bu lags/ zhes zhus pas khyi'u gtso 'khor gsum gyi zhal nas/ nyon dang zla ba dri ma med/ /sngon tshe 'dzam gling shar phyogs su/ /sdig spyod dar ba'i yul gru na /ma 'ongs shin tu mtha' ma'i dus/ /'dzam gling charagatogs gser gling du/ /rgyal po kā zho dri med ces/ /btsun mo nyi shu rtsa lngar ldan/ /bu ni bcu mchis dang po de/ /da lta'i dus kyi 16 /sa 'dzin/ /gnyis pa grogs po 'od ldan te/ /gsum pa

rgyal po'i bu mo yin/ /bzhi pa 'a rga ā na ste/ /lnga pa gzhon nu gtum spyod yin/ drug pa blo gros rab bzang ste/ /bdun pa blon po nyi ma'i ba/ /tsan+d+ra shu kār grags pa'o/ /brgyad pa slob dpon ni tso nyid/ /dgu pa snyan pa'i zlos gar yang / /bcu pa nga yi sprul pa byung / /btsun mo dam pa gser bzang de/ /de tshe btsun mo'i tshul du yong / /blon po chen po yam she yang / /de tshe blon po'i tshul du yong / /khyod kyi mchod pa'i gnas su ni/ /sprul pa'i byang chub sems dpa' mang / lha snang btsun mo nges legs 'di/ /de tshe khyod kyi ma ru 'gyur/ /bu rnams kun gyi chung ba de/ /nga/ser gling rgyal po byed par 'gyur/ /'bangs rnams bde la sbyor gyur kyang /bu bzhi ba dang de'i btsun mo/ /yam she'i skye ba nye bcas kyis/ /khol bu rnams su sdug bsngal skyed/ /dngos mi na de yi rkyen nyid kyis/ /kā sna chen po'i srog la brgol/ /de yang las kyi dbang yin no/ /de nas 'dod spyod lha yul na/ /lha bu chen po blo brtan zhes/ /kho bo byang chub sems dpa' che/ /pad+ma dkar por gyur pa la/ /de tsho mchod dang bsnyen bkur byed/ /yang gcig las kyi dbang nyid kyis/ /dud 'gro klu yi 'gro bar skye/ /bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid du/ /bde gshegs spyan legs byon pa la/ /mchod dang 'jig rten bde bar byed/ /bde ba/shegs de yis chos bstan pa/ /slar yang dud 'gro rnams la ston/ /du ma thar pa'i /sdu du

'khrid/ /gzhan yang bde gshegs du ma la/ /mchod dang 'jig rten bde la sbyor/ /de ltar snying dbus stims shig bu/ zhes gsungs so/ de nas chos kyi bdud rtsi mang du bstsal nas mthar/ kye zla ba/ wa ra ṇa si'i rgyal srid rgyal bu rdzun mas 'phrogs pa 'di ni rgyal po 'di'i lus brje bar ma byas na/ chos rgyal rab snang chen po la sogs pa wa ra ṇa si ba rnams shin tu nyam thag par gyur te snang ngo / sdig can 'di ni bsdod kyang dge ba mi gsog par bsod nams ma yin pa du ma bsags pas na gzhan rnams kyang sdug bsngal la sbyor la/ de'i mthus rang nyid kyang sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong bar 'gyur ro/ des na khyod ni rten 'di kho na nyid kyis rang gzhan gyi don grub par 'gyur bas khyod kyi grogs po 'dod ldan 'di nyid tsan mi'i 'dabs su/ lha mo ku ru kukle nyid/ bram ze mo'i gzugs kyis shing pa la sha'i sdong po'i khong gseng du/ zas bsod snyoms tsam gyis 'tsho ba'i tshul bstan te mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon mdzad pa zhig yod pa de'i drung du khyod dang lhan cig song la/bdag gis 'di ltar lung bstan pa yin pas grong 'jug gi gdams pa zhu zhes zhus shig de ni rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor chen mo yin pas byin gyis rlabs pa tsam gyis 'pho ba la dbang thob par 'gyur ro/ zhesalung bstan no/ de nas g.yas kyi bu mo des skul zhing gtso bo dang sngon1 // gnyis kyis 'gram btegs te/ nyon dang lhas bstsal dge

'dun 'bangs/ /rang bzhin ngabyings kyi gzhal yas su/ /khro gnyer 'od zer bye ba 'phro/ /rnam par sprul pa'i bdag nyid can/ /zlos gar ni pa la la byed/ /sprul pa'i rgyal po'i grogs byed dge/ khyod kyis bdag nyed byang du 'dren/ /ngu la byung bya ba'i dpal yang byed/ /nyon dang rigs can khyi'u chung / /nub tu nga yang grub pa 'dzin/ /sprul pa'i zlos gar der yang sgyur/ /byang phyogs gangs ri'i ljongs su yang / chos kun bden grub ma mchis kyang / kun rdzob sgyu ma'i lung yang ston/ gangs ri'i shar du 'brug ltar grags/ /dga' ba'i rgyal po spyan ras gzigs/ /bdud dpung 'joms pa'i sgra yang sgrog /sprul pa'i khyi'u ngo mtshar can/ /khyod kyi bshes gnyen dam pa 'di/ /e ma shin tu ngo mtshar can/ rgyal ba kun gyi yab legs kyang / /rgyal sras tshul gyi rdzu bag can/ 'di la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / /nyon mongs tshul gyi 'gro la ston/ /shes bya kun khyab thugs mnga' yang / tha mal tshul can e ma ) khyod kyang byang chub snying po'i bar /yab sras rnams kyi rjes su 'dzin/ /ngas kyang rtag tu grogs byed do/ zhes gsungs so/ yang g.yon gyi bu mo des gtso mdzad nas gtso 'khor gsum gyi zhal nas/ /khe ma thogs med byi'u chung / /sngon gyi dus nas rjes 'dzin lha/ /nga ni khyod kyi ma yang yin/ /'di nas nam yang 'bral med kyang / /nub tu slar yong de nas bdag /spyan ras gzigs dbang sprul pa'i sku/ 171/zla

med dam pas shar phyogs su/ bdag 'dren slar yang shar phyogs su/ /khyod kyi thabs mkhas bya ba dang / /bdag gis sgyu sprul thabs bzang gis /byang du dge legs rgya cher ster/ /zla med lo gi shā ra yis/ /'phrin las spel ba'i grogs kyi mchog de nas dri med mgon mchog dang / /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i 'phrin las grogs/ /ye shes 'od kyis ma rig bsal/ /gsang chen du ma'i 'khor lo'i mdzod/ /bde chen rgyal mo bde ba'i gter/ /nub tu dregs pa 'dul bar byed/ /byang phyogs ljongs su bdag sprul gyi/ /rgyun chad med par 'gro ba skyong / /byang chub snying po'i bar du khyod/ /ltos bcas bdag gis rjes su 'dzin/ zhes gsungs so/ gzhan yang gsung gi bdud rtsi du ma zhig bstsal te ri bo ta lar gshegs so/byi'u ni der sems can la byams snying rje sgom zhing bzhugs pas/ re zhig de dang nye ba'i gnas 'dabs su nyam thag pa'i skad cig grags pa la myur du song ste gzigs pas/ rab byung zhig sbrul gdug pa gcig gis lus shin tu dkris te 'dug pa la byams pa rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis lhag pa'i lha la gsol ba shugs drag po btab pas/ srin po 'jigs su rung ba ral gri dang sman rgyal thogs pa zhig gis/ ral gri des sbrul gdug de bskrad/ sman rgyal des rig pa tsam gyis dug thams cad gzhi med du bsel te gar song cha me/ nā song ngo / rab byung de'i mthong snang la ni/ khu byug rang

tshur byung ste kho rang gi steng du rdzing tsam byas pas sbrul bros te dug zhi ba byung ngo / de nas zla bas/ shakya'i rab byung chen po khyod/ /nags gseb sbrul gdug gis mnar ba/ /da lta dug dang ldan mi ldan/ /phyogs ni gang nas gshegs pa la gas/ zhes smras pas/ de na re/ kye sprul pa'i bya drin dang ldan pa khyod ni bdag skyob par byed pa'i mgon ji lta bu lags/ bdag ni khyod kyi drin nyid kyis/ /dug thams cad gzhi med du rab tu zhi bar gyur to/ bdag ni dbus phyogs kyi chos sde chen po len+d+ra'i 'dabs su/ rgyal po'i mchod gnas zhes bya ba'i sa ṭa theg pa chen po chen po la bzhugs pa'i dge slong rnams kyi zhabs 'bring ba/ smi shri bya ba lags so/ /dge slong rnams ljongs rgyu la gshegs pa'i zhabs 'bring du yong ba re zhig nags gseb tu blta ba la sbrul gyis zin pa lags so/ zhes sprus pas/ zla ba ni rab tu byung ba'i rtags tsam la'ang gus pas de'i drung du babs te 'dud pa'i tshul gyis smras pa/ /ku ku shakya'i rab byung khyed/ /gang gi tshul khrims bang mdzod du/ /dad pa'i rin chen nor gyis bkang / /ting 'dzin mi zad nas mkha'i mdzod/ /shes rab 'dod dgu 'byung ba ste/ rten 'ad smad byung yid bzhin nor/ de phyir gus pas khyed la 'dud /bdag ni sprul pa ma lags te tha mal dud 'gro sngon bsags kyi/ /dge ba'i 'bras bu phra mo mis/ /da lta blang dor cung zad go/ /de ring 'di na ra/ 7/nga

dang / /'phrad pa shin tu bskal bzang kye/ /sbrul gdug nad las grol ba de/ /bdag gi nus pa ma lags te/ /khyod kyi jo bo dkon mchog gsum/ /gang gi thugs rje nyid kyis yin/ zhes smras pas/de shin tu mgu ste song ngo / de nas des kyang chos sde rnams su/wa ra ṇa si'i nags su sprul pa'i bya 'di lta bu zhig 'dug rga zhes bsgrags pa la brten te/ dge 'dun rnams kyi gtso bo pa ta chen po rnams dang bcas te shing rta dang a ka ru dang / du ru ka la sogs nga 'i dri bzang po dang / ba dan dang / rol mo'i bye brag la sogs pa thogs te nags gseb tu phebs pas zla ba mthong ngo /zla bas kyang dge 'dun rnams la gus pas mgo dud pa dang gzhog pa thal mo sbyar ba lta bu byas so/ dge 'dun rnams kyis phyag mdzad pa la zla bas gyisol ba/ 'phags mchog 'jig rten 'dren pa'i rjes zhugs pa /tsho gas mchog dge 'dun 'dus pa'i zhabs sen la/ /zla ba dad pa'i yid kyis gus phyag 'tshal/ /blo gros shin tu dman pa'i dud 'gro la/ /zhing gi dam pa rnams kyis phyag mdzad na/ /bsod nams ma lus gting nas jad 'gyur phyir/ /de ltar ma 'tshal bdag gis gsol ba 'debs/ zhes zhus kyang ma gsan par pa: ta che bgres shig gis rgyal ba mchon nyid sngon tshe tshogs rab gsog pa'i tshe/ /ri dgas la sogar sa yam̐ gas rnam pas gnas de bzhin/ /'di lta'i gzugs can spru/ ༵ mame ga 'di khe ma med /blo mchog rnams kyang deng 'dir ka ye

blta bar 'tshal/ zhes sogs chings su bcad pa gsungs so/ de nas de dag gis byi'u shing rta'i steng du bzhab/ ste steng nis gdugs phub/dri bzang dang rolamos bsus te shing rta rgyas tshal bya bar gdan drangs te/ der yang dge 'dun rnams dang de dag gi sbyin bdag gis bsngags pa'i me tog 'thor zhing gus pa'i bkur sti phun sum tsho sa pa byas so/ byi'us kyang de dag la re re nas chos mang du gsungs pas byi'u la dad pa thob cing / pazlo ta rnams la chos kyi bdud rtsi yang zhus so der dgung zhag gcig gi bar du bzhugs te/ kye zhing gi dam pa zhing gi mchog /grol ba'i lam bzang 'doms rtsa dzad pa / /lha mi kun gyi bsod nams gzhi/ /tshogs rtsu chog darbe /dun zhabs la 'dud/ /rmongs brtul dud 'gro zla ba bdag /da ni dben ji 'i nags su 'gro/ /dge 'a ston tshogs rnams bde bar bzhugs/ /slar yang mjal ba'i smon lam 'tshal/ /khyad par ma 'ongs gangs ri'i khrid/ /bdag gis bla ma yab sras kyis/ /dam ches sgron me 'bar ba'i tshe/ /'phrad pa'i smon lam snying nas 'debs/ /bslu med dkon mchog thugs rje dang / /bdag gi mos pa'i mthu 'di dang / /phun tshogs rgyu 'bras rten 'brel gyis/ /smon lam ji bzhin rgyab par shog ces sogs rgya cher gsungs te bcol kyang ma bzhugs par rang gi grogs slob ri dwags kyi gam du 'phur te byon no/ de nas de la/ kye ma nyon dang grogs kyi mchog /da ni 25di nas byang du 'gro/ /nagardo/ 7rdol

yangs rnga/ra bangag gi lhags/ /bya tshogs dpa ga dū sma/da pa yong / /khyud kyang 'di na nga rtson ri dog la/ /gsol ba drag tu 'debs rnga/ra gyis/ /gal te phyi bzhin rang gyur kyang / /'jigs rung chu kha/sa thar mi 'gyur / zhes gsungs te byang phyogs su 'phur byon nas bya rnams dang mjal ste/ bya rnams kyang rgyang ring du bsu ba la yong ste/ sangs rgyas 'dzin gyis gsol ba /skyab gsum lam bzang ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes/ /thar pa'i grong du 'gro ba'i grogs kyi mchog nyam nga'i g.yangalas skyob pa'i dpa' bo che/ /skyabs mchog dam pa khyod nyid gang du bzhugs/ /don gnyis phun tshogs mngon du mdzod lags sam /ngal dang snyun pa la sogs mchis sam ci /bdag cag rnam sa ni khyod kyi drin nyid gyis/ /gzugs dang yid la 'tshe ba'i bdud dang bral/ /ngesapar byung )/ dkon mchog skyabs 'gro ba/ /gong 'phel tshul da bde bar legs gnas so/ zhes zhus pa la/ byi'us kyang de dag gi lan legs par gsungs so/ de nas slo ba dpon sangs rgyas nadzin la slob ma sngar gyi de rnams las ches mang bar snang ba rnams la yang zab rgyas chos bye gnang ba legs par byin te/ mi lo gci ga gi bar du spro zhugs pas/ yang wa ra ṇa si'i rgyal srid grogs po 'od ldan gyis byed dgos par lung ci stan pa byung bar brten ji ltar lung bstan pa bzhi na dro/gas dang bcas te ri bo tsan ku'i nye 'dabs tsan dan gyi nags su shing gi suzhi //na myul bas ma rnyed/ re zhig nam mkha' la cang te'u /zog lo lo

grags pa las gzugs ma mthong ba la gsol ba btab pas/ sprin gyi gseb nas rnal 'byor ma ras dkar po'i phong ka dar da /ra po'i sham thabs can dbu skra gnag snum phyed bcings byas pa la me tog sna tshogasagyis pas pa/ ḍa ma ru dang rtse gsum 'dzin pa zhig mjal ba la gsol ba btab ste/ rgyu mtshan zhib par zhus pa 'i r+ṣa jug tu/ /kye sprul pa'i rnal 'byor chen mo khyod/ /cung zad bdag la dgongs mdzod dang / /drang srong lhung ba'i nags khrod du/ /'phags mchog lo gi shā ra yis/ /bdag la gsal bar khyod lung bstan/ /'pho ba mchog gi gdams ngag dang / /byin gyis rlob par mdzad du gsol/ shes zhus pas cang mi gsung bar cung zad mnyam par bzhag ste/ de las bzhengs nas rtse gsum sil khrol lo zhis skad byin par sgro / zhing blta stangs dang bcas se gol gtogs te phaṭaḥ ces gsungs pa'i gsung gis sa ber pa tsam mdzad/ yang rtse gsum 'od ldan gyi spyi bor bzhag ste/ phaṭa ཿ ces sngar bzhin gsungs pas grogs po 'od ldan zhi'o/ de nas zla ba la 'di skad gsungs/ /nga mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo dpal ldan 'phreng / /nub o rgyan yul gyi ṭā gi'i gtso/ ma sid+dhi rā dza ni ru grags/ mgon dri ma med pa'i slob ma yin/ /yum rdo rje tshe yi rigs 'dzin dang / /dpal phyag rgya chen po'i rig pa 'dzin/ /bu /khyod kyi re ba skong ba'i phyir/ dus de ring 'di na gzu gas su snang / kye grong 'jug zab mo gyis shig ces/ /nga la bla ma'i gsung yang rdokā 7/ /

phaṭa ཿ yig dang po brjod pa'i tshe/ /rgyal bu rdzun ma'i rnam shes de/ /mtho ris go 'phang mthon por 'phangs/ /gnyis pas 'od ldan rnam shesade/ /bton nas wa ra ṇa si ru/ skad cig nyid la 'pho ba byas/ /gnod lan phan pa bsgrubs pa de/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi bslab bya ste/ /'on kyang du mar gnod gyur na/ /gcig la cung zad gnod kyang sla/ da lta rgyal bu rdzun ma'i lus/ 'od ldan nyid kyis byas te yo da/ /slar yang rgya gar gnas chen 'grims/ /bod yul sprul pa rgyun mi chad/ /de ltar shes sam mgrin sngon zla/ zhes gsungs pas/ zla bas zhus pa/dri med thugs rje'i mnga' bdag yab sras kyi/ /shes rab cha nyid sprul pa'i yo gi ni/ sni /bdag gi skyabs gcig gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /zhabs sen zla ba'i gtsug tu thod ltar 'ching / /'phags mchog lo gi kṛ ra'i 'phrin las kyis/ /bdag la lung bstan de ring dngos su mjal/ /e ma 'di ni bskal bzang kun gyi bul/ de yang dri med bla ma yab sras kyi/ /thugs rje nyid las gzhan min tshul 'dis kyang / /dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin lhag par dran/ /'bad rtsol med par phaṭa yig sgra tsam gyis/ rdo rje'i grong dbus thogs med 'jug byed pa/ /sprul pa khyod kyi nus pa e ma ho 'di nas byang chub snying po ma thob bar/ /thuṭa rje'i lcaṭa kyus 'bral med nyer bzung ste/ zag med chos dbyings ngang du 'bral med shog /dkon mchog thuṭa rje ba// /ga 'grub gyur cig ces zhus pas rnal 'byor ma des ḍa ma

ru spyi bor bzhag ste/ /ā bde stong chos dbyings sgra dbyangs 'dis/ /gzung 'dzin spros pa kun zhig nas/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i dang nyid du/ /'du 'bral med pa a la la/ zhes spyi bo nas thims pas zhag bdun gyi bar du thugs sems ro gcig tu 'dres te bde stong gi ngang du gnyid snang nub bo/ zhag bdun song ba dang gnyid 'thug las sad pa bzhin du gyur pa dang mnyam du sngar gyi rnal 'byor ma de zla ba'isnying ga nas dngos su thon te nam mkhar 'phaṭa nas/ /kye hoḥnyon dngamagrin sngon zla /'di nas rang gi gnas su song / /'gro don gnyis skyes bya la yod/ /kun rdzob sems kyi snang ba ru/ /las 'bras ya mtshan bslu ba med/ /bya tshogs rten 'brel lam la bskul/ /'di nas skye ba gcig gi 'og /gangs ri'i khrod du khyod kyang 'gro/ /de nas mi rabs lnga 'das shing / /khyod kyis skye ba gsum blangs mthar/ dri medabla ma'i lung bstan bzhin/ /bod du khyod nyid skye bar 'gyur /bdag kyang brdos bcas lus mi 'gro/ /'on kyang zag med 'od lus kyis/ /de tshe yang yang rjes su 'dzin/ /ne+e pa la yi yul du ni/ /paṇa chen rgyal ba ded dpon nam/ /gsang mtshan sha ri badz+ra zhes/ /phyi rol nyan thos zhi dul can/ /nang du rnal 'byor brtul zhuṭa spyod/ /bod yul sharaskyes pra zhes/ /dri med bla ma'i slob ma byed/ /bslab gsum rnal 'byor mchog la spyod/ /bod dus bu badz+ra zhes/ /dri med bla ma'i drin nyid las/ /zab mo'i bdud rtsi rgya mtshor spyod/ /'brel tsha/ 7/na

dang ldan par byed/ /rgya gar lho ru bsti ta /shākya'i ming mnga' 'gro don spyod/ /bod du pad+ma'i ming 'dzin pa'i/ /dri med bla ma'i dren nyid las/ /zab mo bcud kyi zil dngar gyis/ /mtha' yas 'gro pa'i don kyang byed/ /o ṭī ya nar gsang sngags spyod /rnal 'byor chen po rgyan cha can/ /rdo rje pho nya mo grub pa/ /a wa snro ti'i spyod pa byed/ /yang ni sham bha lar 'gro ste/ /rig pa'i rdo rje rig pa can/ /gser gling rgyal po ka zho dang / /rgya nag yul du yang 'gro'o/ /de la sogs pa du ma ste/ de dag rnams kyi yul du yang /dngos dang sprul pa'i zlos gar gyis/ /yang yang 'phrad cing blo yid 'dren/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du yang / /'bral ba med par rjes su 'dzin/ zhes gsungs te mi snang bar gyur to/ de nas sngar gyi gnas su log ste/ byi'u chung mgrin sngon zla ba nyid bya rnams dang lhan cig tu dam pa'i chos kyes dus 'da' bsru skabs shig wa ra ṇa si'i rgyal bus byi'u btsal ba'i phyir du nags mthar skyo sangs kyi tshul gyis nyin mang por bzhugs shing btsal bas re zhig slob dpon sangs rgyas 'dzin mthong ngo / mthong nas 'khor dang blon po gzhan rnams bzhag nas rang nyid nags gsebatu zhugs te sangs rgyas 'dzin la phyag byas te/ sangs rgyas 'dzin dngalhan cig tu byi'u drung du byung ngo / de nas phan tshun 'brel ba'i gsung gi gleng slong du ma'i mjug tu zla ba'i zhal nas/ nyon dang rgyar bu 'o/ /na nyon/ /kye bo de ring ngo mtshar che/ /bdag lus sngon tshe rgyal
