po'i gzugs/ /khyod ni bya yi rnam pa can/ /da lta bangag ni khu byug lus/ /khyod nyid mi lus rgyal po'i gzugs/ /dngos su gyur pa ngo mtshar che/ /'khor ba pa yi chos nyid kun/ /'di ltar lags so grogs slob rnams/ ya mtshan gzigs mo 'di la stos/ /snying med bslu ba'i chos nyid can/ /'di lta'i 'byor pa sgrub byed pa/ /de las rmongs pa gzhan ci mchis/ /'on kyang grogs po 'od ldan khyod /lo gi sha ra'i bka' bzhin du/ /rgyal srid gnas der gnas pa 'di/ /ma chags spyod pa'i tshul shes na/ /nyes bcas phyir zlog dge ba'i grogs/ shin tu mi 'byor dgra mang ba/ /bya yi lus las mi yi rten/ /ci phyir mthun pa'i rkyen mi mang / /de phyir dal rten mi yi lus/ /rnam dag tshul khrims kun gyi snod/ /tshul 'di rgyal bas kun nas bsngags/ /legs las sbyor ba dge ba'i bzhes/ /wa ra ṇa si'i rgyal khab tu/ /paṇa chen rin chen bshes gnyen yod/ /'jam dpal dbyangs kyis byin rlabs shing sprul nga 'i dge sbyong chen po yin/ de las dam chos bdud rtsi long / /nub phyogs kha che'i rgyal khab tu/ /blon chen dam pa ye shes 'dzin/ /da lha rtse gcig dam chos sgrub/ /dri med bla ma'i rnam sprul te/ de nyid wa ra ṇa si 'dir/ /spyan drongs gyur na kun la phan/ /gzhan yang rang re'i bde legs kun/ /rin chen gsum la rag las phyir/ /rgyal ba sras bcas sku gzugs la/ /zhing phyogs dngos kyi 'du shes kyis/ /dpag med mchod sprin rgya mtsho phul/ /sla chos ser /ci /nga

bral zhing / /bsam pa bzang pos nyer bku la na/ /dper na yung 'bru tsam gyi spong / /rgyal ba rnams la phul ba yi/ bsod nams de yi gzugs yod na/ /stong gsum 'di tsam stong las brgal /snying po med pa'i 'byor pa la/ /dpag med snying po lon gyur na/ /ji ltar thunaya nga ci mi spro/ /bslu med lam bzang 'doms ca ja da pa/ /ston pa sangs rgyas las gzhan su/ /nam yang dmigs su med pa'i phyir/ /de dang mi mthun ston pa la/ /ltos dang bcas pas dug ltar blta/ /ji ltar byas kyang mi rtag cing / /yid brtan skad cig mi rung pa'i/ /'tsho ba'i srog stong phral yang sla/ /skyabs gsum 'dor ba de ltar min/ /rgyal po 'ang ri rgyas la zhus te/ /de khrims bzhib/sa na ches mi rigs /blang dor ji ltar gdams pa (5//nyid kyi rtsal gyis 'bod par mdzod /sna 3gsardul la long pas bzhin/ /shin tu phra ba gsung rab la/ /blo grong mig bu bral ba yis/ /nam yang brnyas dmod mi rung ste/ /gal te the tshom che ba rnams/ /len ma nus kyang btang stoms bya/ /ma gyur sdig pa chen po yes/ /dmyal bar nges par the mi tshom/ /chos ni shin tu zhi ba ste/ /'tsho ba rtsub ceng ma rung nyid/ /tsha grang bzhin du 'galabs na/ /nam yang 'gro la 'tsho mi bya/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rabs thams cad kun/ /dngos dang brgyud pas rang nyid kyi/ /go 'phang mchog la bgri bas na/ /blo gros rim pa ji bzhin blang / /lung sogs gle/sdu 2bam leg 3bru yang / bkur dang ma cho da pa klog pa dang / /kun

chub pa dang 'dri ba tsu gas/ /bsod nams mtha' yas brjod mi lang //'phags mchog dge 'dun rin chen la/ /skyabs swāchog lung rtogs sgrub pa'i grogs/ snying nas zhu zhing sangs rgyas kyi/ /rjes su 'jug par byed pa yi /'khor bani gang yang rung la/ /zhin tu mthun zhing bkur ba bya/ /rang gi mchod gnas dge 'dun sogs/ /zhabs 'og rdul yang thod bzhin bkur/ / stan las ldang dang thal sbyor sogs/ / shus pa'i cha lugs thams cad rgya/ /thod dang 'phreng rgyan zhan pa sogs/ /sgeg pa'i rgyan dang cha lugs kyang / /rgyal dang rgyas/ sras de ye gzugs/ /slob dpon mkhan po bla ma dang / /dge sbyong la sogs 5/dun du min /gang la brten na dad pa dang /gtong dang tshul khrimasal sogs pa/ /legs tshogs 'grib byed mi dge'i grogs/ /che 'di'i — ma min kyang rung / /'grogs dang gnyen pa kun dang spangs/ /dad sogs yon tan 'phel byed cing / /spyod bzang 'gran par dka' ba'i grogs/ /ring du gnas kyang 'bad nas bsu/ de dang lhan cig mthun par bya/ /ska gas/ma glang chen g.yeng ba yi/ /bag med chang gis rab myos pa/ /dran shes lcarga/sa gyu non po yis /dbang med dgespru bskul bar bya/ /rang bzhin dang ni bcas pa yi/ /kha ni ma tho'i nyes sdom pa/ /mi dpe bcu spong nyid du 'du/ /khyim pa rab byung gang pa yang / /rgyal bas tshul 'di ngon chen gsu ngas/ /theg gnyis dam pa'i chos kun gyi/ /med du rgyal ba nyid kyis bstan/ /dge bcu/ 8sdus

kyi thems skas las/ /gnas skabs ma thar thug khang bzang 'dzegs/ /rang bzhin 'bangs rnams thams cad kyang / /dge bcu'i las kyi khrims la sbyor/ /gang zhig bdag dang su 'grogs pa/ /log pa'i 'jigs las skyob byed cing / /'bad pas legs lam dam chos la /khyod kyis thams cad bkri bar mdzod/ /rang gi jo bo dkon mchog ste/ /gang gi thugs rje'i dpung nyid kyis/ /bdag nyid rjes 'brangs bcas pa skyobs/ /'bad rtsol med pa yid bzhin nor/ /skyabs 'di nam yang btang mi bya/ /wa ra ṇa si pa la sogs/ /rang gi 'bangs su gyur rnams kyang / /pha ma lta bu khyod kyis mdzod/ /de dag rnams la khyod kyi bka'/ /shin tu gyi bas lus srog kyang / /gtong la rang dbang med pa'i phyir/ /gus ldan rnams la brtse med pa/ /de las khrel med gzhan ma lags/ /khrims kyi rin chen ra ba nyid/ /'joms pa'i chom por gyur rnams kyang / /re zhig drag po'i tshul nyid kyis/ /tshar gcod tshul la mkhas par mdzod/ /yab rje mi dbang rigs ldan rgyal/ thod bzhin gtsug tu bkur ba dang / /bka' tshig ji ltar bstsal ba las/ /nam yang g.yel med mi 'dang mdzod/ /rgyal po gong ma'i bka' srol gyi/ /khrims dang yo byad sogs pa kun/ /gzhan du byed pa khrims bcas shing / /blo ldan bya ba gang bsgrubs kyang / /snyi nang blon po'i tshogs rnams dang / /gros bsdur 'jam po'i tshul gyis bya/18/sducas chung 'brid sla ca co mang / rgyal po'i 'os su ma lags

shing / shin tu g.yo can glang snying can/ /chos kyi rgyal por ga la thos//rgad la gzhon gyis bkur ba na/ / ya rabs skye bo'i srol yin pas/ /rang gzhan rnams la khrims su bca'/ /bya ba kun la brtag cing dpyad/ /glo bur nyid du bya mi rung / /rang la rgyu mtshan cang med par/ pha rol skye bo'i rjes mi 'brang / /rang nyid gang du gnas na yang / /gong ma rnams ni gtsug ltar bkur/ /phan tshun thad kor mtshungs rnams kyang / shin tu brtse zhing 'grogs par bya/ /dman rnams byams pa'i sems kyis skyongs/ /mdor na khyod kyis rgyal po'i srid /byams pa nyid kyis bskyed 'tshal te/ /pha rol dgra bo 'jom pa la/ /byams pa lta bu'i dpung ma mchis/ phyi nang mtshon gyis mi phug par/ /byams pa 'dra ba'i go cha med/ 'gro gzhan 'bangs su sdud pa la /byams pa lta bu'i longs spyod med/ /bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs pa la/ /byams pa lta bu'i dge ba med/ /mang du 'di spros ci zhig 'tshal/ bdud las rnam rgyal thub dbang gi/ /gsung gi bdud rtsi'i rig pa las/ rgyal po rnams la bstan pas chos/ /blo ldan khyed kyis shes par 'gyur/ /dpal ldan dri med bla ma yis/ /bdag la 'di ltar lung yang bstan/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang sprul pa'i bya/ /da lta khyod kyi 'khor du mchis/ /'od zer ldan pa'i mtshan mnga' ste/ /ma 'ongs rgyal ba'i sras kyi mchog /lha yi rjer 'gyur sprul pa'i sku/ /don dam dbyings su ma nyam /rdo 5/ /

nam mkha' lta bur ro yang gcig /'di nas rgyal bu rdzun ma'i tshab/ /dam pa 'di yis byed par 'gyur/ /'bangs rnams shin tu bde la sbyor/ /tshe 'a par nga dang las mang 'phrad/ /de sogs khyod la lung bstan mang / /'gro ba'i don bzang bsgrub pa la/ /ngal zheng dub par ma mdzod cing / /dri med bla ma'i lung bstan bzhin/ /gsol ba thob dang tshe 'dir yang / /bla ma mchog de mjal bar 'gyur/ /lhag pa'i lha na spyan ras gzigs/ /rtag tu yi ge drug pa bzlos/ /bar chad bdud las rnam rgyal phyir/ /rje btsun myur ma bsten par 'tshal /zhes gsungs so/ 'od ldan rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi sku yi dngos/ /dri med bla ma'i gsung sras lha yi lha/ /mgrin sngon zla ba bya yi rnam pa can/ /dus 'dir bdag la cung zad dgongs mdzod dang / /bdag la khyod nyid rgyal po gyis shig gsungs/ /mchog gi slob dpon dam pa yab sras gnyis/ /slob ma'i tshogs bcos lhan cig mi gnas par/ /gcig pur wa ra ṇasir song gyur cing / /chos med dug gsum rgyal ba rgyal po'i gzugs/ /yab rje gong ma'i srol yang mi zin la/ /zla ba dang sangs rgyas 'dzin/ /rang nyid dam chos sgrub pa'i skabs stod snyam/ /yid la mi bde'i zugs rngus zin gyur nas/ /de lta khas len bgyi ba'i rngo ma thogs/ 'on kyang slar yang nga lhag lhas lung bstan cing1 8/6 nan tan gsung gis dbang med bskul byung nas/ /khyod dang

lhan cig tsa ga'i ri na phyin/ /sprul pa'i rnal 'byor ma mchog de nyid mjal/ /phaṭa yig sgra yis bdag sems mda' ltar 'phangs/ /rgyal bu chos kyi dga' ba'i phung por bcug /tha mal skye bo'i blo ru zhong dka' ba'i/ /ngo mtshar zlos gar rmad byung de ltar bstan/ /da ni ji ltar gsung gi bdud rtsi yi/ /bcud rnams spang dbus sems par bgyid lags so/ /khyod nyid wa ra ṇa sir cis kyang gshegs/ /rigs ldan rgyal po'i thugs kyang gso bar mdzod/ ces gsungs so/zla ba na re/ ku ku/ re zhig bdag nyid rgyal khab tu/ /yongs kyang legs par mi 'gyur bas/ /khyod kyi mdzad spyod bzang po yis/ /rgyal pore thugs kyang gso bar 'tshal/ /slar ni mi ring 'phrad pa yi smon 'dun legs par bgyid par mdzod/ /gzhan yang tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dge ba'i smon lam yang yang 'tshal/ zhes sogs gsungs te/ de nas 'od ldan rgyal khab tu byon te/ rgyal srid chos bzhin skyong ba'i mdzad bzang ni/ sngar rab skyong nyid rgyal por yod pa'i dus las kyang ches lhag par gyur cing / skye bo thams cad kyang bde skyid phun sum tshogs par khyab pas gyur te/ thams cad kyis e ma hoX da ni rgyal bu 'di bsam brnyed do/ 'di lta bu'i mdzad bzang rmad du byung ba'o zhes yid la dga' bdes khyab bo/ de'i tshe rab skyong rgyal po'i mnal lam du/ g.yu yi mchod rten 'od zer dri ma med pa zhig pho brang gi steng rgyal bu bzhugs pa'i steng du 'dug go/ 18snyi'i

mthar mi bdun gyis rim gyis srung ba la rgyal pos dris nga sa de dag gi 'og ma 'og mas bdag sge/sa mi shes te 'dis shes so zhes rim gyis mi bdun rdzoṭa pa'i tha ma des/ mchod rten de'i lto ba kha phye ba'i nang btsunamo dam pa ma ti mahā ni bzhugs 'dug pas des rgyal po'i mgul nas 'khyud de/ da khyod kyi don 'grub bo/ kye lha snang rgyal po khyod kyis bu chos kyi dga' ba nyid dang rgyud gcig tu gyur pa'i bde ba can du kyang chub sems dpa' dri ma med pa'i tog ces bya ba des blon po'i bu'i rnam shes 'phrogs te/ da lta byang chub sems dpa' 'ang yod do khyod byang chub ma thob bar du bdag gis rjes su 'dzin pa yin no/zhes gsungs nas/ rje btsun thol mar gyur te thugs ka na thim pa dang zla ba nya gang ba gcig shar/ de'i 'od kyis sa thams cad snang bar byas pa'i 'og tu zla ba nag po zur gsum pa shar te dkar po de baspribs nas thams cad mun par song / yang zla ba gcig shar te thams cad sngar bzhin gyur pa dang / pho brang gi rgyal mtshan rnying pa rnams brje ba sogs rmis so/ der thugs yid ches par gyur te/sras kyi drung du song nas 'di skad gsungs so/ /kye ma gzhon nu bdag la gson /bdag gi nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ /spyir ni 'khrul ba'i rang bzhin nyid/ /sna tshogs rmi ba'i chos nyid de/ /nam 7yang yid brtan ga la rung / /'on kyang 'di la legs nyes dang / bag cha/sdu 8ji ltar yin par smos/ /yangs pa'i shar phyogs nam mkha'

nas/ /dri med 1 gang zla ba shar/ /sa ga nyin rto bzhin du gsal/ /de shul zla ba zur dzi sum pa/ /nag po'i gzugs shar denyid bsgribs/ /sa gzhi mun pas khyab par rmis/ /de nas mi ring song ba na/ /yang gcig sngar dang 'dra ba yi/ /dri med zla ba gsal bar shar/ /sngon bzhin mun kun bsal bar rmis/ /gang yin bdag gis cha ma mchis/ /bu gcig khyod kyis mkhyen nam ci/ zhes zhus pas/ rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ /yab rje mi yi dbang po chos gi rgyal/ /cung zad dge 'dun 'bangs la snyan gson dang / /rgyal po spyod kyi mnal ba'i rmi ltas de/ /'khrul pa'i bag chags ma lagang nyes pa'ang min/ /dri med nam mkha' rgyal sras zhing gi dbyings/ /dri med chos kyi zla ba gsal shar ba/ /dri med ma tshan mchog 'bral ba'i khyab 'jug grogs/ /dri med dge kun mu na pa bzhin du byas/ /dri med pad+ma bla ma yab sras kyi/ /dri med bstan la mos pa'i rgyal po la/ /dri med tog de'i snying gle+obs 'od da /ra gyis/ /dri med sa gsum thams cad sna nga ba ste/ /de ltar ma khyen nam rku spyod chos kyi rgyal/ zhes zhus pas/ rgyal po shin tu dga' zhing mgu nas/ /kye ma chos kyi zla ba yum gyi lung bzhin du/ /mi zad sdig grob/sa khyab 'jug dug gis zin/ /rgyal sras zla ba med pa'i shul nyid du/ /khyab 'jug mun pas rgya gar yul la khyab/ /de dgakun kyang bcol chung bdag gis byas/ /'phags pa'i gsung la bud med ngag tu btag//89 /

yam she'i sras po dga' ba'i zlon du bskos/ /nyes med chos blon pha rol sa mthar bskrad/ /de dag kun kyang 'gyer pas de ring 'chags/ /da ni bdag gis ji ltar sgrib sbyong bgyid/ /rab skyong bdag gi lhag bsam mthu nyid dang / /dkon mchog bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / /'phaṭa ma zlo gros chen mo'i thugs rje las/ /e ma da ni dri medazla ba shar/ /bdag gi bsam pa grub ceng zhe blo bde/ zhes zhucho te rgya la po rang gis phyag byas shing bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa zhus te 'brel btam mang du gsungs te 'od ldan rang nyid sngon gyi rgyal bu chos kyi dga' ba dang rgyud gcig par zhal gyis bzhes shing / rgyal bu bya'i gzugs su yod pa re zhig la gsang bar mdzad do/ de bzhin du btsunamo nges legs la rgyal pos gsangs pas dga' mgu rangs pa'i sems dang ldan zhing rgyal bu la ba dī na bkur byas so/ de nas wa ra ṇa si'i rgyal bu mdzad spyod shin tu leg snye par gyur to zhes thams cad du grags pas/ rnal 'byor ma byang chub bzang ro ji tso ta'i yul du shing lo gos su gyon ta mi dang mi ma yin la chos 'chad kyin yod pas gsan no/ gsan pa dang / wa ra ṇa si'i rgyal bus slar grong 'jug byas pa yin nam snyam du dgongs nas gzigs pas wa ra ṇa si'i phyogs shig na bya'i gzugs su gyur te chos 'chad pa sangon shes kyis gzigs so/ gzigs pa nas kyi skad cig nyid la rdzu laḥ — 3 de/ sdug bhe zla ba'i drung du byon nas/ /kye sprul pa'i rgyal bu byang chub

sems dpa' khyod/ /las ngan 'phro mad la ga a na yis/ /sku la bar du gcod pa bgyis lags sam/ /da lta wa ra ṇa si'i rgyal khab tu/ la gā sī na nyid kyi gnas lags sam/ zhes gsungs so/zla ba na re/ ku ku/ bslu med dkon mchog rin chen gsum/ /mi 'bral spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /byang chub bar du khyod rang mkhyen/ las ngan bdag la skyob par mdzod/ /sngon nas cha rgyus nges 'dra ba'i/ /bdag nyid rgyu mtshan 'dri ba khyod/ /yul ni gang lags ming de ci/ zhes gsungs pas/ rnal 'byor ma'i zhal nas/kye kye gson dang bdag gi bshes/ /chos kyi dga' ba cung zad dgongs khyod kyis bdag nyid mi mkhyen nam/ /nga ni khyod kyi btsun mo ste/ /gsung gi bdud rtsis bskyangs pa yi/ /thugs kyi sras mo'ang bdag lags mod/ /khyod nyid wa ra ṇa si ru/ /sa ra tsā na'i 'phrul nyid kyis/ /bdud blon la ga yi na bcas /skyed mos tshal du ltad mar phyin/ /la ga ā nas grong 'jug byas/ /wa ra ṇa sir slar yang byung / /ltas ngan gcan gzan wa mo yis/ lus la gser gyi tshos byas kyang / gang gi spyod pa ngan pa la/ /blo gros yod pa su yig mgu/ /chos kyi nyi ma nub tu nub/ /gser bzang mun par gci ཿpur lus/ /dbang po'i mchog gyur snying nyid bton/ /gser bzang gzugari kyang gog por lus/ /nyin mtshan rjod sku yid la rgyas/ gyi mtsho las lhag mchi ma lhung / di/ la

bzod ngaka'i bcing gis zin/ /skad cig tsam yang sdod mi sgo/ /myur du nub tu phyo /ru/ su bros/ /sprul pa'i gzugs nyid btsal snyam ste/nags mthar grogs med gcig pur 'khyams/ /'ji /sa/ skrag bar do'i sems can 'dra/ /bkres skom gdung bas yi dwags 'dra /gti mug mthug pos rab bsgribs nas/ /nam yang khyed sku ma brnyed par /gdung ba'i yul gyis sa la brgyal/ /skyabs me da ri/rkan med gyurapa yis/ /skyabs su rin chen rnam gsum pos/ /gang ṣ+pe thugs rje'i mthu nyid kyis/ /sprul pa'i dge sbyong mchog ce ma rnga jal/ /zhabs kyi pad+mor phyag byas te/ /rjes su 'dzin par gsol ba btab/ /srid 'byung dri med bsil khang mchog /rab tu byung ba'i sgo ru bcug /byang chub sems kyi gdams pa bstsal/ /de nyid ro mang bar du bsgoms/ /de nas 'phaṭa mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /dkyil 'khor chenapor dbang yang bskur/ /bsgom sa bzlas bya tshul zab mo bstan/ /de nyid zla ba bco brgyad par /nyin mtshan med par shugs drag bsgoms/ /'phags pas rjes bzung skal 'phro sad/ de nas ljon 'dir 'gro 'ga' la/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi'i bgo skal byin/ /de ring 'di na mjal bar lhags/ /de ltar mkhyen nam skyabs kyi mchogaces sogs zhib mor gsungs pas byi'u yang thugs shin tu dgyes te smras pa/ skyabs mchog bslu med dkon mchog gsum/ /gang sga thu/sdu 2rje'i mthu nyid kyis/ /de ring 'di na ya mtshan che/ /shin tu

legs so rnal 'byor mas/ /dal 'byor rin chen gru gzings las/ snying po'i nor bu de ltar blangs/ /bdag kyang shin tu yi rang ngo /bdag ni la gā a na dang / /grogs po gzhon nu rnams dang bcas/ /wa ra ṇa si'i byang phyogs su/ /nags tshal yangs par ltad mor phyin /chu bo chen po'i pha rol du/ /'bras bzang dud pa'i shing 'bras kyi /rnyed pa 'tshol du 'gro bo zhes/ /khu byug mdzes pa'i ro gsar la/ /da lta grong 'jug gyis shig zer/ /bdag la nan tan chen po byas/ /bdag gis de ltar grong 'jug byas/ /shing 'bras blta ba'i shul nyid du/ /bdag gi phung ngo ra zhugs gyur nas/ /rang gi gzug nas nyid chu bor bskyur/ /myur du wa ra ṇa si ru/ /grogs po rnams dang lhan cig song / /de nas bdag gis kun tu btsal/ /btsal kyang cha tsam ga la rnyed/ de nas skyabs gsum dam pa la/ gdung ba'i sems kyis gsol ba btab/ /sprin dkar mdzes pa'i phung po'i dbus/ /lha bu dkar pos yin lugs bshad/ /de nas nags gseb de nyid du/ /rgyal po rgya mtsho gcig bsdus pa'i/ /rgyal sras 'jig rten dbang phyug de/ /sprul pa'i bya yi rnam par mjal/ /dam chos gsung gi bdud rtsi bstsal/ /sprul pa'i bya yi lung bzhin du/ /dur khrod rol pa rngam pa ru/ /dri med bla med sangs rgyas mjal/ /dbugs dbyung lung bstan dbang yang bskur/ /de nas nags gseb 'di logs su/ nges med 'khyams pa'i ngang tshul gyis/ /bya tshogs gtsor gyur ga~X'i bya

la/ /skyabs gsum lam bzang 'chad cing 'doms/ /wa ra ṇa si'i rgyal po ni/ /da lta'i dus su 'jig rten dbang / /spyan ras gzigs mgon sprul pa'i gar/ /bdag gi grogs slob 'od ldan zhes/ /thog mar bya yi rnam pa can/ /ri bo tsa mi'i nye 'dabs su/ /sprul pa'i rnal 'byor chen mo yis/ byin gyis brlabs pa tsam gyis ni/ /rnam shes wa ra ṇa si ru /rgyal bu'i phung po'i dbus su bcug /da lta rgyal po de nyid yin /khyod ni rnal 'byor la dbang 'byor/ /bdag la rjes su brtse ba yis/ /bdag cag rnams la dam chos kyi/ /zab rgyas bdud rtsi stsol bar mdzod/ ces zhus te gzhan yang gleng slong zhib tu mdzad nas/ rnal 'byor ma byang chub bzang mos kyang / zla ba dang slob dpon sangs rgyas 'dzin 'khor bcas la/ dam chos kyi bdud rtsi mang du bstsal te zhag bcu gsum gyi bar du lhan cig tu bzhugs te/ yang byang chub bzang mos 'gro don lho phyogs su yod par gzigs nas 'diskad gsungs so/ sprul pa'i byang chub sems dpa' che/ snying stobs zla ltar rab rgyas pa/ /bdag gi byang chub bar gyi skyabs/ /dge 'dun 'bangs kyi zhabs la 'dud/ /'khor bcas bdag la cung zad dgongs/ bdag ni lho phyogs dben khrod du/ /dam chos bsgrub la brtson pa'i phyir/ /re zhig 'gro bar 'dod lags pas/ /'khor bcas kun gyis gnang ba mdzod/ /slar ni byang chub snyeng po'i bar/ /'a/sdu snyeb med pa'i smon lam zhu/ zhes gsungs so/ zla ba'i zhal nas/

gang gi bsam pa rab bzang ba/ /gser bzang dri med mthun smin pa'i/ /deng 'dir grub pa mchog brnyes pa/ /dge sbyong chen mo'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sngon las 'brel ba mthu zab pas/ /gang dang lhan cig rgyal po'i khab/ /wa ra ṇa sir 'dzoms gyur cing / /yang gcig 'khor ba'i gshis nyid kyis /bdag nyid dud 'gro'i gzugs su gyur/ /khyod ni nges med sa mthar 'khyams/ /deng dus bdag cag lhan cig 'dzoms/ /kye ma 'di ltar ya mtshan can/ /rnal 'byor dbang mo khyod nyid la/ 'gro mgon dri med dpal ldan gyis/ /'di ltar lung yang bstan pa mdzad/ /btsun mo bzang mo gser bzang ma /don gyi rnal 'byor chen mo yin/ /po ṭa la sogs gnas chen 'grims/ /sprul pa'i snang brnyan rgyun chad med/ 'og min gnas su mngon sangs rgya/ /khyad par shar phyogs rgya nag tu/ /khyod kyi sdod grogs nges par byed/ /nub phyogs o rgyan yul du dang / /bod yul rnams su yang grogs byed/ /lho phyogs zi ta'i yul de ru/ /yang yang 'byung zhing 'gro don 'phel/ /dza le rar skye ba len/ /ma thongs snyigs ma'i snyigs ma ru /'di nas byang phyogs bod yul lho/ /mon zhes bya bar khyodasprul gyis/ /zla ba bdag gi grogs byed cing /dpal ldan bla ma yab sras kyis/ /de skad khyod la lung bstan no/ /de ni 'gro rdon lho phyogs su/ /'phel na gshegs nas slar yang 'dir/ /myur du mjal ba'i smon lam 'tshal/ zhes gsungs so/ de nas slob dpon sangardo sdus

'dzin la sogs pa ngang yang phan tshun 'brel ba'i bka' mchid mdzad de slar lho phyogs su rdzu 'phrul gyis gshegs so/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po yab yum gyis lung bstan cing dge 3dun rnams kyis shing rtar gdan drangs pa dang rgyal bu rdzun ma pham par mdzad cing gser zlo/ngapa ṭ+wāṃ dang slar mjal ba sogs 'thor bu sna tshogs kyi skabs te cu da ni rang rang gdul bya rnams la tshigs bcad glu dbyangs su bsdeb pa rgya mtsho lta bu zhig yid pa'i nang nas cung zad tsam zhig spros par bya'o/ de yang byi'u nyid der bzhugs pa'i tshe rim gyis bya tshogs 'dus te mthar bya tshogs stong phrag lnga la nye bar gyur cing / ri dwags kyang brgya phrag la nye ba la chos gsungs so/ lhag par nags der seng ge zhig la chos bstan pas 'tshe sems dang bral zhing shin tu dul bar gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' dung 'gro'i tshul bstan pa'i glang chen zhig kyang yod do/ der yul de'i rngon pa zhig byung ste ri dwags du ma zhig bsad/ bya tshogs rnams kyang phyogs bcur stor te re zhig la thams cad ma 'dzom/ de nas yun ring po song nas slar 'dus pa dang / zla ba na re/ ku ku/ dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum /byi'u'i gtsug gi rgyan du bzhugs/ /mi lus rin chen thob na yang /dam pa kun gyis dmod pa'i gnas/ /sdig pa/ sdus ngan 'di ltar gsog /zhin tu yid kyang skyo bar gyur/ /

'azigs rung na po'i bzhin bsdus nas/ /no ngar ldan pa'i mda' mtsho gyis/ /yang yang drin gyis bskyangs byas pa'i/ /mar gyur nyes med ri dwags tshogs/ /gces shing 'phangs pa'i srog dang phral/ /sdug bsngal skyed cing chos shes med/ /spyad pas tshims pa med pa yi/ /zas dang pags pa'i ched tsam du/ /gces shing 'phangs pa'i srog dang phral/ /rang la tsher ma'i zugs rngu yang / /skad cing tsa ci nga mi bzod la /pha rol rnams la 'di ltar 'tshe/ /kye ma thu / r+sā+o snying stobs che/ /da lta cung zad bkres pa yi/ nyam thag sdus bsngal mi bzod ces/ /nag po'i las ngan 'di ltar bsgrubs/ /dgun gyi nyi ma tsha bo zhes/ /'bar ba'i me nang ma zhugs sam/ sngon tshe rnam dkar dge bsags pas/ /da lta mi yi lus gyur kyang / /snying rje med cing sred pa che/ /khro gtam ldan pa 'di lta bu/ /bskal pa bskal pa du mar yang / mnar med pa las thar 'gyur ram/ /blo gros ldan yang mi dge'i rgyu/ /stobs dang ldan yang sdig pa'i dpung / /'di lnga'i mi yi lus nyid las/ /shing 'bras za zhing chab gtsang btung / /gsog 'jog med cing gzhan mnar med/ /dud 'gro'i lus su gyur na yang / /rang re skal pa bzang snyam bgyid/ /'di nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /'di lta'i sdig pa can nyid du/ /mi 'gyur nga yi smon lam 'tshal/ zhes gsungs so/ de nas ri dgas rnams la yang smon 'dun rtse 1//ga

mdzang do/ yang grogs po dga' ba'i mdongs tha bya ba'i rma bya zhig yod pa/ glo bur nyid du zla ba la mgo bos gtugs te shi ba'i tshe 'di ltar gsungs so/ ku ku/ rje bla ma rin chen dkon mchog gsum/ dus rtag tu snying dbus gur khang du/ skad cig kyang 'bral med brtan bzhubs nas/ /'jigs rung gi g.yang sa che las skyobs/ /kye ma ho 'jig rten chos nyid 'di/ /skad cig kyang mi rtag nam mkha'i glog /dus da lta grogs po'i tshul la stos/ /zla ba khyod mno bsam nang du slog /'di rang steng 'bab pa ma shes sam/ /'di khyod la myur du 'bab bo zhes/ /mngon sum du bstan pa ma rga 'am/ mig cer rer bltas kyang long ba khyod/ /rna krong nger nyan kyang 'on pa khyod/ /yid gyig ger gnas kyang bem po khyod/ /tshul 'di 'dra'i snang tshul ma go'am/ /spyir la nyon dbang gis skyed pa'i/ /lus 'chi bdag gi dgra bo'i gcan 'phrang du/ /nges par du 'gro ba 'khor ba'i gshis/ /da de yang skad cig bzhol med par/ /chu 'bab chu drag po'i rgyun bzhin du/ /slar zlog pa med par myur bar 'gro/ /dgra de yang mi ring gam na yod/ /tshe phal cher don med ngang du 'das/ /bya mgrin sngon zla ba lto dang bcas/ /grogs 'di yi snang tshul stos mdzod la/ /dpal na 'chi'i rgud sel dam pa'i chos/ /da long yod ma byed tshul bzhin sgrubs/ /khyod phyi nas rim gyis bzhol ba ni/ brdi/ 8rtags 'dzin 'gong po'i bslu brid yin/ lus shin tu nyam

chung chu spur 'dra/ /dus da lta 'joms par gdon mi za/ tshe ji tsam thob par shes pa'i gdengs/ /de yod na cung zad sla mod kyang / /khyod gdengs med bzhin du 'jigs med pa/ /'di khyod snying rdo rje ma lags sam/ /grogs da lta yod pa da lta shi/ /chos 'di 'dra myur du khyod la yod/ /'di go 'am khu byug mgrin sngon zla//yid bsgrim ste dam chos bya ba ran/ /nags 'du 'dzi'i skye bos dben pa'i khrod/ /da rang gzhan don sgrub dus la babs/ zhes gsungs pas/ bya rna sa kyang 'chi bar 'jigs nas chos la bskul ba'i grogs su gyur to/ yang gnas der chos kyi bdud rtsi bstsal zhing bzhugs pa'i tshe/ hor pazhes bgyi b.ri bya 'jigs su rub ba zhig gis zla ba 'khor bcas la nyin re bzhen du/ zhin tu 'tshe bar byas shing chos bstan pa ni/ go bar gyur pa'i tshe/ zla bas ngas chos go bar dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba btab pa dang / kho rang gi las kyi dbang gis bag chags sad par brten/ /zla ba'i slob ma byi'u zhig yod pa khyer te rang gi tshang du 'phur ro/ des kyang de gsod par brtsams pas byi'us dkon mchog la skyabs 'gro byas pas kho'i mchu dang sbar mo sogs stobs chung bar gyur te sdug bsngal ba'i tshe skye ba dran cing smra shes par gyur te byi'u la smras pa/ nga ni gnod sbyin nag po lcaṭa kyi lan 'phren can zhes bya ba'i skye ba yin pas/ sngar su dang thug na'ang pham par byed nus/ mkha' lding chen po da 97ga

sprul 'jiṭa su rung ba ngas bsgral pa yin kyang /cad lta bu gzug chung la shed chung ba 'di'i lus nga'i rdo je 'i mchu sder gyis cung zad kyang mi gnod pa ci yi na di pa la byi'u rī /— / pa/ de ni bdag pa bzhes gnyen mgri na sngon zla ba zhes bya ba gdu rī/ dang / sangs rgyari kyi 'dzin zhes gnyis yo da pa mthu stobs la mnga' brnyes pa de'i mthu yin smras pas/ 'o na de gnyis da lta gang du yod nga yang blta dgos zer ba dang / byi'u dang lhan cig tu zla ba'i drung du lhags nas bya tshogs rnams khros su dogs te thog mar byi'u btang nas gtam smras te/ de nas zla ba'i drung du khrid pas/ zla ba'i zhal nas/ kye kye nyon dang mthu rdo bas can/ mkha sgyu lding drag po sdig can khyod/ de ring gnas 'dir lhags pa ci/ /khyod kyi spyod pa ngan pa'i gzugs/ /bdag cag yid la 'jigs pa byin/ /sdug bsngal 'jigs rung byin pa 'di/ /sa bon mngar bas 'bras bu mngar/ /sa bon tsha ba rnams las ni/ 'bras bu tsha ba smin pa bzhin/ /'di yi rnam smin 'jigs par 'gyur/ /khyod la 'jigs pa skyed 'gyur te/ /khyod kyang sngon tshe byang phyogs kyi/ /mi ma rin gyi rgyal khams su/ /gnod sbyin lcags kyi lan 'phren can/ /dug gsum bag med la spyod che /kho bo ṛ 〉 ya gling du/ /khyi'u chung ngu zhig tu skyes/ /pha ma bkres shing na rgas gzir/ /bdag gis grong khyer chen po las/ /zas skom blangalha/ 0te gso ba la/ /khyod kyis stong gsum thams cad du/ /'gro

la gnod 'tshe'i phyir du bskor/ /nged cag pha ma dang bcas zos/ /de tshe smon lam 'di ltar btab/ /gnod sbyin 'tshe ba can 'di ni/ /skye ba 'di yi thog rol tu/ /bdag gis dam pa'i chos bstan te/ /lhan cig chos la spyod par shog /de ltar smon lam mthu smin nas/ /khyod nyid mi dge stobs che ba'i/ /sa bon smin pa'i dud 'gror skyes bdag po'i 'bras bu mchu sder rnams/ /shin tu rno zhing ngar dang ldan/ /rgyu mthun 'bras bu da lta yong / /'gro la 'tshe zhing sha khrug za/ /zhe sdong 'khrugs pa me ltar 'bar/ /smon lam mthu yis nga dang 'phrad/ /da lta'i dus kyi byi'u 'di/ /de tshe nga yi ma ru gyur//da ni gnod 'tshe ma spangs na/ /skye ba 'di yi 'og rol tu/ /sems can dmyal ba chen por skye/ /de ltar khyod kyis dran gyur tam/ zhes gsungs pas/ kho yang skye ba gsal bar dran te shin tu 'jigs nas byi'u la/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod pas bshags te/gnod 'tshe spong bar dam bcas so/ de'i tshe mgrin sngon zla bas hor pa de la chos mang du gsungs pa'i mthar lung bstan pa/ nyon dang 'jigs rung mkha' sding che/ /khyod sngon dur khrod gtum drag tu/ /srin po chen por gyur pa'i tshe/ /dge slong bde chen nag po la/ /chos kyi 'brel ba cung zad thob/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i smon la ma byas/ /de yi smon lam 'grub tu nye/ /deng 'dir smon lam nan gyis thob/ /'di 'og gangs ri'i khrod du skye/ /pha ni gnyan ༵༵ ma

spu las/ /nag po cho 'phrul shin tu che/ /ma 'ongs dri med bla ma rjes/ /khyong la dbang bskur byin yang rlobs/ zab chos bsrung ba'i bsrung mar 'gyur/ zhes lung bstan te khos smon lam drag po byas te byi'u'i srung mar 'brad do/ de nas yang bya rim gyis 'phel te la la blo sbyong /la la chos nyan cing gnas pa'i tshe/ hu lu ka zhes pa rgyal po dha ra ta'i blon po blo gros can longs spyod che ba sangs rgyas la zhin tu dad pa zhig rgyal pos chad pa bcad pas bros te nags mtha' der byung bas zla ba 'khor bcas mthong ngo / mthong nas kyang chos gsung ba thos pas shin tu dad de zla ba'i drung du 'ongs pas bya rnams ni sngar mi cher ma mthong bas 'jigs nas bros/ zla ba dang sangs rgyas 'dzin gnyis bzhugs pa la/ sangs rgyas 'dzin gyis/ mi che da nags mthar 'khyams pa'i dpa' bo khyod/ /gnas 'dir ci phyir lhags gyur skyabs ni gang / /bdag cag rnams la gnod pa bgyid min nam/ /grogs med gcan gzan gdug pas mi 'jigs sam/ gsungs pas kho ya mtshan nas/ 'di ni sprul pa zhig go snyam nas tshigs su bcas pa 'di ltar pas/ bslu med skyabs gyur dam pa rnam pa gsum/ /bsrung bar mdzod cig mgon med bdag la'o/ /sngo ljang mar gad zhun mas byugs 'dra zhing / /mdzes pa'i mgrin pa ri mo gsum gyis bkra/ /snyan pa'i gdangs kyis tshig bzang don ldan pa/ /thogs med smra khyod gnaḥ/ lha'adir ci byed thos/ /nga ni chos rgyal snye ra ta t+ta sa/ /bu ltar

ba ce bas skyangs pa'i blon yin zhing / /gnas 'dir nags khrod blta phyir 'ongs pa la/ /nga yi jo bo dkon mchog gsum yin pas/ /gcan gzan gdug par 'jigs pa'i nyam nga med/ ces smras pas/ dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum la /gus pa ldan pa'i skyes bu khyod/ /shin tu legs so skyabs gnas bzang / /bdag kyang snying nas yid rang ngo / dal 'byor rin chen rnyed dus 'dir/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs bzung nas/ /snying po len pa'i dus la babs/ zhes gsungs pas kho shin tu dad nas phyag byas te smras pa e ma de ring ya mtshan rmad du byung / /sman ljongs nags khrod rab tu mdzes pa 'dir/ sprul pa'i bya dang dngos su mjal ba snye/ /khyod ni bdag gi bshes gnyen dam pa ru/ /deng 'dir smra mkhas 'dab chags rnam par shar/ blo gros rab brtsal khyim bdag kho bo ni/ /stobs 'byor rgyal po'i srid la 'gran gyur cing / /nor bu rin chen du mari bang mdzod dang / khang khyim khyu mchog zhing nor dpag med mchis/ /bu tsa chung ma 'khor 'bangs mang mchis kyang / /rgyal po'i khrims kyis dbang 'byor kun dang bral/ /rang nyid gcig phur 'brog dgon 'dir bskrad gyur/ kye ma bdag la chos nor gyis dbul bas/ /snying po len tshul tshig nyung don rgyas pa'i/ /man ngag dam pa stsol bar mdzod cig kye/ zhes zer bas zla bas kho 'dul ba'i dus la babs cing /tshe rabs thon nas 'brel ba'i 'a sa yod par mkhyen nas/ gnad 203

badros kyi gdams pa 'di gsungs so/ snang ba mtha' yas dri rlud rje/ /yab sras phyag 'tshal khyod drin las/ /rang blos ji ltar zin pa zhig /blo ldan 'di yi ngor bshad bya/ /ngos 'jam shel gyi khang logs la/ sran ma 'thor ba chags pa ltar/ /rigs drug grangs med 'di nang nas/ mir gyur pa nyid dka' ba lags/ /'di yi dbul ba tsam sel ba'i/ /yid bzhin dbyig de dkon ma yin/ /gang la brten nas go 'phang mchog /bsgrub tu rung ba'i rten 'di dkon/ /phal gyi rgya mtsho'i mthar bgrod pa'i/ /'jig rten gru de mchog min gyi/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i mthar bsgral byed/ mi yi gru 'di mchog gi mchog /zhin tu dkon pa'i rin po che/ /phyag dar khrod du song gyur nas/ /'jing bu ngal bas khur de bas/ /rnyed dka'i mi lus rin chen 'dir/ dam pa'i snying po mi len par/ /tshe 'di'i bde ba phra po'i ched/ /yongs su gtong de shin tu blun/ bskal pa bskal ba du ma ru/ /bsod nams zong gis bskrun pa 'dir /cung zad longs spyod ma bgyid na/ /de bas pham pa gzhan ci mchis/ /'di yi phan pa ma bsgrubs na/ /phyis na 'di 'dra rnyed min te/ /bdag gi bsod nams nyam chung zhing / /mi dge zhin tu stobs chen ldan/ /ci phyir zhi na nyon mongs 'dis/ /rtag tu bdag nyid bran du bkol/ /dge la nam yang ma sbyar zhing / /mi dge bar ma chad du bcug /dge ba /sdus chen mi ldan na/ /'gro ba ngan nas ngan par 'khor/ /bde

'gro nam yang yod min na/ /dal pa'i rten lta ci zhig sbos/ /snying po gang gis len ce na/ /rgyu med par yang 'gro la brtse/ /gzhan don kho na'i dgongs pa can/ /zhi ba ston cing zhi la sbyor/ ston pa sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin/ /de yi bstan las gtso bo dang / /phal pa'i don gnyis bstan gyur cing / /gtso bo dam pa nges legs ni/ ston pa khyod mkhyen gzhan gyis min/ /khyod kyis ji snyed ci ga gsungs kyang / /mthar thug ye shes rgya mtshor 'jug /sna tshogs mos par thub khyod kyis/ /brtse ba'i ma yis bu la bzhin/ /gdul bya bkra la mkhas mdzad de/ /dman 'bring mchog gi theg pa bstan/ /mthar thug don yang mi rdzogs la/ ma rnams don las phyir phyogs shing / /go 'phang mchog la ring byed phyir/ /theg pa gzhan gnyis btang nas su/ /blo ldan rig dang ldan pa yis/ /mchog gyur theg pa 'dir 'jug rigs/ /sems kyi khyad par rin po che/ /gzhan gyi don du rdzogs byang 'dod/ /byang chub smon dang 'jug sems ca ju / /khyod nyid nam zhig rnyed gyur tshe gyis par gyur kyang rgya sras te/ /dgra bcoms lhun po lta bu yang / /rigs kyi smo tsurdo sgon/ /sdig pa'i mun pa mi bzad pa /'dom la tsho byedabazhin/ /khyod dang ldan pa tsam gyis ni/ /bde ba/be mi ri pe bsngags pa'i yul/ /lha mi kun gyis phyag byar 'os/ /khyo nga bul na yon tan ba/zhag / /ldan yang theg pa chen po min/ /khyod dang ldan na gzhan bral ༵༵ / /

byang chub sems dang 3 zhes su brjod /sems can 'di thag thams cad la bde ba ster bas rin po che/ /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /bskrun spror mdzad pa'i sa bon lags/ /khyod zhus yongs su ma bzung ba'i /dge rtsa bskal pa stong bsags kyang / /bla med pyang chub der mi 'gro/ /khyod dang ldan pa'i dud 'gro la/ /kham gcig bstsal ba'i dge ba yang / rgyal sras spyod pa zhes bya sta/ /bsod nams nam mkha'i pha mthar khyab/ /se sa spyo sdong po 'di med na/ /rlabs chen spyod rnga'i yal gamed/ /de phyir blo gros ldan pa yis/ /nyin mtshan du ni 'di skyed bya/ /smon lam yang ni 'di phyir gdab/ /dge ba de skyed phyir du bsags /bdag la de lta'i sems skyes pa /nam zhig 'gyur snyam rtag tu dran/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rten bkrams te/ /ci 'byor pa yi mchod pa ni/ /'byor ldan gyur na nges par bya/ /gal te yo byad med gyur na/ /dge ba can gyis mos pas bya/ /til gyi gang bu lta bu yi/ /ston pa chos dang tshogs kyi mchog /mkha' dbyings gang ba de dmigs te/ /lus dang ngag yid dang bas 'dud/ /me tog la sogs mchod pa 'bul/ /kha na ma tho med pa yis/ /mchod pa'i yo byad du ma dang / /gling dang gling phran blo yis dbul/ /dug gsum dra / pos kun slangs pa'i/ /rnam smin bsam yas bskyes pa'i sdig /bsam pas gnong zhing 'gyod bya snye/ /rgya/ ༵ rnams kyi spyan sngar bsgrags/ /rang gzhan dge la dga' ba

bsgom/ /phyog bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad du/ mya ngan 'da' bzhed rgyal ba rnams/ /'khor ba ma stong bar bzhugs nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /bdag gis dge rtsa ci bsags pa/ /bla med byang chub phyir du bsngo/ /de dag rnam sa kyi spyan snga ru/ byang chub ba ma pa brtan pos bzung / /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa yang / snying rje che la rag las te/ /byams pa snying rje'i rgyu bral la/ /sems ni 'bras bu mi srid ces/ /byang chub sems bskyed 'dod gyur na/ /dpa' pos dang por snying rje sgoms/ /sdug bsngal bral bar 'dod pa yang / /sdug bsngal mthong la rag las phyir/ /dang por rang nyid sdug bsngal che/ /myong ba'i tshul ni bsam bya ste/ phyis nas ma rnams la yang ngo / /gang gi gti mug 'dis bskyed pa'i/ /rtsa ba'i phra rgyas drug byung zhing / /de las shin tu mang bar gyur/ /de yi dbang gis bsags gyur pa'i/ /las ni rnam pa gsum po yis/ /khams gsum 'di na yongs su 'khor/ 'og ma la ni las bdun dang /yid kyi gsum po bsod nams min/ /de spong pa yi las sogs la/ /bsod nams rnam dkar zhes su bya/ /srog gcad sogs las 'phangs pa'i las/ /'bral bu ngan 'gro gsum thob snye/ /che/mas can dmyal ba 'jigs rung ba/ /de ma thug bsngal mthong lta ci/ /dran pa tsam gyis 'du shes ldan na/ /de snying 'gas la cis mi thug /yang sos balhas 'joms ngu //sbyad

dang / /thig nag rab cha mnar med sogs/ /tsha ba chen so brgyad rnams su/ /lcags kyi ri bo'i 'phrul 'khor du/ /sems can kha cig til bzhin 'chir/ /lcags kyi sta re sog le dang / /ral gri shin tu no sogs kyis /phan tshun dag gam dmyal srung gis/ /bar mtshams med par gcod cing gzhag /phye ma zhib mor gtub par 'gyur/ /la la khro chu'i khu ba ni/ /me 'bar 'khrug pa dbang med sdud/ /lus kun 'tshig cing dum bur 'gyur/ /gzhan dag lcags bsregs gsal shing ni/ /lcags bsregs tsher ma non po yis/ /zhabs sngo spyi bo'i bar du phug gas kyi khang pa sgo med nang / /me yis bsreg cing ngu 'bod 'don/ /lcags kyi khro zang 'bar ba nyid/ /'gyur byed khol ma'i gang bar 'tshod/ /keng rus su 'gyur nyid cing sgre/ /la la phyogs bcu nas 'ongs mes/ /lus dang dbyer med 'bar gyur te/ /shin tu nyam thag sgar gyis ni/ /sems can dag tu dpog par 'gyur/ de yi nye 'khor nyid du yang / /mi gtsang dri ngan 'dam tshan du/ /mchu non 'bu yis thal byung 'phag /las kyi ral gri snan po yis/ /yan lag nying lag khrig khrig gtub/ /lcags kyi mchu srin mche ba sogs/ rab rnon bya khyis —'thog cing 'dru/ /lcags kyi sdong po lcags tsher can/ /las kyi dbang gis 'dzeg cing babs/ /shin tu che ba'i chu nang du/ /'tshodacing 'i/8na tu tsha bar myong / /bshig gcod sems dmyal de dag tu/ /

khrig gi chu klung cher babang pas/ /khrug ge/ rgya rnga — ri ( sa kha d+dha gang / /bsreg pa'i dmyal ba de dag tu/ /gsur gyo dud pa sprin ltar 'khrigs/ /mar tshir sgra yi zi ber g.yo /'tshad pa'i dmyal ba de dag tu/ /rlangs pas steng gi nam mkhar khyab/ /de dag kun tu rgyob gsod dang 7 /kye ma kye hud ngu 'bod sgro/ /'brug sgra bye ba dus gcig tu/ /sgrog pa ji bzhin shin tu che/ /shin tu bkres shing skom gyur te/ /zas skom sgra yang thos mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin a chu kye hud sogs/ /shin tu grang ba'i dmyal ba ni/ /gangs kyi ri bos yongs bskor ba'i/ /'khyags pa'i bas rnamatha kun tu tshud/ /lus la bu yug lhags pa yis/ /rgyun chad med par bsi'/ bsil 'debs/ /a chu kye hud zhes 'bod cing / /kha cig skad gdangs mi thon par/ /so ni tham tham byed cing gnas/ /lus ni kha bcu kha brgyad dang / /kha ni grangs med gas gyur te/ /lus kye ser kha nas byung ba'i/ /rlung ni snying la 'phog par 'gyur/ /ba spu gzings shing bskum bskum 'dug /khrag dang chu ser 'dzag 'gyur cing /tsha grang dmyal ba de kun hūṃ/ /nyi zla bral zhing mun par gnas/ /de lta'i brnag dka'i sdug bsngal ba/ /kye ma bdag gis bzod 'gyur ram/ /sdug bsngal ji tsam myong gyur kyang / /ji srid las kyi nus ba de/ /ma zad de srid sdug bsngal ni/ /tshe lo dpag bad dag tu spyod/ /mi yi sdug bsngal gang yod kun/ /bsdus byas dmyaX 0sdu'i

:ga bsngal ni/ nyin gcig myong ba'i 'chir mi phod/ de bzhin gshin rnge'i 'jig rten la/ /zas skom bral zhing bkres pas nyen/ /gnag cing skras khebs shin tu skom/ /mgrin pa khab mig ltar phra zhing / /sto ba ri yi tshad tsam che/— 'jag ma lta bu'i yan lag gis /sto ba mi theg dgyel zhing g.yob/ /kha cig zas skom gang thos 'bar/ /kha dang mgrin pa sto ba 'tshig /chu sogs mthong nas drung phyin tshe/ /rnag khrug dri ngar mthong bar 'gyur/ /yang na 'jigs rung gdong brnyan can/ mtshon cha thogs pas bskor mthong nas/ phyin tshe rdul phran bzhin du brlags/ /kha cig phan tshun tshogs gyur te/ lus las byung ba'i rnag khrug btung /yang na rang sha bcad de za/ las kyi bcom pa 'ga' zhig gis/ /lud pa phyi sa gcin la sogs/ /mi gtsang pa yang mi rnyed de/ /cung zad rnyed rgang ches mang pos rngams nas khas gzhan rnams kyis ni/ /rdul tsam mi thob sems nyams 'gyur/ /grang bas nyen la nyi ma yang / /char rlung lha bur bsil ba dang / tsha la zla ba nyid kyang ni/ /'bar ba'i me ltar shin tu bsregs/ /ljon shing myu gu rtswa ni'u gseng / /char rgyun bzang po sogs kyang des/ /sdong dub skam dang tsher ma dang / /gyo mo grog po skam po dang /bu yug 'tshub ma sogs su mthong / /'di yang 'phen byed mi dge ba'i /nus pa ma rdzogs de srid myong / /dud 'groḥ sdunas la nges med phyir/ /bde sdug mnyam per mi 'gyur yang /

phal cher sa yi 'og na ma chis/ rab tu gnag pa'i mun pa'i khung / /nyi zla'i sgra yang mi thos par/ /shin tu dog cing btsor te gnas/ /las ngan can de'i zus la yang / /rnon po'i mchu can srin bu sogs/ /grangs med du mas phug cing za/ /dud 'gro rnams ni phal mo che/ /gcigagis gcig la zas su mthong / /rtag rtu mtha' rtsod las la spyod/ /gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa 'ba' zhig 'chang / /shes rab mig dang mi ldan pas /'ga' zhig rang gi pha ma za phan pa rnams la gnod par blta/ /gnod byed rnams la lhag par dga'/ /bye brag lha mi'i yo byad rnams/ /rang dbang cung zad tsam yang med /bcings gzir rdeg cing 'dod pa dang / bkol zhing rmo dang bzho ba dang / /spu rigs sha dang pags sogs ched/ /srog dang dbang med phral bar 'gyur/ /chu gnas rnams ni nges med gnas/ /chu dang gram khrod la sogs la/ /yang nas yang du 'pho 'gyur zhing / /mtshan than pas thug bsngal 'gyur /ri dgas rnams ni rngon pa dang / gcan ga na gdug pa'i 'jigs pa yis rtag tu yid ni mi phebs shing / /8 grang la sogs sdug bsngal bskyed/ /dper na bdag sogs bya rnams la /myong ba'i sdug bsngal 'di ltar mching /bsagaci / pa'i longs spyod mi mnga' bas /zas skom 'byung ba'i 'gyur ldog la/ rag las 'tshol 'gro'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /shing tog lo tog ljon shing bzang /dus kyis rgyud par gyur pa'i tshe/ /rgyal po'i bang mdzod stor ba /snyi/ /

hor pa gir pi khyi 5 sogs/ /gnod par byed pa'i dgra mang bas/ skyilus kyang rang nyid mi/ dbang bar /gzhan gyi zas su 'gyur ba dang / / shal te smi/nod byed med gyur kyang / yid kyi the tshom mtha' yal pas/ /'jigs pa yo re blo mi bde/ dga' zhing 'dun pa'i gnyen grogs rnams/ glo bur dgra yis stor gyur tshe/ /yun ring bar du mi 'phrad cing / /phan tshun dran nas brtse bas gdung / /skad kyis 'bod cing phyogs bcur 'tshol/ /shin tu rmongs pa'i rang bzhin can/ /blang dor mig bu dang bral bas/ /mi dge spyod cing dge ba spangs/ /dam chos smra ba'i skad mi go/ /tshig tsam go yang don mi shes/ /kye ma bde ba skad cig med/ /mtho ris lha yi 'jig rten na/ /'dod lha'i rigs gyur de dag ni/ /'dod cing chags pa'i the yis ni/ /rang dbang med par chad med bsregs /dga' mgur spyod la rtag g.yengs bas/ dam chos spyod par mi khom zhing / /stobs che 'byor ldan mdzes rnams kyis/ /stobs chung 'byor med mi mdzes rnams/ /gzhan du sprug cing sba bkod dang / /phag dog sdug bsngal bskyed par byed/ /gzhan dang g.yul gyi las bskyed tshe/ /mgo dang yan lag bcad pa dang / /dral cing gcod pa'i sdug bsngal thob/ /yun ring zag bde spyod pa'i mthar/ /tshe yi 'phen pa rdzogs pa'i tshe/ /byis pa de dag phal mo che/ /snang nas mun par 'gro gyu/ ༵/ /yid la brjod dka'i lhag bsngal thob/ /rgyan rnying lus

las brtul 'byung zhing / /ston la mi dga' mdza' rnams kyang / /de dang nye bar 'ongs mi 'gyur/ /lha yi khang bzang skyed mos tshal yid 'ong lha yi bu rnams dang / /rab mdzes lta na sdug pa yi/ /lha mo rnams kyi nang na ni/ /rang nyid gcig pu 'gro mthong ste/ /yid la bzod da 'i mya ngan thob/ /gang du skye 'gyur gnas kyang mthong / gal te mnar med sog log par/ /lhung 'gyur de yis mthong ba na/ /lus ni sa la 'dre ldog cing / /ngu zhing mdza' bshes ming nas 'bod/ zas skom spyod pa'i 'du shes bral /de yi grogs su gyur rnams kyang / /kye ma 'di ni mun par 'gro/ /ji ltar bya zhes mya ngan byed /las ngan can te 'phos gyur te/ /nyag phran 'phangs ltar dmyal bar 'gro/ /gong ma rnams ni ting 'dzin gyis/ /bde ba'i ro la spyod byed cing /sdug bsngal drag po mi myong yang /mkha'al 'phur ba'i 'dab bzang ni/ /gshog rtsal ji tsam che gyur kyang / /slar yang sa la lhang ba ltar /bdag tu blta bas rab bcings shing 'du byed sdug bsngal can 'di ni/ /nam zhig las kyi mthu zad nas/ /thur du bltas te rog par 'gro/ slar yang sdug bsnga bsam yas myong / bde la spyod pa goms gyur nas/ /ngan 'gro'i snasdug bsngal myong pa'i tshe /sngon gnas dran sosas gyur pa na/ /'khor 'os bsgyur ba'i rgyal po ni /'bangs kyi tha shal la babs ltar/ tsa ga bsngal lhag ma thob par 'gyur/ /khyad par mi rnams la /rdo

ni/ /'pho snang 'thab rtsod glen rmongs dang /bgres skom tsha grang la sogs pa/ /rigs gzhan myong bya'i thug bsngal kun /cha 'dra tsam re myong bas gnod/ /mthon po rgyud par dogs nas sdug dbul po zas kyis 'phongs pas sdug /'ga' zhig lang tsho ngan pas sdug /rje rnams 'bangs kyis rgol du dogs/ 'bangs rnams rje yis dbang gyur pas/ /sgrag kyang rang nyid mi dbang bar/ /dka' ba brgya phrag du ma spyod/ /khyim thab pho mor gyur rnams ni/ /tshong dang so nam rku 'jab sogs/ /srog dang longs spyod brje bar byed/ /longs spyod ji tsam thob gyur kyang skyi /chog shes med par sdug bsngag 'tshol /khyim thab ngan pa phal mo che/ /rtag tu phan tshun khong khro zhing / /dgra ltar 'thab cing rtsod na yang / /sngon gyi las 'brel dra ba yis /rang dbang med par 'ching bar byed/ /longs spyod dpal 'byor yon tan sogs/ /rang las mtho la phrag dog byed /yid la sdug bsngal zug rngu skye/ /nam zhig mnyam par gyur cing snyam/ /rang dang mnyam la mtho dogs skyes/ /g.yo sgyu'i bya bas pham thabs byed/ /rang las cung zad phun tshogs kyang / /yid la mi dga' chen po skyes/ /sngon nas bsod nams ma bsags na/ /'dod pa btsal kyang mi rnyed de/ /thabs mkhas bya ba byas na yang / /rang gis rang mgo bcom pa bzhin/ /las kyis mi chugs gnas med snyi//14 /sngon gyi las ngan 'bras smin pas/ /thug bsngal bros kyang mi

thar te/ /mi 'dod thog tu 'bab par 'gyur /rang nyid longs spyod stobs ldan tshe/ /ldang zhugs kyis khyab 'dud na yang / /rang nyid las kyis rgud pa'i tshe/ /bu sdug yin kyang sdang zhing gshe/ 2mi dang mi min gdon sogs kyis/ /'tsho zhing mtha' mar srog 'phrog dang / /me chu chom rkun rgyal po sogs/ /'jigs pa du ma'i rang bzhin gyis/ /rtag tu yid la 'jigs pa ster/ /gzhan ⑫ nga sdug bsngal mtha' yas te/ /mi yi sdug bsngal de dag ni/ /blo ldan khyod kyis mthong chos su/ ci rigs mthong bar gyur de'o/ /gzhan yang 'khor ba 'di dag la /skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal gyi/ /mtshams med yongs su gzir ba sti/ /rdzus te skye sogs skye ba yi/ /sdug bsngal shugs drag mi myong yang / /mngal dang spo nga las skyes la/ /skye ba'i sdug bsngal dpag med myong / /sems can mngal las byung ba rnams/ /mngal gyi mi gtsang 'dam rdzab tu/ /pha ma'i khu khrug thig le'i dbus/ /rnam par shes pa zhugs gyur nas/ /mer mer po yi skabs sogs nas/ /ji srid phyi ru btsas kyi bar /zhin tu dog pa'i bum pa ni/ /mi gtsang du mas bkang pa'i dbus/ /bcug pa dang 'dra'i chor ba myang / /de yi grib dang sgrib pa yis/ /dran pa'ang yongs su gtor ba bzhin/ mi yi spyod lam sna tshogs kyi/ /sdug bsngal rnam pa du mas gzir/ /phyi ru btsa' ba'i tshe na yang / /'jam pa'i gos kyang tsher ma ltar/ /reg bya mi bzod myong sogs te /du sa dpa/1 byed

brjod mi langs /de ltar skye ba'i sdug bsngal mthar/ /byis dang gzhon nu dar bab dang /dar ma dar las yal ba yi/ gnas skabs ldan ni rmi lam dang / /glog dang ston sprin lta bu ste/ /de nas myur du rga ba yi/ /pho nyas yongs su zin par 'gyur/ /de yi sdug bsngal 'di lta ste/ rgyags shing gzhon dregs lang tshos sgeg /stobasartsal shugs ldan lus bzang yang rab bsil ba mos reg pa yi/ /chu skyes gzhon nu lta bur rnying / /nyams dman dbang chung zhum zhing skyo/ /dkar ba'i bzhin dang so 'phreng sogs/ /gnag cing mi sdug gras nas 'thor/ /gnag pa/'i 0skra dang sor mo sogs/ /gyur nas dkar zhing kun tu byi/ /dbang po mi gsal 'thib cing mnon/ /gal te 'dug rnga 'i spyod lam las/ /ldang bar mi nus de bzhin du/ /ldang nas 'dug pa'ang dka' bar 'gyur/ /zas sogs 'dod yon bzang po la/ spyod par mi nus bkres pas gzir/ gzi brjid brtson 'grus mdangs kun nyams/ drang po'i gelus kyang gzhu ltar gug /smra ba'i ngag kyang sdib cing 'chal/ /gsal ba'i dran pa rmongs shing nyams/ gzhon pa'i tshogs kyi brnyas shing co/ /mi yi gral nas yongs bud 'dra/ de 'dra'i rga ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ /brjod mi langs pas mnar bar 'gyur/ /de ltar rgas sam gzhon nu rung / /'chi ba'i zhags pa nad rnams kyis/ /srog 'phrog byed cing nyams byed de/ 'di lta/ ༵nga ma khris bad kun las/ gyur pa bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad/ /

khams bzhi 'khrug las kun nas ldang / /sdug bsngal yid mi bde tshogs kyis/ /rtag tu bar mtshams med par gzir/ /sha skam mdangs dang gzi brjid 'phrog /'byung po ma rung du mas kyang / /nad can de la lhag par 'tshe/ yid bab longs spyod mi nus zhing / /mi 'dod bzhin yang rtsub sbyor bstan/ /gal te de 'dra'i nyams nga de/ /tshe zad pa'am rkyen ngan gyis /'tsho bar mi nus 'chi mthong na/ /de tshe rang dang rang nyid kyis/ /'phangs shing sdug pa'i skye bo kun/ /mya ngan smre ngag yid mi bde/ /rgyas shing gdung ba dpag med byed/ /gal te sdig can de la ni /'gyod cing gdung bas kun tu gzir/ /g.yang sa mun nag mun khung du/ 'jigs rung srog chags snang ba 'char/ /mig gyig yan lag g.yob cing 'bod/ /nyam thag de ni skyabs dang bral/ 'khor gnyen longs spyod ci yod kyang / /bor te rang nyid gcig pur 'gro/ 'di yang mtshon tsam nyid phyir te/ /gal te 'gro ba las dbang gis/ /me chu g.yang sa mtshon cha sogs/ /gri ru gum dang gdug can gyis/ /thos sogs na 'chi'i sdug bsngal kyang / /blo ldan khyod kyis rtogs pa ltar/ /'dir ni brjed par ga la langs/ /mdor na sdug bsngal rnam rigasum gyis/ /khams gsum 'ardo dag rtag tu bzung /ji srid las dang nyon mongs dpe/ /gzhan gyi dbang gis nyer len pa/ /yongs su zad par ma gyur bar/ /de srid khams gsum 'khor ba 'dir/ /zo chun 'phrul 'khor ltar 'khor teḥ/17 /

sdug bsngal mtha' yas myong ba'i tshul/ /yang dang yang du yid la bsam/ de ltar sdug bsngal cung zad rgyas bshad la/ /dgos pa dpag med khyod kyis rtogs bya ste/ /gal te duḥ khas yongs su ma skyo bar/ /bdag tu lta ba sun dbyung ji ltar 'dod/ /'di nyid rtsa bcas spang par ma byas par/ /nges par 'byung ba dam pa ga la 'gyur/ /gang zag dman rnams ngan 'gros yongs skyo nas /mngon mtho'i dpal la 'dod pa'i blo dag kyang / /ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsam la rag las shing / /'bring rnams srid la skyo shas drag po yis//thar pa'i lam du zhugs par byed pa dang /mchog rnams rang steng ji bzhin gzhan la'ang ste/ /lam bzang skye ba'i gzhis rtsa snying rje'i rten/ 'di nyid nges phyir dang por sdug bden bstan/ /tshul des yang yang yid ni gdung byas pas/ /blon po rang nyid ji ltar 'jigs pa bzhin/ /'gro ba rnams la'ang de dag thams cad ni/ /bdag gi pha mar gyur tshul nges shes drangs/ /yid 'ongs 'phangs shing sdug pa'i sems can rnams/ sdug bsngal rang bzhin 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /sgrol pa'i lhag bsam khur chen bdag gis khyer de ltar ma lus don kun rdzogs mdzad pa/ /yang dog rdzogs sangs rgyas las gzhan mi dmigs//de phyir de yi go 'phangs yong thob pa'i/ /dam bca' brtan pos byang chub smon pa'i sems/ /bskyed nas dkar phyogs zla ltar gong du the//1 /de nas byang chub dam par rab chas nas/ /rlabs chen rgyal

ba'i sras kyi spyod pa'i tshogs/ /nyams pa med par tshul bzhin gom sa par mdzod/ /ser sna med cing re ba yongs bral bas/ /chos nor srog sogs 'gro la gtong ba'i sems/ /gong du spel bas don gnyis mtha' yas/ 'grub /de phyir dpa' bos sbyin la brtson par mdzod/ legs tshogs kun gyi rtsa lag tshul khrims nor/ /ngan 'gror mi gtong phan bde'i 'bras bu 'byin/ /thar 'dod yongs kyi bslab pa'i gzhi gcig pu/ /de phyir dpa' bos tshul khrims bsrung bar mdzod/ /thob zin dge bsrung ma thob dge ba bskyed/ /nyon mongs dpung 'joms 'di phyi kun tu bde/ /bzod mchog go cha rgyal sras rnams kyis sten/ /de phyir dpa' bos brjod la goms par mdzod/ /ngan zhen spong zhing rlabs chen snying stobs bskyed/ /lam bzang nam yang mi 'dod bde chen 'dren/ /rgyal sras spyod pa kun gyi grogs gcig pu/ /de phyir dpa' bos brtson pa spel bar mdzod /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i yon tan tshogs/ /ji snyed rnams kyi rten gyur bsam gtan mchog /gnas ngan len gyi 'ching ba kun spong ba/ /dpa' bos ting 'dzin tshul bzhin brten par 'tshal/ /shes rab lta ngan mun sol sgron me ste/ phyin drug lam bzang gzhan gyi mig ltar 'gyur/ /'khrul pa rtsadagacod rnam grol ye shes stsol /dpa' bos shes rab tshul bzhin slob par rigs/ /mdor na byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ /rlabs chen spyod pa ji snyed bka' bstsal kun/ /bslab pa gsum mam /1 /la

phyin pa drug /tshul khrims gsum du 'du bar mkhyen mdzod la/ / bas dang shes rab zung 'jug ma bral bar/ /kun mkhyen go 'phang 'bad pas sgrub par mdzod/ /bdag gi byang chub spyod kun dmigs med spyod /de las gyur pa'i bsod nams de dag kyang / /bden par 'khrul pa'i 'gro ba'i tshogs bcas pa/ /bla med byang chub thob phyir brjo bar mdzod/ /bdag ni dud 'gro'i rten du gyur pas na/ /rgyal po'i sde snod slob pa'i skal bas dben/ /khyod ni mir gyur rang dbang 'byor dus 'dir/ /kun mkhyen thub pa'i gsung rab thos bgyis la/ /thos don bsam dang tshul bzhin goms pa yis/ /shes bya'i gnas la blo gros rgyas par mdzod/ /kho bos mis 'di rjod byed dman gyur kyang / /bshes gnyen dam pa du ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /thub pa'i lugs bzang cung zad mthong gyur pa/ /rang gi yid la byas nas bshad pa'i phyir/ /brjod bya bzang po nyid du rigs mdzod la/ /spro ba'i yid kyi nyams su len par gsol/ zhes gsungs pas zhin tu dga' zhing yid ches nas zla bas bstan pa ltar dang / gzhan yang paṇa chen du ma las chos nyan zhing bsgoms pa rgyud yongasasu smin par gyur to/zhal gtam 'di lta bu du ma yod kyang / 'di nyid yongs rdzogs bkod pa ni/ 'dir mkho che ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rnam bzhag cung zad rgyas shing go sla bar snang bas na bkod do/ de nas de'i nub phyogs kyi naXsdu /la yid du 'ong ba zhig tu phebs pas/ grong khyer rdo 'jog

tu bram ze'i rigs las 'khrungs pa rten dge bsnyen/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyangs pa'i nang pa'i paṇ+ḍa ta ju na smri ti zhes bya ba gcig dben pa bsten te ri /nas der rtswa'i spyil bur bzhugs 'dug pa dang mjal phan tshun chos kyi gtam gleng bas/ pazlo ta de yang shin tu ngo mtshar zhing dad de chos mang du nyan te de na re/ kye ma sngon chad bdag gis mkhas dang grub pa chen po rnams las kyang chos nyan par bgyis/ sems par bgyis kyang / tshig gi rim pa brjod bya rgyas pa/ 'jebs pa/ skyon dang bral ba/ 'di dag las mchog tu gyur pa dag thos mod kyi/ bdag gi blo 'dul ba la 'di las phan pa rmad du byung ba 'di lta bu ma byung na/ /bdag tshe rabs du mar khyod kyis rjes su bzung / brtse bar mdzad/ rjes su brtse bar mdzad pa'i las kyi nus pa gdon mi za bar gnas par nges na/ deng phan chad bdag ni khyod kyi slob ma'o/ bran yin no/ khyod ni bdag gi mgon no/rje'o da kho bo byang phyogs rtswa can gyi grong dang nye bar dben pa bsten pa bgyid 'dod na/ bslab par bya ba ji ltar bgyid pa zhig stsal bar 'tshal lo zhes phyag mang du btsal te zhus pas/ zla ba'i zhal nas/gang zhig thos pas ngon dang ldan/ /sems pas ngan 'gro nges par bzlog /bsgoms pas bdud rtsi thob mdzad pa/ /sde sgod gsum la phyaga'atshal lo/ /mang du ma thos rmong shing brtul/ /bdag gis khyed 'dra'i mkhas pa la/ /gsol bar 'os pa ma lags kyang / /lhag bas/lha /ga

phyir cung zad bskul/ /de yang dge la phyogs pa'i tshe/ /phyi dang nang gi bdud gnyis 'byung / /phyi yi bdad ni 'di ltar ste /sngon bdag cag ston pa yis/ /byang chub thugs bskyed nas bzung ste/ /spyod pa spyod tshe kun du yang / /ji ltar thugs bskyed bzang mdzagapar/ /de ltar sdig can bdud kyis kyang / /smon lam log par btab byung bas/ /rang re thub pa'i rjes 'jug la/ /nges par gnod 'gyur shes bya ste/ /byang chub sems dpa' dang po bar/ /ston pa la sogs gzugs bstan te/ /rim gyis sems las nyams byas nas /dman ba nyid du snang bar byed/ /tshul khri /sa tshul bzhin bsrung ba yi/ /dang po'i las can 'khor bzhi'i mdun/ /bla ma 'am grogs 'khor rgyal po sogs/ sna tshogs thabs kyi gzugs bstan te/ /'dod pas byang chub thob 'gyur gyi/ /dka' bas byang chub nam yang min/ /de phyir 'dod la ci dgar spyod /zhes smra brtul zhugs nyams par byed/ /ting 'dzin shes rab spyod la 'ang / /yid dam lha 'am ston pa'i gzugs/ /lung ston chos 'chad de nyams byed /'khor bzhin bden la dga' gyur cing / /'dod pa chung dang mchog shes la/ /grong gi bsngags pa brjod byed cing / /'du 'dzi thabs kyis sprul par byed/ /mis ni dge ba'i bya ba la/ /dang por 'jug tshe bzlog byed cing / /bar du dge las nyams par byed/ /tha mar kun tu bsgrims nas 'tsho/ mdor —na //lha dus dge blo can/ /shes rab chung ba phal mo che/ /phyi yi bdu da

kyi bran du 'gyur/ /de phyir mkhas pa rnams kyis ni/ /bsgrims te de dbang gtang mi bya/ /nang gi bdud kyang 'di lta ste/ /stobs ldan nyon mongs dgra bo 'dis/ /thog med dus nas rang re rnams/ /phung par byas shing brlags par byas/ /bde ba nam yang ma bskyed cing /sdug bsngal thams cad bsgrub par byas/ /phyi yi bdud kyi rtsa ba yang /nang bdud ma rung 'di yis byas/ /dgra dang nad 'bras zugs rngu sogs/ /mi 'dod thams cad 'di yis bskyed/ /dad dang tshul khrims bsod nams sogs/ /legs tshogs ma lus 'di yis bcom/ /sngon chad gnod cing 'dir yang gnod/ /da yang 'di dbang btang gyur tshe/ /mu mtha' med par sdug bsngal byed/ gal te 'di dgrar ma bzung bar/ /'di yi bran du byas gyur kyang / /phyi phyir shin tu gnod 'gyur ba/ /'di las tha chad gang na yod/ mdor na 'di las gnod gyur pa/ /bdag la dgra yis ma byas shing / nad kyis ma yin gdon gyis min /gshin rje 'byung po sogs kyis min/ /de phyir 'di la dgra bzung la/ /rtag tu 'joms par bya bar rigs/ /pha rol do zla'i g.yul tsam las/ /rgyal ba dpa' bo ma yin te/ /thog med bskal pa'i snga rol nas/ /de 'dra'i rgyal ba yang yang thob/ gang zhig bcom pas phyi nang dgra/ /gtan med nyid du 'joms byed pa/ /su zhig ston mongs dgra 'joms pa/ de ni dpa' bo'i dpa' bo yin/ /tshangs dang brgya byin 'khor bsgyur dang / /bsam gta/ 2/de

ba 'ga' thob kyang / /de yang bde ba ma lags te/ /de 'dra'i bde bas phan gyur na/ /yang yang thob pa bgrangs mi langs/ /gang zhig thob pas mi 'gyur zhing / /nam yang sdug bsngal bskyed min pa/ /srid pa zad pa'i bde ba ni/ /bde ba kun gyi bdag po yin/ de phyir su zhig legs 'dod na/ /nyon mongs dgra bo 'jom bya ste/ /de yang dpung bcas mang gyur kyang / /bdag tu 'dzin pa bcom gyur na/ /rtsa ba nyam pa'i ljon pa bzhin/ /sde dang bcas pa 'joms par 'gyur/ /de yi phyir na bdag med pa/ /gnyis bral dbu ma'i lam bzang gi/ /don rtog shes rab kun gyi mchog /'jig rten mgon gyi bstan las gzham /lam bzang 'di dang bral ba'i phyir/ /sgod rtse —nas kyang mnar med 'gro /lam bzang mtshon rnon 'di med par/ /ma rig dra ba ji ltar gcad/ /de phyir mkhas pas rig par bya/ /rno ngar mi ldan mtshon cha yis/ /shin tu sra ba'i dngos la bzhin/ /ting 'dzin ngar dang mi ldan pa'i/ /shes pas ma rig 'jom mi 'gyur/ /thog mar dben pa'i gnas dag tu/ /shin tu brten pa'i ting 'dzin btsal/ /dpa' bo g.yul du zhugs pa'i tshe/ /rno ngar ldan pa'i ral gri yang / /'debs byed lag dang mi ldan na/ /pha rol pham par mi nus ltar/ /ngar ldan ral gri lta bu yi/ /ting 'dzin shes rabaram gnyis kyang / /tshul khrims grogs dang mi ldan na/ /lag /ma g.yul du zhu/sdu 4pa 'dra/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi dang brten/ /tshul khrims nyid

de de la yang / /nyes sdom tshul khrims dam pa ni/ /thun mong mi dge bcu spong dang / /thun mong min pa so so thar/ /byang chub sems pa'i sde sdod sogs/ /du ma yod kyang theg gnyis kyi/ /thun mong nyid du so sor thar/ /nges 'byung bsam pas legs bskul te/ /blo gros rim pa dang mthun par/ /dge bsnyen nas ni 'o ngas rdzogs par/ /ji ltar rithos pa mig bzhin bsrungs/ /de lta 'i tshul khrims dag pa yang / sdug bden bsgoms te spyo bya zhing / /thar pa'i gtam gyis spro ba bskyed/ /yang drang yang du goms byas pas/ /dge ba gang du 'phel bar 'gyur/ 'di dag che chung theg pa gnyis/ /gang gi dbang du byas gyur kyang / /lam gyi sgom tshul spyi lus yin/ /de ste rang rang bsam pa dang / /tshed du bya dang spyod pa dang smon lam dang ni yongs bsngo sogs/ /lam gyi rnam bzhag mi 'dra bas/ /theg pa che'am theg pa dman /rang blor 'tshams pa nyams su len/ /mdor na snying por bsgril gyur na/ /phyi nang bdud gnyis g.yul dag las/ /rgyal phyir dang por bdud gnyis las/ /phyi yi bdud kyis bslu ba ni/ /rgyal ba'i gsung lus phyir phyogs pas/ /log par 'doms pa gang yin te/ /shes par byas la rjes mi 'brang / /gtso bo ma rig bdud 'bangs bcas/ /dgrar bzung dran shes mtshon cha bsten/ /de nas g.yul ni zhi bya zhing / tha mar sa bon rtsad bcad de/ /nges par g.yul las rgyal bar bya/ /nyid kyi spyod pa gang yin pa/ /dran dang shes pas /sdus

mdzod la/ /dam pa'i chos dang 'gal ba rnams/ /ca chil ma'i thal ba bzhin du dor/ /dam pa'i chos dang mthun gyur pa/ /gang yin skyes zin 'bad nas spel /ma skyes pa rnams bskyed pa'i phyir/ /brtson pa gong bzhin 'phel bar mdzod/ ces gsungs pas paṇ+ḍi ta shin tu dga' ste/ kye ma bdag ge bshes gnyen zla ba chen pos ji ltar bstsal ba 'di dag shin tu yid rangs shing yid la bcags par bgyid na/grogs po dam pa/ chos kyi spun ni tsos sangs rgyas 'dzin khyod kyis kyang sems shin tu brtse bas bslab par bya ba zhig bstsol bar rigs so sbos pas sangs rgyas 'dzin na re /gang zhig nyam pa gtan nas zad gyur cing / /yon tan ma lus ldan pa'i skyabs kyi phul/ ston mchog dam pa de la dus kun tu kha tsam min par snying nas skyabs su mchi/ /mkhas pa khyod ni chos kyi yin lugs shes/ /sgra dang don la 'khru'/ pa'i sgro 'dogs chod /de phyir bdag gi rmongs pa'i ngag 'di la/ /yid kyi mgu ba ji ltar ston par 'gyur/ / 'on kyang ni tso rang gi spyod tshul la/ bltas nas skyon gang mthong ba 'di dag rnams/ /mkhas la bshad pas thugs la 'bab par mdzod/ /dka'o dka'o dam pa'i lha chos dka'/ /bdag gi bya ba 'di dang dam pa'i chos/ nam mkha' dang ni sa gzhi'i bar las ring / /ston mchog dam pa thugs rje'i bdag nyid des/ /blang byar bstan rnams bdag gis dor bya ste/lhaḥ6/dor byar bstan rnams bdag gis blang byar gyur/ /rang gi spyod

tshul 'di la shin tu khrel /dkor mchog gsum dang las 'bras la sogs la/ /dad 'dun mi skye gal te skyes gyur kyang / /nyin re bzhin yang je chung je chung 'gro/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thos pas 'jigs mi 'gyur/ /gal te dang por 'jigs kyang phyis su ni/ /ji tsam mang du thos pa de tsam du phyi phyir 'khor ba'i phun tshogs don gnyer skye/ kye ma rgya mtsho'i 'thing gi rde'u dag /ji tsam 'i cho dbus bcug kyang mi sbong ltar/ /bdag gi rgyud 'di chos la ma 'dris pa/ /de tsam chos las phyi rol gyur pa mthong / /bshes gnyen zla bas ji ltar bka' bstsa la ltar/ /nyon mongs 'di ni bdag gi dgra yi gtso/ /'di las gnod 'tshe che gzhan ma mchis kyang /bdag gi bya ba thams cad 'di yi grogs/ /shes pa thams cad 'di yi dpung du gyur/ /bdag ni bdag nyid gcig pur nyam chung zhing / ma rung 'di yis shin tu bcings par gyur/ /dka'o dka'o dam pa'i lha chos dka'/ /shes rab med na dam pa'i lha chos dka'/ /lam dang lam min tshul la shin tu rmongs/ gnad bkag khyad par mi byed thabs mi mkhas/ /ji ltarabastan kyang myur du yid bton nas /rog pa'i ston pas bslu bar 'gyur bas dka' /dka'o dka'o dam pa'i chos 'di dka'/ /dranashes dman na dam pa'i lha chos dka'/ /mang du dka' ba spyad par rlom gyur kyang / /nyes lhung rkun pos dge rtsa kun 'phrog ste/ /'jig rten pa rol then mor 'gro bas dka'/ /dka'o dka'o dam ༵/ 7lha

chos dka'/ /brtson grus dman na dam pa'i lha chos dka'/ /le lo'i dbang gis phyi bshol ngang du ni/ /'chi bdag bdud kyis myur du ga'ajoms gyur cing /gal te yun ring lon kyang de dbang gis/ /'bras bu cung zad tsam yang rnyed pa dka'/ /dka'o dka'o dam pa'i lha chos dka'/ /rang dbang med na dam pa'i lha chos dka'/ /mi dge'i bshes gnyen sdig tshogrogs dbang song rnams/ /mi 'dod bzhin dusdig pa'i las la sbyor/ /rgyal po'am pha ma soṭa kyi dbang bsod rnams/ ji ltar byas kyang dam chos byed par dka'/ /dka'o dka'o dam pa'i lha chos dka'/ /bsod nams dman na dam pa'i lha chos dka'/ /mthun rkyen tshang tshe blo yid chos 'gro dka'/ /chos spyod 'dod tshe mthun pa'i rkyen mi 'byor/ /'gal rkyen rnam pa du mas kun tu mnar/ /des na dang po'i pas can bdag lta bu/ dam pa'i chos 'di shin tu dka' bar gyur/ /'on kyang dka' ba'i tshad rnams rig byas te/ /dka' nang mi dka' blo yi ngo bor te/ /dngos lam min zhing 'gyur med mi gnas par/ /goms na sla ba rten 'brel chos nyid yin/ /'di lta'i mgon dang 'phrad par gyur dus 'dir/ /ska yang gzhan du mi byed sangs rgyas 'dzin/ /rang gis rang la rtag tu skyon rtog byed/ /'di ni sangs rgyas 'dzin gyi chos lugs lags/ zhes gsungs pas kyang shin tu mos pa thob bo/ der zla bas slob dpon sangs rgyas 'dī/ snyedang / pazlo ta da na smri tiḥsogs la/ bla ma dri med dpal

ldan lha ba sras kyi gsung dang / rang gis ji ltar dran pa ltar dang bla ma dri med dpal ldan dang rad nyid gnyis de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srung gi bstan pa la/ dge slong dri med 'od dang / dge slong gser mdog can du gyur pa'i skye sa rabs dang / rang dang la gā rmā na gnyis bram ze'i khyi'u rig byed brten dang / blo brtan gnyis su gyur pa dang / de yang sngon 'jig rten chags nas ring por ma lon pa'i tshe/ rang dang rgyal po rigs ldan gnyis glang chen stag sna dang /seng ge 'jigs su rung bar skyes pa dang / de'i 'og tu rang dang btsun mo gser bzang ma gnyis bung ba'i rgyal po sgra ldan dang / /bung ba'i btsun mo g.yu sgra ga nyis su gyur pa dang / yang rang dang stong dpon yam she gnyis glang spyod ston pa skar ma'i rgyal po dang / gdol pa'i khyi'u ma na gar gyur pa dang / rang nyid blon po pa snar skyes pa'i tshul rnams gsungs pa'i rim pa ltar bshes gnyen dam pa'i bka' bcag pa'i nyes dmigs dang / phrag dog gi nyes dmigs dang / zhe ldang gi nyes dmigs dang / nor rdzas longs spyod la chags pa'i nyes dmigs dang / bshes gnyen ngan pas bslus te lta ba log par spyod pa'i nyes dmigs dang / tshul zernga/sa srung ba'i phan yon rnams bsten te/ re zhig yi ge mang bas 'jigs te 'dir ma bkod do/ /de nas nga ta dha na sgri ti grong khye ri rtswa can dang nye ba'i dben par song ngo /rang gi 'dul bya rnams la tshigs bcad glu dbyangs su bsdebs ༵ ༵

mtsho lta bu'i nang nas/ blo dman gyi go bad zhing / deng dus nye bar mkho ba 'ag zhig smras pa'i skabs te bdun pa'o/ / / /de nas de'i che rgya gar nub phyogs su chos kyi blon po ye shes 'dzin kyang / sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rang gi yi dam gyi lhas rngu/la te/ /grogs dharma tā dang gru la po gtum spyod la sogs pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa wa ra ṇa sir myur du phebs te/ dang por chos blon blo gros rab bzang dang 'phrad nas chos blon gyis kyang ye shes 'dzin yin par ngo ma shes par su yin zhes gtam dris pas/sbos pa/ /nu ba phyogs kha che'i rgyal khams che nas yong / /rigs ldan rgyal po'i khrims phog nag can yin/ /slar yang rigs ldan rgyal po'i rgyal khab 'dir/ /sngon gyi las dbang btsan pas mchis par gyur/zhes gsungs pas/ sngon gyi blon po ye shes 'dzin yin par shes te/rab tu dga' nas gtam lan tsam yang ma mjal bar/ rigs ldan rgyal po'i drung du song nas zhus pa/ rgyal po yang myur du sgo drung du bsu bar phebs te/ ye shes 'dzin gyi mgul nas 'khyud de/ smras pa/ kye ma bsam pa bzang po'i chos kyi blon/ /bdag la phan par 'dod pa'i bka' drin can/ /snying stobs rab tu che ba'i mkhas khyod kyis/ /phan par sgrub la bdag gis /nod par go/ /'phags ma yum dang sras kyi bka' bcag nas/ /stong dpon yam she'i phra ma rdzun dzig nyan/ /nyes pa me/ sdur khyed rnams chaganas nas bskrad/ /kye ma bdag gi bya ba zhin tu

ngan/ /de ring bzad par mdzod cis blo ldan mchog /da ni 3rgyad pa drag pos snying la zi /slan chad khyod ni bdag gi bla mar bkur/ zhes smras pa dang / ye shes 'dzin gyis / e ma gson dang rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal/ /khyod ni bya'i chub sem / mnga' 'bangs kyi mgon/ /yab mes gong ma'i rjes jungan blo grong can/ /rmad byung mdzad pa bzang la su yis sto na/ 'on kyang rang gi 〉ca gyi las dbang ge /wa ra ṇa si'i gnas nas bskrad gyur kyang / /'phags ma blo gros chen mo'i bka' drin las/ /dri med bla ma sangasargyas yab sras dang / /gsang ba'i bdag po dngos gyur chos rgyal cha jal/ /dam chos bdud rtsi ju+oms pa med par myong / /rtse gcig bsgrubs ngas las rjes bzang po rnyed/ /de yang khyod kyis bskrad pa'i drin yin phyir/ /khyod ni bdag gi dge bshes bzang po lags/ /rje yi 'bangarig la bzod par gsol ba ni/ /rnam pa kun tu srid par dka' na yang / /rmad byung rgyal po khyod kyis 'gyod bshags mdzad/ /ya mtshan che'o rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal/ /bzod par gyur pa smos kyang ci zhig dgog zhes smras pas rgyal po rab tu ngagyes tso/ lha tā la yang sngar ltar bzod gsil byas pa/ da dung sngon gyi ma rangs pa cung zad ma zhi nas bas pa/ kye ma gson dang chos kyi rgyal /ya mtshan gzigs mo gzigs lags sam/ /sngon tshe nged rnams bskrad pa'i tshe/ tshig tu gas la ba dran 'gas som/ /blo ldan ngan pas dor gyur nas/ re zhig sdug bsngal myong gyur kyang / /nam zhig pham par mi 'argyu~X ṭ+wāṃ/ /

bsam bzang ka na mchis kyang sla zhes sogs smras te/ gleng slongaba'i skabs tshar ba dang / pho brang du phebs te/ sras rgyal po dang mjal bas/ sras rgyal pos sngon gyi byi'u sogs kyi lung bstan pa dang / rang nyid kyi sngon gyi bag chags kyi dbang gis/ ye shes 'dzin mjal ma thag tu yin rab chi dad de phyag byas shing ye shes 'dzin gyis kyang rgyal bu la phyag byas te/ rgyal pos ye shes 'dzin dar gzab dang rat+na'i khrir bzhugs su gsol te/ gsol ba btab pa/ ma rig mun pa kun sel ba'i/ ye shes sgron me rab tu gsal /ma lus rgyal ba sras bcas kyi/ /mtha' yas chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa/ /bshes gnyen dam pa khyod la 'dud/ /sna tshogs 'gro ba 'dul slad du/ /blon po'i tshul du rab bstan te /rgyal khrims phog pa'i tshul kyang mdzad /'gro 'dren snang ba mtha' mas dngos/ /dri med bla ma'i spyan sngar gshegs/ /brtson pas sgrub pa snying por mdzad /sgrub pa mthar son slar yang ni/ bdag cag don du 'dir gshegs pa/ /e ma khyod ni ngo mtshar che/ /da ni bdagacag mgon du khyod/ /'dir bzhugs chos kyi bdud rtsi stsol zhes zhus pas/ ye shes 'dzin gyis/ sngon gyi rgyal bu chos kyi dga' ba min pa sogs ji ltar ba bzhin/ bla ma chen po dang rgyal po ma sho ka chen po la sogs pas lung bstan pa'i stobs dang / rang nyid kyis kyang mkhyen mod kyang / re zhig yab rgyal po la sogs pa la gsang ba'i slad du ma mardo/ ༵ ltar mdzad de smras pa/ e ma rgyal ba'i sras po snying stobs

can/ /'phags ma sgrol ma'i sras gcig dge 'dun 'bangs de ring mjal ba skal bzang ngo mtshar che/ /'phags ma yul gyi lung bstan ji bzhin du/ /khyod kyi sku la blon pos bar chang byas/ /wa ra ṇa sir sdug bsngal mun pas khyab/ /yab rje rigs ldan mya ngan gdung pas zin/ /'on kyang slar yang khyod kyi snying stobs kyis /wa ra ṇa si'i 'bangs cas mgon du byon/ /las ngan blon po'i bar chad brtsam pa'i tshe/ /rgyal bu'i thugs yid ngal bar ma gyur tam/ /bdag cag bsam pa bzang ba'i blon po gsum/ /yum zas thuṭa rje can gyi bka' drin las/ dri med pad+ma bla ma sangs rgyas mjal /gsung gi gad sa pa bsgrubs pas 'bras bu rnyed/ /rnyi tshe yi dus byas bdag cag gnyis/ /slar yang yab sras mjal phyir gnas 'dir lhags/ /da ni yab sras bka' bzhin sgrub par 'tshal zhes pa la sogs pa dang / chos kyi gleng slong ba dpag tu med par mdzad do/ nub mo yab rgyal po sogs ma bzhugs pa'i tshe/ ye shes 'dzin dang sras rgyal po gnyis lhan cig tu bzhugs te/ sras rgyal pos rjon ji ltar gyur pa'i smyo rgyus thams cad dang / rgyal bu chos kyi dga' ba da lta bya'i rnam par bzhugs yod pa sogs ji ltar ba bzhin du zhus so der zla ba 'ga' zhig gi bar du yeshes 'dzin gyis rgyal po yab sras la sogs pa la rang nyid kyis ji ltar rtogs pa'i chos bshad cing bzhugs so/ de dag gi tshe yang / yab rgyal po ni/ gong du 'byung ba ltar rang gi rmi lam dang /sdu/ kyi

gsung las la ga a na'i rnam shes ma gnas par rtogs kyang / sngon gyi rgyal bu chos kyi da ga' ba dngos yin min the tshom yod cing / nges legs sogs btsun mo 'ga' zhig dang nang blon gyi gtso bo 'ga' zhig gis ni/ sngon du rgyal bu la bar chad byung nas/ la gā a nas grong 'jug byas pa dang / slar rgyal bu cho sa kyi dga' ba nyid kyis grong 'jug mdzad pa yin snyam pa tsam yod la/ nang blon phal cher dang gyi blon rnams dang / 'bangs dang bcas pas rgyal po'i mdzad spyod bzang ngan gyi 'gyur zlog yin snyam pa las grong 'jug byas pa sogs cung zad tsam yang mi shes so/ de nas ye shes 'dzin dang / sras rgyal po gnyis kyis bya mgrin sngon zla ba btsal ba la gshegasapar bgros te/ chas pa la nye ba'i skabs/ zla ba la yang yi dam lhas wa ra ṇa mir song zhig ces bskul ba la brten nas/ 'khor gzhan rnams bzhagagrogs po sangs rgyas 'dzin khrid de/ wa ra ṇa si'i rgyal khab tu phebs te mun pa sros kyi bar du rgyal po'i bla shing gi rtser bya'i skad 'don zhing brdzus te bzhugs/ mtshan mo pho brang gi bya 'dabs kyi 'og tu yib ste bzhugs/ nam langs pa na/ ye shes 'dzin dang sras rgyal po bzhugs pa'i o dkar nas 'dzul te nang du phebs pas sras rgyal pos mthong nas shes te phyag byas pas/ ye shes 'dzin gyis kyang mkhyen te phyag mdzad ba / zla ba'i zhal nas/ gang la skyabs su gsol bas ba/ 3/da pa/ /rin chen gsum la snying nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /kye ma chos

kyi blon po ye shes 'dzin/ /nub phyogs shul thag ring por gshegs pa'i tshe/ /sku la nyon mongs gdung ba ma myong ngam/ yid la mya ngan zug rngu ma skyes sam/ /dri med bla ma'i zhal bzang mjal lags sam/ /da dung gson dang kho bo'i snying gi bu/ 'phags ma'i gsung gis ji ltar lung bstan bzhin/ /'phags ma 'jig rten 'di nas gzhan du gshegs/ dge 'dun 'bangs nga mgon med gcig pur lus/ /de tshe blo ngan blon pos kho bo bslus/ /nags khrod 'brog dgon sta ga por rab tu 'khyams/ 'on kyang bslu med dkon mchog rnam gsum dang / /'phags ma blo gros chen mo'i mthu nyid kyis/ /dri med bla ma yab sras dngos dang mjal/ /thos par dka' ba'i gsung gi bdud rtsi thos/ yang gcig bdag gi las dang yab sras mthus/ /thun rmongs dud 'gro byas kyang dam chos go/ /da lha'i bar du naṭa khrod stug por mchis/ /kye ma de ring gnas 'dir lhan cig 'dzoms/ /bslu med rten 'brel ya mtshan shin tu che/ /bdag gi grogs po byang chub sems dpa' mchoga'agro ba'i don mdzad rgyal po khyod nyid kyang / /rgyal srid gnas 'dir skyo bar ma gyur tam/ zhes gsung pa / ye shes 'dzin 'khor ba'i gnas tshul rig cing grub pa'i go 'phang brnyes kyang sngon rgyal bu chos kyi /dga' ba dang ha cang blo mthun pa'i stobs kyis/ der bya'i rnam pa can/ lus chung zhing spu'i dra bas khebs pa de mthong bas yid lhag par 'byung ste/ phyag gnyis kyis zla ba pang du blangs nas spya/3 /ba

bsol zhing smras pa/ /kye bslu med dkon mchog rin chen gsum/ /sku gcig bsdus bla ma chen po rje/ /dpal dri med pad+ma badz+ra la/ snying rus pa 'i gting nas skyabs su mchi/ /'khor ba'i gnas 'di'i snang tshul la/ /skyo shal tshig tsam min par skye sa/ /zhen pa snying gi dkyil nas chod/ /rgyab/ pu chos kyi dga' ba zhes/ /rgyal bu'i lus la lha yi gzuṭa/de ring nyam chung 'dab chags lus/ /mdog sngo spu yi dra bas khebs/ ma mngon sum 'di ltar mthong / /dngos rnam sa 'di dag thams cad kun/ /bden par 'dzin pa'i rang cha tshang rig /thams cad sgro ma lta bur go/ /kye sngon gyi smon lam mthu stobs kyis/ /sku 'dab chags bya yi lus gyur kyang / /dus de reng gsungs dbyang dngos su thos/ /nged bsam pa bar nga po'i blon po gsum/ yab rgyal po'i khrems kyis mthar spyag kyang / /khyod yum sras gnyis kyi thuṭa rje las/ /nub kha che dzalasdo ra mu/ /dpal gsang bdag rgyal po'i skur bstan pa/ /rje chos rgyal ma zho ka dang mjal/ /mgon rgyal po de yi bka' dri na las/ /dri med ma sangs rgyas mjal/ /gdams ngag zab mo'i bdud rtsi thos// /sgrub pa'i tshad rdzogs catha' ru 'khyol/ /bslu med dkon ma chog rnam gsum dang / yum sra4 ske ga nyi sa kyi ca/thu stobs kyis/ /lus la gdung ba ma thob cing / /sems la mya ngan ma 'tshal lags/ zhes 7 sa te/ zla ba spyi bo'i steng du bzhag go/ de nas sras rgyal pos zla ba dang / slob tshodapas rdo ngas rgyas 'dzin gnyis 'a thal chu tre sbyar spyo smras pa/ bslu med

rngu kun 'dus pa'i sku/ /bdag sge/ bshes gnyen bu yo gdug // /zla ba yab sras la phyag k+ṣ-i tshal/ /kho bo rgyal ngo/ 'od ldan yang / / 6ba sras gnyis kyi bka' drin las/ /dge la cung zad rab 'dun cing g.yeng byung bya ba rab tu myong / 'khor ba'i bde la chags gyur pa'i/ /skye bo phal ji tha smon 'i yul/ /thob na dmya'/ ba dang 'dra ba/ /rtagatu sdug bsngal myong 'gyur ba'i /rgyal pyid bab hūṃ rī na ji ra kur/'on kyang kho bo skal ba bzang skyi /bshes gnyesna de'i/ ju/ zung dang ci /blon chen dam pa ye sheng 'angan/ /khyed rnam bdab d+ngha cing ni du gyur/ /zhes smras pas/ ni tso sangs rgyas 'dzin na re/ de ring ngo mtshar ltad mo mthong / /sngon gyi rgyal bu dam pa de/ /de ring 3dab chag sa khu byug lus/ /sngon gyi blon chen dam pa de/ /de ring dus su dzo zhi'i gzugs/ /ka la spang ka 'od ldan de/ /de ring rgyal po'i rnam par gyur/ /ye ma ngo mtshar shin tu che/ /rgyal bu chos kyi dga' ba yi/ /nye bar blangs pa'i gzugs phung 'di/ /tshong 'dus mgro na po'i gnas khang 'dra/ /dang porachos kyi dga' ba'i gzugs/ /bar du la ga ā na'i ba/nas/ da lta grogs po 'od ldan te/ /khu khrag bcig las grub gyur cing / /skye 95 chis 'phos par ma gyur kyang / /ga thubang phung ba/cig la rim bzhin du/ /gang zag ba/ ༄ ma gyis bdag sa/ra bzu pa / /kye ma bden med mkhyen lags sam/ /'di yis kho yo ji chi rtsa tshan gyur/ / / /ra bar yid bte med par go/ /zag bcas thug bsngal rang bzhin rtogs/ /chor+sā shu ///na

par med par go/ zhes sbos pas/ ye shes 'dzin zhin ཿ ngo mtshar zhing thugs ches so/ der zla ba'i zhal nas/ kho bo mab rigs ldan rgyal po yang mjal bar 'dod cing / /blon po dharma sogs dang 'phrad par 'dod pas spyan drongs shig gsungs pa ltar/ spyan drang pa'i tshe/sras rgyal po 'od ldan gyi zhal nas/ kyi lha mkhyen par mdzod cigasngon khyad kyi sras chos kyi dga' ba de ni khu byug 'di yin no/ zhe smras pas/ rgyal po yid ches par the tshom du gyur pa'i tshe/ zla ba zhal nas/ e ma yab rje chos kyi rgyal/ /dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyi 'bangs/ khyod kyi bdag nyid mi mkhyen nam/ nga ni khyod kyi zas gcig phu/ chos kyi dga' ba dge 'dun 'bangs/ /sngon che ma shā dza la'i 'gram/ /nags tshal bzang por skyo ngas tshe/ /grogs po'i 'phrul gyis grong 'jug gis/ /'di 'dra'i dud 'gro'i gzugs su gyur/ /'on kyang da lta /shod kyi sras/ /wa ra ṇa si'i rgyal po 'di/ /sprul pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /khyod kyi thug bsngal sel ba'i phyir/ /blon po'i rnam shes 'pho mdzad nas/ /gzugs phung 'di la zhugs pa yin/ /dgongs sam rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal/ zhes smras pa'i tshe/ rgyal cu bya'i gzugs nyam chung ngur gyur pa de mthong zhing / sngon gyi rgyal bu'i yon tan dran jigs yid rab tu gdungs te brgyal bar gyur to/ der brgyal sangs pa'i thabs byas pas brgyal las sangs nas ngu 'bod kyi ༵༵nga ba drag pos zla ba phyag tu blangs nas dpral bar gtugs nas

smras nga/ kye ma kye hud las ngan rgyal ngo zung skyi /brtsa chu nga bla ma nga bya ba ngan la zhugs/ /'phags pa'i bka bcab/ blog po'i ngag la nyan/ /ma rung sdig can khyod kyi 'khor du ba skos /da ni 9 gyod pa drag pos snying la zin/ /nga yi snying gi ze'u 'bru nir tre zu ca pe /ṣ+ṭa pa'i mingoms rgyal bu dam pa de/ /shin tu nya ga chung du ne+e ciX'i skuzab/sa su gyur/ /'di mthornga kho po'i kā/nga ni rga/sa la thu ri /pho bra — me da cing 'khor med btsun mo med/ /longs spyod med cing na bza' ma mchis par/ /nags khrod stug por bzhugs pa de yi tshe/ /lha sra /zu+od kyi thugs la ci zhi ga nas/ngas/ /khyod kyi de lta'i dza sha ba sngal la brten cing / /blo chung kho bo rgyal po'i pho brang du/ /mi ri ༄dod dgur long su spyod byed ji/ kye ma bdag ni shin tu tha chad de / /dud 'gro re dud 3gro mthar thug ma yin nam/ /'phags 3 blo pos chen pa sang du bzhugs/ /kye ma de ring smin lam ma yon nam/ zhe r+sha gyi sgyu dod pos shing ngus pas/ rgyal po'i thugs gso ba'i phyir du ba'i zhal nas/ kye gson dang blo lda na yab rje chos kyi rgyal/ /thu sa 4 nga na gsol 'a nga yicig 'di gson/ /khyod bcol chung bya rlag mang ba ma lag kyang / /'di kho bo'i sngon spu las kyi dbang gis yin/ /lus chung zhing mdo / nganabya yi gzuṭa gyar kuci / / yid blo dzen mi dang khyad par ma mchis pas/ /rten gang la brten bza dze ga bsnga la ma mchis so//lung bzang yang snying ponang zad mi ba na khu/ra/ /dgra nyon mongs rnams kyil bran dā bkoX 3/ra

te/ /sdig mi dge las ngan gsog par byed gyur na/ /rten bzang bas ci bya sdig stobs che ba'i rgyu/ /'khor 'du 'dzis dben pa'i sman ljongs nags khrod du/ /grogs chog shes ldan pa bya dang ri dgas la/ /chos skyo shas nges 'byung drag po bskyed cing bsgoms/ /gnas gang la brten kyang sdug bsngal ma mchis so /'khor drin dang shes bzhin rtag par bya ra mkhan /'khor brtson 'grub drag po dge la bskul bar bzang /'khor ting 'dzin brtan po log sgrub med cing skya nyan/ /'khor 'di la brten na 'khor rnams kun gyi mchog /phar rang bzhin bzang na tshur la brnyas par byed /phar sdang bar byas na rje la dgra ltar blta/ /rang 'dod don kun la bar gcod log sgrubs mkhan/ /mi skye ba ngan pa'i 'khor gzhan nga mi 'dod /lam ma rig mun pa sel ba'i lus bzang la/ /chos gnas lugs rig pa ye shes rgyan gyis mdzes/ /khyod bstan na zag med thar pa'i bde ba ster/ /nga dam pa'i btsun mo shes rab grogs dang 'grogs/ /dus dang por mthun pa'i 'dzum dkar bslu byin mkhan/ /yu / ring du 'dris tshe mi bsrun srin mo dngos /gang bsnye na pas nyon mangs dug lnga kun gyi gzhi/ /de btsu mo bzang po ma gegs mkhyen par mdzod/ /blo ngo tsha khrel yod ya rabs bzang po'i gos/ /'gro su la btags kyang rab mdzes tshul zems rgyad /rgyan btags pa tsam gyis mchod 'os thob pa'i rgyan/ /rgyan ba/rdo po 'di dag rnams la kho bo mos/ /khong yod na mi 'dod kun
